jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.excerpt: About Real GeeksReal Geeks is a leading real estate technology company helping agents and teams build their brands, generate leads, nurture relationships, and grow their businesses.
jobs.description:
About Real Geeks

Real Geeks is a leading real estate technology company helping agents and teams build their

brands, generate leads, nurture relationships, and grow their businesses.

Our integrated platform combines IDX websites, CRM, marketing automation, AI-powered tools,

and lead generation solutions to help real estate professionals build stronger, more sustainable

businesses.

We're a relatively small, fast-moving technology company with ambitious goals. We're looking

for a marketing leader who can help us sharpen our positioning, elevate our brand, and

accelerate growth.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to own and drive our marketing

strategy.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who knows how to turn great positioning into

compelling campaigns, brand awareness into demand, product innovation into customer

adoption, and marketing investments into measurable business results.

You'll lead a small team of marketing professionals and work closely with our Sales, Product,

and Training teams to ensure our messaging, campaigns, product launches, and customer

experience are aligned.

We don't need someone who simply manages marketing activities. We need a driver, a

changemaker, and a builder. Someone who challenges the status quo, brings fresh ideas, sets

a clear direction, and inspires others to execute.

You'll need to think strategically, act decisively, and be comfortable getting into the details. We're

a lean organization, and everyone — including our leaders — rolls up their sleeves when

needed.

What You'll Own

Marketing Strategy & Positioning

  • Develop and own a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives and revenue goals.
  • Define and sharpen our brand positioning, differentiation, value propositions, and messaging across key customer segments.
  • Translate market insights, customer needs, and competitive intelligence into clear marketing priorities.
  • Build integrated marketing plans that connect brand awareness, organic growth, demand generation, product marketing, and customer engagement.
  • Establish a consistent, compelling brand narrative across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.

Team Leadership & Execution

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of three marketing professionals, creating clarity around priorities, ownership, and expectations.
  • Build a focused, accountable, high-performing team that works collaboratively toward shared goals.
  • Create a culture of ownership, creativity, continuous improvement, and results.
  • Establish effective planning and execution processes so that every major initiative has a clear what, why, who, when, and definition of success.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly, manage resources effectively, and keep the team focused on the work that matters most.
  • Step in and execute when needed. This is a hands-on leadership role, not one for someone who prefers to delegate everything.

Budget Management, Data & Performance

  • Own the overall marketing budget, ensuring investments align with company strategy, priorities, and revenue objectives.
  • Define and own marketing KPIs, performance dashboards, and reporting.
  • Use data to guide strategy, prioritize investments, evaluate results, and continuously optimize performance.
  • Build a culture where decisions are grounded in customer insights, market evidence, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure initiatives begin with clear objectives, success metrics, owners, timelines, and execution plans.
  • Regularly assess what's working, what's not, and where to double down, adjust, or stop.

Organic Growth & Demand Generation

  • Balance long-term brand building with near-term lead generation and revenue opportunities.
  • Develop integrated campaigns across organic, paid, email, social, events, and other channels that support both new customer acquisition and existing customer engagement and expansion revenue.
  • Lead organic growth initiatives that expand Real Geeks' visibility, authority and market position, including content marketing, SEO/AEO/GEO strategy, social media, partnerships, and thought leadership.
  • Provide strategic direction and oversight for demand generation, empowering the Demand Generation Manager to own channel strategy, paid media allocation, and campaign optimization within agreed budgets and goals.
  • Ensure the Marketing and Sales teams are aligned on sales goals and underlying metrics, including demand gen spend, lead volume and conversion rates
  • Ensure the Sales team has a predictable pipeline of qualified leads that enable them to achieve or exceed sales targets.
  • Partner with the Sales team on strategies to improve conversion throughout the lead funnel.
  • Establish clear accountability for campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and marketing ROI.

Product Marketing & Launches

  • Own the marketing strategy for launching new products, features, and enhancements.
  • Ensure product innovation translates into clear, differentiated customer value and compelling reasons to choose Real Geeks.
  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Training to develop compelling positioning, messaging, and launch plans, and ensure consistency in messaging and tactics across internal and external channels.
  • Develop integrated launch campaigns to drive awareness, interest, and adoption of new and existing products among prospects and customers.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Expertise

  • Significant experience in B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS, technology, or a subscription-based business.
  • Proven success developing marketing strategies, positioning products, and building brand awareness in competitive markets.
  • Experience leading product marketing, go-to-market strategies, and successful product or feature launches.
  • Deep understanding of organic growth, content marketing, SEO, AI search trends, and modern demand generation.
  • Experience owning marketing budgets and managing investments against measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading small, high-performing marketing teams and managing cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between marketing, sales pipeline, customer acquisition, product adoption, and revenue.
  • Excellent analytical skills and experience using data, attribution, and performance metrics to inform decisions.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in real estate technology or the real estate industry is strongly preferred.

Leadership & Mindset

We're particularly interested in how you work, not just what you've done.

  • You're a driver. You create momentum, challenge assumptions, make decisions, and move things forward.
  • You're a strategic thinker. You see the big picture, understand the business, and connect marketing activities to meaningful outcomes.
  • You're a builder and a changemaker. You thrive on improving what's already there, introducing better ways of working, and creating something stronger.
  • You're collaborative. You build strong relationships across teams, welcome different perspectives, and know that great marketing doesn't happen in a silo.
  • You're scrappy and resourceful. You know how to make a big impact with a small team and limited resources.
  • You're hands-on. You're equally comfortable developing a strategy, reviewing campaign data, refining messaging, or jumping in to help execute.
  • You're data-obsessed. You ask questions, test assumptions, measure results, and make evidence-based decisions.
  • You're focused and organized. You don't confuse activity with progress. You bring structure, discipline, and accountability to execution.
  • You're an empowering leader. You set clear goals and guardrails, give your team ownership of their areas of expertise, and hold people accountable for outcomes without micromanaging.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Real Geeks has a clear, differentiated market position and a consistent, compelling brand story.
  • Brand awareness and organic visibility are growing among our target customers.
  • Marketing is generating an increasing volume of qualified inbound leads and contributing measurably to sales pipeline and revenue.
  • New products and features are launched effectively, with strong cross-functional alignment, growing awareness and interest, and measurable customer adoption.
  • Sales, Marketing, Product, and Training are closely aligned around messaging, priorities, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • The marketing team is focused, accountable, collaborative, and consistently delivering high-impact work.
  • Marketing investments are managed responsibly, with clear ownership of channel-level decisions and measurable returns.
  • Marketing decisions are guided by clear plans, meaningful metrics, and continuous learning.

What We Offer

  • The chance to make a meaningful impact in a company where your ideas, leadership, and execution will directly influence our success.
  • The opportunity to shape our marketing direction, build a stronger brand, bring innovative products to market, develop a talented team, and work closely with leaders across the business.
  • An enviable company culture, established customer base, and strong technology platform with significant growth potential.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where initiative and results matter.
  • Competitive executive compensation and benefits (including a generous ESPP through FNF)

jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer (MSP+WFH + Benefits)
jobs.excerpt: To apply, visit our website remotepro. ph/We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team.
jobs.description:
To apply, visit our website remotepro.ph/We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.

About the Role:

You're not here to close tickets faster. You're here to make sure the same problem doesn't come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You'll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You'll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.

.The Mindset We're Looking For

The best engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

  • They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: "How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?"
  • They take ownership. From the moment a problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's fully resolved, documented, and won't come back
  • They think upstream. Instead of asking "how do I fix this faster?" they ask "why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?"
  • They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for
  • They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to

Who Thrives Here

People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we've also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren't in conflict here.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that's not a problem — it's the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.

This Role Is Not for You If:

  • You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next
  • You fix the symptom and move on without asking why
  • You treat documentation as someone else's responsibility
  • You're comfortable letting a ticket sit without following through
  • Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus
  • You're looking for a stable, low-pressure remote job with a predictable routine

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.

Responsibilities:

  • What You'll Do
  • You'll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn't just to solve the problem in front of you — it's to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.
  • That looks like:
    • Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms
    • Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become incidents
    • Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely
    • Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery
    • Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes
    • Mentoring junior engineers so that when they come to you stuck, they leave sharper and more capable — not more dependent
    • Communicating clearly with clients and vendors — technical enough to be credible, human enough to build trust
    • Documenting everything you touch so clearly that others can build on it without asking you a single question

Requirements

    • 5+ years of IT experience, minimum 2 in an MSP or multi-client environment — you've seen enough environments to know what good looks like
    • Deep proficiency in Windows Server (2016–2022), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) — you don't need to look up the basics
    • Strong networking fundamentals — routing, switching, VLANs, firewall management (SonicWall, Fortinet, or Meraki); you can trace a problem through the stack
    • Solid Microsoft 365 and Azure experience (AZ-104 level or equivalent) — you know the platform well enough to administer, troubleshoot, and advise clients on it
    • PowerShell scripting proficiency — you write scripts that work, that others can read, and that solve real operational problems
    • Hands-on experience with RMM and PSA platforms (Datto, HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, or equivalent) — you know how to use your tools, not just log into them
    • VOIP support experience (3CX or similar) — you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise without escalating
    • Strong diagnostic skills — you find root causes, not just the closest available fix
    • Natural mentor — you make the engineers around you better without making them dependent on you
    • Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there
    • Honest communicator — you say what's happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn't good news
    • Long-term mindset — you want to grow with a company, not job-hop

How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)

We're honest about how we work with new team members.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand client environments, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their work, their tools, and their clients' environments.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.

What Success Looks Like

At three months: You've taken full ownership of your client environments. Escalations from junior engineers are getting cleaner answers — and fewer of them. You know where the gaps are and you've already started closing them.

At six months: Recurring issues in your client environments are measurably down — because you automated them away, not just resolved them faster. Your documentation and scripts are becoming what the team reaches for first.

At twelve months: Clients notice the quality difference. The "this issue again?" moments have dropped significantly. Junior engineers are visibly sharper from working with you. You've shaped how we operate — and RemotePro.ph is investing in your next step.

How We Work

We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.

Benefits

Permanent Work from Home

Competitive Salary

HMO

Mental health programs thru HMO

Maternity Assistance thru HMO (female employees)

Paid Vacation Leave

Technology Allowance

Internet Allowance

Weekly Payout

Career growth and advancement

Ingredion is a Fortune 500 provider of ingredient solutions that helps nourish, comfort, sustain, and delight people around the world. Ingredion’s wide range of ingredient solutions is strategically designed to address changing consumer trends and preferences. Our specialty portfolio includes starch-based texturizers, clean and simple ingredients, plant-based proteins, sugar reduction and specialty sweeteners, and food systems. Our innovative ingredient solutions are used by consumers in everyday products, from foods and beverages to paper and pharmaceuticals. And we do it all in a planet-friendly sustainable manner.

We bring the potential of people, nature, and technology together to make life better.

The Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst will lead high value projects related to Salesforce in an agile development environment, working with business stakeholders, technical staff, and partners to deliver solutions that improve sales and sales support productivity and effectiveness through automation, process improvement, user experience, and analytics. The Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst will evaluate enhancement requests from end users to determine need, feasibility, and offer recommendations to optimize platform functionality and gain consensus among key business stakeholders on harmonized functional requirements with suggested prioritization based on anticipated business impact.

To deliver these solutions, the ideal candidate will become an expert in Ingredion’s business environment, how Salesforce is currently being utilized, and how it can be continuously improved to align with and support business objectives, strategies, and processes. You will lead requirements-gathering sessions, develop product roadmap recommendations, contribute to planning and prioritizing the work to be done, and oversee testing and change management activities and other project work required to bring solutions to light. Ideally you are a diligent, hardworking individual who learns new functions and processes rapidly, and consistently delivers outstanding results.

Additionally, the right candidate will advance CRM analytics to provide actionable insights for Go-To-Market teams and the broader organization to optimize business decisions and identify growth opportunities. This role is well-versed in business process documentation and will be expected to maintain documentation of CRM processes.

The position reports directly to the Global CRM Manager working closely with the Global IT function and Regional CRM business leads and other stakeholders to support an integrated approach to Commercial Excellence.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Work with the business to identify opportunities for driving sales productivity and effectiveness through technology, data, and process improvement.
  • Manage the product roadmap, prioritization, release planning, and delivery of key features for the business processes and technologies you oversee.
  • Perform the Senior Business Analyst role in often complex technical projects, overseeing requirements gathering, research, testing, deployment, documentation, training, communication, and user enablement.
  • Manage, track, and ensure the timely resolution of risks, blockers, issues, and bugs.
  • Review, test, and measure business impact of CRM enhancements to ensure they are providing business value and delivering expected ROI. Develop test cases and user acceptance testing (UAT) plans. Develop best practices for and oversee business user acceptance testing.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases as well as relevant solutions and best practices in the marketplace, evaluating and implementing new features and solutions, as required.
  • Develop training materials and, in collaboration with Regional CRM Leads and Power Users, facilitate end user training sessions on the Salesforce.com application.
  • Measure and report on performance, achievements, and outcomes.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams that address strategic business issues involving CRM.
  • Partner with Salesforce and other partner vendor Customer Success management teams to drive engagement, adoption and utilization, and capability development.

This position is well-suited for you if you bring:

  • A passion for customers, demonstrated business acumen and digital first mindset
  • Experience managing and or implementing technology enabled end-to-end Customer Relationship Management and familiarity with Sales, Marketing and or Commercial processes
  • Understanding of the lead-to-cash processes, preferably within a B2B manufacturing environment
  • Process orientation with analytical skills to identify and tap improvement opportunities
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively and influence various levels of the organization across functions and or a variety of cultures/geographies
  • Attention to detail and ability to prioritize effectively within a fast-paced environment
  • Experience, working in a B2B environment and/or the manufacturing industry, preferably within the food, nutritional, specialty chemical industries or other relevant B2B environments

Qualified candidates will have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of increasing responsibility and impact in the areas of business analysis, product management, data analysis, system administration, solution architecture, or business intelligence
  • Salesforce certification is highly desired (e.g., Admin, Advanced Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant)
  • Deep Salesforce expertise, or translatable experience working with other CRM platforms, including system administration, user setup and maintenance, role hierarchy, profiles & permissions, security, page layouts, objects, fields, workflow, approval processes, formulas, queues, assignment rules, and data management
  • Experience with SAP or similar ERP system preferred
  • Experience in leading and managing complex projects with corresponding change management
  • Ability to drive results through collaboration, influence, relationship-building, and teamwork
  • Experience with software development methodologies, tools, and best practices
  • Strong quantitative analysis skills, including advanced knowledge of Excel
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and solve complex problems with focus on simplicity and scalability
  • Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision

jobs.description:
Ready to turn your engineering experience into leadership impact?

ServiceChannel is looking for an experienced Software Engineer and technical leader to help guide a globally distributed team building and evolving our SaaS platform.

  • Advancing the responsible use of AI across engineering

What you’ll bring:

  • Significant hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong C#/.NET and React/TypeScript expertise
  • SaaS and scalable architecture experience
  • Technical leadership, mentoring or engineering management experience
  • A desire to lead both technology and people

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Job Description:

Position Purpose

The Inventory Coordinator supports inventory and logistics operations by ensuring shipments, delivery milestones, and inventory transactions are recorded accurately and on time.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipment activity, maintaining accurate records in OTM and NetSuite, supporting inbound and outbound logistics processes, and helping ensure compliance with Nextracker’s procedures, Incoterms, title-transfer requirements, and audit controls.

The coordinator will work closely with Inventory, Logistics Operations, OTM support, internal business teams, and freight forwarders/3PL partners to resolve discrepancies, improve shipment visibility, and support timely IR/IF transactions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review shipments for missing, delayed, or incorrect OTM milestones.
  • Compare freight forwarder delivery records with OTM data.
  • Coordinate with Logistics Operations to obtain shipment schedules, pickup confirmations, delivery information, and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up with freight forwarders, in coordination with Logistics Operations, to ensure all required milestones are updated accurately and on time.
  • Coordinate with the OTM team to resolve system issues, missing milestones, and transaction exceptions.
  • Maintain an open-issue tracker and follow up through resolution.
  • Provide regular status updates and escalate overdue or high-risk issues.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end reconciliation activities.
  • Identify shipments that may impact inventory receipts, fulfillments, revenue transactions, payment processing, audit compliance, or delivery visibility.
  • Process inventory receipts and fulfillments in NetSuite in accordance with Incoterms, title-transfer, and risk-of-loss requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and timely inventory transaction records in NetSuite.
  • Validate shipment, ASN, receipt, and fulfillment data for completeness and accuracy.
  • Support SOX and other audit requirements by maintaining appropriate documentation and audit trails.
  • Collaborate with 3PL partners and internal teams to improve data accuracy, service levels, and operational performance.
  • Prepare and maintain Excel, Power BI, and other operational reports.
  • Support process improvements and other special projects assigned by management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Looking for 5+yrs experiences
  • Prior experience in logistics, inventory management, supply chain operations, or a related field is preferred but not required. Entry-level candidates who are eager to learn, highly detail-oriented, analytical, and strong problem-solvers are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data-reconciliation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with ERP and transportation management systems; NetSuite and OTM experience is preferred.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI and reporting tools is preferred.
  • Understanding of global logistics, 3PL operations, Incoterms, and title-transfer concepts is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with teams across different time zones.
  • Knowledge of logistics processes and continuous improvement practices.

Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. jobs.description:
Department:

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is Walker & Dunlop’s technology organization, bringing together product, design, engineering, data, infrastructure, information security, and operations to build, operate, and protect the technology that powers our business.

You will have the opportunity to apply modern technology and AI within one of the nation’s leading commercial real estate finance and advisory services firms. W&D’s market position, deep industry expertise, client relationships, and proprietary data provide a strong foundation for solving meaningful business problems, improving how we work and serve our clients, and creating new sources of competitive advantage.

Across WDTech, we combine business context with disciplined technology practices and a high standard for security, resilience, and quality. Teams have ownership of meaningful problems and collaborate across disciplines, make thoughtful decisions, and continuously improve the products, platforms, and capabilities that move W&D forward.

The Impact You Will Have

As the VP, Analytics, Data Science & AI Data Enablement at Walker & Dunlop (W&D), you will lead the company's Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Data Science functions while advancing how AI is used to analyze data and inform business decisions.

In this role, you will set the strategy for how W&D turns data into actionable insights, accelerates delivery, and expands access to trusted information across the organization. You will lead the development of modern analytics capabilities, establish consistent data definitions and governance standards, and enable business users and AI tools to access and interpret data reliably. By connecting analytics strategy with business priorities, you will help ensure that data-driven insights are timely, consistent, and accessible to the people and systems that depend on them.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Set the vision and develop a phased roadmap for business intelligence, analytics, data science, and AI-assisted analysis aligned with W&D's strategic priorities.
  • Establish an operating model for partnering with business lines to identify needs, prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and deliver high-value analytics solutions.
  • Define and maintain standards for analytical quality, key performance indicators (KPIs), business metrics, and reporting consistency across the organization.
  • Improve the speed and quality of analytics delivery by establishing performance targets, measuring results, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the development and delivery of business intelligence solutions, advanced analytics, and predictive models that support decision-making across capital markets, credit risk, servicing, sales, and other business functions.
  • Lead the modernization of reporting and analytics capabilities, transitioning legacy reporting to scalable, governed business intelligence solutions.
  • Enable business users to conduct AI-assisted analysis using governed data, with clear standards for accuracy, reliability, and appropriate use.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and AI Enablement teams to integrate data and analytics into business workflows, providing the datasets, metrics, and analytical capabilities needed to support implementation and measure results.
  • Establish practices for testing, validating, and monitoring analytical and machine learning models, while maintaining standards for data quality, governance, and access.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of shared business definitions, metrics, and semantic frameworks to ensure consistent interpretation of data across reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
  • Make trusted business context and data definitions accessible to analysts, business users, and AI tools to support consistent and reliable analytical results.
  • Partner with AI Enablement, Data Engineering, and Product leaders to maintain the data structures, knowledge resources, and retrieval approaches needed to support AI-assisted analysis.
  • Expand shared data definitions and analytical capabilities based on business priorities, established reporting needs, and evolving demand.
  • Lead, coach, and develop analytics and data science leaders and their teams, establishing hiring and development plans aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Provide technical direction and oversight by reviewing analytical models, queries, dashboards, and methodologies to ensure quality and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product leaders to maintain reliable shared datasets, establish service expectations, and support the data infrastructure required for analytics and AI applications.
  • Communicate analytics strategy, progress, performance, and business outcomes to executive leadership and key stakeholders in clear, actionable business terms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field required; master's degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, applied data science, or a related field, including at least 7 years of experience leading multiple teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing analytics strategies aligned with business priorities and measurable organizational outcomes.
  • Proven ability to improve analytics delivery, operational efficiency, and analytical quality.
  • Experience implementing machine learning models, predictive analytics, and AI-assisted analysis in production environments.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing analytics and data science teams.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, preferably AWS, and cloud analytical databases such as Amazon Redshift or Snowflake.
  • Experience in commercial real estate, financial services, or capital markets preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, machine learning, and data modeling, with the ability to evaluate analytical quality and provide technical direction.
  • Working knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau, as well as SQL and Python.
  • Practical understanding of modern AI analysis tools, their applications, and responsible practices for implementation and use.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, access controls, and analytical standards.
  • Understanding of semantic layers, metric definitions, and business context required to support consistent reporting and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable analytics initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts and technical trade-offs to executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • Strong leadership and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build partnerships, and collaborate across business functions.
  • Ability to balance long-term strategic planning with technical oversight, operational priorities, and timely execution.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a results-oriented approach and commitment to delivering measurable business value.
  • Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders

This position has an estimated base salary of $220,000 - $260,000 plus a discretionary bonus and stock compensation. An employment offer is based on the applicant’s relevant work experience, applicable knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data.



What We Offer 

  • The opportunity to join one of Fortune Magazine’s Great Places to Work winners

  • Comprehensive benefit options* that have earned Walker & Dunlop the gold level of the 2025 Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation™, some of which include:
    - Up to 83% subsidized medical payroll deductions

    promote health, engagement, and balance

﻿About Shore360:

﻿Shore360 is a 100% Australian-owned BP firm based in the Philippines, providing customized staffing and administrative support for international companies, handling recruitment, HR, IT, and office facilities so clients can focus on core business, offering transparent pricing, dedicated teams, and flexible setups.

﻿Position Summary

The E-commerce Development Specialist is responsible for developing, managing, optimizing, and continuously improving Ultra Football's online store to deliver an exceptional shopping experience for customers.

The role focuses on driving online sales, improving website functionality, enhancing customer engagement, and ensuring the effective presentation of products across the website. This position works closely with the merchandising, marketing, inventory, customer service, and IT teams to support the company's digital growth and commercial objectives.

For Ultra Football, the role should be particularly focused on the online football retail experience, including football jerseys, boots, training apparel, equipment, accessories, and other football-related products.

Key Responsibilities

1. Website Development & Management

  • Manage, maintain, and continuously improve the Ultra Football e-commerce website.
  • Ensure website functionality, navigation, product pages, and shopping cart features operate efficiently.
  • Identify website issues, coordinate technical fixes, and implement improvements to enhance user experience.
  • Work with developers and IT teams to implement new website features, integrations, and enhancements.
  • Ensure the website is mobile-responsive, user-friendly, secure, and optimized for performance.
  • Monitor website speed, functionality, accessibility, and overall customer experience.

2. Product & Content Management

  • Manage product listings, product descriptions, images, pricing, specifications, sizes, colours, and stock availability.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent product information across all online product categories.
  • Create and maintain product collections, landing pages, promotional banners, and featured product sections.
  • Coordinate product launches and updates for new football boots, jerseys, teamwear, apparel, and accessories.
  • Ensure product pages are optimized for search engines and customer conversion.
  • Collaborate with the merchandising and inventory teams to ensure product information and stock levels are accurate.

3. E-commerce Strategy & Sales Optimization

  • Develop and implement strategies to increase online sales, website traffic, and customer conversion rates.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer shopping journey and reduce cart abandonment.
  • Monitor sales performance and recommend initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.
  • Optimize product recommendations, cross-selling, upselling, and promotional campaigns.
  • Support seasonal campaigns, major football tournaments, new product releases, and exclusive product drops.
  • Develop strategies to maximize customer engagement and repeat purchases through Ultra Rewards and other loyalty initiatives.

4. SEO & Digital Marketing Support

  • Implement search engine optimization (SEO) strategies to improve organic website visibility.
  • Optimize product titles, descriptions, metadata, URLs, and website content.
  • Coordinate with the marketing team to execute digital campaigns, promotions, and product launches.
  • Ensure website content aligns with advertising campaigns, email marketing, and social media promotions.
  • Monitor website traffic, search rankings, and campaign performance using analytics tools.

5. Website Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Monitor and analyze e-commerce performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other reporting tools.
  • Prepare regular reports on:
    • Website traffic and visitor behavior.
    • Online sales and revenue performance.
    • Conversion rates.
    • Average order value (AOV).
    • Cart abandonment rates.
    • Product performance and best-selling items.
    • Customer acquisition and retention.
  • Identify trends, issues, and opportunities through data analysis.
  • Recommend data-driven improvements to increase website performance and sales.

6. E-commerce Operations & Integration

  • Coordinate with warehouse, inventory, customer service, and logistics teams to ensure smooth online order fulfillment.
  • Monitor product availability and inventory synchronization between online and physical stores.
  • Support online ordering, payment gateway, shipping, returns, and click-and-collect functionality.
  • Ensure a seamless integration between the website and relevant third-party applications and platforms.
  • Assist in troubleshooting order processing, payment, checkout, and website-related issues.
  • Ensure accurate implementation of website promotions, discount codes, and loyalty rewards.

7. Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Research emerging e-commerce technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Conduct regular website audits and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Perform A/B testing on website layouts, landing pages, product presentations, and checkout processes.
  • Recommend innovative features to enhance customer experience and increase sales.
  • Stay updated with e-commerce best practices, digital retail trends, and competitor activities.

Qualifications and Requirements

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field.

Work Experience

  • At least 2–4 years of experience in e-commerce management, website development, or digital commerce operations.
  • Experience managing an online retail store or e-commerce platform.
  • Experience in sports retail, fashion, footwear, or consumer goods is an advantage.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Shopify Plus, Magento, or WooCommerce.
  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
  • Understanding of SEO, website optimization, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Experience with product information management, inventory systems, and third-party integrations.
  • Knowledge of payment gateways, shipping integrations, and online checkout processes.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent project management and organizational abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.
  • Customer-focused and commercially driven mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Proactive, innovative, and adaptable to changing business needs.
  • Passion for football, sports retail, and digital commerce is highly desirable.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the E-commerce Development Specialist will be measured against the following:

Performance Area

Key Performance Indicator

  • Online Sales
  • Achievement of monthly and annual online sales targets
  • Conversion Rate
  • Improvement in website visitor-to-purchase conversion
  • Website Performance
  • Website uptime, speed, and functionality
  • Product Management
  • Accuracy and timely uploading of product listings
  • SEO Performance
  • Improvement in organic traffic and search rankings
  • Customer Experience
  • Reduction in cart abandonment and checkout issues
  • Average Order Value
  • Growth in average customer spending per transaction
  • Campaign Execution
  • Timely and accurate implementation of online promotions
  • Website Optimization
  • Successful implementation of website improvements
  • Reporting
  • Timely submission of accurate e-commerce performance reports

Key Working Relationships﻿﻿

The position will work closely with:

  • E-commerce and Digital Marketing Team
  • Merchandising and Buying Team
  • Inventory and Warehouse Operations
  • Retail Store Operations
  • Customer Service Team
  • IT and Web Development Team
  • Brand and Marketing Partners

ShoreXtra Perks﻿

  • Referral Incentives – Get rewarded for bringing top talent to the team via our referral program.
  • Statutory Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, and Solo Parent Leaves, Magna Carta for Women, OT, and Premium Pays

jobs.description:
A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY– GreenGen is tackling climate change for the world’s leading investors. As part of our team, you will work collaboratively across the company and directly with clients to build and facilitate strategies that reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions, advancing them towards a net-zero carbon world. Share your passion for solving the world’s most challenging issues at a place where you can effect real change that creates a more sustainable future – energize your career at GreenGen! Join our team of outstanding professionals who are focused on performance, thought leadership, innovation, and the power of ideas that come from a diverse and inclusive workforce where every employee believes in our mission and contributes to our success. GreenGen offers an opportunity to design and enhance a rewarding and fulfilling career. We are dedicated to growth creating the success of our employees through competitive base salary, incentives, education, and health and retirement benefits.

WHO WE ARE– Founded in 2011, GreenGen is an award-winning global leader assisting the world’s leading investors with executing net-zero carbon strategies to drive financial outcomes and decarbonize their assets. Our unique approach to integrating energy, capital markets, real estate, and technology helps us support our clients across diverse asset portfolios. We believe that investing in climate is profitable, and all team members have the responsibility to help our clients meet their sustainability goals while creating both financial and climate outcomes.

POSITION SCOPE– This is an entry-level position suited to a person with 0-2 years of relevant experience looking to gain access to the exciting energy efficiency/green industry. The Associate position is an integral role in our pre-assessment, solutions design, solutions implementation, and measurement and verification process. Training and support will be provided to build skills quickly in this exciting, growing, global industry; however, it is expected that the right person will take initiative to go above and beyond to learn the business.

Specific attention to detail is a vital characteristic of the position as Associates are held accountable for providing reports and documentation at the various stages of the project from design through solution implementation and measurement and verification, tracking utility rebate applications, and for communication within the team and to clients when necessary. As an Associate, you will be responsible for:

  • collection and analysis of utility bills and consumption data
  • responding to the team project managers and energy engineers’ requests for research and reporting
  • supporting the project and client needs

Tasks will include utility bill analysis, energy simulation modeling, utility rebate program analysis, ASHRAE Level I and II energy auditing, technology feasibility studies, cost-benefit analysis, building commissioning participation, report generation, energy efficiency research, and project development.

WHAT WE NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, sciences, or other relevant disciplines
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel including the use of pivot charts, mathematical functions, statistical functions, and regression analysis
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and PowerPoint
  • Understanding of major building components including HVAC, lighting, and building control systems
  • Basic understanding of building construction and structural design
  • Ability to identify and analyze energy savings opportunities and use Excel-based tools for generating cost and savings estimates for solutions in HVAC, lighting, building controls, and building envelope
  • Ability to read and analyze utility bills including an understanding of common rate structures, tariffs rates, and the ability to differentiate between ‘demand’ and ‘energy’ charges
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in team environment with minimal supervision

WHAT WE WANT

  • Familiarity with building energy modeling software (eQUEST, Trane TRACE 700, or other relevant modeling software)
  • Understanding of commercial-scale renewable energy and CHP systems, supply-side energy procurement strategies, and demand response
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of commercial energy efficiency rebate programs and rebate application processes

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES

  • Prepare assessment reports for commercial and light industrial facilities that outline key building operating metrics and operating procedures
  • Analyze utility bills and organize energy information into usable charts and graphs in Excel
  • Prepare presentations and marketing materials that show analysis, solution recommendations, and cost and savings estimates in a compelling and concise manner
  • Research new energy efficiency technologies, companies, and products
  • Conduct payback analysis on energy savings measures
  • Present analysis and solutions to multiple levels within client organizations
  • Manage custom and prescriptive rebate application process
  • Perform measurement and verification on solution performance including regression analysis
  • Management of large data sets
  • Travel approximately 5-10% of the time
  • Modifications to our existing Excel-based tools to suit new energy savings analysis needs
  • Perform other duties as assigned

LOCATION– Remote (United States)

GreenGen operates internationally, requiring regular travel; however, GreenGen’s corporate headquarters is located in Bethesda, MD. This position does not require relocation to Bethesda. West Coast preferred.

TRAVEL – Travel to client locations within the US, and possibly South America, Caribbean, and UK will be required for this role up to 15% - 20% of the time

BENEFITS

  • Medical/dental/vision
  • Mobile/data stipend
  • 25 days off per year to start (includes holiday, vacation, and sick leave) 
  • 401(k)
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Professional development allowance

SECURITY CLEARANCE– Applicants should have no background issues that may preclude eligibility for security clearance; preference given to applicants with current security clearance (not required)

WORK AUTHORIZATION – Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US without requiring visa sponsorship for employment

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As Principal Technical Product Manager – Aftermarket, you will own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the digital solutions that support the Service & Repair value streams in support of Avionics & Electric Power & Propulsion. You will represent the customer across the end-to-end repair lifecycle, from customer request, quotation and induction through repair execution, materials and shipment to invoicing. You will lead a portfolio of ERP and enterprise applications, together with Product Owners and technical teams, to deliver measurable improvements in turnaround time, cost, quality and customer experience.

You will be accountable for all aspects (strategy, roadmap, planning, delivery and support) of the end-to-end digital lifecycle of the Service & Repair and aftermarket product portfolio, and you will directly affect the organization's ability to meet its service, repair turnaround time, quality and cost objectives. You will have significant autonomy, and you will need a high level of strategic and operational judgment to balance competing business priorities and deliver results.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Product vision & strategy Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for the Service & Repair and Aftermarket product portfolio, aligned with Avionics & Electric Power & Propulsion Aftermarket business priorities.
  • End-to-end ownership Act as the technical IT owner for the full repair lifecycle: quotation, repair order induction, inspection and repair execution, materials and spare parts, shipment, invoicing and warranty.
  • Business partnership Partner with Aftermarket, Repair shops, Supply Chain, and Finance leaders to understand business problems, align IT investments and turn business outcomes into an enterprise-wide product roadmap.
  • Portfolio leadership Coordinate a portfolio of 10+ products that make up the aftermarket application suite, including ERP Oracle modules such as Service/Depot Repair, Order Management, Inventory and Procurement, plus integrated shop-floor, MRO and customer-facing applications.
  • Simplify & modernize Standardize and simplify the Service & Repair process across sites and D&S ERP Oracle instances, eliminate technical debt and customizations, and drive cost-out and modernization initiatives, including cloud and ERP transformation.
  • Data-driven decisions Define and track product KPIs (repair turnaround time, on-time delivery, quote cycle time, system availability, customer satisfaction) and use them to prioritize the roadmap and demonstrate value.
  • Delivery & risk Manage risks, scope changes, dependencies and non-standard events across multiple interdependent programs, and provide clear status reporting and communication to senior leadership.
  • Executive influence Influence executive-band stakeholders and shape strategy, resource allocation and policy for the area of responsibility.
  • Compliance by design Ensure solutions meet Aerospace quality, regulatory and compliance requirements, including traceability, airworthiness release documentation, export control, cybersecurity (CMMC, UK Cyber Essentials, etc.) and SOX.
  • Culture Build a culture of customer focus, Lean continuous improvement and high performance that drives innovation; navigate ambiguity and prioritize conflicting demands.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 10 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 13 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 15 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of overall professional experience, including at least 3 years in ERP product management, Service & Repair / MRO, or aftermarket solutions.
  • Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a US citizen.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Experience with Service & Repair / MRO, aftermarket or supply chain business processes.
  • Hands-on experience with an ERP platform supporting service, repair or order management processes (Oracle E-Business Suite / Oracle Fusion Cloud preferred; SAP considered).
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects.
  • Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

The base pay range for this position is $152,000- $202,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 12th, 2026.​

​

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​

GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.description:
About Object Edge:

Object Edge is an AI-native, forward-deployed engineering firm. It builds Hive, a company brain for revenue, embeds engineers to build agentic workflows on it, and provides management engineering to lead the change.

Award-winning eCommerce consultancy that delivers end-to-end design and development solutions centered around our client’s goals and customer needs.

Our teams unite curious, intellectual advisors across the globe who creatively solve business problems and produce measurable results.

About the Position:

Senior Data Engineering (Databricks)

What You’ll Do

• Be a technical leader in teams with minimal oversight and direction to deliver innovative

solutions on the Databricks Platform using core cloud data lakehouse methodologies,

tools, distributed processing engines, event streaming platforms, and other modern

data-related technologies.

• Be part of the Databricks Center of Excellence.

• Build the next generation of data platforms and work with some of the most forward-

thinking organizations in data and analytics.

• Work under the direction of a Solution Architect to help design and implement

components of our clients’ data platform solution.

• Participate in design sessions and be able to break down complex development tasks,

and complete development items on time.

• Contribute to various COE initiatives to develop Databricks solution accelerators and

bring an innovative mindset.

Location: Remote - United States

What You’ll Bring:

As a Senior Engineer in the Databricks practice, you will bring a curious mindset and a passion for

exploring innovative solutions to address our clients’ most pressing data challenges. You are a self-

starter who excels at breaking down complex problems and eagerly shares insights with your team

and the broader Builder community.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and implement data solutions using Databricks, with hands-on experience in

specific Databricks platform features such as Delta Lake, Uniform (Iceberg), Delta Live

Tables (Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines), and Unity Catalog.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and optimize data pipelines for both

batch and streaming data, ensuring data quality and efficiency.

• Stay updated with emerging technologies, the latest Databricks platform features, and

continuously improve your skills in Databricks and other relevant tools.

Experience You’ll Bring:

• Strong data engineering experience, with at least 2 years of hands-on data pipeline

design and development experience with Databricks, including specific platform

features like Delta Lake, Uniform (Iceberg), Delta Live Tables (Lakeflow Declarative

pipelines), and Unity Catalog.

• Proficiency in designing and building robust, scalable, YAML configuration-driven data

pipelines with batch, micro-batch, and streaming data ingestion and processing patterns

using tools like Auto Loader, demonstrating a strong understanding of modern data

engineering practices.Experienced in building complex job/workflow orchestration patterns

using either Databricks jobs/workflows or other orchestration tools like Airflow, dbt

etc.

• Exposure to building robust data quality, pipeline audit/observability solutions with

Databricks native features and/or other data quality tools/frameworks like Great

Expectations, Collibra, dbt, etc.

• Proficiency in Big Data Platforms: Apache Spark, Presto, Amazon EMR.

• Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses: Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Google

BigQuery.

• Strong programming skills using SQL, stored procedures, and object-oriented programming

languages (like Java, Python, PySpark, etc.).

• Familiarity with building DevOps, CI/CD pipelines using Databricks Asset Bundles with

automated validation and testing.

• Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform is a big plus.

• Familiarity with NoSQL Databases and Container Management Systems.

• Exposure to AI/ML tools (like MLflow), prompt engineering, and modern data and AI agentic

workflows.

• An ideal candidate will have Databricks Data Engineering Associate and/or Professional

certification completed with multiple Databricks project delivery experience.

Compensation:

Salary is commensurate with experience based on department and role.

Job Title: Strategy Director - OpenData

Job Location: Frankfurt, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is looking to hire a strategy leader to rebuild the data foundation for the life sciences industry with OpenData, our customer reference data product. We are looking for a strong data expert and leader who can navigate the convergence of sales, marketing, products, and services into a cohesive vision for the market. This position will be responsible for the long-term success of Veeva OpenData by working across teams to drive results.

What You'll Do

    • Evangelize the value of Veeva OpenData to transform the industry’s data foundation
    • Build relationships with executives responsible for data and analytics to drive key deals in partnership with sales teams
    • Define and own clear value proposition metrics for different customer segments
    • Take responsibility for customer success and run key projects that have strategic importance
    • Build customer relationships to share back the voice of the customer and support the Veeva OpenData product team
    • Provide research and analysis to support the creation of thought leadership and point-of-view reports, white papers, articles, blog posts, tweets, and presentations

Requirements

    • 5+ years professional experience with at least 3-5 years in technology or management consulting working or at a master data management software company
    • Deep expertise in life sciences with a core competency in data strategy or master data management
    • Strong ownership, drive, and independence
    • Strong communication skills with different audiences
    • Ability to build relationships with data, analytics, and business leaders
    • Good teamwork skills, especially with colleagues from other disciplines
    • Travel up to 50%

Nice to Have

    • Languages in addition to English

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Veeva charitable giving program
    • Health and wellness programs
    • Opportunity for rapid progression and personal growth

Compensation

    • Total compensation: 150,000 - 255,000 EUR

Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. jobs.excerpt: Overview• Tier One Technologies has an immediate need for a Test Automation Engineer to support our US Government client.
jobs.description:
Overview

  • Tier One Technologies has an immediate need for a Test Automation Engineer to support our US Government client.
  • This will be a 100% remote position.
  • SELECTED CANDIDATES WITHOUT REQUIRED CLEARANCE WILL BE SUBJECT TO A FEDERAL GOVERNMENT BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION TO RECEIVE IT.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of complex applications and services.
  • Define automation test strategy and plans for products, systems, components, and major modifications, aligned with enterprise goals and delivery timelines.
  • Design, implement, and maintain robust UI, API, and integration test automation frameworks and suites.
  • Create, document, execute, and analyze complex test scenarios, including edge cases and failure-mode coverage, and communicate results to stakeholders.
  • Participate in final system integration and validation activities to identify functional, performance, and reliability issues.
  • Establish and maintain internal quality control standards, including reliability and regression programs, test data management, and traceability where needed.
  • Ensure testing procedures comply with required industry or organizational standards (security, accessibility, performance, SDLC controls, etc., as applicable).
  • Identify chronic or systemic issues in test coverage, tooling, environments, or process; propose and implement measurable improvements.
  • Provide actionable feedback and recommendations for product and design changes based on test outcomes and defect trends.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to improve testability, observability, and defect prevention (shift-left quality).
  • Coordinate as needed with vendors or suppliers to support component-level test approaches, tooling, or test data requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership within the quality/testing domain through mentoring, best practices, and contributions to shared frameworks and standards.

Qualifications

  • A degree from an accredited College/University in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline is preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in software quality assurance/control, software development and/or related field.
  • Strong experience building automated tests using TypeScript/JavaScript (and/or Java or C#) for modern application stacks.
  • Hands-on expertise with front-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Angular, including component and UI testing.
  • Proficiency with modern testing tools and patterns (for example, Testing Library, UI automation approaches, API testing, contract testing, and reliable test design).
  • Experience testing backend services and microservices, including Spring Boot, and managing dependencies and builds using tools such as Maven.
  • Experience with container-based integration testing (for example, Test containers) and designing repeatable test environments.
  • Ability to design maintainable automation frameworks with sound engineering practices (clean code, modularity, version control, CI/CD integration).
  • Strong troubleshooting and defect isolation skills, with the ability to interpret test results and identify root causes across multiple layers (UI, API, data, environment).
  • Demonstrated ability to improve quality processes, define standards, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including translating findings into clear recommendations for engineering and product partners.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing workflows using tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, and Gemini Vertex AI to accelerate test creation, analysis, and triage while maintaining code quality and security expectations.
  • Prior experience with multiple defect tracking tools (e.g. Rational, Mercury) is a PLUS.
  • Strong analytical skills for test case design and result interpretation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be a US Citizen or have permanent residence status (Green Card).
  • Must be able to obtain Public Trust Clearance.
  • Must have lived in the United States for the past 5 years.
  • Cannot have more than 6 months travel outside the United States within the last 5 years. Military Service excluded.

Prenetics (NASDAQ: PRE) is a leading health sciences company with a focus on consumer health. The company went public on NASDAQ in 2022 and continues to pioneer innovative solutions in consumer health.

IM8 is our newest venture, a next-generation health and wellness brand co-founded with global icon David Beckham. Launched in 2024, IM8 has become one of the fastest-growing supplement brands in the world within just six months.

Role Overview

The Customer Experience Manager will lead IM8’s global frontline CX operation and play a key role in designing the next stage of our service model as we scale.

This role owns the Service Delivery pillar within Customer Experience — overseeing team performance, service quality, operational infrastructure, and frontline retention impact — while helping evolve what “premium wellness service” means at IM8.

We are looking for a leader who can both operate within structure and contribute to building it. Someone who sees CX not just as execution, but as a strategic lever for retention, loyalty, and long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Global Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a 10+ global team across multiple time zones (with planned expansion)

  • Establish performance standards, coaching frameworks, and career progression pathways

  • Build a high-accountability, high-development culture

  • Lead structured onboarding, training, and continuous development programs to elevate capability, consistency, and leadership readiness across the team.

  • Partner with BPO providers to maintain quality and operational alignment

  • Continuously assess and refine team structure as we scale

    • First Contact Resolution (FCR)

    • SLA adherence

    • Agent productivity

    • Messages per Ticket (MPT)

    • Escalation rates

  • Own and optimise the CX tech stack (e.g., Gorgias, Shopify, automation and AI tools), ensuring systems are configured to support efficiency, visibility, and scalable growth.

  • Evolve reporting frameworks and dashboards as the operation matures

  • Drive continuous improvement across workflows, tooling, and automation

  • Identify operational risks and proactively implement mitigation strategies

  • Collaborate on the development and refinement of scalable SOPs and playbooks

3. Retention & Commercial Impact

  • Partner with CX and key stakeholders to reduce churn and increase LTV

  • Translate frontline insights into actionable commercial recommendations

  • Support the development of proactive service and lifecycle engagement strategies

  • Ensure service interactions support broader retention and revenue objectives

  • Contribute to evolving how CX directly influences commercial outcomes

4. VIP & Premium Experience

  • Operationally support and optimise IM8’s VIP framework

  • Help define service standards for high-value members

  • Ensure differentiated handling where appropriate

  • Contribute ideas to elevate the premium member experience over time

5. Scalability & Infrastructure

  • Contribute to the design of a scalable global service model

  • Support workforce planning in line with growth forecasts

  • Ensure automation, AI, and tooling are leveraged effectively

  • Help evolve the operating model as complexity increases

The following represent core areas of accountability; specific targets will be agreed in alignment with company growth plans:

  • CSAT

  • SLA adherence

  • Agent productivity

  • Service-attributed churn reduction

  • Retention uplift from proactive initiatives

  • Team engagement and development metrics

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years in high-growth D2C, e-commerce, or subscription environments

  • 3+ years leading team leads or managers

  • Experience scaling frontline CX operations

  • Strong understanding of CX metrics and operational levers

  • Demonstrated ability to use data to drive improvement

  • Commercial awareness and understanding of retention economics

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Experience managing global teams across time zones

Preferred Experience

  • Subscription or wellness category exposure

  • Experience with AI-driven CX tools and automation

  • Exposure to VIP, loyalty, or premium service design

  • Advanced CX platform experience (e.g., Gorgias, Zendesk)

  • Leadership Competencies

  • High standards with balanced pragmatism

  • Strategic thinker with strong execution capability

  • Strong coaching and team development orientation

  • Builder mindset — comfortable evolving structure while operating within it

  • Comfortable operating in high-growth, fast-changing environments

Why This Matters

This role is not static.

As IM8 scales, so will the scope, complexity, and opportunity within Service Delivery. The successful candidate will play a key part in shaping how CX evolves over the next phase of growth.
