jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Program Lead, Enterprise Clinical Partnerships (ECP) Performance Management, is responsible for driving the success of Humana's portfolio of enterprise clinical partnerships through strategic oversight, performance management, operational governance, and cross-functional collaboration.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Program Lead, Enterprise Clinical Partnerships (ECP) Performance Management, is responsible for driving the success of Humana's portfolio of enterprise clinical partnerships through strategic oversight, performance management, operational governance, and cross-functional collaboration. This role serves as a key connector between internal business partners and external clinical vendors to ensure programs deliver measurable value for members, providers, and Humana.

The Stars Vendor Performance Lead will lead performance improvement initiatives, develop executive insights and recommendations, drive accountability across stakeholders, and enhance Humana's performance management capabilities through data-driven decision-making and operational excellence. This individual must be comfortable operating in ambiguity, influencing across a highly matrixed organization, and translating complex data into actionable strategies. A strong understanding of Medicare Advantage quality performance, Stars, HEDIS measures, and population health outcomes is critical to ensuring clinical partnerships contribute to enterprise quality goals and member outcomes.

The Enterprise Clinical Partnerships Performance Management team is responsible for evaluating, monitoring, and improving the performance of Humana's specialty and clinical vendor partnerships. The Program Lead works across Clinical Strategy, Quality, Market Operations, Analytics, Care Management, Product, Finance, Network, and Vendor Management teams to drive outcomes, optimize performance, and support enterprise objectives.

This role combines strategic thinking, operational leadership, analytics, and stakeholder management to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and advance Humana's value-based care strategy. The Program Lead develops performance frameworks, facilitates governance processes, and delivers actionable recommendations to senior leadership while ensuring vendor initiatives align with Stars, HEDIS, quality improvement, and member experience priorities.

In This Role You Will

  • Lead performance management activities across a portfolio of Enterprise Clinical Partnership programs and vendors.
  • Develop and maintain program health scorecards, performance dashboards, executive reporting, and business reviews.
  • Analyze clinical, operational, financial, enrollment, engagement, Stars, HEDIS, and quality performance metrics to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to define improvement initiatives, action plans, and measurable outcomes tied to quality and performance objectives.
  • Facilitate vendor performance reviews, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and governance meetings.
  • Identify opportunities for partnerships to improve quality outcomes, care gap closure, preventive care compliance, medication adherence, member experience, and population health performance.
  • Translate complex performance challenges into structured analyses, actionable recommendations, and operational solutions.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve program performance, operational effectiveness, member outcomes, and quality results.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations, business cases, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.

Ciklum is looking for an Expert Logic Design Engineer to join our team full-time in the Czech Republic.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

We are looking for an Expert Logic Design Engineer to take a leading technical role in the architecture, design, and optimization of next-generation FPGA and ASIC-based control platforms.

This position involves solving challenging digital design problems with extremely demanding timing, latency, and performance requirements. You will work closely with system architects, verification engineers, software developers, and hardware specialists, driving technical decisions and contributing to the development of proprietary digital IP.

Our client is an innovative technology company developing advanced control and measurement systems for quantum computing. Its hardware and software platforms enable precise, real-time control of complex quantum systems, supporting the evolution of quantum computing from individual qubits to large-scale architectures.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, microarchitecture, and RTL implementation of complex, high-performance FPGA/ASIC digital subsystems
  • Design and optimize highly configurable, ultra-low-latency digital logic using SystemVerilog
  • Drive end-to-end digital IP development, from system requirements and architectural trade-offs to RTL implementation and integration
  • Make architectural decisions to optimize timing performance, latency, resource utilization, scalability, and power efficiency
  • Address complex timing closure, clock-domain crossing, synchronization, and critical-path optimization challenges
  • Develop advanced digital processing and control architectures, including signal processing pipelines, waveform generation, and deterministic real-time control
  • Define hardware-software interfaces and collaborate with software and system architecture teams to ensure efficient system integration
  • Work closely with verification engineers to define verification strategies and ensure robust functional coverage
  • Review RTL designs, identify architectural and implementation risks, and provide technical guidance to other engineers
  • Contribute to the evolution of FPGA-based platforms and the development of reusable digital IP for future ASIC implementations
  • Drive engineering best practices, design quality, and technical improvements across the development lifecycle

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of professional experience in complex FPGA or ASIC digital logic design
  • Expert-level proficiency in SystemVerilog RTL design (mandatory)
  • Extensive experience defining digital architectures and microarchitectures for complex hardware systems
  • Proven track record of independently delivering complex digital IP or subsystems from specification to implementation
  • Deep understanding of RTL optimization, logic synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and timing closure
  • Strong experience optimizing digital designs for deterministic latency, high clock frequencies, resource utilization, and power efficiency
  • Advanced knowledge of synchronous digital design, CDC, clocking architectures, and hardware interfaces
  • Strong understanding of FPGA and/or ASIC development methodologies and implementation constraints
  • Experience with simulation-based verification and debugging of complex digital systems
  • Ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, resolve challenging technical issues, and guide implementation decisions
  • Strong technical leadership, analytical, and communication skills
  • English proficiency sufficient for effective collaboration within an international engineering team

Desirable:

  • Extensive experience with AMD/Xilinx FPGA architectures, particularly AMD Versal
  • Advanced experience with AMD Vivado, FPGA implementation, and timing closure
  • Familiarity with Synopsys VCS, Siemens Questa, and related verification/debugging tools
  • Experience with ASIC digital IP development and FPGA-to-ASIC design considerations
  • Experience designing complex DSP pipelines, waveform generation engines, or real-time control architectures
  • Deep understanding of deterministic, nanosecond-scale timing and synchronization
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces such as AXI, PCIe, DDR, or proprietary interconnects
  • Experience with performance, area, and power (PPA) optimization
  • Knowledge of Python, Tcl, or other languages used for EDA workflow automation
  • Experience leading technical design reviews or mentoring senior engineers
  • Background in quantum computing, semiconductor development, telecommunications, high-performance instrumentation, or similar advanced technology domains

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexible working hours
  • Home office option
  • 5 weeks of holiday
  • 5 sick days
  • Multisport Card
  • Meal allowance
  • Internal trainings including workshops and seminars
  • Paid certifications and technical as well as soft-skills training
  • Possibility to participate in international conferences
  • Fresh fruit, coffee, and a weekly company breakfast in the office
  • Loyalty bonus after 5, 10, 15 and more years with the company
  • Referral bonus programme
  • Corporate events including team building, outdoor activities, Christmas party, health week, summer ice cream, and more
  • Hybrid and remote working options available across our Czech offices in Prague, Hradec Králové, and Zlín

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

With delivery centers in Prague, Hradec Králové, and Zlín, our Czech team delivers end-to-end solutions across industries. Here, innovation thrives through collaboration, and every idea drives our partners' success.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

​Senior Specialist Account Executive, Data 360 & Agentforce


Team: Data 360 Specialist Sales | Location: [Germany / remote] | Languages: German and English

​The Experience

Make an impact on how organizations run
Data and AI are changing how every organization works, and this is where it’s happening. Leaders everywhere are asking how to become an agentic enterprise, where AI agents work alongside people to serve customers, solve problems, and take action in real time. Most are held back by the same obstacle: their customer data is scattered, inconsistent, and not ready for AI.

Data 360 unifies customer data in real time. Agentforce turns that data into AI agents that act for customers and employees. This is no longer a bet on the future. In Salesforce’s second quarter of fiscal 2027, Agentforce and Data 360 annual recurring revenue reached nearly $3.9 billion, up over 210% year over year. That makes them the fastest-growing part of Salesforce and the core of its growth path. They are proven at scale with world-leading organizations: Siemens uses Data 360 to power its SiePortal customer platform, AT&T uses Agentforce, Data 360 and MuleSoft to give retail experts real-time customer context, and L’Oréal uses Service Cloud and Data 360 to cut case handling time by 64% for advisors across 25 brands. Salesforce Delivers Record Second Quarter Fiscal 2027

Demand is strong and growing fast, and so is the opportunity to shape it. As a specialist, you own the growth of Data 360 and Agentforce in your assigned segment. You close deals, and you also build the market: turning proven use cases into repeatable plays, equipping colleagues to sell, and creating the reference stories that bring in the next customers.

Your impact will show up in four places:

  • On customers: you help them move from AI experiments to agents that deliver measurable results.
  • On the market: your wins become the reference stories others follow.
  • On colleagues: you equip account teams to spot and sell the opportunity.
  • On your career: high visibility and responsibility, in the fastest-growing part of Salesforce and at the center of one of the biggest shifts in business technology.


What you’ll ​Actually Be Doing

Win business

  • Identify, qualify, and close Data 360 and Agentforce opportunities, with annual contract value (ACV) as your core target.
  • Support and, where it makes sense, lead deals together with account teams, solution engineers, product specialists, and partners.
  • Lead discovery that uncovers real business problems, then judge honestly whether and how Data 360 can solve them.
  • Build clear business cases that link our solutions to measurable outcomes.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals through negotiation and close.

Grow your segment

  • Analyze ACV, pipeline, and pipeline generation for your segment, spot the gaps, and plan and carry out fixes.
  • Plan and run events and campaigns that generate pipeline and move deals forward.
  • Enable account executives with training, talk tracks, and coaching so they can spot and sell Data 360 opportunities.
  • Create and maintain selling assets such as case studies, knowledge bases, and customer stories.
  • Turn customer wins into reference stories and proven use cases into repeatable plays for your segment.
  • Share your expertise with audiences at company events, customer seminars, or other formats that suit your strengths.
  • Align with sales leaders at all levels on priorities and plans for your segment.

​Y​ou're Our Person If...

We hire for what you can do, not where or how you learned it. You don’t need every skill listed here. Tell us where you’re strongest.

Selling complex solutions

  • You can run a structured process for high-value, multi-stakeholder deals, from qualification through negotiation to close.
  • You can sell solutions customers may not yet see as urgent by connecting them to a business problem, rather than selling from a catalog.
  • You can show results against targets, in whatever context you’ve worked (enterprise, commercial, partner-led, or another model).

Analytical and strategic thinking

  • You break problems into parts, prioritize, and take action.
  • You read numbers such as pipeline, conversion, and revenue, and turn them into a plan.
  • You think about growth over the mid to long term, not just this quarter.

Ownership and adaptability

  • You take ownership of a goal and lead without needing formal authority.
  • You change your approach quickly when something isn’t working.
  • You thrive in a fast-growing market where products, competitors, and playbooks evolve every quarter.

Discovery and storytelling

  • You lead discovery conversations that surface needs customers hadn’t yet put into words.
  • You tell persuasive, evidence-based stories to both technical and business audiences.

Technical fluency

  • You understand how modern data platforms work (for example, cloud data warehouses, data lakes, customer data platforms, integration, and BI tools) well enough to hold credible conversations with technical buyers.
  • You can explain data and AI concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • You’re curious about AI agents and how they change the way businesses operate.

Collaboration and communication

  • You work well across teams and bring others along, including by teaching and enabling them.
  • You communicate and negotiate clearly in business-level German and English.


​Even Better If...

  • Experience selling or working with customer data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, analytics, or AI products
  • Experience scaling a fast-growing product or offering
  • Familiarity with the Salesforce platform, Tableau, Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery
  • Experience working with partners and system integrators

Where your skills can come from

There’s no required degree, number of years, or job title. You might have built these skills in:

  • Sales, consulting, or customer-facing technical roles
  • Product, marketing, or business development roles that owned growth for a market or segment
  • Data, analytics, or engineering roles that moved toward customers
  • Entrepreneurship, partnerships, or customer success
  • Self-study, certifications, bootcamps, military service, or a career change

If you can show you can do the work, we want to hear from you, and we want to see the impact you can make here.


How we’ll evaluate you

We assess skills directly, and every candidate goes through the same steps:

  • A conversation about your background and motivation
  • A practical exercise with two parts to choose from or combine: a mock discovery call or business-case presentation, and a short segment-growth plan based on sample pipeline data
  • A structured interview with the team, scored against the same skills criteria
  • A conversation on how you collaborate and what support you need to succeed

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Patent Data Specialist (Enrichment Quality & AI Readiness) Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools?
jobs.description:
Patent Data Specialist (Enrichment Quality & AI Readiness)

Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools?

Do you revel in finding the root cause of an error, then making sure it never happens again?

Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent data, ready for the AI that professionals worldwide rely on.

About the team:


LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy.

Every one of those decisions rests on the same foundation: patent data that is grouped, attributed, and kept up to date correctly. We are looking for someone who wants to help get that foundation right.

About the role:


Patent data is hard for people and machines alike. One invention can be filed in dozens of countries under different numbers and rules; one company can hold patents under many names, subsidiaries, and spellings; and whether a patent is still alive depends on events spread across years and jurisdictions. Any data or AI system built on top is only as good as the answers to a few basic questions. Which filings belong to the same family? Who really owns a patent once subsidiaries, acquisitions and spelling variants are untangled? Is a patent still in force, and do we know this for every country we are interested in? A single wrongly grouped family or misattributed owner can quietly change how a customer sees a competitor.

In this role, you will work alongside senior patent data experts to define what correct looks like for these foundations, test our data against it, and track down why things go wrong. It is a rare chance to combine patent knowledge with hands-on data work, and to grow into a recognised expert in an area that underpins everything we do.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Work with our senior patent data experts to define and maintain governed quality standards and acceptance criteria for patent families, ownership, legal status, and coverage, including how to handle tricky edge cases.
  • Build and maintain versioned test sets and worked examples, such as correctly grouped families or correctly resolved owners, that engineering teams build closed-loop evaluations on, so data quality is checked automatically and continuously.
  • Analyse our data to find quality problems, investigate their root causes with engineering teams, recommend fixes, and help design checks so they do not recur.
  • Lead smaller quality-improvement projects end to end, with support from senior colleagues.
  • Assess the quality of data from new sources and patent authorities before and after it enters our platform.
  • Review the output of automated and AI-assisted enrichment, such as ownership mapping, and feed what you learn back into the standards and evaluations.
  • Document rules and decisions clearly so they can be applied consistently, by people and by automated tools, including agentic workflows.
  • Help resolve data questions raised by product teams and customers, sometimes against tight timelines, and turn recurring ones into reusable guidance.
  • Present findings to colleagues and stakeholders

Requirements:


  • Experience working with patent data or patent information, for example as a patent analyst, patent information specialist, searcher, or in a data role at a patent office, data provider, or IP firm.
  • Understanding of how patent data is structured: families, priority claims, kind codes, legal status, assignees, and the differences between patent authorities.
  • Hands-on data skills: you are comfortable querying and analysing data yourself, for example in SQL, Python, or similar tools.
  • A methodical approach to data quality: spotting anomalies, finding root causes and checking that fixes work.
  • Practical use of AI tools in your own work beyond basic chat, for example AI-assisted data analysis, coding assistants or automated extraction, and an understanding of where automated and AI-based enrichment can go wrong.
  • Precision and care with detail, combined with the judgment to know which problems matter most.
  • Clear written communication: you can explain a data rule or an edge case so others can apply it.

Experience and education.


  • Typically, 2 or more years in patent information, patent analysis, or data roles involving patents or similarly complex data.
  • A degree in a scientific, engineering, technical, information science or related subject, or equivalent practical experience


It would be great if you also have.


  • Experience with company ownership data, corporate hierarchies, or entity resolution
  • Experience with non-English patent data, for example Chinese, Japanese or Korean
  • Familiarity with data modelling, taxonomies, or classification systems
  • Experience with data quality tooling or automated testing of data

You do not need to have worked for a data or software company before. We will help you learn how our platform works; you bring curiosity, rigour, and a feel for patent data.


This role is probably not for you if you'd rather analyse patents for specific end clients than work on the data behind the analysis, if you don't enjoy working hands-on with data, or if you're not keen to use AI tools in your work.

Why Join Us?

You'll help make sure the data behind patent decisions worldwide is right, learning from experienced experts, with the backing of a global group that has been building data, analytics and AI products for many years, and with colleagues who care about getting things right.


In your application


Please tell us briefly about one of the following:

  • A time you found an error in patent data or other complex data: how you spotted it, what caused it, and what you'd put in place to stop it happening again.
  • A time you used an AI tool on a complex data analysis task, or to parse complex data: where it helped, where it got things wrong, and how you checked.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.


· Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working for you


We know that your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy additional days.
  • Health screening, eye care vouchers, and private medical benefits
  • Wellbeing programs
  • Life assurance
  • Access to a competitive contributory pension scheme
  • Save As You Earn share option scheme.
  • Maternity, paternity, and shared parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer.
  • Access to extensive learning and development resources
  • Access to employee discounts scheme via Perks at Work

About the business -


At LexisNexis Intellectual Property (LNIP), we believe that whenever a person works on a patent and understands the future trajectory of a specific technology, that person has the potential to fundamentally change how society operates. We are proud to directly support and serve these innovators in their endeavors to better humankind. We enable innovators to accomplish more by helping them make informed decisions, be more productive, comply with regulations, and ultimately achieve superior results. By harnessing the latest advances in machine learning combined with expert analysis, LexisNexis Intellectual Property is disrupting how actionable insight is extracted from patent data. Information can now be accessed with efficiency, accuracy and at a speed that is just not possible by traditional methods. Our overall success is measured by how well we deliver these results

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

jobs.description:
About us

At Koltin, we’re redesigning the way we care for our moms, dads, and grandparents to help them remain healthy and independent for as long as possible.

How do we do it? Through our health memberships, which provide personalized, preventive care to support our members’ long-term well-being.

We are the first company in Mexico offering health memberships that include major medical insurance coverage for older adults-up to 84 years old-backed by BBVA Seguros Salud.

Sobre el rol

Buscamos a nuestro primer(a) Senior Software Engineer - Agents & LLMs. Nuestros miembros nos escriben decenas de miles de veces al mes, muchas veces con miedo, enojo o una historia detrás de la pregunta. Vas a poner agentes en producción para atenderlos, en un dominio donde la respuesta que suena bien y está mal es el peor error posible.

Lo que construyas se vuelve la base de cómo toda la empresa construye con LLMs. Trabajas con producto, data y otros ingenieros, y decides qué construimos, qué compramos y qué ensamblamos.

Generalista con una especialidad fuerte (modelo T): te mueves por todo el stack, con inclinación a LLMs y agentes.

Lo que harás

  • Agentes en producción. Orquestación, tool calling contra nuestros sistemas y el contexto del miembro armado desde múltiples fuentes, sobre WhatsApp y los canales que vengan.
  • La barra de calidad. Evals sobre casos reales y criterios de aceptación definidos antes de lanzar.
  • La plataforma. Observabilidad de LLMs (trazas, costo, latencia, calidad), evals como infraestructura, acceso a modelos agnóstico de proveedor y versionado de prompts, para que otros equipos no empiecen de cero.
  • Seguridad en un entorno regulado. Guardrails, PII, verificación de identidad y human-in-the-loop donde el riesgo lo pide.
  • Proyectos de punta a punta. Vas por el problema detrás del pedido, lo partes en fases y lo llevas a producción con visibilidad de riesgos y decisiones.
  • Subir la vara. ADRs, review, pairing y patrones que otros equipos reusan.

Lo que buscamos

Contratamos por fundamentos, modelos mentales y patrones. El stack se aprende.

  • Debe contar con un recorrido de al menos 5 años en el ciclo completo de desarrollo.
  • Haber llevado LLMs en producción, con al menos un sistema frente a usuarios reales que operaste después del lanzamiento.
  • Tool calling en serio. Diseñaste las tools y sabes qué hacer cuando el modelo llama la equivocada o con los argumentos equivocados.
  • Evals en serio. Datasets de casos reales, LLM-as-judge calibrado contra humanos, regresiones antes de cada cambio de prompt o modelo.
  • Datos sensibles en producción: PII, retención, acuerdos de procesamiento con proveedores.
  • Español nativo o fluido, inglés profesional.

Suma puntos

  • Context engineering: compactación, memoria, context provisioning vía tools.
  • Retrieval agéntico y servidores MCP, más allá de RAG sobre embeddings.
  • Seguridad de agentes: prompt injection directa e indirecta, permisos mínimos por tool, red-teaming.
  • Multi-agente, subagentes y ejecución durable.
  • Costo y latencia: prompt caching, routing entre modelos, structured outputs.
  • Evals online: shadow mode, A/B entre prompts o modelos, feedback humano que vuelve al dataset.
  • WhatsApp, voz, salud o seguros.

Cómo trabajamos

  • Usamos IA para todo, y eres dueño(a) de lo que llega a producción.
  • Self-merge por defecto, con CI, tipos y pruebas como bloqueo. Las decisiones de arquitectura viven en ADRs, y ahí enfocamos el review.
  • Ingeniería se sienta con producto, data y operaciones.

Qué NO es este rol

  • Investigación o fine-tuning: construimos sobre modelos de frontera.
  • Demos: lo que cuenta es lo que se sostiene en producción, medido.

Proceso de selección

  1. Revisión de CV
  2. Entrevista con People (15 min)
  3. Entrevista con Producto (45 min)
  4. Entrevista técnica y live coding con el equipo (1 hora)
  5. Entrevista Hiring Manager (45 min)
  6. Cierre con Founders (30 min)

Cuidamos el tiempo de las personas: te damos retroalimentación en cada etapa y buscamos cerrar el proceso en pocas semanas.

jobs.excerpt: Target start: January 4, 2027. Our client is a marketing agency helping home-service contractors grow through search marketing.
jobs.description:
Target start: January 4, 2027.

Our client is a marketing agency helping home-service contractors grow through search marketing. Our clients include pressure washing, roofing, exterior cleaning, and Christmas lighting businesses.

These are owner-operated businesses where reliable leads keep crews working and trucks moving. Our clients care about whether their marketing brings real business opportunities—and we do too.

We’re hiring two Senior Google Ads Strategists to own portfolios of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts. You’ll have the authority to make decisions and the responsibility to explain their impact.

You’ll manage approximately 20–30 accounts, typically spending $2,000–$4,000 per month each. These are small-budget, often seasonal accounts where strong judgment matters more than relying on automation.

We’re looking for someone who identifies problems, proposes solutions, and takes action without waiting for a task list.

What you’ll own

  • Account strategy and execution: Manage campaign structure, budgets, bidding, keywords, negative keywords, ad copy, and landing page improvements across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.

  • Proactive performance monitoring: Spot changes in lead volume, cost per lead, lead quality, and conversion tracking before a client raises a concern.

  • Root-cause analysis: Investigate whether declining performance comes from tracking issues, search queries, bidding, landing pages, competition, seasonality, or account changes.

  • Weekly account reviews: Each Monday, prepare a written analysis and revision plan for priority accounts. Explain what you expect your changes to achieve, then review the actual outcome the following week.

  • Accurate comparisons: Use the appropriate year-over-year period to assess seasonal performance and distinguish meaningful trends from short-term fluctuations.

  • Documentation and processes: Record what you changed and why as you work. Turn repeatable solutions into SOPs and share useful findings with the team.

You’ll independently make day-to-day account decisions. Revision plans for accounts on the weekly priority list must be reviewed with your manager before implementation.

Success means generating qualified leads that contribute to client revenue, using budgets effectively, and catching issues early.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, with strong Search campaign expertise and experience generating leads for local or service businesses.

  • Google Ads as your primary specialism, with the ability to manage Microsoft Ads accounts.

  • Experience independently managing multiple accounts. Agency or freelance experience is particularly relevant.

  • Strong analytical judgment with small budgets and low conversion volumes. You know when the evidence supports a decision and when there is too little data to draw a reliable conclusion.

  • Confidence diagnosing conversion tracking issues and learning new analytics tools.

  • Clear documentation habits and the ability to explain your decisions.

  • Strong English for team collaboration, written analysis, and occasional client emails.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach: you take ownership, raise issues early, and remain open to feedback.

  • Availability for at least four hours of overlap with US Eastern Time. Our Ads Manager typically works 7 AM–4 PM ET.

Experience with home-service contractor accounts is a bonus. Your strongest evidence should come from Search-led lead generation.

Our values:

  • State-of-the-Art Innovation: Bring hypotheses, testing ideas, and tools that could improve client results.

  • Efficiency: Turn repeatable work into better processes and scalable systems.

  • Attention to Detail: “Finished means no one has to fix it.” Take responsibility for accurate tracking, campaign setup, and documentation.

  • Results Driven: Focus on qualified leads and business outcomes.

  • Collaboration: Share your findings and help improve the team’s expertise.

  • Happy Clients: Catch performance issues early and communicate clearly.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work for candidates based in Europe.

  • Performance bonuses paid in May and November, up to 10% of annual salary, based on achieving your KPIs.

  • 15 days of paid time off in your first year, plus one additional day for each year with us. This allowance includes sick and personal days and is prorated by your start date.

  • Paid holidays: New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Black Friday, and the Christmas Eve–New Year period.

  • A company closure during the final week of the year.

  • Authority to manage your accounts and a manager who values collaboration and informed decisions.

Hiring process

The process includes a recruiter interview, a conversation with the hiring team, and a short practical assessment. You’ll be asked to analyze an account, compare performance against the correct year-over-year period, and explain your recommendations.

jobs.description:
Meet Instinct 👋

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

A Sneak Peek of Your Role 🔭

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Training Specialist is a cross-trained product expert who delivers hands-on training and enablement support across Instinct's full product suite — to both onboarding and active customers. You are part of a tightly coordinated team that operates as a single unit: shared ticketing, round-robin assignments, and a commitment to delivering a fluid, consistent experience regardless of which specialist shows up.

You do not own a single account or project. You are deployed where training is needed — whether that is a new hospital moving through onboarding, an active customer navigating a contact change, a team getting oriented to a newly released feature, or a post-upsell product tour. This flexibility is your strength, and you are expected to be fully interchangeable with your teammates.

You leverage Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to reference account history, preferences, and project context so every interaction feels informed and personal — even when you are stepping in without prior direct relationship. You are expected to travel frequently, and you build your work in a way that ensures your absence never disrupts the team.

What You'll Do 🛠️

Training Delivery

  • Onboarding Training: Deliver product training to hospital teams at key milestones during the onboarding process — coordinating with the Onboarding Manager to ensure timing supports go-live readiness.
  • Active Customer Training: Support active customers navigating contact changes, new feature releases, post-upsell product tours, or areas of low adoption identified through the CS or Enablement team.
  • Cross-Product Fluency: Maintain current, confident training capability across Instinct's full product suite — keeping pace with releases and updates as they ship.
  • Flexible Deployment: Operate as a shared resource across the team — picking up new training assignments from the shared queue, adapting quickly to new accounts, and delivering consistent quality without needing extended ramp time.

Account Intelligence & Preparation

  • Pre-Session Research: Before each engagement, use Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to review relevant account notes, workflow preferences, prior training history, and any context that allows you to show up informed.
  • Contextual Delivery: Tailor each training session to the specific hospital — referencing their workflows, product configuration, and team dynamics rather than delivering a generic walkthrough.
  • Session Documentation: Log training outcomes, follow-up items, and customer feedback in HubSpot and Glyphic after each engagement, ensuring teammates and account owners have full visibility.

Team Coordination & Travel

  • Shared Team Model: Operate within the team's shared ticketing and assignment system — taking on new work, communicating capacity, and maintaining coverage standards that keep SLAs intact.
  • Travel: Travel frequently to deliver on-site training — building relationships with hospital teams and delivering sessions in-person where context and environment make it more effective.
  • Continuity: Structure your ongoing work so that any teammate can step in during travel without disruption — documenting, communicating, and organizing to support team continuity.
  • Feedback Loop: Bring patterns, product gaps, and customer feedback back to the Training and Enablement Director and Enablement team to inform content development and product roadmap conversations.

Who You Are 🐱‍💻

Must Haves:

  • Veterinary Practice Experience: Required. You have worked in a veterinary hospital and understand how clinical teams operate, communicate, and adopt new tools.
  • Instinct Software Experience: Strongly preferred. Prior experience using or training on Instinct products significantly accelerates your effectiveness.
  • Customer-Facing Training or Education: 1–3 years delivering product training, clinical education, or customer enablement in a fast-paced environment.
  • CRM & Call Intelligence Tools: Comfortable working in HubSpot and using call intelligence tools (e.g., Glyphic) to prep for and document customer sessions.
  • Travel Availability: Able and willing to travel frequently — typically multiple trips per month — without disruption to team operations.

How Instinct will Care about YOU 🌞

  • We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
  • We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
  • We pay our team well.
  • We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
  • We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
  • We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
  • We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

jobs.excerpt: As a Social Media Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling a content calendar; you are the reason vCluster shows up in every conversation that moves the AI infrastructure industry, within hours instead of weeks.
jobs.description:
As a Social Media Manager at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling a content calendar; you are the reason vCluster shows up in every conversation that moves the AI infrastructure industry, within hours instead of weeks. Our customers are the AI Clouds and GPU infrastructure providers building the next generation of compute, and this market moves every day: rankings, funding rounds, launches, outages, hot takes. You will watch all of it, decide what's worth saying, and bring our CEO and leaders finished options to choose from.

As a Social Media Manager, your role will include:

  • Industry Radar: Follow the AI cloud and GPU infrastructure space more closely than anyone else in the company. That means SemiAnalysis, Hacker News, X, funding announcements, product launches and the wider tech scene. Build your own system of alerts, feeds and agents so nothing important gets past you.

  • The 24 to 48 Hour Window: When something happens, bring leadership options, not questions: several finished posts with different angles, ready to publish. There's no planning cycle and no three rounds of approval. Once the moment passes, the post is dead.

  • Executive Voice and Ghostwriting: Turn our CEO's and leaders' points of view into posts that sound like them and get read. When they'd normally hit repost, you write the take they should have published instead. You bring the ideas; they approve and steer.

  • Creative Swings That Aren't Reactions: Invent the stunts, running formats, recurring bits and visual series that make people stop scrolling and ask who made them. You know when each one wins, and you make the visual yourself.

  • Company Channels and Launches: Own the vCluster LinkedIn and X accounts, including a heavy launch and event calendar with several posts per launch. This part is table stakes. You run it cleanly so there's room for the creative work.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Work that broke out: You can show posts, accounts or moments you made happen, and explain what you were reacting to, how fast you moved and why it worked.

  • Speed with judgment: You'd rather ship a sharp post today than a perfect one next week. You also know which moments need a quick gut check before they go out.

  • Opinions about the feed: You know which tech accounts are winning on LinkedIn and X right now and why, and you can name inspirations beyond the obvious ones.

  • Fast learning: You don't need to know GPU clouds or Kubernetes on day one. You do need to get up to speed fast enough to form your own point of view, and you enjoy taking in far more industry signal than most people.

  • Taste with AI: You use AI tools every day to move faster, and the ideas, judgment and voice are still clearly yours.

  • Ownership: You don't wait for a brief. You bring the ideas, run the program and take direct feedback in the room.

Bonus points for:

  • Technical audiences: You've grown social for developer tools, infrastructure, AI or startup founders.

  • Founder or exec ghostwriting: You've built an executive's personal presence on LinkedIn or X.

  • Short-form video: You can cut a clip from a talk, demo or event floor and post it the same day.

  • Live event coverage: You're comfortable working an event like KubeCon on your own and running social live.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $105K - $125K

jobs.description:
Senior Associate / Vice President, Investments
Remote Position
Reports to: Executive Vice President of Investments

Role Overview
The Senior Associate / Vice President, Investments (the “Investment Professional”) will be a core member of PROVE Partner's parent company Allira’s investment team, supporting the full transaction lifecycle for Allira’s non-single-event business lines: bulk purchases of medical lien receivables, acquisitions of pre-settlement funding portfolios, and attorney lending. The Investment Professional will be trained to source, underwrite, structure, and execute these transactions and to manage the resulting assets through resolution, with Vice President candidates expected to lead transactions with greater independence and help develop junior team members.

The Investment Professional will work directly with the Executive Vice President of Investments on pipeline management, portfolio-level due diligence, cash flow modeling, investment committee materials, legal documentation, asset boarding, and ongoing performance monitoring. The role will work cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, Servicing, Sales, and Allira’s institutional capital partners to ensure transactions are structured appropriately, operationally executable, and aligned with Allira’s return targets.

This is a hands-on, high-growth role for a candidate who wants to build deep expertise in an esoteric, cash flow-based asset class and help scale Allira into a best-in-class litigation finance investment platform. Title and compensation will be commensurate with experience.

Key Responsibilities
  1. Sourcing and Pipeline Management
    • Partner with sales, brokers, and referral sources to convert prospective medical providers, pre-settlement funders, and law firms into closed transactions
    • Screen inbound bulk receivable, portfolio purchase, and attorney lending opportunities against Allira’s investment criteria and return thresholds
    • Manage and maintain the pipeline of active opportunities, including tracking status, data requests, and next steps for each prospect
    • Prepare marketing materials, indicative pricing, and preliminary analyses for prospective counterparties
    • Participate in prospect and client meetings, including periodic travel to counterparties
  2. Underwriting and Due Diligence
    • Conduct portfolio-level due diligence on medical lien receivables and pre-settlement portfolios, including concentration analysis by law firm, provider, state, case type, and modality
    • Build and maintain static pool, collection curve, duration, and cash flow models to project returns and downside scenarios
    • Perform corporate, principal, and guarantor diligence on medical providers, pre-settlement funders, and law firms for attorney lending facilities
    • Analyze historical reduction, write-off, and resolution timing data to validate underwriting assumptions and pricing
    • Coordinate legal, servicing, and operational diligence with internal teams and outside counsel
    • Review case-level data, lien documentation, and servicing files to assess collateral quality and enforceability
  3. Transaction Structuring and Execution
    • Draft term sheets and proposals across a range of structures, including outright purchases, forward flow arrangements, lines of credit, and non-recourse advances with upside-sharing or promote features
    • Prepare investment committee memoranda and return models for transaction approval
    • Support negotiation of definitive documentation, including purchase agreements, credit agreements, and servicing agreements, in coordination with Legal
    • Facilitate asset boarding, funding mechanics, and treasury coordination at closing
    • Support post-closing items including go-forward fundings, re-underwrites, audits, and amendments
  4. Portfolio Management and Asset Monitoring
    • Monitor performance of acquired portfolios and attorney lending facilities, including paydown timing, collections, covenant compliance, and realized versus underwritten outcomes
    • Maintain portfolio reporting on yield, MOIC, IRR, vintage trends, and concentration by counterparty, law firm, provider, and geography
    • Identify emerging risks and underperformance trends and help develop remediation plans with Servicing and Legal
    • Prepare materials for regular portfolio reviews with leadership and support borrowing base and capital partner reporting with Finance
    • Support investor and lender diligence requests related to portfolio performance and asset quality
  5. Data, Analytics, and Process Improvement
  • Help build and maintain underwriting templates, return models, and decision-support tools across bulk receivables, pre-settlement, and attorney lending
  • Improve feedback loops between origination, underwriting, Servicing, and realized performance
  • Support the development of portfolio analytics, scenario analysis, and forecasting frameworks
  • Leverage AI tools day-to-day to accelerate diligence, modeling, memo drafting, and data analysis, and identify and help implement process-improvement, automation, and AI opportunities to streamline deal execution and strengthen portfolio oversight
  1. Relationship Management and Collaboration
  • Establish and cultivate strong, long-term relationships with medical providers, pre-settlement funders, law firms, brokers, and institutional capital partners
  • Coordinate across Sales, Legal, Servicing, and Finance to ensure a seamless counterparty experience from sourcing through post-closing support
  • Foster strong coordination across business lines and contribute to a collaborative, data-driven team culture
Qualifications
  • 3–5 years (Senior Associate) / 5–7 years (Vice President) of direct experience in structuring, underwriting, or executing financial transactions, preferably in asset-based finance, specialty finance, structured credit, or receivables investing at an investment bank, private credit fund, asset manager, specialty finance company, or similar institution
  • Strong quantitative, financial modeling, and analytical skills, including experience building cash flow models and analyzing portfolio-level data (static pools, collection curves, concentrations)
  • Working understanding of risk-adjusted return analysis, asset performance monitoring, and transaction structuring
  • Experience drafting investment memoranda and reviewing financing structures and associated legal agreements; Vice President candidates should have a demonstrated track record of independently leading transactions from sourcing through closing
  • Strong attention to detail, commercial judgment, and the ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with counterparties, capital partners, and senior leadership
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) as an everyday part of the workflow for analysis, drafting, and research; experience with SQL, Power BI, Salesforce, or similar tools a plus
  • Familiarity with litigation finance, medical receivables, pre-settlement funding, law firm lending, or adjacent esoteric asset classes preferred; Bachelor’s degree required

Job Description

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is a leader in open networking for organizations that need secure, scalable, automated operations across bare metal, cloud and edge. Our product, VyOS, is an enterprise-grade networking platform for consistent operations and automation at scale, delivering full control and high performance with zero vendor lock-in. More than 1,500 organizations run VyOS in production, from service providers and cloud providers to enterprises and public institutions. Our goal is to restore ownership of network infrastructure to our users through transparent, vendor-neutral networking. Your network, your rules.

Job description

The System Engineer (IT Support) at VyOS is the first line of IT for our employees. This role covers internal user support: service desk tickets, access requests, user accounts from onboarding to offboarding, and setting up and maintaining macOS and Windows laptops. Our team is fully remote and spread across several countries and time zones, so most of the work happens remotely, in writing, through the IS service desk.

The System Engineer resolves most requests on their own and passes complex infrastructure issues to senior IT team members. They keep the knowledge base up to date so users can fix common issues without opening a ticket. They also look for requests that keep coming back and could be automated or prevented. This is a junior-to-middle position, with clear room to grow into broader systems and infrastructure work.

Reports directly to the CIO.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years in IT support, service desk or junior system administration.
  • Hands-on experience supporting both macOS and Windows users.
  • Experience with a ticketing system (Jira Service Management preferred).
  • Experience managing users and access in cloud services (Atlassian Cloud, Google Workspace, Entra ID or similar).
  • Experience writing knowledge base articles or user guides.

Nice to have

  • Microsoft Intune, Apple Business Manager or Windows Autopilot.
  • Jira Service Management configuration: queues, request types, SLAs and automation rules.
  • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Cloudflare Zero Trust.
  • AWX or n8n or Zapier.
  • Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, MD-102, Apple Certified Support Professional or Atlassian Certified Associate.

Skills

  • Good working knowledge of macOS and Windows 10/11: setup, troubleshooting, updates and user accounts.
  • Basic knowledge of identity and access management: SSO, MFA, groups and roles, least privilege, and creating and removing user accounts.
  • Able to administer SaaS platforms such as Atlassian Cloud and Google Workspace.
  • Basic knowledge of networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi) and endpoint security.
  • Basic scripting skills (Bash, PowerShell or Python).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to problems.
  • Clear written communication: can explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague in a short message.
  • Service mindset: owns each request from start to finish and respects users' time.
  • Able to work independently in a remote team and manage their own ticket queue.
  • Good spoken and written English (B2 or higher).

About VyOS

VyOS is an enterprise-grade network operating system that combines routing, firewall, VPN and core network services in one system with one configuration. It runs on standard x86-64 hardware, on every major hypervisor and in every major public cloud, so one design runs anywhere. Network engineers manage VyOS through a single CLI with commit and rollback, or through the API and standard automation tools.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

Our Core Values

Our values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:

  • Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.
  • Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
  • Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.

jobs.description:
Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Whether we’re developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward.Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits.

Who We're Looking For

The Machine Learning Operations Consultant enhances the reliability, quality, and automation of Syniverse's ML model development and deployment lifecycle. This role focuses on modernizing Ground Truth (GT) dataset management, strengthening model quality assurance and validation practices, and designing a fully automated model re-training pipeline. The consultant works independently and collaboratively with the Technical Curation (TC) team and other stakeholders, delivering recommendations, designs, and implementation support through workshops, analysis, and documentation. This is an engagement-based, time-and-materials advisory role rather than a traditional full-time position.

-

Some of What You'll Do

Ground Truth (GT) Maintenance

  • Assess current S3-based GT storage and versioning practices.
  • Recommend and design a scalable GT management system supporting seamless, criteria-based (age, source, quality) replacement or updating of records at the record level, while preserving vital historical data needed for domain-specific classifiers.
  • Evaluate migration toward a more structured storage solution (e.g., database-backed repository) to enable advanced filtering, automated quality/validation checks, and access by multiple downstream services.
  • Provide implementation support or a prototype for automated GT refresh and validation processes tailored to the training pipelines.

Model Quality Assurance and Validation

  • Evaluate the current post-training assessment approach, including use of small live-data snapshots and empirical accuracy/degradation thresholds.
  • Design and set up an independent integration testing framework using small, highly curated test datasets targeted to specific product requirements, run alongside the latest production data snapshots.
  • Recommend additional quality checks, including methods to detect and quantify data distribution shifts (data drift) between historical GT blends and live production data.
  • Define procedures and tools for ongoing model quality monitoring post-deployment.

Re-training Automation

  • Design and support implementation of a fully automated monthly re-training pipeline that ingests new material from the TC team and integrates with the updated GT management system.
  • Recommend best practices for handling imbalanced datasets, including evaluation of privacy-aware, LLM-based synthetic data augmentation techniques where appropriate.
  • Select and configure orchestration tooling (e.g., MLflow, Apache Airflow, or a custom system) to establish a formal, well-documented, and reproducible re-training process that reduces reliance on manual curation or any single individual.
  • Integrate GT maintenance and model quality checks into the automated pipeline, and deliver comprehensive documentation, knowledge transfer, and handover.

Program and Communication

  • Participate in regular progress review meetings and provide periodic status updates against the agreed work plan and milestones.
  • Maintain written documentation of issues, proposed solutions, and any agreed changes to scope or priorities.
  • Track and report hours/effort weekly in accordance with time-reporting requirements.

Experience, Education, and Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or operating machine learning data pipelines, including dataset versioning, storage, and validation practices.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud object storage (e.g., AWS S3) and evaluating relational/NoSQL database-backed alternatives.
  • Experience with ML orchestration/automation tools such as MLflow, Apache Airflow, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with model validation techniques, including drift detection and integration/regression testing for ML models.

Additional Requirements:

  • Understanding of supervised learning workflows and Ground Truth dataset management at scale.
  • Familiarity with privacy-conscious, LLM-based synthetic data generation approaches for addressing imbalanced datasets.
  • Working knowledge of data quality and distribution-shift (data drift) monitoring methods.
  • Strong documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, reproducible technical designs and runbooks.
  • Good communication and analytical skills; able to work independently in an iterative, workshop-driven engagement.
  • Ability to comply with client data-handling protocols and security requirements, including when using personal equipment.

-

Why You Should Join Us

Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture.

jobs.description:
Intern Testimonials

“Interning at Ballotpedia is an incredibly rewarding experience. I have had the opportunity to work with a welcoming, supportive team which allows me to learn new skills and challenge myself. The feeling of knowing we are all working towards a common mission is unmatched — it gives the work a greater sense of purpose.” - Alisha Khodabocus, Summer/Fall 2025 GIS Analyst Intern

“Interning with Ballotpedia provides not just the opportunity to strengthen technical skills, but also the chance to work with a supportive team toward the incredibly important goal of making election information clear for American voters.” - Rook Bowman, Spring/Summer 2024 GIS Analyst Intern

“Ballotpedia is an excellent place to work. You will be encouraged to grow and learn, and be given the freedom to explore new territories.” - Noah Pedroso, Spring 2023 Data Engineering Intern

Program Description

As a Ballotpedia Tech Team GIS Analyst intern, your primary job includes a combination of 1) research and outreach to determine election boundary rules, and 2) formatting and processing shapefiles. All of this is in service of Ballotpedia's sample ballot lookup app <>, which allows voters to see upcoming elections for their address. Specifically, your work will involve:

  • research to understand the legal requirements for who can vote in which types of elections
  • sourcing maps through online research, outreach to government offices, or georeferencing to create new shapefiles
  • testing and formatting the files to conform to Ballotpedia's database requirements
  • working with the Ballotpedia database to add the boundaries and perform tests

As an intern, you will go through a similar onboarding experience to full-time Ballotpedia employees. You will meet one-on-one weekly with a member of the team to coordinate your tasks.

Desirable experience for GIS Analyst intern:

  • GIS (working with shapefiles, formatting, georeferencing) using tools such as ArcGIS or QGIS
  • Research/data entry
  • Attention to detail in following instructions

Ballotpedia’s spring 2027 internship runs from Monday, January 11, 2027 through Friday, May 7, 2027. Ballotpedia’s spring internship is a part-time internship program; interns will work approximately 10-20 hours per week depending on their availability.

Ballotpedia is happy to facilitate credit for your internship experience if that is available to you. If you will be seeking credit for your internship, and if there is anything that Ballotpedia will need to do to assist you, please include that information in the same file as your cover letter.

Environment

Ballotpedia interns will work remotely, as all Ballotpedia staff work remotely. To join Ballotpedia, you must have a well-functioning computer with Internet access. Ballotpedia uses Google Applications (Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and more) to accomplish our goals. Some familiarity with Google Applications is helpful.

Compensation

Interns will be compensated at $20.00 per hour.

Please note:If the minimum wage in your area is more than $20.00 per hour, you will be compensated per your area’s minimum wage.

To Apply

Please attach the following in PDF format:

  • résumé
  • cover letter which states your interest in the GIS Analyst internship including:
    • a statement of what you hope to learn from this internship

Please ensure that either your resume or your cover letter includes your current address. Applications that do not include a current address will not be accepted.

If you are hired for this position, Ballotpedia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Ballotpedia is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E-Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

About Ballotpedia

Ballotpedia is a mission-driven organization dedicated to providing Americans with accurate, relevant, and reliable information about politics, elections, and public policy. Our goal is to close the ballot information gap and help voters make informed decisions. We value innovation, humility, hunger, and a collaborative spirit and are committed to continuously improving our offerings to better serve our audiences, readers, and candidates.
