jobs.description:
Title: Marketing Asset Manager
Location: Remote (eastern or central US time zone-based)

Position Summary:
MOCA is seeking a Marketing Asset Manager to improve how prospective and current customers find information, understand our software and services, and take the next step across our corporate, Touchplan, and MOCA Services websites. This hands-on role combines website design, WordPress and Elementor expertise, and making data-informed improvements to the customer journey.

You will turn business goals and audience needs into clear navigation, effective page layouts, and useful content experiences. Working with marketing colleagues and external developers, you will own day-to-day website execution and maintain a prioritized plan for improving usability and conversion performance. You will also manage and maintain our marketing and brand assets, ensuring materials remain current, organized, and consistent with approved branding and messaging. While this is a remote position, the company is seeking applicant located in either the eastern or central time zone of the United States.

Essential Functions:

Customer Journey and Website Design

  • Map key visitor journeys, from initial discovery through evaluation, inquiry, and access to customer resources. Identify confusing navigation, missing information, and barriers to taking action.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to site structure, navigation, page hierarchy, internal links, and calls to action based on audience needs and business priorities.
  • Design and build pages and landing pages in WordPress using Elementor. Apply strong visual judgment to typography, spacing, imagery, and content hierarchy across desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
  • Create reusable page templates and components that support consistent branding and efficient updates across the websites.

Website Performance and Conversion

  • Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity/heatmap tools, user feedback, and behavior analysis tools to identify where visitors struggle and prioritize improvements.
  • Improve inquiry and demo request journeys, including forms and confirmation experiences. Coordinate with marketing operations to verify tracking, CRM connections, and lead routing.
  • Develop testable recommendations for page layouts, messaging, and calls to action. Use A/B testing where traffic supports meaningful results and usability testing to inform other changes.
  • Report on website performance with clear recommendations, tracking priority actions and qualified inquiries alongside traffic and engagement.
WordPress Management and Website Quality
  • Manage routine WordPress content updates and publishing, including page edits, announcements, and job postings. Coordinate hosting, plugin and theme updates, backups, and troubleshooting with hosting and development providers.
  • Test pages, navigation, links, and forms across browsers and devices. Apply accessibility practices for headings, contrast, alternative text, keyboard access, and form labels, and coordinate remediation with developers.
  • Monitor page speed and site health, optimize images and page assets, and collaborate regularly with developers to identify, prioritize, and resolve performance and technical issues.

Search Visibility and Content

  • Apply on-page SEO practices, including descriptive page titles, meta descriptions, logical headings, and internal links. Monitor indexing and crawl issues and coordinate technical fixes with developers as needed.
  • Work with content and marketing colleagues to organize and adapt product, service, industry, and customer content for website visitors. Keep claims, statistics, client logos, and resource links current.

Digital Asset Management and Brand Support

  • Maintain website design standards and document reusable templates and publishing practices. Apply approved brand guidelines consistently across digital content.
  • Support the organization and upkeep of marketing assets, ensuring teams can find current, approved versions.
  • Package emails and newsletters using approved copy and assets. Build and format email layouts, apply brand standards, and test mobile display, links, and calls to action. Coordinate with marketing operations on audience targeting and sending.

Qualifications/Experience - Required:
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, web design, graphic design, digital media, communications, or a related field preferred.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in website management, digital design, or digital marketing, with direct responsibility for improving business websites.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building and maintaining WordPress websites with Elementor, including responsive layouts, reusable templates, and routine troubleshooting.
  • A portfolio showing strong web design judgment and examples of customer journey, usability, or conversion improvements.
  • Practical understanding of user experience, website navigation, accessibility, on-page SEO, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Experience interpreting Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console data and using findings to recommend website changes.
  • Strong editing, quality assurance, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing requests and collaborate with marketing, sales, and development teams.
  • Strong attention to detail, practical problem-solving abilities, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Qualifications/Experience - Preferred:
Experience with B2B software, professional services, and/or the AEC industry; Elementor; basic HTML and CSS; Pardot/MCAE, Figma or Adobe design tools; behavior analysis or usability testing tools; and marketing automation or CRM integrations. Familiarity with Flywheel hosting and SEO tools such as Yoast or Semrush is helpful.

jobs.title: International Recruiter – European Customer Service Roles – Karachi
jobs.excerpt: If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Karachi and across Pakistan.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.

This is NOT for you if

  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.description:
Relae (formerly Carbon Direct) helps organizations like Microsoft, Mitsubishi, and JPMorgan Chase make defensible, high-stakes decisions across energy strategy, decarbonization, environmental markets, and natural capital. Our teams combine scientific rigor with commercial and policy fluency to answer questions that matter, and we invest just as seriously in the people answering them, with a clear path for career growth, structured manager development, and real ownership of hard problems from day one.

The Role

Overview

Relae is seeking an AI/ML Engineer for our Power, Data and Innovation team. This role will be responsible for designing, building, training, and maintaining machine learning models for production. You will be directly working with Relae’s existing and prospective clients to provide insights and analysis on power hedging and procurement of electricity, gas and other energy commodities to help analyze operational and market risks and flexible load opportunities, including assessments of associated emissions impacts.

This is an individual contributor role, and this role will work closely with software engineers, data scientists, energy economists, and power systems engineers to build models that support hyperscaler, utility, and corporate energy buyer clients navigating the AI-driven data center power boom.

Responsibilities

  • Leveraging a deep understanding of power systems data, identify, gather, and validate appropriate datasets for relevant power-sector applications, including assessment of uncertainties and data gaps, and develop analytical approaches to mitigate them.
  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for energy market forecasting and grid analytics (data ingestion from ISO/utility feeds and weather sources, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring).
  • Productionize forecasting and optimization models such as nodal price, load, or renewable generation forecasts with robust testing, observability, and documentation, in collaboration with cross-functional software and power advisory teams, and automated evaluations to ensure safe, frequent releases.
  • Collaborate with power systems engineers and energy market analysts to translate research insights and domain expertise into performant, scalable forecasting and optimization systems.
  • Contribute to technical design reviews, coding standards, and mentoring of best practices with the Tech & Software teams at Relea.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment in power trading, energy procurement, commodity risk management, utility strategy, energy markets, or related roles.

Equity-Based Opportunity for a Skilled Developer

Join Our Growing Startup!

We're Omnitrain, a dynamic and innovative marketing automation SaaS startup bootstrapped from zero to a rapidly expanding user base of over 50 paying subscribers. We are building an AI driven Marketing SaaS platform hosted on the Google Cloud Platform and are tapping into the latest generative AI models. We're seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Engineer to join our team on an equity-based compensation model, with the option for salary upon achievement of revenue goals.

We are in the process of raising a pre-seed fund -- this is your chance to get in on the ground floor.

This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on a promising venture and share in its future success.

Our Mission

Omnitrain’s very name communicates our ambitious goals for our roadmap and market impact.

Think of each aspect of digital marketing as a car on a train.

The moving parts of marketing work together in a linear fashion.

  1. Companies make ads to tell the world about their product.

  2. These ads are circulated online to a variety of marketing platforms, such as Facebook, Google, TikTok, etc..

  3. When people click those ads, they go to a landing page that continues the promise of the ad.

  4. People persuaded by the landing page’s message proceed to convert.

  5. Analytics are collected about the customer journey in order to identify what’s working well and what isn’t.

  6. Automation is leveraged to adjust the ads accordingly based on their performance.

We seek to expand our platform to provide solutions for each part of the train.

Marketers are responsible for potentially thousands or even millions of dollars in ad spend every month. And the reality is that the numbers can turn sour at any time, 24/7. There’s been brands who have literally lost millions in ad spend in as little as an hour or two due to human errors and misconfigurations. Many marketers are utterly chained to their work for fear that things could fall apart at any time and require immediate recalibration.

Our mission is to liberate these folks from their shackles.

In 2024, we released our MVP, the world’s first and only Text-to-Ads solution, which solves for the first car of the train (ad creation) in a way that no other solution in the market has been able to do. Thanks to our innovative proprietary systems in place, our solution instantly creates winning image ads for practically any business or service.

Now we’re looking to expand this concept to other kinds of ads (reels, video, UGC, etc), leveraging emerging technology to do so.

And of course, we plan to tackle the rest of the cars of the train in the future.

We have in-house talent that have many years of experience in building brands from zero to millions as well as a successful exit. We want to do it again, and we want you to be a part of it.

  • Equity Ownership: Opportunity to own a stake in a high-growth startup.

  • Impactful Work: Make a meaningful contribution to a product that is already generating revenue.

  • Potential for High Returns: Share in the financial rewards if the company achieves significant success. Paid salary possibilities are available upon achieving revenue targets.

  • Full stack coding: Develop and maintain high-quality software components across the full stack on GCP, emphasizing cloud functions, Firestore database, Firebase authentication, REST APIs, and integrating with a complex UI app written in Nuxt with Vue 3, and other tools or frameworks such as Quasar, PWA features etc.

  • API Development and Integration: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable APIs to support our core product functionality and integrations with third-party services. This can include AI products such as LLMs or image/video generation, marketing platforms (Meta, Google, etc), payment platforms (Stripe)

  • Microservices and data management: Write, edit, debug microservices as Firebase functions (gen 1 and gen 2), Firestore triggers, Pub/Sub queue processing code etc.

  • Generative AI: Explore and integrate generative AI technologies and techniques, ensuring their application is as pivotal as traditional API integration.

  • Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to UI/UX, APIs, database, deployment to GCP, writing test cases, debugging. Write high-quality, efficient, and testable Javascript code adhering to best practices and standards across the stack.

  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with the CTO and the development team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, assisting the team in overcoming obstacles and achieving milestones.

  • Commitment: We are looking for a part time commitment of about 20 hours a week. Less is acceptable. The more time, effort, and skill you can commit to the venture, the more you stand to gain in percentage of the operation.

Qualifications

  • Vue 3 Expertise: Experience in building modern apps with Vue 3 Composition API, preferably in a Nuxt 3 environment. This is non-negotiable - experience with React or Angular will not be considered. You must be a Vue developer to succeed here.

  • JavaScript experience: A compelling record of work with Javascript, front end and back end (Node.js 20+). Solid understanding of CRUD principles and best practices in creating APIs and calling external APIs. You must be able to demonstrate your ability to write front end and back end code in JavaScript or TypeScript. Experience with CSS or SCSS is also necessary.

  • GCP experience: We use Firebase and many other GCP services, and experience with the platform is essential. You should be able to write and deploy functions as microservices, work with Firestore and Google storage, Firebase authentication

  • Database Proficiency: General knowledge of, and working experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. We use Firestore at the moment, PostgreSQL down the road. Knowledge of BigQuery is useful but not essential.

About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

Lead Research Scientist – Foundation Models for Vision AI & Physical AI

Company: Centific

Location: Seattle, WA or Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid/Remote)

About the Team

Centific’s Physical AI Lab is building the next generation of embodied intelligence at the intersection of multimodal foundation models, simulation, agentic AI, and real-world robotics. Our mission is to move from perception and reasoning to robust real-world action across safety, industrial, healthcare, warehouse, autonomous systems, and smart environment use cases.

We are looking for a Research Leader with deep foundational model-building experience, a strong publication record, and the ability to translate frontier research into deployable systems and long-term IP.

The Role

As Lead Research Scientist, you will define and drive Centific’s research agenda in Vision AI, multimodal foundation models, simulation-first learning, agentic AI, and embodied intelligence. You will lead a small team of researchers, engineers, and interns while contributing directly to model design, large-scale training, benchmarking, and external scientific visibility.

This role is for someone who has gone beyond applying existing models and has materially advanced architectures, training methods, datasets, or evaluation frameworks in AI, robotics, vision, autonomous driving, or multimodal learning.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead high-impact research in multimodal foundation models, world models, embodied AI, vision-language-action systems, and agentic AI.
  • Develop new approaches for perception, temporal reasoning, spatial intelligence, affordance understanding, autonomous decision-making, and sim2real transfer.
  • Advance challenging robotics capabilities including dexterous manipulation, contact-rich interaction, bimanual coordination, long-horizon task execution, navigation in dynamic environments, and robust action under uncertainty.
  • Contribute to large-scale model building, including multimodal pretraining, distributed training, fine-tuning, distillation, and evaluation of models for vision, robotics, and autonomous systems.
  • Help shape research relevant to autonomous driving and mobile autonomy, including scene understanding, multimodal sensor reasoning, planning-aware perception, and edge-case robustness.
  • Guide integration of research with simulation and digital twin platforms such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Omniverse, or related environments.
  • Establish rigorous benchmarks and reproducible evaluation frameworks for robustness, safety, generalization, manipulation success, policy performance, and real-world deployment readiness.
  • Mentor Ph.D. interns and engineers, and help build a strong research culture grounded in rigor, speed, originality, and scientific excellence.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Autonomous Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong publication record in top venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CoRL, RSS, or leading autonomous driving/robotics venues.
  • 5+ years of research experience in academia, industry, or advanced R&D environments.
  • Demonstrated experience building or advancing large-scale foundational models, novel architectures, or training methods in multimodal AI, vision, robotics, autonomous driving, embodied AI, world models, or simulation-based learning.
  • Deep expertise in PyTorch and/or JAX, GPU training, distributed experimentation, and large-scale model development.
  • Proven ability to lead ambitious technical programs and mentor junior researchers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications or patents in multimodal foundation models, dexterous robotics, autonomous driving, spatial intelligence, simulation-based learning, manipulation, or embodied AI.
  • Strong experience in Vision AI, including perception, tracking, grounding, 3D scene understanding, video understanding, sensor fusion, or multimodal reasoning.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI systems, tool-using agents, planning frameworks, and memory-based architectures; experience with agentic memory, knowledge graphs, or long-horizon reasoning systems is a plus.
  • Experience with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, OpenUSD/Omniverse, Open3D, PyTorch3D, NeRF/3DGS, or related simulation and 3D stacks.
  • Familiarity with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, planning, MPC, control, teleoperation data pipelines, or policy learning for robotics and autonomous systems.
  • Experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Triton, TensorRT, Docker, W&B, or large-scale training and deployment infrastructure.
  • Background in trustworthy AI, robotics safety, evaluation, or explainability for autonomous systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • Publishable, reproducible, and deployable research that strengthens Centific’s Physical AI portfolio.
  • New technical IP in multimodal AI, simulation, dexterous robotics, autonomous systems, and embodied intelligence.
  • Strong mentorship and research leadership across a growing team.
  • Demonstrable impact on model robustness, large-scale training capability, sim2real performance, manipulation capability, and real-world deployability.

Our Stack

Modeling: PyTorch, JAX, Hugging Face, xFormers

Simulation: Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, OpenUSD, Omniverse, Open3D

Systems: Python, Ray, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Triton, TensorRT

Multimodal AI: CLIP, SAM, VLMs, world models, vision-language-action architectures, agent frameworks

Why Join Centific

Help define Centific’s research direction in Physical AI, publish frontier work, mentor the next generation of researchers, and see your science move into real systems.

How to Apply

Email your CV, publication list, GitHub/Google Scholar, and optional 1-page research statement to

Subject: Principal Research Scientist – Foundation Models, Vision AI & Physical AI

Salary Range: $200,000-$300,000 + OTB

Centific is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Job Summary

The Bill Review Specialist connects our clinical data with strategy. In this role, you will apply specialized expertise in medical data entry, and national repricing systems to analyze complex, high-exposure medical claims and litigation demands. By conducting precise line-item audits, you uncover billing irregularities and deliver clear, defensible insights that attorneys and adjusters rely on to make fair, evidence-based decisions. Your work directly safeguards reimbursement integrity and upholds Dane Street’s reputation for excellence in the legal and healthcare communities.

Mission, Culture and Values

At Dane Street, we believe exceptional employee experiences create exceptional client experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous improvement, accountability, and care.

We care for our customers, we care for our employees, and we care for one another. Every team member plays an important role in creating an environment where people feel respected, supported, empowered to grow, and inspired to do meaningful work.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct regular quality control of reports
  • Software & Payer System Repricing Optimization
  • Apply knowledge of repricing payer guidelines to maximize accuracy and identify erroneous billing/overbilling.
  • Ensure correct application of fee schedules, line-item audits,CCI edits, and clinical validation rules across commercial, auto/PIP, and workers' compensation lines.
  • Translating complex coding systems (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, DRG) into plain language for attorneys.

What Makes this Role Successful

The Bill Review Specialist role combines analytical precision with a sharp eye for clinical coding and reimbursement integrity. You thrive in the details, moving effortlessly between line-item audits and national repricing platforms to spot billing anomalies, unbundling, and fee schedule discrepancies. By consistently applying NCCI edits and clinical validation rules, you ensure every report produced is audit-proof, accurate, and aligned with current payer guidelines. You can also successfully translate dense coding structures into straightforward, plain-language insights that attorneys and adjusters can confidently stand behind during litigation and settlement negotiations.

What Your First 90 Days May Look Like

First 30 days

  • Become familiar with Dane Street's Medical Bill Review processes, systems, and workflows.
  • Learn national repricing systems, payer guidelines, and client-specific requirements.
  • Understand fee schedules, UCR benchmarks, NCCI edits, and coding guidelines.
  • Review sample medical bills and reports to understand quality and accuracy expectations.
  • Become familiar with CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and DRG coding.

First 31-60 days

  • Independently review and audit medical bills and supporting documentation.
  • Identify duplicate, excessive, unsupported, unbundled, or incorrectly billed charges.
  • Apply appropriate fee schedules, repricing guidelines, and coding edits.
  • Prepare accurate and detailed bill review reports.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and turnaround time expectations.
  • Communicate billing discrepancies and findings clearly to the appropriate teams.

First 61-90 days

  • Consistently manage assigned bill review workload with accuracy and efficiency.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in repricing systems and medical billing guidelines.
  • Produce accurate, complete, and defensible reports.
  • Independently identify billing irregularities and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Translate complex billing and coding information into clear, understandable findings.
  • Identify opportunities to improve review accuracy, workflow efficiency, and overall quality.

  • Frequent communication with team members, leadership, and external partners via email, chat, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
  • Occasional moving or positioning of office equipment or files weighing up to 10–15 pounds.

Why Join Dane Street?

  • Professional growth opportunities
  • Meaningful work supporting the healthcare industry
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Great Place to Work Certified since 2021
  • Commitment to employee development

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support your own internet services.

Maintain an uninterrupted internet connection.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

At Dane Street, caring for people is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Requirements

A High School Diploma or equivalent

We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. jobs.title: Director, Communications & Editorial Strategy
jobs.excerpt: About BuildersBuilders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference, grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division.
jobs.description:
About Builders

Builders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference, grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division. Founded by Daniel Lubetzky, our community spans 5M+ citizens, 650M video views, and 400+ movement partners including José Andrés, Katie Couric, Adam Grant, Lonnie Ali, and Karl Rove. Through a growing ecosystem of content, tools, partnerships, and activations, we turn civic engagement into meaningful action, empowering people to participate, collaborate, and deliver real-world impact to enact lasting change.

About the Position

Builders is searching for a communications leader who is already operating in what comes next. This role leads traditional comms/PR and extends into all communication verticals, including CRM, SMS, social, and key campaign messaging. We are looking for a plugged-in leader in the news, politics, media, or lifestyle space who has mastered the fundamentals of earned media and brings deep, trusted relationships across the political media landscape on both sides of the aisle.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own Builders' communications and editorial strategy and lead its earned media operation, driving coverage across national and Texas outlets, independent media, creator, and emerging platforms.

This is a communications-first role with editorial upside. The editorial scope gives the right leader room to shape how Builders thinks and speaks across channels and strengthen our audience strategy.

Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Leadership

  • Set and own Builders' communications strategy, aligning earned media, editorial, and organizational priorities with clear goals and measures of success.
  • Serve as the judgment-setter on if, when, and how Builders engages in cultural, political, and civic conversations at the national and Texas levels.
  • Lead crisis and rapid-response communications, aligning messaging across channels during key news cycles.
  • Develop messaging and communications frameworks for dedicated campaigns and evergreen content, ensuring consistency, clarity, and cross-partisan credibility across all channels.
  • Lead and develop communications and editorial team members and freelancers, setting a high bar for quality, speed, and voice.
  • Own the communications tech stack and champion the thoughtful use of AI tools.
  • Report on coverage, share of voice, and audience impact, using data to make strategic decisions, not just report metrics.

Earned Media and Pitching

  • Lead the proactive earned media operation, identifying story angles, shaping pitches, and securing coverage across national outlets and key regional markets, most notably Texas.
  • Monitor the news and culture cycle in real time to spot reactive opportunities and move credibly and quickly.
  • Treat creators as a core earned media channel, building relationships to reach audiences traditional press does not, in partnership with the Social team.

Political and Media Relationships

  • Bring and expand a network of trust-based relationships with journalists, producers, and editors who cover politics, civic life, and solutions-oriented news, positioning Builders as a go-to source for cross-partisan civic stories.

Editorial Voice and Content

  • Help define and operationalize the "Builders lens": balanced, solution-oriented, values-driven commentary that safeguards organizational reputation and public trust.
  • Distill complex policy and political issues into compelling content with non-partisan framing that moves audiences beyond "us vs. them" thinking and surfaces common ground.
  • Lead the editorial calendar for the Builders and Builders TX newsletters, blog, and SMS, and contribute to social channels, aligning earned media moments with owned content.

Requirements

  • 7-10 years of PR or communications experience, with the majority in earned media (pitching, placing, and managing press) and at least 2 years leading strategy or managing people.
  • A proven pitching track record: you can point to placements you drove in national and major regional outlets, and you know what made them land.
  • Established relationships with political, civic, and national news reporters, producers, bookers, and creators, with demonstrated credibility across the political spectrum, and deep familiarity with the beats, outlets, and fault lines that shape civic life.
  • Experience advising senior leaders on communications strategy, reputation, and rapid response, including supporting executive spokespeople or public figures in media contexts.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and editorial judgment: you can draft or edit a pitch, press release, op-ed, or reactive statement that is clean and compelling under deadline, and you know what will land with a skeptical, politically diverse audience.
  • A servant leader with experience managing team members or freelancers and building a high-performing function, willing to roll up your sleeves and get the work done.
  • A technology-forward mindset and fluency in the modern PR tech stack, including AI tools.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment where priorities shift.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for Builders' cross-partisan mission: you believe most Americans share more common ground than our political moment suggests, and you see reaching both sides of the aisle as a feature, not a constraint.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the Texas political and media landscape, including key outlets, reporters, and civic players.
  • Experience building or growing a trusted editorial voice, publication, or newsletter, including the use of audience analytics.
  • Experience in nonprofit, advocacy, or civic sector communications.

Benefits

What Builders Offers

  • Competitive annual compensation
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision insurance with company coverage options of 100%
  • 25 days Paid Time Off (20 personal, 5 sick)
  • 401K with company match
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • Charitable gift matching program
  • The opportunity to make a real impact through your day-to-day work

EEO

At Builders, we are committed to an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is championed. Builders is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Job Description

The Director, HR Business Partner serves as the senior HR advisor to the Regional Vice President and regional leadership team, translating business priorities into an actionable people strategy across 600+ stores. As a member of the regional leadership team, this role uses workforce insights and business acumen to strengthen leadership capability, build talent pipelines, improve organizational effectiveness, and support regional performance.

The Director leads a team of HR Business Partners and is accountable for consistent, high-quality HR partnership across the region. Working across HR Centers of Excellence, Employee Relations, and Legal, this role anticipates workforce needs and risks, delivers integrated talent solutions, and leads organizational change aligned with regional and enterprise priorities.


What will you do?

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Partner across HR Centers of Excellence to integrate talent acquisition, organizational development, compensation, benefits, and employee relations solutions into a cohesive regional people strategy.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of field operations through regular store and market visits, using firsthand insights to shape regional people strategies and enterprise HR decisions or program design

Talent, Organization & Culture

  • Own regional talent and succession planning, identifying critical roles, talent risks, bench gaps, and development actions that strengthen leadership capability and internal mobility.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to establish workforce and staffing priorities, leadership selection standards, and talent-pipeline strategies.
  • Lead organizational design and change initiatives that align structure, roles, talent, and labor models with current and future business needs.
  • Own the regional engagement and retention strategy, using employee feedback and workforce insights to address the underlying drivers of turnover and performance.
  • Champion an inclusive, high-accountability culture and consistent team member experience across all districts.

Team Leadership & Execution

  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of HR Business Partners, establishing clear priorities, consistent service expectations, and measurable outcomes aligned with regional business needs
  • Build HRBP capability through ongoing coaching, talent development, succession planning, and differentiated performance management
  • Create an effective operating rhythm across the regional HRBP team to identify emerging workforce trends, align priorities, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution across districts
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-impact people matters, coordinating the appropriate Employee Relations, Legal, and HR Center of Excellence partners

Job Title: Master Class - Business Consultant - Life Sciences Commercial (Germany)

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the Life Sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.

We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.

Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.

Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.

The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

    • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
    • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
    • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions
REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
    • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
    • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
    • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
    • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
    • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
    • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team
THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
    • You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
    • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
    • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise
    • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
    • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Compensation

    • Starting Salary: 70,000 EUR
    • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates should be legally authorized to be employed in the EU.

Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. There is no requirement to live near a Veeva office if a candidate is in proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

Sales Assistant – CRM, Sales Support & Pipeline Coordination

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Assistant to support day-to-day sales operations, CRM management, scheduling, pipeline coordination, reporting, proposals, and client communication.

This is a hands-on sales support role designed to keep the sales process organized and moving forward so Account Executives and sales leaders can focus on selling, closing deals, and building client relationships.

You’ll maintain CRM accuracy, coordinate meetings and follow-ups, prepare sales materials, track pipeline activity, and ensure no lead, task, or opportunity falls through the cracks.

What You’ll Own

CRM Management & Pipeline Support

  • Maintain accurate records for leads, contacts, deals, and opportunities
  • Update pipeline stages, activity notes, next steps, and follow-up tasks
  • Work within CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or Pipedrive
  • Identify and clean duplicate, incomplete, or outdated CRM records
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and pipeline visibility
  • Ensure sales activities and next steps are properly documented
  • Flag stalled opportunities and overdue follow-ups

Scheduling & Sales Coordination

  • Schedule discovery calls, sales meetings, product demos, and follow-ups
  • Coordinate calendars across multiple time zones
  • Manage scheduling through Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, or similar tools
  • Handle confirmations, reminders, reschedules, and calendar changes
  • Ensure sales representatives have the necessary context and materials before meetings
  • Keep follow-ups and next steps moving on schedule

Proposals & Sales Documentation

  • Draft, format, proofread, and organize:
    • Proposals
    • Quotes
    • Presentations
    • Sales collateral
    • Client-facing documents
  • Support RFP and RFI preparation when required
  • Create polished materials using Google Slides, PowerPoint, Canva, or similar tools
  • Maintain organized records of contracts and sales documentation
  • Ensure client-facing materials are accurate and professional

Sales Reporting & Pipeline Tracking

  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports
  • Maintain pipeline summaries and leadership dashboards
  • Track:
    • Pipeline movement
    • Sales activity
    • Conversion rates
    • Follow-up completion
  • Assist with sales forecasting and operational reporting
  • Keep reporting data accurate, organized, and accessible
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into pipeline activity

Client Communication & Follow-Up

  • Draft professional follow-up emails, meeting recaps, reminders, and client communications
  • Support inbound lead routing and prospect coordination
  • Track outstanding follow-ups and ensure timely completion
  • Coordinate communication between prospects, sales representatives, and internal teams
  • Maintain a professional customer experience throughout the sales process

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations
  • Coordinate contracts, approvals, documentation, and internal handoffs
  • Support smooth transitions from prospect to customer onboarding
  • Track outstanding internal requirements and task ownership
  • Identify and help resolve administrative bottlenecks affecting deal progression

Requirements

  • 1–2+ years of experience in sales support, sales coordination, administrative support, or operations
  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
    • Pipedrive
  • Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office
  • Experience coordinating meetings, calendars, and sales follow-ups
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational ability
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities
  • Strong follow-through and accountability
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting B2B sales teams or Account Executives
  • Experience preparing proposals, quotes, or sales presentations
  • Familiarity with SDR/BDR and lead-generation workflows
  • Experience in SaaS, agencies, professional services, or other sales-driven businesses
  • Excel or Google Sheets experience with pivot tables, dashboards, and KPI tracking
  • Familiarity with sales forecasting and pipeline reporting

Tools & Platforms

HubSpot | Salesforce | Zoho | Pipedrive | Google Workspace | Microsoft Office | Calendly | Google Slides | PowerPoint | Canva | Excel / Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and naturally detail-oriented
  • Proactively follow up instead of waiting for reminders
  • Enjoy keeping CRMs, calendars, and pipelines organized
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Can manage multiple priorities without sacrificing accuracy
  • Take ownership of tasks through completion
  • Thrive in fast-paced, sales-driven environments
  • Enjoy helping sales teams operate more efficiently

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing the CRM for missing information, upcoming meetings, stalled opportunities, and overdue follow-ups.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate demos and sales calls, prepare proposals and presentations, update pipeline stages, communicate with prospects, maintain reports and dashboards, and ensure Account Executives have everything they need before client conversations.

In short: you keep the sales engine organized, accurate, and moving so the sales team can focus on generating revenue.

What Success Looks Like

  • High CRM accuracy and data cleanliness
  • Consistent completion of sales follow-ups
  • Accurate and timely meeting coordination
  • Error-free proposals and sales documentation
  • Reliable sales reports and dashboards
  • Improved pipeline organization and visibility
  • Smooth sales-to-onboarding handoffs
  • Strong responsiveness and follow-through
  • Positive feedback from Account Executives and sales leadership

Career Growth

This role can provide a path into:

Sales Coordinator | Sales Operations Specialist | Revenue Operations | Account Management | SDR/BDR | Executive Sales Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Task – CRM Cleanup + Proposal Exercise
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have experience in sales support, CRM management, scheduling, pipeline coordination, or sales operations and enjoy keeping teams organized and opportunities moving forward, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and build your career in sales operations while directly supporting a high-performing sales team.

Enterprise Network Engineer

As an Enterprise Network Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, securing, optimizing, and supporting Metronet's enterprise network infrastructure and network security systems. You will help ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of our wired, wireless, WAN, data center, cloud-connected, and remote-site environments while supporting critical business operations across the organization.

This role is ideal for an experienced network professional who has successfully designed, deployed, and supported enterprise-scale network and security solutions within medium to large business environments. You will lead network and security initiatives, manage infrastructure upgrades, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and contribute to the continued modernization of our enterprise technology environment.

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who can take ownership of projects from planning through implementation, work independently with minimal supervision, and bring practical, real-world experience with enterprise networking technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting large-scale firewall deployments, data center networking, routing and switching infrastructures, and multi-site enterprise environments. Success in this role comes from combining strong technical expertise with sound decision-making, problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead the design, deployment, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of enterprise network infrastructure and network security platforms, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, WAN circuits, VPNs, and related technologies.
  • Independently manage assigned network engineering projects from planning and design through implementation, documentation, testing, and operational support.
  • Design and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, and cloud-connected network architectures to support business requirements, remote site connectivity, resiliency, performance, security, and future growth.
  • Develop, maintain, and evolve network and network security standards, reference architectures, implementation practices, and engineering best practices that support scalability, security, and operational excellence across the enterprise.
  • Design, implement, review, and maintain network security controls including firewall policies, ACLs, segmentation, VPN access, NAT, secure management access, zero trust-aligned controls, and access control frameworks.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex network and network security incidents, including routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, DNS, DHCP, WAN, cloud connectivity, performance, availability, and policy-related issues.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews, network access reviews, security policy cleanup, and assist with vulnerability remediation efforts related to network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain network and security documentation including diagrams, standards, configurations, procedures, support records, implementation plans, firewall rule documentation, and maintenance window documentation.
  • Respond to, document, update, and resolve assigned network and security operations tickets in accordance with established service levels, escalation procedures, and change management practices.
  • Drive network growth initiatives, capacity planning, infrastructure refresh projects, technology standardization efforts, and network security platform modernization across the enterprise.
  • Lead and collaborate with vendors, service providers, contractors, security teams, and internal stakeholders to successfully deliver network projects, site deployments, migrations, cutovers, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Occasional travel to Evansville, IN for team meetings and collaboration events (approximately twice per year).
  • All other duties as assigned

JOB QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or better in related field or 4+ years of related network engineering and network security experience minimum.

  • Experience with network security concepts including segmentation, ACLs, least privilege access, secure remote access, zero trust principles, logging, monitoring, and incident response support.

  • Experience with dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, or EIGRP, including route filtering, redistribution, and troubleshooting preferred.
  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies, VPN technologies, WAN provider coordination, and remote-site connectivity preferred.
  • Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining Cisco network devices in enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, security, and data center environments.
  • Understanding of cloud networking and hybrid network connectivity concepts, including public cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and related security controls.
  • Experience with network monitoring, firewall logging, NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, packet analysis, and performance troubleshooting tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex network engineering projects, troubleshoot advanced technical issues, and drive solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to communicate technical and security matters clearly to peers, leadership, vendors, contractors, and non-technical counterparts.

About SSA

Scientific Safety Alliance (SSA) exists to Accelerate Science. Delightfully. Since 2023 we have grown from $0 to $20M EBITDA with no outside equity (#175 on the Inc. 5000).

The Opportunity: Director of Talent

SSA has acquired 28 companies in three and a half years, and our ability to keep growing depends on finding, hiring, and keeping exceptional people. As our Director of Talent, you will oversee SSA's talent acquisition function and build our global talent attraction strategy across every branch in the United States, Puerto Rico, the United Kingdom, and Austria. You will lead our recruiting team and turn a decentralized, branch-by-branch approach to hiring into one scalable, global engine that brings in field service technicians, engineers, scientists, and corporate professionals at the speed our business demands.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who loves both strategy and execution. You will partner closely with branch leaders and the executive team to forecast hiring needs, build pipelines for hard-to-fill technical roles, build an employer brand that attracts top talent in every market where we operate, and give leaders the data they need to make good hiring decisions. You will also play a key part in our acquisition strategy, helping integrate newly acquired teams and planning the talent needed as each branch grows. If you want to build a best-in-class talent function at a fast-growing, employee-owned company, we want to talk to you.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Global talent attraction strategy: Design and execute SSA's global talent attraction strategy across the U.S., Puerto Rico, the U.K., and Austria, defining how and where we find talent in each market and aligning it with business growth, acquisitions, and branch-level forecasts.
  • Talent acquisition oversight: Own SSA's full talent acquisition function, including recruiting operations, sourcing, hiring standards, and candidate experience, for every branch and corporate role.
  • Team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop SSA's team of recruiters; set clear goals, manage priorities across branches, and build a high-performing, accountable culture.
  • Branch partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to branch leaders and executives on workforce planning, role design, compensation positioning, and selection decisions.
  • Technical and field hiring: Build sourcing channels and talent pipelines for hard-to-fill roles such as field service technicians, certification specialists, engineers, and laboratory professionals, including partnerships with technical schools, military transition programs, and industry networks.
  • Process and systems: Standardize the end-to-end recruiting process, from requisition approval through offer; own SSA's applicant tracking system and recruiting technology, and hand new hires off seamlessly to the HR team for onboarding.
  • Global employer brand: Build SSA's employer brand across all of our markets, including careers content, social presence, and candidate messaging, highlighting our employee ownership, culture, and mission to Accelerate Science. Delightfully.
  • Metrics and reporting: Build talent dashboards covering time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and new-hire retention, and use the data to improve results.
  • M&A integration: Support due diligence and integration of acquired companies, including talent assessments, retention of key employees, and post-close hiring plans.

  • Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with employment laws in every country and state where we operate, including EEO, pay transparency, and background check requirements.

  • A documented global talent attraction strategy, with clear sourcing plans for each country and role family.

  • Strong offer acceptance rates and 90-day and first-year retention of new hires.
  • Lower reliance on, and spend with, outside recruiting agencies.
  • Monthly talent reporting delivered to branch and executive leadership.
  • A recruiting team that is well-trained, accountable, and consistently meeting its goals.
  • Acquired companies integrated with key talent retained and hiring plans in place.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of talent acquisition experience, including 3+ years leading a recruiting team.
  • Proven success building a talent attraction or employer branding strategy across multiple countries or regions.
  • Proven success building or scaling a talent function in a high-growth, multi-location organization; experience in a private equity-backed or acquisitive company strongly preferred.
  • Track record of hiring field service, skilled trades, technical, or scientific talent at volume.
  • Experience with recruiting across multiple states and, ideally, internationally (U.K., EU, or Puerto Rico).
  • Strong command of recruiting metrics, with the ability to turn data into action.
  • Experience selecting, implementing, or managing an applicant tracking system and modern recruiting tools.
  • Excellent influencing and communication skills, with credibility among executives, branch leaders, and candidates alike.
  • A builder's mindset: comfortable creating structure where little exists and moving quickly.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred.

Benefits

  • 100% paid Medical Dental & Vision insurance
  • Health insurance (100% for employee and family)

Job Description

Join Us as a Senior Clinical Team Manager within our Internal Medicine Therapeutic Business Unit- Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

The Senior Clinical Trial Manager is accountable for achieving the final clinical deliverable (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. Interprets data on complex issues and makes good business decisions with support from line management. The role involves working to ensure that all clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations, and maintaining profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the clinical team. Typically the Senior Clinical Trial Manager works independently on projects of moderate to high complexity, and may assume regional lead or Clinical Study Manager responsibilities.


The therapeutic scope includes Cardiovascular & Internal Medicine- This need is for Nephrology, Dermatology, GI, (UC/CD), Cardiovascular (in particular Cardiovascular outcome trials), Liver, Nephrology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Diabetes, Obesity, Dyslipidemia, Women's Health, Rheumatology, (RA, SLE, Gout), Endocrinology.


We are currently looking for experienced CTMs who are currently working in at least one or more of the above indications.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage all clinical operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of moderate to high complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Lead CTM responsibilities on regional level, Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities or take on additional responsibilities, e.g. process improvements, manage complex programs, have wider management or project coordination responsibilities.
    •Develop clinical tools (e.g. Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the Data Quality Plan. Contribute to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensure timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborate with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings.
    •Collaborate with the clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicate with the team and leads team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department.
    •Ensure achievement of the final clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitor clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. May routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials.
    •Communicate with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study-related issues.
    •May coordinate all start-up activities, and ensure that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Ensure timely regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Reviews and follows up on all questions raised by ethics committees. Responsibility may vary based on project timelines.
    •Provide input into preparation of forecast estimates for clinical activities.
    •Responsible for clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements.
    •In North America, where assigned to GPHS (Government & Public Health Studies) projects, may have limited line management responsibilities.

    Education & Experience Requirements:
    •Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
    •Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 8+ years).

    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:
    •Strong leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teams.
    •Strong planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload and workload of team members
    •Strong interpersonal and problem solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organization
    •Solid understanding of change management principles
    •Comprehensive understanding of the practices, processes, and requirements of clinical monitoring
    •Strong judgment, decision making, escalation, and risk management skills
    •Effective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiency
    •Capable of evaluating own and team members workload against project budget and adjust resources accordingly
    •Strong financial acumen and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management
    •Strong attention to detail
    •In-depth understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc.
    •Strong computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.
    •Capable of independently managing clinical only studies.


    Why Join Us?

    When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

    Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

Founded in 2017, Lovelytics helps some of the most complex enterprises across Energy & Utilities, Media & Entertainment, Manufacturing, Retail & CPG, Healthcare and Financial Services modernize their data and put AI to work, not in a deck, but in production. We move fast, stay close to the cutting edge, and care more about outcomes than optics.

Our work spans the full data and AI lifecycle: Data Strategy & Advisory, Data Engineering, Analytics & Visualization, Generative AI & ML, and Cloud Migration & Modernization. All of it is delivered primarily on Databricks, with deep partnerships across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

In September 2026, Lovelytics became a CDW company. CDW completed its acquisition on September 25, 2026, bringing our team into its Data & Analytics Practice. Together, we can take customers from data strategy to production AI with a single partner across the full technology lifecycle.

Lovelytics now has 600+ people across the United States, Canada, Argentina, and Colombia, all working exclusively in data and AI. Lovelytics is seeking an experienced Data Architect with SAP expertise to lead the design and delivery of complex data engineering and integration solutions for our clients. South Africa, a role for someone who decides

This opening is for South Africa. Take ten minutes over our website and LinkedIn first. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. If your answers could belong to any company, they will fall at this stage.

The company and the job

Drop Zero Digital is a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person in South Africa who is good at making decisions. The AI image service is our fastest growing line, and your area, whichever it is, will help it along.

You will have one named area. It is chosen in the trial, after we have seen where your strengths lie. It will be one of two:

  1. The hiring machine: how people are found, screened and hired here. The funnel runs through you from sourcing to scheduling, with chasing, an accurate tracker, and a warning to us when the process has a fault.
  2. Client delivery operations: how client work is planned, briefed, chased and shipped. You hold the timelines, brief the team in full and keep tasks from going quiet.

At heart it is one job. You see something slip, decide the answer and close it before being asked.

We want a decider, not an assistant and not a coordinator. Every day brings real calls, and we weigh the quality of them above the volume. We want a team that decides well without management, which means this is not the job for anyone who waits for instructions each morning.

What we need to see in you

  1. You make decisions and answer for them, including bad ones.
  2. You know whose call it is, yours or someone else's, and you get that right either way.
  3. You use feedback and change, without giving up a view you have good reason for.
  4. You get better fast. A person at seventy percent and climbing is worth more than one flat at eighty five.
  5. You tell us when something is failing, even when it is our process at fault.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially when the subject is a problem.

Steps from application to trial

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

Our decision is made in the trial, and so is the choice of your area. You work on live work from week one and hear straight how each decision landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

On experience

No number of years is asked for. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever you list is verified, covering employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. Having held a full-time job in the last 12 months is the one requirement. Beyond that there is no minimum, so a short history costs you nothing. Misrepresenting what you have is disqualifying, and the true account is never held against you.

Requirements

      1. Full time once hired, and it is your only job. During the paid trial you put in 4 hours a day, 2 of them at a fixed time within our working day, and you can keep your current job. Pass, and you give notice and come on full time within 30 days.
      2. Internet you can rely on: minimum 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in South Africa.
      5. You track your working hours in our time tracking tool from the start.

Benefits

1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

For those who earn it, responsibility and pay grow quickly. Authority over decisions that reach a client grows slowly and deliberately, and comes from a track record, not a good first month. We would rather you knew that now than found out two months in.

As a regulated service provider to major financial institutions, SitusAMC is subject to client, regulatory, and contractual obligations governing AI use. This role implements and operates platform configuration to the requirements defined by Information Security and AI GRC. Governance, policy, risk acceptance, control requirements, and independent control assurance remain with those teams, and design and build of enterprise security infrastructure remains with Information Security Architecture and Engineering. The Administrator does not set or self-attest the control baseline. The position works under the direction of senior engineering and architecture staff and provides a foundation for growth into the AI Operations Engineer role.
