jobs.excerpt: Operations Associate, remote from GeorgiaGeorgia is where this hire lives.
jobs.description:
Operations Associate, remote from Georgia

Georgia is where this hire lives. Give our website and LinkedIn ten minutes before you do anything else. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. We reject answers that could be pasted onto any other company.

Who we are

Drop Zero Digital is a lifecycle marketing agency. Right now our AI image service is the quickest growing part of the business, and the person we hire in Georgia will help it grow through whichever area they run.

What you would do

One named area will be yours. The trial decides which, because we want to see where you are strongest first. Your area will be one of these:

  1. Hiring. You own how we find, screen and hire people: the whole funnel, with sourcing, chasing and scheduling, a tracker that tells the truth, and a warning from you when the process itself is faulty.
  2. Client delivery. You own how client work is planned, briefed, chased and shipped: timelines held, briefs that are complete, and nothing allowed to stall unseen.

Both come down to the same thing. You spot what slipped, you pick the fix, and you finish it unprompted.

The role is built on judgement. You will not be assisting, and you will not be coordinating. Each day brings real decisions, and the measure is how well you make them, not how much you clear. Our aim is a team of people who decide well unmanaged, so a job that starts with someone handing out tasks is not this one.

The people who do well here

  1. They decide and carry the consequences, wrong calls included.
  2. They sort their calls from other people's calls and get that boundary right each time.
  3. They take feedback as information and change, without caving on a view they have reason to hold.
  4. They improve fast: seventy percent and rising is worth more to us than eighty five and flat.
  5. They flag failure when they see it, even when the failing thing is our process.
  6. They write honestly and clearly, particularly when the news is bad.

The steps, start to finish

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial carries the decision, including which of the two areas you end up with. Live work begins in week one, and every call you make gets a straight answer from us on how it landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Experience and checks

We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Each employer you name gets verified on dates, title and paid status, using a contract and payslips, in one exchange. We need one full-time job within the last 12 months. We set no other minimum, so a short history is fine. A misrepresented history is not fine, and it disqualifies. The true version, however short, is never penalised.

Requirements

      1. Full time after hire, as your only job. The paid trial is 4 hours a day, of which 2 sit at a fixed time within our working day, and you may stay in your current job throughout. After a pass you give notice and move to full time within 30 days.
      2. Dependable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, checked live together.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in Georgia.
      5. Your working hours are logged in our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

People who earn it see pay and responsibility rise quickly. Decisions that reach a client are handed over slowly and deliberately, on the strength of a record and never on a good first month. You should hear that now, not discover it in month two.

iVigee is a physician-lead pharmacovigilance exclusive company, combining deep regulatory expertise with AI-enabled tools (such as iViReg, iViTracker, iViSight) to support clients' drug safety life cycles.

Founded in 2021, all our leaders have years of experience in all areas of pharmacovigilance - science, regulations, and technology. Our acquisition strategy allows us to attract and choose both the best global talent, and companies.

Our world leading Pharmacovigilance Intelligence platform iViReg is the first to truly focus on the needs of PV professionals, and as we open that system up with our AI interface, we continue to embrace the current and future needs of the pharmacovigilance community and demonstrate our commitment to it.

With strategic centres of excellence in Europe and the US, and our network of experts in over 150 countries, we service the complex global needs of our clients with speed and ease.

Trustworthy professionals

Our competence gives us confidence that we will deliver on our promises. We do it with integrity and quality that earns trust. We do it with a smile, as we love our work that makes our clients happy, saves life and prevents harm.

Enabling innovation

Best practices and tools are giving us our competitive advantage. We are early adopters. We iterate frequently to be better than yesterday, every day.

Sustainable manner

We are interested in long-term relationships, lasting solutions, and good work-life balance. We improve our environment, support communities, raise talent, and build our company to last.

As a company applying the Topgrading methodology, we conduct a thorough recruitment process covering your career history, achievements, challenges, important decisions and key professional relationships. At the final stage, shortlisted candidates will be asked to arrange reference calls with selected former supervisors.

Team working

English (fluent)

The team

You’ll be supported by 11 experienced mentors and team leads, focused on coaching and development.

There are clear progression pathways into Senior Account Manager roles, specialist positions, and management, with many team members advancing internally.

Please see the link below to learn more about Conor’s career journey, progressing from a Customer Service Agent to a management role within our organisation.

iwoca.co.uk/inside-iwoca/life-as-a-customer-success-mentor-at-iwoca

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

ᐱᔭᕆᐊᖃᒻᒪᕆᒃᑐᖅ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᕐᒥᒃ ᐊᔪᙱᓐᓂᖃᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᖅ: ᑖᓐᓇ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑦ ᐅᖃᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕆᐊᓕᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᕐᓗᒋᑦ ᑲᒪᒋᔭᐅᔪᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑐᐊᖅ ᐅᖃᓪᓚᒍᓐᓇᖅᑐᑦ. ᖃᐅᔨᒪᓂᐊᖅᐳᓯ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅᑖᕋᓱᒃᑐᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᑦ ᐅᖃᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᙱᑦᑐᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᒋᔭᐅᔪᓐᓇᔾᔮᙱᑦᑐᑦ.

CCA−ᑯᓐᓂ, ᓇᓗᓇᐃᖅᓯᒃᑲᓐᓂᖅᐳᒍᑦ ᖃᓄᖅ ᑲᑎᖅᓱᖅᑕᐅᔪᓐᓇᕐᒪᖔᑕ. ᐃᓄᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᒃᐱᒍᓱᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒃᐳᒍᑦ, ᑐᓴᐅᒪᖃᑎᒌᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒃᖢᑕ, ᑕᐅᑐᒐᖃᓪᓗᐊᑕᖅᖢᑕᓗ ᓇᓂᓯᓇᓱᒃᖢᑕ ᐋᖅᑭᒍᑎᒃᓴᓪᓚᑦᑖᓂᒃ−ᐊᑭᓖᓇᓱᑐᐃᓐᓇᙱᖦᖢᑕ.

ᐅᒃᐱᕆᔭᖃᕈᕕᑦ ᓇᒡᓕᒍᓱᖕᓂᖅ ᐊᑑᑎᖃᕐᓂᖓᓂᒃ, ᐱᓗᐊᙳᐊᖅᖢᓂ ᑭᓇᑐᐃᓐᓇᕐᒥᒃ ᐊᒃᓱᕈᕐᓇᖅᑐᒃᑰᖅᑐᖃᖅᑎᓪᓗᒍ ᐃᓅᓯᕐᒥᓂ, ᑖᓐᓇ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅ ᐱᕕᒃᓴᖃᖅᑎᑦᑎᕗᖅ ᑐᑭᖃᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᒥᒃ ᐊᒃᑐᖅᓯᓂᖃᕈᓐᓇᕐᓂᕐᒥᒃ. ᑲᑎᖃᑎᖃᖃᑦᑕᕐᓂᐊᖅᐳᑎᑦ ᐃᓄᖕᓂᒃ, ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᐃᕙᒡᓗᑎᑦ, ᓈᓚᒃᐸᒡᓗᑎᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᖅᑐᖅᑕᐅᙱᓪᓗᑎᑦ, ᐃᑲᔪᖅᐸᒡᓗᒋᓪᓗ ᐊᔪᕆᖅᓲᔾᔨᕙᒡᓗᑎᑦ ᑮᓇᐅᔭᑎᒍᑦ ᐊᒃᓱᕈᕐᓇᖅᑐᒃᑰᖅᑎᓪᓗᒋᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᔨᒻᒪᕆᐅᓗᑎᒃ ᐃᒃᐱᒋᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒡᓗᒋᓪᓗ.

ᕿᓂᖅᑐᒍᑦ ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᓕᕆᔨᒥᒃ ᑐᑭᓯᐅᒪᔪᒥᒃ ᐱᒻᒪᕆᐅᓂᖓᓂᒃ ᑐᓴᐅᒪᖃᑎᒌᖕᓂᖅ, ᐅᒃᐱᕆᔭᐅᓂᖅ, ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᖅ ᓄᓇᕗᒻᒥ ᓄᓇᓕᖕᓂ. ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅᑖᖅᑐᖅ ᐊᑐᕐᓂᐊᖅᑐᖅ ᖃᓪᓗᓈᑎᑐᑦ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᓪᓗ ᐅᖃᐅᓯᕐᒥᓂᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᕐᓂᕐᒥᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᑦᑐᓂᑦ ᐃᑉᐱᒍᓱᑦᓯᐊᕐᓂᕐᒥᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒍᑎᑦᓴᓂᓪᓗ ᑐᕌᒐᖃᕐᓂᕐᒥᑦ ᐅᖃᖃᑎᒌᓐᓂᕐᒥᑦ.

ᑭᓱᓕᕆᔨᐅᖕᒪᖔᑦ

ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᓕᕆᔨᐅᓗᑎᑦ, ᐃᒪᐃᓕᐅᖃᑦᑕᕐᓂᐊᖅᐳᑎᑦ:

  • ᐅᖃᖃᑎᒋᓗᒋᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᑦ ᐊᑭᓖᙱᖦᖢᑎᒃ − ᐃᓚᖏᑦ ᖃᖓᑦᑎᐊᓵᖅ, ᐃᓚᖏᑦ ᐊᑯᓂᐅᔪᒃᑯᑦ
  • ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᓗᓂ ᖃᐅᔨᒋᐊᕐᕕᒃᓴᒥᒃ ᑎᑭᑉᐸᓪᓕᐊᔪᓄᑦ ᐊᓂᕙᓪᓕᐊᔪᓄᓪᓗ ᐅᖄᓚᔪᓄᑦ
  • ᐱᓕᕆᕙᒡᓗᓂ ᑐᑭᓯᓇᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᐊᑐᐊᒐᕐᓂᒃ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᓯᕐᓂᒃ ᐊᔾᔨᒌᒃᑎᑦᑎᔪᓂᒃ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒋᐊᕈᑎᒃᓴᓂᒃ
  • ᐋᔩᖃᑎᖃᖅᐸᒡᓗᓂ ᐊᑭᓕᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᑕᐅᓯᒪᔪᓂᒃ ᒪᓕᒡᓗᓂ ᐱᓕᕆᕝᕕᒋᔭᐅᕙᒃᑐᒧᑦ ᑲᒻᐸᓂᒋᔭᐅᔪᒧᓪᓗ ᒪᓕᒃᑕᐅᔭᕆᐊᖃᖅᐸᒃᑐᓄᑦ
  • ᖃᐅᔨᓴᖅᐸᒡᓗᓂ ᐅᖃᐅᔾᔪᐃᕙᒡᓗᓂᓗ ᐊᑭᓕᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐱᕙᒌᔭᖅᑕᐅᓯᒪᔪᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓕᖅᑎᑦᑎᓂᕐᒧᓪᓗ ᐊᑐᖅᑕᐅᖔᕈᓐᓇᖅᑐᓂᒃ
  • ᖃᐅᔨᒋᐊᕐᕕᐅᓗᑎᑦ/ᑐᑦᑕᕐᕕᒋᔭᐅᓗᑎᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᒃᓴᕆᑎᑕᐅᔪᒧᑦ ᑮᓇᐅᔭᖁᑎᖃᕐᕕᒋᔭᕐᓄᑦ
  • ᑎᑎᕋᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᓗᒋᑦ ᐅᖄᓚᔪᑦ ᑕᒻᒪᖅᑕᙱᓪᓗᑎᒃ ᒪᓕᒡᓗᑎᒡᓗ ᒪᓕᒋᐊᓕᖕᓂᑦ
  • ᐊᐅᓚᑉᐸᒡᓗᒋᑦ ᐅᖄᓚᔪᑦ ᓇᓗᖅᑯᑎᙱᓪᓗᑎᑦ, ᓈᓚᑦᑎᐊᖅᐸᒡᓗᑎᑦ, ᑐᑭᓯᓇᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒡᓗ ᑭᒡᓕᒋᑎᑕᐅᔪᓂᒃ
  • ᐊᑐᕐᓗᒋᑦ CCA−ᑯᑦ ᐱᓇᓱᐊᑦᑎᐊᕆᐊᖃᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᒪᓕᒋᐊᓕᖏᑦ ᑲᒪᒋᓗᒋᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᓕᒫᑦ ᓱᓕᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᑎᒃ, ᓱᓕᓗᑎᒃ, ᐱᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᑎᒃ, ᐊᒻᒪ ᐃᒃᐱᒍᓱᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᑎᒃ..

ᑭᓱᒥᒃ ᓇᒃᓴᕐᒪᖔᖅᐱᑦ

ᕿᓂᖅᑐᒍᑦ ᐃᓄᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᒪᐃᑦᑐᓂᒃ:

  • ᖃᓪᓗᓇᐅᔭᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕆᐊᓕᒃ ᐃᓄᒃᑎᑐᓪᓗ ᑖᔅᓱᒧᖓ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᒧᑦ ᑐᓴᐅᒪᖃᑎᖃᕆᐊᖃᖕᓂᖓᓄᑦ ᓄᓇᕗᒻᒥᐅᓂᑦ ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᓂᑦ.
  • ᐋᔩᖃᑎᖃᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐊᑲᐅᙱᓕᐅᕈᑕᐅᔪᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᔪᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ
  • ᓇᖕᒥᓂᖅ−ᐱᓇᔪᒍᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᓂ, ᑐᕌᕆᔭᖃᕈᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᓂ, ᐃᓗᓕᓕᒫᖏᓐᓂᒡᓗ ᑕᐅᑐᒐᖃᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ
  • ᐃᓕᖅᑯᓯᖃᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᖅ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓕᕆᔨᒻᒪᕆᐅᓂᖅ ᑕᒪᐃᓐᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᒍᓯᕐᓂᒃ
  • ᐊᑲᐅᒃᓴᕐᓗᓂ ᐃᓄᑑᓗᓂ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕆᐊᒃᓴᖅ ᓱᒃᑲᓕᔪᒥᒡᓗ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᒃᑐᓂ ᐊᕙᑎᓕᖕᒥ
  • ᖃᕋᓴᐅᔭᓕᕆᔪᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᕐᓗᓂ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐊᔾᔨᒌᙱᑦᑐᓂᑦ ᖃᕆᓴᐅᔭᓕᕆᔾᔪᑎᓂᑦ ᐊᑐᕈᓐᓇᕐᓗᓂ

ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑦᑕᖅᓯᒪᓂᑰᓗᓂ ᐊᑮᑦᑐᐃᔭᐃᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᓂᐅᕕᖅᐸᒃᑐᓂᒃ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᕐᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᐅᖄᓚᕝᕕᐅᕙᒃᑐᓂᒡᓘᓐᓃᑦ ᐱᕚᓪᓕᕈᑕᐅᔪᓐᓇᖅᐳᖅ ᑭᓯᐊᓂ ᑕᐃᒪᐃᑦᑕᕆᐊᖃᙱᖦᖢᓂ. ᐃᓕᑦᑎᔪᒪᑦᑎᐊᕈᕕᑦ, ᐱᕈᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᔪᒪᒍᕕᑦ, ᐊᓯᔾᔩᔪᒪᒍᕕᓪᓗ, ᑐᓴᕐᕕᒋᔪᒪᕙᑦᑎᒋᑦ.

ᖃᓄᖅ ᐃᓕᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᐃᕙᖕᒪᖔᑦᑕ

ᖃᐅᔨᒪᔪᒍᑦ ᑕᒪᓐᓇ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᖅ ᐊᒃᓱᕈᕐᓇᕈᓐᓇᕐᓂᖓᓂᒃ, ᑕᐃᒪᐃᓐᓂᖓᓄᓪᓗ ᓴᓇᓯᒪᕗᒍᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕐᕕᒋᔭᐅᔪᒥᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᑐᐃᔪᒥᒃ ᑲᔪᓯᓂᖃᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᕆᔭᕐᓂᒃ ᖃᓄᐃᙱᑦᑎᐊᕈᓐᓇᕐᓂᕐᓂᒃᓗ, ᐱᓕᕆᔨᓪᓚᕆᐅᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᓇᖕᒥᓂᕐᓗ. ᐅᕝᕙᐅᑯᐊ ᓇᓂᔪᓐᓇᖅᑕᑎᑦ CCA−ᑯᓐᓂ:

  • ᐊᑭᓕᖅᑐᖅᑕᐅᓗᑎᑦ ᐱᓕᒻᒪᒃᓴᖅᑎᑕᐅᓗᑎᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓚᐃᓴᓐᓯᑖᕐᓗᑎᑦ ᖁᓱᙱᓪᓗᑎᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᕙᒌᔭᖅᓯᒪᓗᑎᑦ ᐱᒋᐊᕐᓂᖓᓂ
  • ᐅᓪᓗᓕᒫᒧᑦ ᐃᑲᕐᕋᑦ, ᐃᓚᐅᓪᓗᑎᒃ 8:00−ᒥᑦ ᐅᓪᓛᒃᑯᑦ 4:30−ᒧᑦ ᐅᓐᓄᒃᓴᒧᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᐱᓇᓱᐊᕈᓯᐅᑉ ᓄᙳᐊᓂᑦ ᓇᓖᕌᒐᒃᓴᑦ
  • ᐊᑭᑦᑐᕋᐅᑎᓂᒃᑯᑦ ᐊᑭᓕᖅᑕᐅᔾᔪᑎᑦ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓂᖏᑦ ᑐᓂᓯᓲᑦ ᐱᓕᕆᐊᕐᓄᑦ ᓈᒻᒪᒃᑐᒃᑯᑦ
  • ᑲᑎᙵᔪᓄᑦ ᐱᕚᓪᓕᕈᑎᒃᓴᓄᑦ ᐸᕐᓇᐅᑎᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᖃᓄᐃᙱᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐊᒻᒪ ᓴᐃᓕᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐃᓱᒪᒃᑯᑦ
  • ᑐᙵᓇᕐᓂᖅ, ᐃᓚᐅᑎᑦᑎᓂᖅ, ᐃᑲᔪᖅᓱᐃᓂᕐᓗ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᑦ ᐃᓕᖅᑯᓯᖃᕐᓂᖅ ᑕᒫᓃᑉᐳᒍᑦ ᐃᑲᔪᖃᑦᑕᐅᑎᔪᒪᓪᓗᑕ ᑲᔪᓯᑦᑎᐊᕐᓂᕐᒧᑦ
  • ᐊᕙᑎᒧᑦ ᓈᒻᒪᒃᑐᖅ ᓄᒃᑕᕐᓂᖅ (ᐊᖏᕐᕋᒥ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔭᕐᓂᖅ)
  • ᐱᕕᒃᓴᐃᑦ ᐱᕈᖅᐸᓪᓕᐊᓂᕐᒧᑦ ᐱᕙᓪᓕᐊᓂᕐᒧᓪᓗ, ᐊᑯᓂᐅᔪᒃᑯᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᕆᔪᒪᔭᕐᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓱᐃᕙᓪᓕᐊᒍᕕᑦ ᐅᕝᕙᓘᓐᓃᑦ ᐱᕚᓪᓕᕐᓂᐊᕈᕕᑦ ᐱᒻᒪᕆᐅᔪᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑦᑕᖅᓯᒪᓂᑰᓂᕐᒥᒃ
  • ᐱᓕᕆᓪᓚᑦᑖᕐᓗᑎᒃ ᐃᓕᑦᑎᕙᓪᓕᐊᓂᖅ ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᖃᐅᑎᓄᑦ ᐅᓂᒃᑳᓕᐅᕐᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᐊᑭᓕᒃᓴᖃᐅᑎᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓱᐃᓂᕐᒥᒃ, ᓇᖕᒥᓂᕐᓗ ᑮᓇᐅᔭᓂᒃ ᐊᑐᖅᑐᒃᓴᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓱᐃᓂᕐᒥᒃ
  • ᐱᓕᕆᖃᑎᒌᑦ ᓯᕗᓕᖅᑎᖏᑦ ᑐᑭᓯᐅᒪᔪᑦ ᐃᖅᑲᓇᐃᔮᒥᒃ ᐊᖏᖅᓯᒪᑦᑎᐊᖅᖢᑎᒡᓗ ᐃᓕᖕᓂᒃ ᐃᑲᔪᕈᒪᓪᓗᑎᒃ ᑲᔪᓯᔪᓐᓇᑦᑎᐊᖁᓪᓗᑎᑦ
  • ᑐᑭᓯᓇᑦᑎᐊᖅᑐᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᑎᒃᓴᓂᒃ ᐱᓕᕆᔾᔪᑕᐅᓂᐊᖅᑐᓂᒡᓗ ᖃᐅᔨᒪᔾᔪᑎᒃᓴᓂᒃ ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓕᖅᑎᑕᕐᓄᑦ ᐊᔾᔨᒌᒡᔫᒥᑎᑦᑎᔾᔪᑕᐅᔪᓐᓇᖅᑐᓂᒡᓗ

ᖃᐅᔨᒋᐊᒃᑲᓐᓂᕆᑦ ᐱᔨᑦᑎᕋᕐᓂᕆᕙᒃᑕᑦᑎᓐᓂᒃ ᐅᕙᓂ cca.ca

Mandatory Language Proficiency: This position requires complete fluency in Inuktitut in order to support clients who speak only Inuktitut. Please note that applications from candidates without proven Inuktitut fluency cannot be considered.

At CCA, we’re redefining what collections can be. We treat people with respect, communicate with clarity, and focus on finding real solutions—not just chasing payments.

If you believe compassion matters, especially when someone’s going through a tough time in their lives, this role offers a chance to make a meaningful impact. You’ll connect with individuals, to offer support, listen without judgement, and help guide them through financial challenges with professionalism and respect.

We are looking for a Collections Officer who understands the importance of communication, trust, and relationship-building within Nunavut communities. The successful candidate will use their English and Inuktitut language skills to support consumers through respectful and solution-focused conversations.

What the Role Involves

As a Collections Officer, you will:

  • Speak with consumers who’ve missed payments—some recently, some long-term
  • Establish contact through inbound and outbound calls
  • Work within clear policy and process to offer fair and firm solutions
  • Negotiate payment arrangements in accordance with client and company guidelines
  • Investigate and advise on payment plans and settlement options
  • Serve as the contact/liaison for your assigned account portfolio
  • Document calls accurately and meet compliance standards
  • Manage each call with confidence, an empathetic ear, and clear boundaries
  • Uphold the CCA Code of Conduct by treating every consumer with integrity, honesty, dignity, and respect..

What You Bring

We’re looking for individuals who are:

  • Fluency in English and Inuktitut is required for this role due to the need to communicate with Nunavut-based consumers.
  • Skilled in negotiation and conflict resolution
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and detail-focused
  • Ethical and professional in all interactions
  • Comfortable working independently and in a fast-paced team environment
  • Proficient with computers and able to navigate multiple software programs

Experience in collections, customer service, or call centers is a bonus but not required. If you're eager to learn, grow, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

How We Support You

We know this work can be challenging, so we’ve built a workplace that supports your success and well-being, professionally and personally. Here’s what you’ll find at CCA:

  • Paid training and licensing to help you feel confident and prepared from day one
  • Full-time hours, including standard 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM shifts and prime-time weekday options
  • Competitive commission structure that rewards your performance fairly
  • Group benefit plan to support your health and peace of mind
  • Friendly, inclusive, and supportive team culture we’re here to help each other succeed
  • Eco-friendly commute (Work from Home)
  • Opportunities for growth and development, whether you’re building a long-term career or gaining valuable experience
  • Hands-on learning in credit reporting, credit repair, and personal budgeting
  • Team leaders who understand the job and are committed to helping you thrive
  • Clear tools and frameworks that guide your decisions and keep things consistent

We believe in treating our team members with the same respect and care we offer to our clients. When you join CCA, you’re not just starting a job—you’re joining a team that values your voice, your growth, and your well-being.

Conditions of Employment

  • To meet provincial licensing requirements, you must have a work permit (at least 6 months of validity remaining at time of application), permanent residency, or be a Canadian Citizen.
  • Be available for full-time work.
  • Criminal Record Check is required for successful candidates

Our Story

Since 1991, Commercial Credit Adjusters Ltd. has been a trusted leader in Accounts Receivable Management across Canada. We specialize in ethical, effective collection solutions tailored to both businesses and consumers. Our commitment to professionalism, integrity, and results has earned us a reputation for excellence in the industry. Learn more about our services at cca.ca

Job Title: Senior Systems Analyst – HR Technology Services (HRTS)

Job Location: Remote, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

About the Role

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific's Human Resources Technology Services (HRTS) team as a Senior Systems Analyst supporting the delivery of complex HR technology initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M&A), Phase X implementations, Workday enhancements, integrations, and other strategic projects.

This role combines strong HR technology and data expertise with hands-on project coordination, business analysis, and testing leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with HR, Payroll, IT, technical teams, and external partners to translate business requirements into actionable plans, coordinate activities across multiple workstreams, and drive successful implementation.


Job Summary

The Senior Systems Analyst will support and coordinate complex Workday and HR technology initiatives from requirements gathering through testing, deployment, and stabilization.

This position requires a strong understanding of Workday, HR and Payroll processes, employee data, and downstream system dependencies, along with exceptional analytical and organizational skills. The individual will be responsible for bringing structure to complex bodies of work, tracking progress, anticipating risks and dependencies, facilitating issue resolution, and ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility into activities and next steps.

The role will also play an important part in developing and coordinating end-to-end testing strategies, particularly for initiatives involving multiple Workday functional domains, integrations, data conversion, and downstream applications.


Responsibilities

Business Analysis & HR Technology

  • Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, business stakeholders, and technical teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for Workday and related HR technology initiatives.
  • Analyze HR business processes, Workday functionality, and employee data to identify gaps, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications and coordinate with Workday domain architects, integration developers, and other technical resources to support solution design and implementation.
  • Understand Workday data structures, business processes, integrations, and downstream system dependencies sufficiently to identify potential impacts and facilitate cross-functional discussions.
  • Support data conversion activities, including data mapping, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, mass data loads, and downstream integration readiness.
  • Analyze large data sets using Excel and other analytical tools to identify discrepancies, validate results, troubleshoot issues, and support business decisions.

Project & Delivery Coordination

  • Coordinate defined bodies of work across M&A integrations, Phase X initiatives, Workday enhancements, integrations, Time & Absence, and other HR technology projects.
  • Develop and maintain detailed activity trackers, schedules, milestones, action items, and dependencies in alignment with broader project plans and timelines.
  • Proactively follow up with functional and technical teams to track commitments, identify blockers, resolve issues, and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Coordinate requirements gathering, solution discussions, implementation sequencing, testing readiness, and deployment activities across multiple workstreams.
  • Identify risks, issues, and downstream impacts; communicate status and recommended actions to project leads and stakeholders.
  • Facilitate working sessions and status meetings to ensure clear ownership, timely decisions, and accountability for deliverables.
  • Partner with project managers, solution architects, and domain leads to support implementation planning, change assessments, and production readiness.

Testing & Implementation Readiness

  • Coordinate end-to-end testing activities across Workday functional domains, integrations, downstream systems, and business stakeholders, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing.
  • Support development of testing strategies, scenarios, timelines, and execution plans to ensure appropriate coverage of business processes, employee populations, data flows, and downstream impacts.
  • Ensure testing prerequisites are identified and addressed, including access, test data, environments, scenarios, expected results, and resource availability.
  • Track testing progress, defects, blockers, risks, and outstanding decisions, driving follow-up and resolution across functional and technical teams.
  • Analyze defects and data discrepancies to identify potential impacts across related scenarios, employee populations, integrations, and downstream processes.
  • Facilitate testing status and defect triage meetings, ensuring clear ownership, priorities, and timely resolution.
  • Maintain visibility into overall testing health, completion status, unresolved risks, and readiness for deployment.
  • Support cutover preparation, production validation, and post-implementation stabilization activities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience supporting enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) systems, HR technology implementations, business analysis, or related initiatives.
  • Strong experience with Workday HCM, including an understanding of core HR processes, reporting, employee data, business processes, and cross-functional system dependencies.
  • Strong knowledge of HR and Payroll business processes and how employee data flows between Workday and downstream applications.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex Workday implementations, M&A integrations, enterprise enhancements, or other large-scale HR technology initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience working with large data sets, performing data analysis, reconciliation, and validation using Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience coordinating activities across multiple functional and technical teams, managing dependencies, tracking progress, and driving timely completion of deliverables.
  • Experience supporting requirements gathering, functional analysis, testing, data conversion, and implementation activities.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners.
  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and ability to proactively identify issues, drive follow-up, and operate effectively in a fast-paced global environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating or leading complex Workday SIT, UAT, regression testing, or end-to-end testing activities.
  • Experience with testing management, defect tracking, test scenario development, and cross-system impact analysis.
  • Experience supporting M&A integrations, Phase X implementations, or divestitures.
  • Knowledge of Workday integrations, including EIBs, PECI, WECI, PICOF, and related downstream HR/Payroll systems.
  • Experience with ADP GlobalView or other enterprise payroll platforms.
  • Experience supporting Workday Reporting, Time Tracking, Absence Management, Security, or other HCM functional domains.
  • Proficiency with Smartsheet or similar project and testing coordination tools.

Success in this Role

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical, organized, and proactive HR technology professional who combines strong Workday and HR process knowledge with the ability to coordinate complex initiatives across multiple teams. They anticipate dependencies, connect issues across systems and workstreams, drive accountability, and maintain clear visibility into progress and risks. They are comfortable working independently, managing detailed execution activities, and helping ensure successful testing and delivery without requiring extensive direction or oversight.

jobs.excerpt: About BEAMONBEAMON is the AI workspace for lawyers.
jobs.description:
About BEAMON

BEAMON is the AI workspace for lawyers. Draft, review and research with legal AI you can trust, connected to the legal content lawyers already rely on and to a workflow engine that turns AI output into finished legal work.

700 clients in 10 months. That is how fast law firms and legal teams are moving to BEAMON.

  • Built for lawyers, not adapted for them. Assist, Draft (in Word) and Extract cover the daily work: research, drafting, redlining, contract review at scale.

  • Content no one else has. We were the fastest growing independent European AI assistant to integrate content from legal publishers, starting with Dr. Otto Schmidt.

  • The European challenger. Others have the headlines. We grow fast anyways.

The master plan:

  1. Own DACH. Become the default legal AI for every small and medium law firms and legal teams in Germany and Austria.

  2. Win multiple verticals. Lawyers, legal teams, notaries and municipalities. We help small teams win big – with BEAMON.

  3. Set the standard. Make BEAMON the benchmark for how legal experts work with AI.

We're early. Most of the work is ahead of us, so we are building a world-class team.

The opportunity: Event & Community Manager

Your job: make BEAMON the legal AI that German-speaking lawyers have met in person. When a Kanzlei partner thinks legal AI, they remember the dinner, the roadshow stop or the webinar where it clicked. And the BEAMON people who were in the room.

Harvey and Legora buy the headlines. We win the people.

You'll start by building our events engine across Germany and Austria including. webinars, and intimate dinners with partners, clients and prospects. Then you go bigger: blockbuster events and product launches people talk about. You know that in legal, trust is personal. A managing partner won't come to a "networking event". She will come to a dinner with six peers, a sharp topic and a host who knows her name. That instinct is your unfair advantage.

This is a role with senior-level ownership from day one. Nobody will hand you an event calendar. You build it, along with the playbooks, the supplier list and the budget that let it scale.

Every event we run meets YOUR standard. If it doesn't feel like BEAMON, it doesn't happen. If you nail it, you'll grow into leading events and community for BEAMON as we scale.

Full-time, remote, based in Germany or Austria. Hybrid if you are in Vienna. Frequent travel is part of the job.

This is a role that requires proactiveness, creativity and ownership. You’ll report to me, Chris (Head of Growth). I ask a lot and together we will achieve a lot.

You'll work closely with me (Chris, Head of Growth), Co-founder & CEO (Michael Grupp), Marketing, Sales, and our partners.

What you'll own

Because of you, lawyers and legal teams meet BEAMON, trust it and start a trial.

  • Events portfolio. You plan and run the full range: roadshows and webinars with partners, executive dinners and roundtables, flagship events, and BEAMON's presence at third-party conferences. In Germany, Austria and beyond.

  • Invites and outreach. You own the guest list. You reach the prospects, clients, partners and legal influencers we want in the room, and you get them there. You don't take no for an answer: a polite no is the start of the conversation.

  • Community. You are the focal point of the BEAMON community. You know our members by name, keep them engaged between events, and turn happy clients into champions who host, speak and bring peers.

  • Logistics and on-site. Scheduling, registrations, participant communication, Know Before You Go, speaker and staff briefings. On the day, you run the room and nothing falls through.

  • Budget and suppliers. You own event budgets, venues, caterers, agencies and contracts. You negotiate hard and every euro shows up in pipeline.

  • Content and brand. With the Legal Content Marketer, you create event identities, invites, promotional content and recaps that keep working after the lights go off. Every touchpoint looks and feels BEAMON.

  • Performance. You track every event from invite to pipeline and report back within a week. You know which formats work, and you kill the ones that don't.

How we measure success

Your success shows in pipeline and in who is in the room.

KPIs:

Primary| Event-sourced pipeline: Trials and demos where an event or community touchpoint was a touchpoint
Secondary| Audience quality:Share of attendees who are decision makers at target firms and legal teams, and show rate vs. registrations
Event ROI: Pipeline generated per euro of event spend

Events live: Hosted events, roadshow stops and webinars per quarter

Partner events: Events co-hosted with partners per quarter

Need to have

  • Events. 5+ years of B2B event marketing and management. You've run event programs, not just single events, from 10-person dinners to 300-person flagships. We love the challenge and scary timelines.

  • Organized under pressure. You run several events at once, and nothing falls through. You live by run-of-show docs, checklists and deadlines.

  • Budgets and suppliers. You've owned event budgets, managed venues and agencies, and negotiated contracts that held.

  • Bold. You want to BEAMON to be known for the super-cool events.

  • Ownership. Strong work ethic. You don't wait for a brief, you are proactive and want to see your ideas come to live (not mine ;) ) – because you know what great looks like.

  • Languages and location. Native German, English at C1 or better. Based in Germany or Austria.

Extra points for

  • Network. You already know people in the DACH legal scene: bar associations, legal tech meetups, publishers, in-house communities.

  • Partners and agencies. You've co-hosted events with partners or publishers and know how to get the best out of agencies.

What you get

  • A competitive salary according to your seniority level.

  • VSOP shares in the company

  • Learning budget, hardware, wellbeing contribution and more.

  • Exposure across every area of legal AI marketing, and a fast track to grow with BEAMON.

jobs.excerpt: Indonesia needs someone who can make the callLiving in Indonesia and ready to own decisions?
jobs.description:
Indonesia needs someone who can make the call

Living in Indonesia and ready to own decisions? Start by spending ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that would suit any other employer do not get through.

Who gets on well with us

  1. Owns decisions, and owns them still when they turn out badly.
  2. Sees where their remit ends and someone else's begins, and is accurate about that edge from both sides.
  3. Hears criticism as useful information and shifts, but keeps a view that has solid reasons behind it.
  4. Gets better at pace. Seventy percent and climbing is worth more to us than eighty five and stuck.
  5. Raises the alarm when something is going wrong, even when the cause sits in our own process.
  6. Puts things in writing plainly and honestly, particularly the bad news.

What the work is

Drop Zero Digital is a lifecycle marketing agency, and in Indonesia we are taking on one person with a talent for deciding. Our AI image service is the fastest growing thing we sell, so wherever you land, you are helping that service grow.

A single named area will be yours. We assign it once the trial has shown what you do best, and it will be one of these:

  1. Hiring. You look after how we find, screen and take on people, running the funnel from sourcing through chasing and scheduling, keeping the tracker accurate, and telling us straight when the process itself needs fixing.
  2. Client delivery. You look after how client work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped, keeping to deadlines, giving the team a full brief and making sure nothing sits stuck.

The core is identical in both. Spot the slip, pick a response, finish the job without waiting for a nudge.

Do not expect an assistant seat or a coordinator seat. Real decisions arrive daily and we grade you on how sound they are, not on the size of your pile. Our plan is a team that decides well unmanaged, so a job that begins each morning with someone telling you what to do will disappoint you.

The steps, in order, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

In the trial we make our decision, and we also fix which of the two areas is yours. You are on live work from week one, with a frank account from us of each call. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

About your experience

We ask for no number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

For whichever roles you name, we verify employer, dates, title and paid status through a contract and payslips, all in one exchange. One full-time job inside the last 12 months is required. Past that, a short history is fine. If you misstate the history you have, you are disqualified, and an honest short account is never held against you.

Requirements

      1. Full time after hire, and this job is your only one. On the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 at a fixed time inside our working day, and your present job can continue. If you pass, you give notice and join full time within 30 days.
      2. Reliable internet of at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in Indonesia.
      5. Your working time goes into our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1000 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Those who earn it see pay and responsibility rise quickly. Authority over decisions that reach a client comes slowly and on purpose, built on a record instead of one strong month. Hearing that today beats finding it out in month two.

You’ll take ownership of the full site monitoring lifecycle, from qualification and initiation through interim monitoring, site management, and close-out. You’ll work closely with sites and study teams to strengthen protocol adherence, resolve data queries, maintain essential documentation, and ensure safety information is appropriately reviewed and reported.

jobs.excerpt: About VouchedAt Vouched we are building a powerful identity verification platform to provide worldwide access to life’s most critical services, including healthcare, financial services, rentals, and more.
jobs.description:
About Vouched

At Vouched we are building a powerful identity verification platform to provide worldwide access to life’s most critical services, including healthcare, financial services, rentals, and more. Companies use Vouched to verify identity while onboarding and authenticating users. We make identity verifi cation easy with a combination of machine learning and data checks. Our customers leverage our APIs, integrations, and no-code solution to onboard customers to their systems.

What We Do

  • Verify thousands of people every day across multiple countries and industries providing access to critical services
    • Serve fast-growing startups, unicorns, and large enterprises, with a focus on providing fast, easy integration for developers
    • Run on a modern cloud infrastructure powered by automated integration and unit testing, provisioning, deployments, monitoring, and notifications
    • Operate in a highly regulated, security-sensitive space. Safeguarding personal and identity data is core to everything we ship
    • Drive to own the market and deliver a world-changing client and end-user experience

We are a small but mighty team looking for people who align with our values and have a strong sense of hustle, creative problem solving, grit and energy to help us scale! We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a Senior QA/SDET who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is passionate about building quality into every release alongside a talented team. The ideal candidate blends a tester's instinct for finding what breaks with strong software engineering skills, partnering closely with engineering, product, and ML stakeholders to ensure the platform that powers identity verification for customers around the world works correctly, every time.

You will own quality across the full product lifecycle, from reviewing requirements and designs through test planning, automation, release validation, and production verification. You will build and maintain the test frameworks, automated suites, and quality gates that let our team ship quickly and with confidence across our APIs, web capture SDK, mobile SDKs, and customer dashboard.

Security and compliance are central to this role. Because Vouched handles sensitive personal and identity data, we expect you to treat security, privacy, and regulatory compliance as first-class, non-negotiable quality requirements. You will design tests that verify access controls, data handling, and auditability, help produce test evidence that supports our compliance posture across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, etc., and ensure that test environments and test data never expose real personal information.

You should be someone who is deep into the details, who partners with teammates to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Correctness matters at Vouched: a missed edge case can block a real person from accessing healthcare or financial services. We expect our Senior QA/SDET to foster a culture of shared ownership of quality by championing testability, facilitating open conversations about release risk, and working with the team to catch issues long before they reach customers.

A critical component of this role is the fluent use of modern AI-powered tooling to accelerate test development. You will be expected to leverage tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and similar platforms, to rapidly produce test plans, automated tests, test data, and quality tooling. We expect AI-accelerated workflows that turn product knowledge into reproducible, maintainable, and trustworthy automated coverage rather than manual, one-off regression passes. The ability to use AI tools to scaffold test suites, generate edge-case scenarios, accelerate failure triage, and build internal tooling that engineering can rely on is essential and not optional.

Experience working with distributed teams, strong written and verbal communication skills, and a bias toward action are essential. While knowledge of AI-based identity verification products is a plus, a passion for working with innovative technologies and helping to scale a dynamic team is key.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the test strategy for the Vouched platform, balancing unit, integration, API, end-to-end, and exploratory testing to maximize risk coverage and release speed.
    • Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for our REST APIs, web capture SDK, mobile SDKs (iOS and Android), and customer dashboard.
    • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines as quality gates, keeping suites fast, reliable, and free of flaky tests so every change ships with confidence.
    • Validate identity verification flows end to end across real devices, browsers, cameras, and network conditions, including document capture, selfie and liveness checks, and webhook delivery.
    • Build and curate safe, synthetic test data (ID documents, selfies, and identity records) that exercises edge cases across countries and document types without using real personal data.
    • Test for security and privacy: authentication and authorization, input validation, PII handling and redaction, and data retention, partnering with security on vulnerability findings.
    • Support compliance readiness by producing traceable test evidence and change-validation records for frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR (HIPAA a plus).
    • Drive performance, load, and reliability testing to ensure our APIs and processing pipeline meet latency and throughput targets as we scale.
    • Partner with ML engineers to validate model and pipeline changes using regression datasets and accuracy benchmarks before they reach production.
    • Own release validation and sign-off ; triage, reproduce, and root-cause defects, including production issues reported by customers, and turn every escaped bug into lasting automated coverage.
    • Define and report on quality metrics (defect escape rate, automation coverage, flakiness, time-to-detect) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
    • Leverage AI-powered tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others) to accelerate test creation, test data generation, and failure triage.
    • Champion a culture of quality across engineering by reviewing designs and pull requests for testability and mentoring engineers on testing best practices.
    • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve test speed, coverage, and reliability.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in software quality engineering, including at least 3 years as an SDET or test automation engineer within a software engineering organization.
    • Strong programming skills in at least one language used for test automation (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, or Kotlin/Swift) and a track record of writing clean, maintainable test code.
    • Hands-on experience building and scaling test automation frameworks for web UIs and APIs (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Selenium, Jest, Postman, or similar).
    • Experience testing mobile applications or SDKs on iOS and Android (Appium, XCUITest, Espresso, or similar), including real-device clouds such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs.
    • Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar) and working with containerized and cloud environments (Docker, GCP preferred).
    • Experience with performance and load testing tools (k6, Gatling, JMeter, or similar) and using observability tools (Datadog or equivalent) to investigate failures.
    • Solid understanding of security and privacy testing: authentication and authorization, OWASP Top 10, input validation, and safe handling of PII in test environments.
    • Experience working in regulated environments and supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, including test evidence and audit readiness.
    • Proficiency with AI-powered development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent; demonstrated ability to accelerate test development with them.
    • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills across the stack, from client to API to database.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write clear test plans, bug reports, and quality reports.
    • Experience working in a startup environment is required.
    • Experience managing or collaborating with distributed teams is essential.
    • Familiarity with identity verification, computer vision, or AI/ML-based solutions, or with testing ML model quality, is a plus.

Benefits

Our Commitment

We are committed to providing an environment where everyone receives equal consideration and treatment regardless of gender, gender identity, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, HIV/AIDS/Hepatitis C status, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, height, weight, and any other protected category under the law. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Compensation

Base salary range: $180,000 – $210,000 USD annually, depending on experience and leveling. This role is also eligible for equity compensation and company benefits.

Benefits

  • Equity compensation

• Remote working environment

  • Self-managed paid time off• 11+ annual company holidays
    • 401(k)
    • Health Care Benefits: Medical, Vision, Dental
    • Wellness benefits: EAP, LifeHealth Online, One Medical, Perkspot

• Parental leave

jobs.description:
Position: Sales Development Representative

Salary: 25,000 ZAR to 30,000 ZAR

Working Hours: Aligned with UK Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor



ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is redefining human risk and secure behaviour management in cybersecurity. Trusted by global enterprises and high-growth mid-market organisations—including Vodafone, Merck, Arriva, and Hershey—the company reduces human cyber risk through AI-driven automation and cutting-edge Agentic AI solutions. We are scaling rapidly year-on-year, bringing our UK outbound engine in-house, and investing heavily in a modern, data-backed sales development function built for high performance and high autonomy.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As UK Outbound Sales Development Representative, you will sit at the very front of our growth engine. This is an autonomous, phone-first, results-driven seat responsible for establishing our in-house outbound presence in the UK market. You will target, engage, and qualify enterprise and mid-market security decision-makers—CISOs, Heads of Security, and IT Security Managers—booking high-value Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs) that directly build Keepnet’s sales pipeline.

Armed with an advanced outbound stack (including parallel diallers like Orum and Nooks, alongside HubSpot CRM), you will operate with freedom, high trust, and end-to-end account ownership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive Phone-First Multichannel Prospecting: Execute outbound campaigns across phone, email, and LinkedIn into UK B2B organisations, maintaining high daily call volumes via parallel dialling tools (Orum, Nooks) to maximise live decision-maker conversations.
  • Deliver Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs): Book meetings that actually take place with verified decision-makers (CISOs, IT Security Managers, and budget holders) in target accounts, operating against a target of your first QHM within 30 days and 10 QHMs per full production month post-ramp.
  • Execute Deep Discovery & Qualification: Apply the company's SDR Playbook (lightweight BANT and MEDDPICC frameworks) to uncover tooling gaps across phishing, vishing, smishing, and quishing, while assessing security awareness maturity.
  • Capitalise on Contract Renewal Windows: Identify current vendor relationships, contract lengths, and renewal dates, leveraging company's buy-back program to convert "in-contract" objections into active sales opportunities.
  • Maintain Channel & Conflict Awareness: Pre-screen accounts for existing partner relationships (MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and resellers) and existing clients, resolving routing questions collaboratively before initiating outreach.
  • Ensure Seamless Handoffs: Document comprehensive, actionable discovery notes and transition booked meetings to Account Executives within 24 hours of scheduling.
  • Uphold Strict CRM Hygiene: Maintain HubSpot as the single source of truth—logging all interactions, preventing duplicate entries, and populating all mandatory qualification fields.
  • Operate with Built-In Compliance: Adhere strictly to UK GDPR, PECR, TPS/CTPS screening protocols, suppression list governance, opt-out handling, and approved messaging standards.
  • Feed Frontline Intelligence: Share objection patterns, competitor movement, and market feedback with Sales and Marketing to continuously sharpen outreach messaging and value propositions.

Requirements

  • 2 Years+ of B2B SaaS Outbound Experience: Proven track record in a dedicated SDR or BDR seat carrying quota, generating pipeline, and booking qualified discovery meetings.
  • Phone-First Craftsmanship: Exceptional cold-calling confidence and conversational fluency; skilled at hooking senior prospects in the opening seconds, navigating initial brush-offs, and steering live phone discovery.
  • Enterprise Prospecting Capability: Credibility and commercial acumen to hold substantive, peer-level conversations with senior IT, Security, and Compliance stakeholders in organisations with 1,000+ seats without needing to be an engineer.
  • Parallel Dialler & Tooling Literacy: Practical experience using parallel diallers (such as Orum, Nooks, or equivalent high-velocity calling software) alongside modern sales engagement tools.
  • CRM Discipline: Rigorous data and pipeline tracking habits, with willingness to complete HubSpot certifications if not already held.
  • Flawless Communication: Outstanding verbal and written English skills, capable of composing compelling, error-free executive messaging without supervision.
  • Self-Directed Remote Discipline: Strong operational independence to manage daily activity, pipeline numbers, and metrics aligned strictly with UK business hours from South Africa.
  • Independent Contractor Readiness: Legally set up to operate as an independent contractor or registered entity in South Africa, maintaining a professional home office, high-spec workstation, noise-cancelling headset, and stable fibre internet.

PREFERRED:

  • Direct experience prospecting into the UK B2B market from an offshore/remote setup.
  • Prior background selling or setting appointments within Cybersecurity or related high-compliance technical SaaS sectors.
  • Experience operating as an early or founding SDR, building outbound cadences, lists, and messaging frameworks from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with indirect channel sales models, including MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and value-added resellers.
  • Active hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and HubSpot CRM.

What You’ll Bring:

  • A Builder’s Mindset: You take full commercial ownership of your territory. If a workflow or list is suboptimal, you diagnose it, propose a solution, test it, and build a repeatable process.
  • High Question-to-Talk Ratio: The discipline that defines elite SDRs: asking sharp, incisive questions, actively listening, and documenting what prospects say—including negative signals—rather than pitching over objections.
  • Commercial Acumen over Rote Scripting: You do not rely on rigid scripts; you understand how enterprise businesses make procurement decisions, how risk is evaluated, and how to unearth real urgency.
  • Responsible Innovation: Familiarity with leveraging modern AI tools (such as Claude) within approved security and compliance guardrails to accelerate prospect research, personalise outreach, and streamline account tiering.
  • Resilience and Accountability: A relentless work ethic that thrives on pipeline creation, celebrates closed business, and takes pride in being the definitive first voice of the company in the UK market.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Director, Procure to Pay Operations to lead our Accounts Payable function and guide it through its next stage of growth. You will own the end-to-end AP lifecycle: non-PO invoice processing, payment runs and bank file management, supplier onboarding and master data integrity, and the handling of returned EFTs, stale-dated checks, and unclaimed property. You will lead a team of AP Managers who oversee back-office and shared services staff. You will set the standard for accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows payment operations in detail. You will manage ACH, wire, check, and international payment processes. You will make sure every payment, including ad hoc and off-cycle payments, goes out accurately, on time, and with proper controls. You will protect the organization through strong internal controls, SOX compliance, tax reporting oversight, and proactive defense against fraud, including business email compromise and payment redirection schemes.

You will also shape the future of AP. Working closely with IT, Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Purchasing, and Sourcing, you will develop a forward-looking strategy built on automation and self-service. You will lead system enhancements on Oracle Fusion Cloud, and you will contribute to migrations, acquisitions, and process integrations.

What You Bring

You are a seasoned AP leader with at least 5 – 7 years of experience. You have managed managers, and you have run a back-office or shared services operation. You have deep knowledge of payment methods and banking, including ACH/NACHA, and you have hands-on experience with return EFTs, stale checks, and escheatment. Oracle Fusion Cloud experience is a must. You communicate clearly, influence people at every level, and stay effective in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent experience is required.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop AP Managers, who in turn manage back-office staff.
  • Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.

Invoice Processing

  • Oversee the full invoice lifecycle for non-PO invoices.
  • Reduce manual work through automation, improvements, and analysis of exceptions.
  • Handle invoice questions, discrepancies, duplicate invoice prevention, and recovery of overpayments and credits.

Payment File Management

  • Own the scheduled payment run process, including ACH, wire, check, and international payments.
  • Oversee creation, transmission, and reconciliation of payment files to banks.
  • Manage ad hoc and off-cycle payment files, including manual, and exception payments, with proper approvals and controls.
  • Ensure compliance with bank cutoffs and payment policies.
  • Coordinate with Treasury on cash forecasting, funding, and payment timing.

Return EFTs, Stale-Dated Checks, and Unclaimed Property

  • Manage the process for returned or rejected EFT/ACH payments. This covers investigating the cause, validating bank details, re-issuing payments, and correcting the supplier master data.
  • Manage voids and reissues.
  • Manage the stale-dated check process.
  • Ensure compliance with escheatment and unclaimed property regulations, working with Legal, Tax, and Accounting.

Supplier Onboarding and Change Requests (Internal and External)

  • Own the supplier onboarding process, including W-9/W-8 collection, TIN matching, and bank account validation.
  • Manage supplier master data change requests from internal requestors and external suppliers. These include banking changes, remit-to updates, and legal name or address changes.
  • Maintain supplier data integrity through regular cleansing, duplicate detection, and inactive-supplier handling
  • Work to enhance supplier portal and self-service tools to reduce manual intervention.

Controls, Compliance, and Audit

  • Maintain a strong internal control environment, including SOX controls where applicable.
  • Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, and Compliance on testing and remediation.
  • Ensure compliance with tax reporting (1099, VAT/GST, and withholding) in partnership with Tax.
  • Define, document, and update policies, procedures, and desk-level instructions.
  • Monitor and mitigate fraud risk, including business email compromise and payment redirection schemes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • IT: Partner on ERP, AP automation, bank connectivity, and system integrations. Lead UAT, defect resolution, and roadmap prioritization.
  • Purchasing and Sourcing: Align on AP processes, supplier setup, and payment terms.
  • Treasury, Accounting, Tax, and Legal: Coordinate on working capital initiatives, cash management, month end close, reconciliations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Business Stakeholders: Resolve escalations and communicate expectations on approvals and turnaround times.

Strategy, Process Improvement, and Reporting

  • Develop a forward-looking AP strategy that considers automation
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to system implementations, migrations, acquisitions, and process integrations.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • 5 – 7 years required, 10+ years desired of AP experience, including at least 5 – 7 years managing an AP operations team.
  • Demonstrated experience managing managers and a back office or shared services team.
  • Deep knowledge of the full AP lifecycle, including invoice processing, payment runs, supplier maintenance, and exception handling.
  • Hands-on experience with ad hoc payment files, return EFTs, stale checks, and escheatment processes.
  • Strong understanding of payment methods and banking, including ACH/NACHA, wires, and checks.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud is a must.
  • Strong knowledge of internal controls, fraud prevention, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent critical thinking, forward planning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to move swiftly, multitask, and reprioritize in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels and across departments.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About PhorestPhorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.
jobs.description:
About Phorest

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, we're a SaaS company and a trusted partner to over 155,000 hair, beauty and medspa professionals worldwide. Our all-in-one software and AI-driven tools help them manage bookings, take payments, market their services, grow their client base and get the best from their teams.

Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Australia-based Product Marketing Manager to give this high-growth market our dedicated, full-time focus within our Product organisation.

Sitting directly alongside our Australian commercial teams, you will take full ownership of ensuring that what we build globally lands with genuine impact locally. You will translate product capabilities into compelling customer narratives that reflect how Australian salon and clinic owners actually talk, work, and grow their businesses.

You won't be starting from zero. You will plug into established launch playbooks and share learnings with peer PMMs based in North America, DACH, and the UK and Ireland. Working during Australian business hours, you will lead local launch readiness, educate our regional Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams, and drive sustainable adoption and revenue growth across the region.

What You'll Do

  • Customer and Market Intelligence:Act as the strategic voice of the Australian customer. Phorest strongly champions direct customer contact, so you will regularly jump on calls with local salon, spa, and clinic owners to understand how they run their day-to-day, what causes friction, and the actual language they use. You'll also have the option to attend key local customer and industry events alongside our regional Sales and Marketing teams. While event travel isn't mandatory, our PMMs find it one of the most effective ways to meet clients and prospects face-to-face, soak up market dynamics, and gather unfiltered feedback.

  • Narrative and Positioning:Own how our products are positioned in Australia. Take global feature sets and translate them into human, ‘feelings over features’ customer stories that cut through technical jargon and resonate directly with local operators.

  • Commercial Partnership and Strategic Enablement:Work hand in hand with our regional Sales, Customer Success, and Education teams on the ground. Act as a strategic partner rather than an order taker. You will listen to field feedback, push back constructively on low-impact ad hoc requests, and build the foundational talk tracks, battlecards, and objection guides that set local teams up to hit regional revenue and retention targets.

  • GTM Execution and Launch Readiness:Lead regional go-to-market execution for product releases. Partner closely with Product Ops and peer PMMs across other regions to keep launch milestones on track, ensuring local commercial teams are thoroughly trained, confident, and equipped with client-facing materials before features go live.

  • Experimental Communication:Bring a curious, test-and-learn mindset to how we reach the market. If standard channels like email or webinars aren't landing with local customers or sales teams, proactively test new formats, messaging angles, and delivery methods to drive engagement and adoption.

What Success Looks Like

  • There is always a clear line between your day-to-day work and the region's commercial objectives.

  • Regional Sales, CS, and Marketing teams feel confident pitching new capabilities because your messaging reflects how Australian salon and clinic owners actually talk and work.

  • Local customer-facing teams actively bring you into customer challenges and rely on your strategic advice, viewing you as an indispensable partner rather than an order taker.

  • You stay self-directed and productive during Australian business hours while maintaining smooth, asynchronous alignment with teammates across other time zones.

Who You Are

You are a curious, commercially minded storyteller who loves turning complex product features into clear, relatable stories. You enjoy setting other people up for success, and you get genuine satisfaction from doing the deep groundwork that helps customer-facing teams shine in front of clients.

You'll thrive in this role if you are:

  • You bring a calm head to shifting priorities and view the absence of rigid process as an opportunity to build practical solutions that leave a mark.

  • You listen carefully to what sales and commercial teams ask for, but step back and evaluate the bigger picture before jumping into execution.

  • You don't need a huge army of specialists to get things done; you're comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write clean copy, pull your own Looker reports, and test ideas directly.

  • You enjoy having daily ownership over your calendar and priorities. You know when to run ahead independently and when to sync asynchronously with global counterparts, with the flexibility to occasionally overlap with European/US hours to connect with your manager and global peers.

What You Bring

  • Typically 3 to 5 years of Product Marketing experience (or equivalent B2B/Vertical SaaS commercial experience), with a track record of taking features to market and driving adoption.

  • Demonstrated experience marketing to distinct, niche audiences or complex ecosystems where different users within the same business have different motivations.

  • Practical experience across the full product marketing lifecycle, including customer research, positioning, messaging, launch planning, and sales enablement.

  • Comfort using Looker (or similar BI dashboard tools) to evaluate adoption numbers, track funnel metrics, and assess launch performance.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to strip away jargon and articulate value simply to both technical teams and busy business owners.

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.

Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

jobs.description:
European roles, your afternoon hours. No night shift. If you recruit for foreign clients from the Philippines, this is the same game, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Cebu City and across the Philippines.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

This is NOT for you if

  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • A direct line to us for any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.description:
Senior Electrical Engineer, Analog & Mixed-Signal

Location: NYC

About Us

Voyant Photonics is transforming machine perception with a new class of LiDAR devices that are compact enough to fit in the palm of your hand and powerful enough to measure range, velocity, and reflectivity with unparalleled accuracy. By leveraging cutting-edge silicon photonic chips smaller than your fingertip, we deliver sensors that are not only revolutionary in performance but also affordable enough to integrate into any system.

Our technology disrupts the status quo of bulky, expensive, and power-hungry LiDAR systems, making high-precision sensing accessible for widespread adoption in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, industrial automation, and beyond. With Voyant, the next generation of machines can see, understand, and navigate the world like never before.

Discover how we're redefining what's possible by making real products out of cutting-edge research in silicon photonics.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a senior hardware leader to set the technical direction for the analog and mixed-signal electronics behind our LiDAR modules. You'll operate at the intersection of product design, silicon photonics, and machine perception — owning the hardest trade-offs, setting the standard other engineers build to, and mentoring the team as we scale. This is a high-leverage role for someone who wants their fingerprints on a foundational technology, not just a single product.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the analog and mixed-signal architecture for next-generation LiDAR modules, setting technical direction across TIAs, ADCs, precision current sources, and power delivery (LDOs, switching regulators).

  • Act as the technical authority on signal integrity, power integrity, and EMI/EMC across the product line — establish the design standards and review processes the rest of the team works to.

  • Lead bring-up, characterization, and validation strategy (EVT/DVT/PVT) across multiple concurrent programs, with accountability for robustness, repeatability, and manufacturability at scale.

  • Own the highest-stakes design trade-offs (performance, cost, power, integration complexity) that shape product roadmap and unit economics.

  • Mentor and provide technical direction to other hardware engineers; serve as the senior technical voice in cross-functional reviews with system architects, mechanical engineering, and firmware.

  • Drive supplier and component strategy for critical analog parts, engaging directly with vendors and foundries on custom or constrained components.

  • Represent hardware engineering in technical deep-dives with customers, partners, and investors as needed.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in hands-on hardware development, with end-to-end ownership of multiple systems shipped at high volume.

  • Leadership: Track record of setting technical direction for a team or product line — not only individual delivery.

  • Technical Strengths:

    • Recognized expert in low-noise analog and high-speed digital design.

    • Go-to authority on signal/power integrity, high-density interconnect, and EMI mitigation techniques.

    • Proven success driving designs through high-volume DFM, reliability testing, and yield optimization.

  • Tools & Skills:

    • Expert in schematic capture and simulation (e.g., SPICE), with deep fluency in Altium or similar.

    • Advanced use of SI/PI simulation tools (e.g., HyperLynx, SiWave) and measurement tools (GHz-range scopes, VNAs, spectrum analyzers).

    • Extensive experience integrating FPGAs, microcontrollers, and custom analog ASICs at the board level.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in photonics, LiDAR, or other precision-sensing hardware.

  • Experience building or scaling a hardware engineering team, or serving formally as a technical lead/architect.

  • Knowledge of flex and rigid-flex PCB design.

  • Familiarity with Verilog-AMS, mixed-signal modeling, or FPGA development.

  • Experience designing for high-reliability or harsh environments (e.g., automotive, aerospace, defense).

Benefits Package

  • Competitive base salary and a meaningful equity package.

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision).

  • Unlimited PTO and paid company holidays.

  • Team events and company meetups.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Voyant Photonics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $140K - $170K
