jobs.description:
Love Turning Leads Into Revenue? So Do We.

At NewLaw Business Model, we're helping estate planning lawyers build thriving businesses through education, coaching, technology and managed services.

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Specialist who combines commercial thinking, technical expertise and a passion for improving conversion.

This isn't a traditional CRM administration or sales support role. You'll partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to uncover revenue opportunities, evaluate solutions and build the systems and processes that help us attract, engage and convert more prospective members.

The Opportunity

You'll play a critical role in improving how NewLaw attracts, engages and converts prospective members across our education, membership and B2B managed-services offerings.

As a key partner to Sales and Marketing, you'll bring an independent, data-driven perspective to revenue performance—identifying what's working, where we're losing opportunities and what we should do differently.

You'll evaluate conversion challenges, recommend commercial and operational improvements, design more effective lead journeys and independently build the technology and tools needed to bring those ideas to life. This includes everything from HubSpot architecture, lead scoring and automated follow-up to conversion experiments, sales enablement, reporting and AI-powered workflows.

You'll have meaningful autonomy to investigate revenue performance, evaluate alternative approaches, recommend solutions, make implementation decisions within your area of responsibility and lead cross-functional improvements.

You'll also help establish the operational standards and systems that support a more efficient, scalable revenue engine.

Your work will directly influence conversion rates, sales effectiveness, customer acquisition efficiency and revenue growth.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Drive Conversion & Revenue Growth

  • Analyze the revenue funnel to identify conversion barriers and opportunities.

  • Develop and recommend strategies to improve lead engagement, sales effectiveness and customer acquisition.

  • Design and implement conversion experiments, funnel improvements and performance optimization initiatives.

Build Smarter Revenue Systems

  • Own and optimize HubSpot CRM architecture, lead scoring, segmentation, routing, automation and reporting.

  • Independently evaluate systems requirements and implement workflows that improve revenue operations.

  • Improve integrations and data flows connecting Marketing, Sales and downstream business processes.

Enable Sales & Marketing

  • Develop tools, workflows and resources that improve sales productivity and conversion.

  • Create and optimize lead nurture sequences, sales communications, landing page messaging and conversion assets.

  • Identify and implement AI-enabled tools that improve lead intelligence, follow-up and team effectiveness.

Turn Data Into Better Decisions

  • Build reporting that provides visibility into acquisition, engagement, conversion and sales performance.

  • Evaluate performance trends and recommend practical commercial improvements.

  • Lead cross-functional revenue initiatives from discovery through implementation and measurable results.

What “Success” Looks Like

  • Optimize our lead funnel: Identify conversion leakage and improve how prospects move from initial interest to becoming members.

  • Strengthen sales enablement: Build better tools, messaging, automations, and resources that help Sales convert more effectively.

  • Improve lead nurture: Create smarter, more personalized journeys that re-engage prospects and accelerate conversion.

  • Explore AI-powered growth: Implement practical AI and automation solutions that improve revenue team productivity and performance.

  • Build better revenue intelligence: Connect Marketing, Sales, and customer data to identify new growth opportunities.

Who You Are

You're a commercially minded, technically capable operator who combines independent judgment, analytical thinking and hands-on execution.

You don't just identify problems—you investigate, evaluate alternatives, recommend improvements and build the solutions.

You Bring:

  • Experience in Revenue Operations, Growth Operations, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations.

  • Advanced hands-on HubSpot expertise, including CRM architecture, workflows, automation and reporting.

  • Strong understanding of revenue funnels, CRO, lead management and sales conversion.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify and implement measurable commercial improvements.

  • Experience developing sales enablement tools, automated workflows and conversion-focused communications.

  • Strong analytical, project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Even Better If You Have:

  • Experience with education, memberships, SaaS or B2B managed services.

  • Experience with webinar funnels, lifecycle marketing or high-volume lead generation.

  • Familiarity with APIs, Zapier, Make, AI-enabled workflows or connected revenue systems.

  • Experience with sales messaging, conversion testing or CRM integrations.

You'll Thrive Here If...

  • You're curious about why people buy, what drives conversion and how to improve results.

  • You're a self-starter who sees opportunities and takes initiative.

  • You think strategically but love getting hands-on with implementation.

  • You're equally energized by creative experimentation, technology and data.

  • You enjoy challenging assumptions and testing new approaches.

  • You collaborate confidently with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

  • You thrive in an evolving organization with room to innovate and make an impact.

Why NewLaw?

  • Real ownership: Identify revenue opportunities and independently drive meaningful improvements.

  • Commercial impact: See how your work influences conversion, sales effectiveness and growth.

  • Technical innovation: Build smarter HubSpot systems, automations and AI-enabled workflows.

  • Opportunity to build: Help shape a growing Revenue Operations function.

  • Mission-driven work: Help lawyers build better businesses and serve families more effectively.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt (W2)

  • Annual Base Wage: Pay Range: $85,000-$95,000/ annually

    • Starting base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including geographic location, applicable experience, relevant skills, market data, and internal equity.

    • Bonus Eligibility: This position is eligible for company-wide and individual performance-based discretionary bonuses.

This is a 100% remote position open to qualified candidates authorized to work and residing anywhere in the continental United States, with the exception of California. NewLaw Business Model is not currently hiring or registered to employ individuals in the State of California for this position.

  • 401K Retirement Program w/Discretionary Company Match

If you're excited about identifying growth opportunities, building better conversion experiences, and making a measurable impact on revenue, we'd love to hear from you. jobs.description:
Inside Sales & Social Media Lead Closer

Remote – U.S.-Based | Flexible Schedule | Evening Availability Required

Own The Leads. Build Relationships. Close Business.

Are you someone who enjoys connecting with people, responding to opportunities, and turning conversations into sales?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where responsiveness, organization, and follow-through make the difference between winning and losing a customer?

Are you self-motivated, competitive, and someone who takes pride in making things happen without needing someone looking over your shoulder?

If so, Mongo Attachments has an opportunity for you!

We're looking for a driven, sales focused Inside Sales & Social Media Lead Closer to take ownership of our incoming lead management process, engage with prospective customers, and help grow our online presence.

This isn't simply a customer service or social media position – it's an opportunity to directly impact company revenue by managing incoming opportunities, developing new business through social media, following up with customers, and closing sales.

We're looking for someone who understands that speed matters, relationships matter, and every lead represents a potential sale. The right person will take ownership of the process, stay engaged, and consistently look for ways to generate business and improve results.

Location:100% Remote (U.S.-Based)

Schedule:Flexible scheduling with a strong emphasis on evening availability to align with peak incoming lead volume.

Important:This position requires someone who is comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and being available during evenings when prospective customers are actively reaching out.

What You'll Do

You'll be responsible for managing incoming sales opportunities, generating new business, and maintaining customer relationships by:

  • Managing and responding to all incoming leads in a timely, professional, and organized manner.
  • Following a structured lead management process to ensure no opportunities fall through the cracks.
  • Responding quickly to incoming Facebook messages and converting customer inquiries into sales opportunities.
  • Managing and maintaining lead information, communication history, and follow-up activities within Salesforce CRM.
  • Taking ownership of leads from initial inquiry through follow-up and closing.
  • Actively monitoring industry-specific Facebook Groups to identify potential customers and new business opportunities.
  • Initiating professional outbound conversations and developing new sales opportunities through social media.
  • Following up with previous customers to check on their experience, gather feedback, and identify additional product needs.
  • Identifying opportunities to upsell customers on additional attachments, accessories, and related products.
  • Proactively requesting customer reviews on Google and Facebook to strengthen Mongo Attachments' online reputation.
  • Maintaining consistent communication with prospective and existing customers to provide an exceptional customer experience.
  • Developing and following standard operating procedures to improve lead response times, follow-up consistency, and conversion rates.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve the lead management process, customer experience, and overall sales performance.
  • Staying productive during slower lead periods by taking initiative on administrative projects, market research, process improvements, and other business development activities.

What Makes You Successful

You're someone who:

  • Understands that speed and responsiveness are critical to converting online leads into customers.
  • Enjoys communicating with people and building relationships through phone, email, and social media.
  • Is confident, professional, and persuasive when communicating with prospective customers.
  • Takes ownership of every lead and understands the importance of consistent follow-up.
  • Is organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and opportunities simultaneously.
  • Is comfortable using social media as a tool to generate business, not simply as a platform for browsing.
  • Understands the importance of customer service and creating a positive customer experience.
  • Takes initiative and looks for opportunities to generate additional business.
  • Is self-motivated and capable of working independently without constant supervision.
  • Can manage their time effectively and stay productive in a remote work environment.
  • Is comfortable working flexible hours, including evenings when lead activity is highest.
  • Is motivated by performance and wants their compensation to reflect the results they produce.
  • Understands that the goal isn't simply to respond to leads – it's to convert them into customers.

Preferred Experience

  • 1–3 years of experience in inside sales, lead management, digital sales, or social media community management.
  • Proven experience working with Salesforce CRM or a comparable CRM platform (required).
  • Experience managing incoming leads and maintaining consistent follow-up processes.
  • Familiarity with Facebook Business Suite, Facebook Messenger, and Facebook Groups.
  • Experience generating business through social media engagement and outbound messaging.
  • Experience with customer retention, upselling, and post-sale follow-up.
  • Familiarity with Google Business Profile and online review management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and manage a flexible remote schedule.
  • Experience in construction equipment, heavy equipment, compact equipment, excavators, attachments, forestry, land management, or related industries is a plus.

Why Mongo Attachments?

Mongo Attachments is a growing competitor in the mini excavator attachment and accessory market, specializing in niche products for Micro-Mini, Mini, and Midi excavators. We serve both direct-to-consumer and dealer markets, with a commitment to providing quality products, quick lead and delivery times, and customer service that stands above the competition.

Our team comes from hands-on backgrounds in construction, forestry, and land management. We understand our customers because we've lived the work ourselves. We don't just sell attachments – we believe in the industries we serve and the people who make them successful.

When you join Mongo Attachments, you'll enjoy:

  • A competitive annual base salary of $42,000.
  • Additional sales commissions based on closed business, with significant earning potential.
  • Monthly performance bonuses for generating verified customer reviews.
  • Target earning potential of $60,000+ annually, with high-performing individuals having the opportunity to earn $80,000+.
  • 100% remote work environment.
  • Flexible scheduling based on business needs and performance, with evening availability required.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with up to a 4% company match.
  • Paid vacation / PTO and holidays.
  • The opportunity to directly impact company revenue and customer relationships.
  • The opportunity to grow alongside an expanding company.

How You'll Be Rewarded

We believe people who produce results should be rewarded for them. That's why this position includes an incentive structure that rewards both closed sales and contributions to our online reputation.

Sales Commission:

  • 1–15 closed sales per month: $50 per sale.
  • 16–30 closed sales per month: $75 per sale, retroactive to the first sale.
  • 31+ closed sales per month: $100 per sale, retroactive to the first sale.

Customer Review Bonuses:

  • Earn $150 for securing at least five verified 5-star customer reviews within a calendar month.
  • Earn an additional $25 for each verified review beyond the initial five.

The more business you generate and the more value you create, the greater your earning potential.

This Role Is Ideal for Someone Who...

  • Enjoys sales and wants to be directly involved in generating revenue.
  • Understands the importance of responding quickly and following up consistently.
  • Likes connecting with customers and turning conversations into business.
  • Is comfortable using Facebook and other digital platforms to develop new sales opportunities.
  • Takes pride in being organized, dependable, and accountable.

jobs.description:
About MedReview

MedReview is a leading provider of payment integrity solutions that help national and regional health plans promote population health, ensure payment accuracy, reduce administrative waste, improve provider relationships, and optimize financial performance. For more than four decades, MedReview has partnered with health plans, third-party administrators, and other healthcare organizations to deliver technology-enabled solutions that identify savings opportunities, drive operational efficiency, and improve healthcare outcomes.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Physician Reviewer reporting to the Senior Medical Director to serve as a physician leader and clinical subject matter expert for complex payment integrity reviews, clinical validation determinations, DRG validation, readmission reviews, appeals, peer-to-peer discussions, and regulatory complaint resolution. This role provides physician-level judgment on disputed, high-dollar, high-risk, and clinically complex matters and serves as a supervisory and consultative resource to physician reviewers, nurse auditors, coders, quality teams, operations, and client-facing leaders.
The Senior Physician Reviewer applies deep clinical expertise, regulatory knowledge, and payment integrity experience to deliver accurate, defensible, and compliant determinations across Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other government-sponsored healthcare programs. The role is critical to maintaining clinical quality, provider credibility, client satisfaction, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Review Leadership
  • Perform complex clinical validation reviews and provide final physician determinations on disputed findings.
  • Review and validate diagnoses, severity of illness, risk adjustment factors, clinical documentation, medical necessity, and reimbursement-related issues.
  • Conduct DRG validation and clinical documentation reviews to confirm accurate assignment and reimbursement.
  • Perform readmission reviews, including assessments of preventability, appropriateness, and documentation support.
  • Review escalated, high-dollar, high-risk, and clinically complex cases requiring physician-level judgment.
  • Provide specialty-specific clinical expertise for inpatient and outpatient payment integrity reviews.

Appeals and Regulatory Management
  • Manage physician-level appeals involving clinical validation, DRG validation, medical necessity, and other payment integrity findings.
  • Conduct peer-to-peer discussions with treating physicians and hospital representatives.
  • Prepare and review clear, evidence-based clinical rationale letters supporting determinations.
  • Participate in external review processes involving providers, health plans, clients, and regulatory agencies.
  • Respond to Medicare complaints, regulatory inquiries, Independent Review Organization requests, and other escalated appeal matters.
  • Provide expert clinical support during litigation, arbitration, audits, or formal dispute resolution activities, as required.

Quality and Compliance
  • Ensure reviews comply with CMS regulations, Medicare guidelines, applicable state requirements, payer policies, clinical criteria, and industry standards.
  • Support quality assurance activities, reviewer calibration, internal audits, and client audit initiatives.
  • Help develop and maintain clinical review policies, methodologies, decision frameworks, and documentation standards.
  • Participate in audit-of-audit programs and continuous quality improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor appeal overturn trends, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to review quality and consistency.

Leadership and Supervision

jobs.title: Executive Support Specialist - California Insurance Experience Required
jobs.excerpt: The client moves fast.  Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.
jobs.description:
The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.

About RemotePro.ph

We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.

To apply, please visit us at:

Summary

This role is focused on California insurance — personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate — you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.

Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations — managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.

The Mindset We’re Looking For

The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:

  • They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution
  • They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it
  • They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality
  • They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting
  • They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas
  • They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it

Who Thrives Here

People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.

We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.

This Role Is Not for You If:

  • You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track
  • You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response
  • You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice
  • You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation
  • Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule
  • You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans
  • You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start
  • Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy

There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.

Responsibilities

You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.

That looks like:

  • Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role
  • Managing inbound communication across email and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention
  • Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and flagging anything at risk before it becomes a problem
  • Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Preparing reports, summaries, and briefing materials that are clear and ready to use without further editing
  • Maintaining organized records across CRM systems and shared drives — so information is always findable and current
  • Using AI tools to draft communications, summarize threads, and eliminate repetitive manual tasks
  • Supporting market research, competitor analysis, and social media scheduling when needed

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of recent, hands-on experience working inside a California insurance agency — personal and commercial lines — handling renewals, quoting, and account servicing; this is the non-negotiable requirement for this role
  • Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, easy to listen to; clients always feel heard
  • Proven experience in a support, virtual assistant, or administrative role
  • Active, confident daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace
  • Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent)
  • Strong written English — emails are clear and professional before they're sent
  • High attention to detail — errors get caught before they leave your desk
  • Strong organizational skills — multiple priorities, nothing slips
  • Self-directed once you're up to speed — asks the right questions early, works independently after

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent)
  • Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment
  • Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or Monday.com)
  • Basic bookkeeping or invoice processing experience (QuickBooks or Xero)
  • Experience with market research and competitor analysis

How We Work

We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.

There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.

Benefits

Permanent Work-from-Home Setup

Competitive Salary

HMO Coverage

Mental Health Programs

Maternity Assistance through HMO (Female employees)

Paid Vacation Leave

Technology Allowance

Internet Allowance

Weekly Payouts

Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities

They coordinate onboarding and new hire training, track and process 45-day and 90-day performance reviews, and manage the annual company review cycle from kickoff through completion. With a strong eye for detail and a commitment to confidentiality, the Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator creates a consistent, effortless experience for every candidate and employee, from the first interview through every review.

About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

At GoGlobal, the Regional Product Owner (GPO), Accounting & Tax owns the A&T product end to end — its global scope, standards, commercial logic, processes, and economics — and leads the function as a Managing Director–level member of the Delivery leadership team. Reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, you are accountable for the growth, profitability, and reputation of A&T worldwide.

This is a leadership role whose primary objective is business growth through flawless delivery. You are the senior product and delivery voice for A&T in the market — client-facing, trusted by prospects and key accounts, and the partner of choice for Revenue and Sales in winning and expanding business. As the ultimate subject-matter expert for A&T, you stay close to market trends and customer demands and translate them into how the service is designed, packaged, priced, and delivered.

You lead the A&T function regionally through the Outsourcing Control (OC) leads. You build the delivery organisation to meet both market opportunity and client expectation, set and defend global standards as the foundation for scalable and sustainable delivery, and act as an inspiring leader for the teams who deliver A&T every day.

Roles & Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership & Growth

• Own the growth agenda for A&T — revenue, win rate, retention, and expansion — as the primary measure of the role’s success.

• Act as the senior, client-facing product authority for A&T: anchoring strategic client engagements, pitches, high-stakes decisions, and escalations.

• Partner with Revenue and Sales as the expert in the room — qualifying opportunities, shaping scope and pricing, and helping convert and expand accounts.

• Define and evolve the commercial logic — packaging, bundling, premiums, and guardrails — so A&T can be sold and delivered profitably at scale.

• Own the reputation of the A&T product in the market.

Product Strategy & Standards

• Own the regional scope, service definitions, and standards for A&T — what is in, what is out, and how it is delivered.

• Set regional execution standards, SLAs, and compliance expectations across all regions and delivery models.

• Drive consistency of delivery across regions while enabling them to flex within agreed guardrails.

Market Insight & Service Design

• Act as the ultimate subject-matter expert for A&T, maintaining a deep, current view of market trends, competitor moves, and evolving customer demands.

• Translate market and client insight into the design of the service and the delivery organisation, so the function is structured to meet both demand and expectation.

• Shape the product roadmap and delivery-model choices (in-house, outsourced, automated) to capture growth opportunities.

Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement

• Set the regional A&T operating model and process standards; approve processes, SOPs, and control frameworks before they enter delivery.

• Support the enterprise AI direction and drive its adoption within A&T to enable scale and quality.

Cost Management & Commercial Sustainability

• Own product-level cost-to-serve for A&T, driving efficiency, productivity, and long-term economic sustainability.

• Make deliberate trade-offs across scope design, automation, sourcing, and delivery-model choices to keep delivery economics healthy as the product scales.

• Diagnose cost pressures, identify root causes, and lead corrective action, supported by Finance on modelling and analysis.

Regional Delivery Governance & Team Leadership

• Lead the Outsourcing Control leads accountable for regional delivery outcomes and economics.

• Provide the framework within which regional autonomy — in-house versus outsourced mix, capacity, and hiring proposals — is exercised, and arbitrate cross-regional or peer-function disagreements when escalated.

• Lead, mentor, and develop the OC leads; build product, commercial, and delivery capability across the global A&T team.

Scope & Commercial Governance

• Propose and own changes to product scope, service tiers, and commercial logic, routing them through the agreed approval framework for impact assessment and implementation readiness.

• Support enabling functions on scope-to-catalogue mapping, SKU registration, and pricing alignment.

• Validate post-implementation effectiveness of scope and commercial changes through defined metrics, and refine where needed.

Compliance, Audit & Risk

• Set the regional compliance posture for A&T across accounting standards (IFRS, local GAAP), tax legislation, and statutory reporting requirements.

• Ensure A&T delivery maintains internal controls and regulatory adherence in every jurisdiction the product serves.

• Engage with internal and external audit on A&T product-level matters.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with the Chief Delivery Officer, peer Global Product Owners, Revenue, Technology, and the enabling functions across Delivery.

• Represent the A&T product in cross-functional and executive forums.

Key Performance Indicators

• Revenue growth and win rate for the product.

• Retention and net revenue retention (NRR).

• Margin and cost-to-serve.

• Delivery SLA attainment and quality.

• Client satisfaction (NPS).

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or equivalent is a plus.

• 15+ years of experience in accounting, tax, or finance operations, with at least 5 years owning a product, service line, or regional / global function end to end.

• Managing Director–level leadership experience, with the gravitas to operate as a senior commercial and product leader.

• Track record of driving growth — revenue, win rate, retention, and expansion — not only delivery.

• Experience running a service-line P&L at scale — owning cost-to-serve, productivity, margin, and pricing logic.

• Experience leading senior delivery and product leaders — regional heads, process leads, and outsourcing-control / vendor-management leads — across multiple regions.

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations

We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Senior Project Manager, Martech and Data

PMO | Remote | Full-Time | EMEA

Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

BPX is hiring a Senior Project Manager to lead delivery of martech and customer data projects for enterprise clients. You will run workstreams inside large, multi-year transformation programmes, covering engagement platforms such as Braze, customer data platforms such as Twilio Segment, cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, and the content and work management tools around them. You own the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the client conversation, working alongside a programme manager, strategists, architects and specialist engineers. This is a hands-on role: you need enough technical understanding to challenge an estimate, spot a dependency between a data change and a live journey, and keep a mixed client and BPX team moving at pace. On every project you run, you are the person the client relies on to know where things stand.

What you'll do

  • Plan and lead martech and data projects from scoping and kick-off through build, testing, go-live and hypercare.

  • Build and maintain delivery plans, sprint plans and resource plans, and manage dependencies across workstreams, vendors and client teams.

  • Run agile ceremonies and governance, including stand-ups, sprint reviews, steering updates and status reporting.

  • Own RAID logs, change control and escalation, and resolve issues before they reach the client's timeline.

  • Track budget, hours and burn against plan, and flag variance and scope change early with options.

  • Coordinate use case backlogs and release plans with client product owners, marketing teams and IT.

  • Bring changes to live platforms safely, with clear testing, cutover and rollback plans.

  • Work with change and enablement leads so adoption is planned as part of delivery, not after it.

  • Support pre-sales with delivery plans, effort estimates and statements of work, and contribute to BPX's delivery methods and templates.

What you'll bring

  • Six or more years in project management, including at least three years delivering martech, CRM, data or digital technology projects.

  • Track record of running projects inside large enterprise programmes, with multiple workstreams, vendors and stakeholder groups.

  • Strong grasp of agile and hybrid delivery. Certification such as PRINCE2, PMP, AgilePM or Scrum Master is an advantage.

  • Working technical understanding of marketing automation, CDP or cloud data projects. Experience with Braze, Segment, Snowflake, Adobe or Salesforce platforms is an advantage.

  • Confident with delivery tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet or Workfront, and with tracking budget and hours against plan.

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated industries is an advantage.

  • Consulting or agency background, credible with senior client stakeholders and calm under pressure.

  • Fluent English and the right to work in an EMEA country where BPX operates.

Why this role, why now

BPX is delivering more large, multi-workstream martech and data programmes than ever, and project management is what keeps them on track. We are adding project managers so every workstream has an owner, and so our PMs can grow across more than one client. If you want to run real technology delivery, with modern platforms and specialist teams around you, rather than chase status updates, this is that seat.

jobs.title: Storyteller, New Media & Content
jobs.excerpt: About MenloMenlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
jobs.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

We’re building a humanoid robot in public, one day at a time. Asimov’s story already lives across X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Discord. It’s told by our team and by a growing community of builders who take our open-source CAD and code and make wild things with it. We need someone to turn that raw material into stories people can’t stop watching.

As our New Media & Content Storyteller, you’ll own how Menlo and Asimov show up on screen. You’ll find the story inside an engineering week, shoot it, cut it, and ship it in a format native to every platform. You’ll work from the lab floor alongside our engineers and researchers, not from a brief, and your lead character is a working humanoid.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Menlo’s short-form and long-form video end to end, taking each story from a moment in the lab to a finished, platform-native piece that ships the same week

  • Run our build-in-public series, turning daily progress across hardware, locomotion, and research into a narrative people follow day after day

  • Shoot, edit, and publish across X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, adapting each story to how that platform actually works

  • Find the story in the technical, working with engineers and researchers so a new gait, a firmware fix, or a policy breakthrough lands with a non-expert audience without dumbing it down

  • Amplify our community by spotting what builders make with Asimov, remixing it, and giving them a stage

  • Capture our demo nights, community talks, and launches, and turn each one into content that lives well beyond the event

  • Grow the audience: track what works, test formats and hooks fast, and double down on what lands

  • Shape Menlo’s voice on camera and in writing, and build a library of footage, scripts, and assets the whole company can draw on

What We Look For

  • You have a portfolio of video and social content that grew a real audience, whether for a brand, a product, or yourself

  • You shoot and edit fast with whatever’s on hand, from a phone to a proper rig, in Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar

  • You understand each platform natively, and you know why what works on TikTok fails on YouTube

  • You’re genuinely curious about technology and robotics, and happy to ask engineers basic questions until the story clicks

  • You write sharp hooks, scripts, captions, and threads

  • You ship constantly and treat analytics as feedback, not judgment

  • You use AI as a real collaborator in your creative workflow

Nice to Have

  • Experience creating content for a hardware, deep tech, or developer-focused company

  • An existing following on any platform

  • Comfort on camera as a host or narrator

  • Motion graphics, 3D, or animation skills in tools like After Effects or Blender

  • A background in film, journalism, or documentary, especially covering science or engineering

  • Experience working with creator and developer communities

Why Join Menlo

Most content roles are about making a product look exciting. Here, the product is a walking, open-source humanoid that gets better every week, and you’ll see every breakthrough before anyone else does. You’ll have room to experiment, an engineering team that builds in public by default, and a community already making content you can build on. If you want to tell the story of robots entering the world while it’s actually happening, come build it with us.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Business Development

Position Overview:


The Bengali Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Bengaliand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for a HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist to support the VA ESOMcontract. The HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialistserves as a trusted advisor for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) field organizations as they transition to ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) as the enterprise system of record. The Specialist leads change management at the site level, training field staff on new processes, tools, and expectations while maintaining operational continuity.

Kentro configured ServiceNow HAM for the VA, and this role is central to translating that configuration into consistent, policy-aligned practice in the field. The Specialist interprets VA asset management policy and directives, advises end users on compliant processes, and resolves complex and non-standard issues through root cause analysis and technical research, including issues involving device operating systems and how endpoint data is reflected in hardware asset records. The Specialist prioritizes incoming requests, tests and refines guidance to ensure end users receive accurate direction, and documents best practices that strengthen adoption and data quality across the enterprise.

Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,000 –$120,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.


Responsibilities

Change Management and Adoption

  • Lead site-level change management activities that prepare field staff to adopt ServiceNow HAM, including readiness assessments, targeted communications, and reinforcement of new processes.
  • Identify adoption barriers and sources of resistance, and partner with the Change Management team to develop targeted interventions that sustain behavior change.
  • Deliver training, coaching, and just-in-time support so field staff can independently navigate ServiceNow HAM, submit requests, and track status.
  • Reinforce job aids, standard operating procedures, and training materials, and recommend updates based on field feedback and observed adoption trends.
  • Monitor adoption indicators and field sentiment, escalating risks and recommending course corrections to program leadership.

Policy Interpretation and Compliance

  • Interpret VA and federal asset management policies, directives, and procedures, and translate requirements into clear, actionable guidance for field staff.
  • Ensure field practices and ServiceNow HAM usage align with applicable policy, identifying gaps and recommending corrective actions.
  • Advise stakeholders on how policy applies to non-standard scenarios, documenting interpretations to promote consistency across sites.

Client Relationships and Field Engagement

  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with VA field stakeholders.
  • Select the most effective communication channel (e.g., chat, email, phone, or virtual meeting) based on issue urgency and stakeholder needs.
  • Prioritize field requests, change management activities, and programmatic tasks based on urgency, operational impact, and site needs.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and provide proactive, timely updates through issue resolution.

Technical Issue Research and Resolution

  • Conduct root cause analysis and investigative research to resolve standard and non-standard asset, inventory, and ServiceNow HAM issues.
  • Apply working knowledge of device operating systems (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android) to diagnose issues with device identification and discovery, explain how endpoint data populates hardware asset records, and advise on operating system considerations that affect asset lifecycle decisions.
  • Test, validate, and iterate on resolution approaches and end-user guidance within ServiceNow to confirm accuracy before broader dissemination.
  • Escalate configuration defects and enhancement opportunities to the appropriate technical teams with clear supporting documentation.

Inventory and Asset Process Support

  • Support field inventory activities and reconciliation in ServiceNow HAM across the hardware asset lifecycle, from receipt through disposition.
  • Apply standardized asset processes consistently across field sites to strengthen data accuracy, accountability, and audit readiness.

Documentation and Best Practices

  • Document best practices and policy interpretations aligned to the ServiceNow HAM environment configured for the VA.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge articles and reference materials that enable field staff to complete tasks independently and consistently.
  • Capture lessons learned and field insights to inform continuous improvement of processes, training, and platform configuration.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science or technical discipline is required (8 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education).
  • 5+ years of experience in relationship management, change management, and/or IT asset management operations.
  • Working knowledge of IT hardware asset lifecycle activities, such as receiving, inventory, and disposition.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and adoption reinforcement.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret policies, regulations, or directives and apply them to ensure operational alignment.
  • Working knowledge of common device operating systems and their relationship to hardware asset data.
  • Proven ability to independently research, test, and resolve non-standard issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical processes to non-technical audiences and produce clear, accurate documentation.
  • Sound judgment in managing competing requests across multiple stakeholders and sites.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to consistently follow standardized procedures.
  • Experience operating within large, complex, and regulated organizations, preferably federal or federal-adjacent.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience with ServiceNow HAM, HAM Pro, or the Hardware Asset Workspace.
  • Experience supporting end users through a system implementation, rollout, or hypercare period.
  • Familiarity with federal property management and equipment accountability requirements.
  • Experience supporting inventory reconciliation or physical asset audits.
  • Prior experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs or another federal health or civilian agency.
  • Active ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator (CSA).

Clearance Requirement:

  • US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card)
  • Willing and able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance
  • Must meet updated ID requirements:
    • If you do not currently meet the ID requirements outlined, you must be willing and able to update your current forms of ID in a timely manner to complete the suitability process successfully.

Benefits

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. jobs.excerpt: JOB SUMMARY:The Senior Director, Strategic Information/Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (SI/MEL), Health Programs is a strategic leader within FHI 360, responsible for the technical leadership and strategic direction of strategic information, monitoring, evaluation, analytics, data systems, and learning (SI/MEL) across the Health Programs (HP) portfolio within the Programs and Research Group (PRG).
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Director, Strategic Information/Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (SI/MEL), Health Programs is a strategic leader within FHI 360, responsible for the technical leadership and strategic direction of strategic information, monitoring, evaluation, analytics, data systems, and learning (SI/MEL) across the Health Programs (HP) portfolio within the Programs and Research Group (PRG). The Senior Director also provides scientific and technical leadership in epidemiology, surveillance, health informatics, and data use. This role provides technical and operational oversight to a division comprised of multiple project SI/MEL teams, fosters innovation, and ensures the delivery of high-quality, timely, and actionable data aligned with organizational objectives and funder requirements. The Senior Director establishes and continually refines SI/MEL frameworks, approaches, tools, and activities; identifies specialized partnership needs; and engages qualified partners to ensure technical performance. Working across FHI 360 Health Programs projects and country portfolios, the Senior Director strengthens the integration of surveillance, MEL, data management, analytics, and digital health systems, in close collaboration with project SI/MEL leadership teams to ensure coherence, technical alignment, and mutual learning across initiatives. The Senior Director leads one integrated SI/MEL team that serves all Health Programs projects, so that each country has a single SI/MEL point of contact across awards, with shared standards, harmonized indicators, and staffing and level of effort planned across the portfolio. The Senior Director collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to gather and share evidence, lessons learned, and best practices to drive continuous improvement and organizational impact. The Senior Director serves as a recognized technical leader and thought partner in strategic information, surveillance, epidemiology, and health informatics. They also contribute technical leadership to new business development and represent FHI 360 as a thought leader in strategic information, health informatics, and data-driven program improvement. Engagement with country and field teams is exercised primarily through project SI/MEL leadership; direct, hands-on support to field teams is expected on bilateral awards and is provided to global projects at the request of project leadership. Their decisions are guided by organizational strategy and have significant short- and long-term impacts on public health and development outcomes.


RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

Complexity & Problem Solving:

  • Navigates complex and technically demanding SI/MEL challenges inherent in project implementation, requiring innovative approaches and deep analytical skills.
  • Offers strategic direction and innovative SI/MEL solutions for portfolio-specific challenges.
  • Analyzes project performance against indicator targets, data quality assessments, and portfolio-level trends, and identifies areas for improvement.
  • Recommends actionable solutions to enhance effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Fosters innovation and shares best practices to drive organizational impact.
  • Contributes to achieving sustainable development goals.
  • Resolves methodological and measurement problems that cross awards (conflicting indicator definitions, non-comparable denominators, data quality gaps, and evaluation design trade-offs) and sets the technical standard to be applied across the portfolio.
  • Strengthens institutional data governance, interoperability, and integration of information systems, including DHIS2, EMRs, LMIS, and custom databases.
  • Ensures project data systems meet funder reporting standards (e.g., DATIM, DHIS2, MER indicators) and support programmatic decision-making at all levels.
  • Provides technical leadership in the design, implementation, and utilization of surveillance systems and public health evaluations.
  • Leads efforts to strengthen the collection, analysis, interpretation, visualization, and use of health data across country portfolios.
  • Guides methodological approaches for surveillance and program evaluation.
  • Identifies opportunities to leverage routine health information systems, EMRs, surveillance platforms, and real-world data to improve program performance and public health outcomes.
  • Serves as a senior resource on epidemiologic methods, disease surveillance, measurement approaches, and data quality across the portfolio.

Discretion & Impact:

  • Exercises discretion over SI/MEL technical and methodological matters with direct impact on project outcomes and organizational success.
  • Makes decisions on resource allocation, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Influences portfolio performance and reputation.
  • Decisions contribute to achieving organizational objectives and driving positive change.
  • Impacts both short- and long-term public health outcomes.
  • Sets and enforces portfolio-wide SI/MEL technical standards; erroneous methodological or reporting decisions may result in inaccurate performance reporting to funders, audit findings, or critical delays in schedules.
  • Provides strategic insights that directly inform organizational strategy and programmatic priorities.

Collaboration & Interaction:

  • Engages with internal and external stakeholders to gather and share evidence, lessons learned, and best practices.
  • Fosters partnerships with project teams, funders, and implementing partners.
  • Facilitates communication and knowledge exchange to enhance project outcomes.
  • Communication style is characterized by transparency, collaboration, and teamwork.
  • Works cross-functionally to achieve common goals and drive organizational impact.
  • Establishes and maintains relationships across FHI 360, including with all Groups and Enterprise Support colleagues.
  • Serves as senior technical advisor to project leadership, to the SI/MEL Directors and Advisors assigned to FHI 360’s global health projects, and to headquarters management.
  • Provides high-level technical guidance on surveillance and data use for epidemic control, global health security, and cross-cutting health programs (HIV, TB, RMNCH, malaria, polio, AMR, etc.).
  • Supports proposal development by providing SI/MEL technical input, writing relevant sections, and contributing to results frameworks; promotes knowledge management and learning by synthesizing lessons learned, disseminating best practices, and contributing to technical briefs and conferences.
  • Builds capacity of FHI 360 technical teams and local partners in data management, visualization, and use of evidence for decision-making.
  • Cultivates strategic partnerships with ministries of health, U.S. Government agencies, multilateral and global health partners, academic institutions, foundations, and implementing partners.
  • Represents FHI 360 in technical working groups, conferences, funder engagements, and global technical forums.
  • Fosters collaboration between SI/MEL, surveillance, health informatics, digital health, and program teams to maximize data use and organizational learning.

Management & Supervision:

  • Oversees SI/MEL implementation across the projects within their division.
  • Provides leadership and guidance to project teams.
  • Sets strategic direction, manages budgets, and ensures programmatic quality.
  • Focuses on fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Manages project staff and shapes the portfolio structure for optimal efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Leads a team of seasoned technical experts, handling supervision, performance management, and professional development.
  • Leads one integrated SI/MEL team across Health Programs projects: assigns country backstops across awards, plans and monitors level of effort and workload across funding sources, manages transitions as countries move between awards, and ensures continuity of support to country teams.

Cardinal Health™ WaveMark™ Solutions, is a market leader in healthcare inventory automation and analytics providing a scalable, enterprise-level, cloud-based platform that integrates with clinical and financial systems. For more than 20 years, WaveMark™ has helped health systems automate and simplify clinical and supply chain workflows, enabling clinicians to spend less time managing supplies and more time focused on patient care.

Job Summary

The Interfaces Product Manager has primary responsibility for the delivery and lifecycle management of the Interfaces and API strategy roadmap to support supply chain and clinical workflow integration with the WaveMark solution. The role enables interoperability while preserving data fidelity required to sustain workflows supported within the solution. This role translates validated customer, user, business, integration, and technical needs into clearly defined product requirements and prioritized delivery work. The Product Manager manages assigned interfaces, APIs, features, and capabilities from discovery through definition, development, validation, launch readiness, adoption, optimization, and lifecycle support.


This individual contributor works independently on complex assignments with general guidance on new projects. The role leads assigned workstreams through influence and collaborates with Senior Product Managers, Engineering, Engineering Product Operations, Architecture, Design, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, Implementation, Support, Data & Analytics, Quality, Security, and Operations.
