jobs.title: International Recruiter – European Customer Service Roles – Bengaluru
jobs.excerpt: If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Bengaluru and across India.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

Please review the job details below.

Intuitive Machines - West is currently seeking a Senior Cost Estimating Analyst to join our team. This position can be based in our Palo Alto, CA office, or performed remotely within the U.S. In this role you will be responsible for leading cost estimating efforts across our commercial and government portfolio.

In order to be successful in this role, you must have strong experience in cost estimating for complex aerospace systems and programs. You will need proficiency in multiple estimating approaches including parametric modeling, engineering build-up, and analogy-based methods. This includes developing accurate cost estimates, bases of estimates, work breakdown structures, and supporting new business pursuits and program execution across both commercial and government contracts.

Intuitive Machines - West is a leading provider of comprehensive space technologies. We deliver innovative solutions to government and commercial customers helping them unlock the promise of space to solve problems on Earth and beyond. We address a broad spectrum of needs for our customers, including mission systems engineering, product design, spacecraft manufacturing, assembly, integration and testing. Intuitive Machines - West is a trusted partner in commercial and government missions, combining decades of deep mission understanding with reliable performance and longevity.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Lead cost estimating efforts for spacecraft systems, subsystems, and components across commercial and government programs
  • Analyze Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs), and other proposal documentation to develop accurate cost estimates
  • Work closely with program management, engineering, finance, and contracts teams to ensure alignment between technical solutions and cost estimates
  • Create engineering build-up estimates in collaboration with technical teams, incorporating labor, materials, and other direct costs
  • Generate submission-ready cost estimate documentation including bases of estimates (BOEs), bill of materials (BOMs), work breakdown structures (WBS), and cost volumes
  • Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and other government regulations when applicable
  • Develop detailed parametric cost estimates using industry-standard tools such as SEER-H (Galorath) or TruePlanning (Unison)
  • Develop and maintain parametric cost estimating relationships (CERs) based on historical data and industry benchmarks
  • Develop learning curve analyses and production rate impacts for recurring spacecraft production
  • Present cost estimates and estimating methodologies to executive leadership
  • Continuously improve estimating processes, tools, databases, and parametric models used by the team
  • Support audit reviews by government agencies when required, ensuring transparency and adherence to cost estimating policies

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, Mathematics, or related technical field. 4 additional years of relevant experience may be substituted for a degree.
  • Minimum of 5 years of cost estimating experience in aerospace, defense, or related technical industry
  • Experience developing cost estimates for complex hardware and/or software systems
  • Experience with multiple cost estimating methodologies including parametric, analogy-based, and engineering build-up approaches
  • Experience creating work breakdown structures, bases of estimates, and supporting cost documentation

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

  • Master's degree in engineering, finance, business, or related domain
  • 10+ years of experience in cost estimating for aerospace or satellite systems
  • Experience with parametric cost estimating tools such as SEER-H (Galorath), TruePlanning (Unison), or similar software
  • Experience developing and calibrating parametric cost estimating relationships (CERs) using historical data
  • Knowledge of FAR, DFARS, CAS, and TINA for government contract cost estimating
  • Experience with both commercial and government (DoD, NASA, Intelligence Community) cost estimating
  • Experience with ProPricer or other government proposal pricing software
  • Experience with learning curve theory and application to production cost estimates
  • Experience presenting to and supporting senior leadership decision-making
  • Proven track record of supporting successful commercial and government proposal wins
  • Active team player who works well under pressure and can manage multiple concurrent estimates
  • Organized, detail-oriented individual with ability to multi-task while maintaining accuracy and quality
  • Creativity in solving complex estimating challenges with limited data
  • Excellent analytical skills with ability to translate technical requirements into accurate cost estimates
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Excel (complex formulas, macros, data analysis)
  • Strong communication skills necessary to explain estimating methodologies and results to technical and business stakeholders

jobs.title: Video Editor
jobs.excerpt: IM8 is a next-generation health and longevity brand co-founded by David Beckham and Prenetics (NASDAQ: PRE), on a mission to make world-class nutritional science accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
IM8 is a next-generation health and longevity brand co-founded by David Beckham and Prenetics (NASDAQ: PRE), on a mission to make world-class nutritional science accessible to everyone. Launched in late 2024, IM8 grew Q1 2026 revenue nearly 6x year-over-year to $33.8M, and the company has raised full-year 2026 IM8 revenue guidance to $190M–$210M. Over 60% of revenue is generated outside the US. We ship to 43 countries, and our athlete partner roster includes David Beckham, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aryna Sabalenka, Ollie Bearman, and Inter Miami CF.

We are built on science, not story — our flagship Daily Ultimate Essentials carries 90 active ingredients, we run randomized controlled trials on our products, and we hold a clinical-grade standard in a category notorious for shortcuts.

Why This Role Is Different

Most editing roles are a queue: raw footage in, competent cuts out, and someone else decides whether it worked. This one isn't. At our growth rate, creative has to scale faster than the rest of the business or it becomes the bottleneck — we already generate hundreds of millions of views from AI-driven campaigns, and every video is a brand promise made in the first three seconds. On a subscription model with the LTV we're building, a hook that doesn't land isn't just a weak post — it's paid spend burned and a customer we never met. We need someone who treats the edit as a brand asset, not a service desk.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Video Editor — IM8, to own the day-to-day creation of scroll-stopping video across every social platform: direct-response ads, organic content, and long-form brand-building films. You are a master of pacing and storytelling, fluent from high-end editorial to direct response, and comfortable taking a brief and adding your own creative spin.

Your mandate: turn raw footage into content that stops the scroll and builds the brand — every cut, every platform, every time.

What You'll Do

  • Turn Shoots into Scroll-Stopping Content

  • Edit raw footage into high-performing video tailored for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and emerging platforms

  • Balance volume with quality — turn around multiple video concepts daily without dropping craft

  • Range across styles, from high-end editorial to direct response, taking a brief and adding your own creative spin.

Move Fast, Stay Sharp

  • Deliver polished, high-quality edits on tight deadlines while holding an exceptional technical and creative bar.

  • Manage revisions efficiently — take feedback, iterate, and protect the creative vision at the same time.

Collaborate Across Creative

  • Work with copywriters, designers, and the Creative Strategist to align on concept and storytelling, from initial brief to final cut.

  • Keep brand expression consistent and compelling across every video touchpoint.

Stay Plugged In

  • Keep ahead of editing trends, meme formats, and platform updates, then bring fresh techniques into our workflow.

  • Know what's blowing up before everyone else does — and use it.

Maintain Brand Consistency

  • Ensure a consistent look and feel across all video content, working within brand guidelines while finding room to push creative boundaries.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years in video editing, with a portfolio of polished, high-quality short-form social content that demonstrates mastery of pacing, storytelling, and advanced technique.

  • Video ads produced for high-growth eCommerce brands, across both editorial and direct-response styles.

  • Command of advanced editing — creative transitions, visual effects, and innovative methods that elevate content beyond standard cuts.

  • Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or comparable tools, and you know how to push them to their creative limits.

  • A strong grasp of social-first storytelling: what hooks an audience versus what gets scrolled past

  • Genuine passion for culture, trends, and the social media landscape.

Non-Negotiable

  • You have personally cut short-form content that performed at scale — not vibes, real views and real spend behind it — or a clear, specific reason why that benchmark doesn't apply to your trajectory. If you can't make that case in a sentence, this isn't your role

  • You are open-minded, coachable, and able to take feedback without losing your creative point of view.

Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics and 3D experience with Blender or Cinema 4D.

  • Experimenting with AI tools for editing and ideation.

  • Long-form / editorial brand-building video experience alongside short-form.

You Must Be AI-Native

Active, fluent daily AI tool usage is mandatory, not optional. We expect you to be embedding AI into every workflow you touch on day one.

Beat Claude Challenge

Shortlisted candidates complete a role-specific assignment, scored against a baseline we generate using Claude — same data, blind review. To advance, your thinking needs to be better than what the best AI produces. Ties don't advance.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, Lovelytics helps some of the most complex enterprises across Energy & Utilities, Media & Entertainment, Manufacturing, Retail & CPG, Healthcare and Financial Services modernize their data and put AI to work, not in a deck, but in production. We move fast, stay close to the cutting edge, and care more about outcomes than optics.

Our work spans the full data and AI lifecycle: Data Strategy & Advisory, Data Engineering, Analytics & Visualization, Generative AI & ML, and Cloud Migration & Modernization. All of it is delivered primarily on Databricks, with deep partnerships across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

In September 2026, Lovelytics became a CDW company. CDW completed its acquisition on September 25, 2026, bringing our team into its Data & Analytics Practice. Together, we can take customers from data strategy to production AI with a single partner across the full technology lifecycle.

About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

jobs.description:
About Clarenza

Clarenza is building the capital markets layer that helps private market investors move faster with more confidence, connecting the right counterparties, surfacing credible deal intelligence, and translating market nuance into decision-ready clarity for investment committees.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who thinks like an investor. You will use Clarenza the way an associate at a buyout or growth fund would: running data rooms through the platform, checking every figure against its source, and pinpointing where our KPIs and investment memos can better reflect the underlying documents. This is not generic software testing. Your work will directly improving the product experience. This role reports to the CEO.

What You’ll Own

  • Deal Processing: Running test and live data rooms (CIMs, management accounts, audited statements, cap tables, board packs) through Clarenza and reviewing the KPIs and memos it produces.

  • Figure Verification: Matching every number to its source across revenue, EBITDA, margins, ARR, growth, net debt, cash burn, headcount and market size.

  • Error Detection: Hunting for the classic errors: scale and unit mistakes, wrong or mixed currencies, period mismatches (FY vs LTM vs quarter, calendar vs fiscal year), adjusted and reported figures presented as the same thing, sign errors, double counting, totals that don't add up, implausible values, and CIM claims that contradict the audited accounts.

  • Red-Flag Test Rooms: Building realistic data rooms with planted inconsistencies and scoring whether Clarenza catches them.

  • Answer Key: Maintaining the correct value, source and page for every KPI, so each new release can be checked against it.

  • Issue Logging: Documenting findings precisely in our issue tracker (document, page, expected value, reported value, severity and steps to reproduce).

Who You Are

  • Education: Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's programme in finance, accounting, economics or business, or an equivalent qualification (for example, a CFA candidate while at university), with enrolment status and study regulations that allow this internship.

  • Financial Fluency: A solid grasp of the three financial statements and how they link, including EBITDA adjustments, working capital and net debt. You know why adjusted and reported EBITDA differ.

  • Excel: Strong Excel skills.

  • Private Markets Interest: A clear interest in private equity, venture capital, growth equity, buyouts or family office investing.

  • Sceptical Mindset: Meticulous and comfortable saying a number is wrong, then proving it.

  • Autonomy: Clear written communication and the discipline to work remotely without close supervision.

  • Language: Fluent English (C1 or above), written and spoken.

  • Nice to Have: A previous internship in PE, VC, M&A, transaction services, audit or corporate finance; valuation, LBO or three-statement modelling experience; SaaS metrics knowledge (ARR, NRR, CAC payback); German (many DACH deal documents are in German); membership of a student finance club; hands-on use of AI tools, with basic Python or SQL as a plus.

Location & Working Style

  • Location: Remote-first, with working hours overlapping CET. The team is based in Hamburg (HQ), Vienna and Lisbon.

  • Engagement: Unpaid internship, either a mandatory curricular internship or a voluntary internship alongside your studies. 3 months (longer only if required by your study regulations), 15 to 20 hours per week, flexible start.

  • Development: Weekly 1:1 with the CEO, a written learning plan agreed in week one, midpoint and final reviews, a detailed internship certificate (Praktikumszeugnis), a personal reference and university paperwork on successful completion. Where there is a strong fit, a conversation about future roles with us.

  • How to Apply: Send your CV (one page preferred), a short note (max 200 words) on why private markets interest you, confirmation of your enrolment and whether this would be a mandatory internship, and your preferred start date, duration, and weekly hours to with the subject "Financial Analyst Internship". The process is a 20-minute intro call, a 60-minute take-home exercise (a two-page financial summary with deliberate errors to find), and a 30-minute walkthrough of your findings and audit trail.

You’ll work within the team’s established processes, test harness, CI pipelines, and reporting systems to develop integration tests in Go within the service repositories. You’ll migrate relevant checks from the Java suite closer to the service code, ensure test results remain visible, and maintain the remaining Java tests throughout the transition.

Tech Stack: Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Docker, testcontainers, and GitHub Actions. The existing regression coverage also includes a Java test suite (TestNG, Maven), with reporting in ReportPortal.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain Go integration tests for Backoffice services using real infrastructure dependencies and the team’s existing test harness.

  • Own the testing backlog for Backoffice services, prioritising coverage, selecting the appropriate testing level, and determining which checks should remain in the Java suite.

  • Migrate selected test scenarios from Java to Go within the service repositories, preserving relevant checks and removing those that are no longer needed.

  • Integrate tests into existing CI pipelines and maintain reliable test execution, ensuring clear visibility of results, investigating failures, and fixing or explicitly retiring flaky tests.

  • Maintain the remaining Java tests until they are migrated or removed.

  • Collaborate with Backoffice engineers to improve service testability while following existing testing patterns and reporting standards.

Required Experience:

  • Solid hands-on experience with Go, including writing maintainable tests and reusable helpers within existing services, rather than one-off scripts.

  • Practical experience with integration testing using real dependencies (databases, caches, or message brokers) via Docker or testcontainers.

  • Ability to determine when unit testing is sufficient, when integration testing is needed, and when end-to-end testing is unnecessary.

  • Experience testing HTTP APIs, including API clients, contracts, and behavioural assertions.

The Director, Payer Relations – Regional is responsible for developing and executing regional payer engagement and coverage strategy for the TearCare® System.   • Develop and execute a regional payer-relations strategy for TearCare aligned with Market Access, commercial, clinical, medical, legal, and compliance priorities.
  • Prioritize regional payer organizations based on patient impact, policy opportunity, access barriers, provider needs, and business priorities; maintain account-specific engagement and coverage plans.

  • Coordinate with Field Reimbursement Managers and Sales leadership to identify regional access barriers, distinguish account-level reimbursement issues from payer-policy issues, and establish appropriate escalation and follow-up pathways.
  • Provide payer-policy interpretation and strategic guidance to internal stakeholders while avoiding guarantees of coverage or payment and preserving payer-specific nuance.
  • Create executive-ready regional updates that summarize payer engagement, policy status, open barriers, opportunities, risks, decisions needed, and next actions.
  • Represent Sight Sciences at payer meetings, medical society discussions, healthcare policy forums, and other relevant external engagements as assigned.

  • Bachelor’s degree in health policy, healthcare administration, business, life sciences, health economics, public health, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in payer relations, market access, reimbursement, health policy, managed care, medical affairs, health economics, or a related healthcare field, including leadership of payer-facing initiatives.

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects with Sales, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, Government Affairs, and Marketing partners.

Our client is a fast-growing consumer goods brand with distribution across DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail. US production, inventory, fulfilment, and logistics run through an outsourced 3PL and co-manufacturing partner, with an Australia-based team and a US Operations Director overseeing the overall plan.

About the Role

We're looking for an Operations Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of US production, inventory, fulfilment, and logistics through the 3PL and co-manufacturing partners. You'll set daily priorities, hold partners accountable to their commitments, resolve operational issues end to end, and give the Operations Director accurate reporting and practical recommendations.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You are not coordinating from a distance: you're the main day-to-day point of accountability for the 3PL and co-manufacturer relationships, multi-channel fulfilment, inventory accuracy, and financial controls.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day relationship with the 3PL and co-manufacturer, aligning priorities, confirming commitments and deadlines, and holding partners accountable for delivery
  • Report on dispatches, aged orders, production, stock, and risks, including sales run rates against forecasts with variances flagged
  • Investigate missed commitments with evidence, drive recovery actions, and escalate capacity gaps and stockout risks before commitments are missed
  • Turn the approved production plan into agreed daily and weekly schedules, tracking actual units by SKU and component availability
  • Keep production jobs, purchase orders, receipts, and records accurate in Cin7, and document and resolve quality complaints with corrective actions
  • Manage DTC, wholesale, Faire, Amazon, and retail fulfilment, keeping PO versions, routing, BOL, ASN, and EDI records current
  • Resolve overdue, partial, replacement, and unscanned orders, and track domestic freight through to customer delivery
  • Coordinate stock counts and month-end reconciliations, and resolve discrepancies across Cin7, the 3PL's warehouse system, Shopify, Faire, and Amazon
  • Check 3PL, co-manufacturing, and freight charges against approved rates, document errors and losses, and give Finance accurate shipment costs and invoice follow-up
  • Improve recurring workflows to reduce manual effort and errors, document procedures, and verify AI-assisted outputs
  • Analyse fulfilment and freight costs by channel and check packaging and shipping assumptions for new products and bundles

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in fulfilment, logistics, inventory, or production, including experience managing US operations with US-based 3PLs, co-manufacturers, domestic carriers, and US retail and Amazon requirements
  • At least 2 to 3 years at manager level as the main day-to-day owner of an outsourced 3PL relationship, covering priorities, SLAs, stock accuracy, invoice checks, and partner accountability
  • At least 2 to 3 years at manager level as the main day-to-day owner of a co-manufacturer relationship, covering production scheduling, packaging, quality checks, and corrective actions
  • Evidence of independent ownership, such as a partner transition or turnaround you led, KPIs you were accountable for, disputes and credits you recovered, or escalations you brought with a recommendation
  • Confident with Cin7 or a comparable inventory system, Shopify, and 3PL warehouse management systems
  • Multi-channel fulfilment experience across DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail, including routing guides, BOL, ASN, and EDI
  • Strong reconciliation and reporting skills with excellent Excel or Google Sheets
  • Clear, confident written and spoken English

Nice to Have

  • Experience in consumer products manufactured, warehoused, and shipped across multiple channels
  • Background in organic, health, or beauty consumer goods
  • Experience with month-end operations reviews and presenting KPI results and recommendations to senior leadership

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US Eastern Time business hours, plus regular calls with an Australia-based team during US late afternoon and evening

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your 3PL and co-manufacturer management experience, and walking through a specific operational problem you owned and resolved end to end with evidence

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

💼 Senior HR Director
🌍 Open to Latin America: This role is open to candidates based in Latin America.

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing, multi-vertical industrial and commercial real estate company currently at 40 to 45 employees and scaling to 80 to 100 within two years. With a clear and active growth trajectory, they're building their people function from the ground up.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior HR Director to build the people function from scratch, owning talent acquisition, executive recruiting, organizational design, performance management, management development, employee relations, and a measurable accountability culture.

This is not a traditional HR role, and the company doesn't need a compliance administrator. It needs a strategic operator who thinks in terms of human capital ROI, builds systems that surface and retain high performers, manages out underperformers decisively and compliantly, and can personally headhunt C-suite and senior operational leaders. You'll be the sole dedicated HR resource, reporting directly to senior leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Own recruitment at all levels, from entry-level hires through executive search, building a repeatable, fast hiring process that supports growth to 80 to 100 employees
  • Personally lead executive searches, including sourcing, assessment, and closing senior candidates such as COOs, CMOs, and VPs
  • Plan resources and headcount with business unit leaders to anticipate hiring needs before they become urgent
  • Design and manage onboarding and offboarding so new hires reach full productivity quickly and exits are consistent, compliant, and respectful
  • Design performance evaluations and a quarterly check-in cadence, and implement KPIs with business unit leadership to create a measurable accountability culture
  • Identify fit issues early in each employee's tenure and address them fairly, with documentation, including transitions where needed
  • Build a culture of opportunity with career maps and development paths, and develop managers' leadership capability so accountability cascades through the organization
  • Lead organizational design as the company scales and structures evolve
  • Handle employee relations and day-to-day people issues promptly, with fairness and discretion
  • Write, maintain, and consistently administer policies, procedures, and the employee handbook, keeping them current with US employment regulations
  • Manage US employment law compliance across distributed team structures, including EOR and contractor frameworks
  • Lead change initiatives, communicate them clearly, and confirm buy-in and consistent enforcement at all levels of management

What We're Looking For

  • Senior people, talent, or HR leadership experience in a growing entrepreneurial environment, with verifiable experience scaling a company from roughly 40 to 50 employees to 100 or more
  • Sophisticated executive search capability, including personally headhunting and closing senior leadership hires rather than relying on applicant pipelines
  • Significant exposure to US employment practices and compliance, including at-will employment, EOR and contractor frameworks, and distributed teams
  • Strong commercial judgment, able to speak in terms of headcount ROI, labor efficiency, and performance metrics
  • Exceptional spoken and written English with the executive presence and directness to influence senior leaders and deliver difficult feedback
  • Self-managing, with a genuine desire to build rather than maintain and a track record of creating people processes from scratch
  • Full commitment to working US Central Standard Time business hours
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; strong practical experience will be weighted heavily

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a multi-vertical company spanning operations-intensive verticals such as warehousing, logistics, construction, or real estate alongside professional services or capital management
  • Background working with US-based companies or US workforces from an offshore or remote capacity
  • Familiarity with EOR platforms such as Deel or Remote for cross-border employment compliance
  • Experience in Latin America or South Africa with strong exposure to US company operating culture

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Full-time commitment to US Central Standard Time business hours

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume with specific detail on organizations you helped build or transform, approximate employee populations managed, and senior positions you personally recruited
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your experience scaling HR at a company from the 40 to 50 person stage upward, and walking through one underperformance situation you managed directly and how you resolved it
  • A written response (one page maximum) to this scenario: a 45-person entrepreneurial company intends to become an 80 to 100 person organization. Outline your first 90 days, showing how you would audit the current team, create accountability, establish the recruiting function, and begin searches for a COO, asset manager, and sales and construction management personnel

Only candidates who submit all three components will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: Financial Client Services Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Our Organization This position supports our trusted behavioral health programs within the Advanced Recovery Systems family.
jobs.description:
About Our Organization

This position supports our trusted behavioral health programs within the Advanced Recovery Systems family. Advanced Recovery Systems is the parent organization of The Recovery Village, Promises Behavioral Health, The Right Step, and The Ranch, bringing together established treatment brands with a shared commitment to expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based addiction and mental health care.

In this role, you will be part of a larger, growing organization focused on improving patient outcomes, supporting our employees, and strengthening the communities we serve.

The Financial Client Services Specialist provides centralized, patient-centered financial counseling and upfront patient collections for all Advanced Recovery Systems Outpatient and Intensive Outpatient (IOP) facilities, including both affiliated and stand-alone sites.

The Financial Client Services Specialist is accountable for all insurance and benefit verification, patient financial responsibility review, financial counseling, and upfront collection of private-pay fees, copays, deductibles, and other patient responsibility for assigned Outpatient patients. This position focuses solely on financial and insurance responsibilities.

The Financial Client Services Specialist reports directly to the National Director of Outpatient Services and partners closely with Outpatient facility leadership, Admissions, Utilization Review, and Revenue Cycle Management to support consistent financial workflows across the Outpatient network.

CORE JOB DUTIES:

1. Serve as the centralized financial point of contact for patients and responsible parties at all Outpatient and IOP facilities, including affiliated and stand-alone sites, providing services virtually by telephone, video, and secure electronic communication.

2. Complete insurance eligibility and benefit verification for all assigned Outpatient patients prior to or at admission by contacting payers directly and/or using online payer portals (e.g., Availity, Navinet, Instamed) or other approved applications, following the “Collection of Patient Responsibility” procedures.

3. Identify coverage details including deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, coordination of benefits, network status, and pre-authorization requirements, and communicate findings to Admissions, Utilization Review, and facility leadership as appropriate.

4. Calculate and provide accurate estimates of patient financial responsibility and educate patients and responsible parties on insurance benefits, billing expectations, financial policies, and available payment options.

5. Collect applicable private-pay fees, copays, deductibles, and other patient responsibility upfront and within 24 hours of admission, and establish approved payment arrangements for balances not covered by third-party insurance, or for patients without coverage, in accordance with organizational policy.

6. Ensure patients sign the “Notice of Standard Billing Practices/Acknowledgement” and all pertinent financial forms in the Financial Counseling bundle within 72 hours of admission, using approved electronic signature tools.

7. When copays or deductibles cannot be collected, have the patient complete an “Advance Repayment Agreement” for monies advanced and notify the Admissions team and facility leadership. Work with Admissions on the resolution and collection of agreed-upon funds.

8. Process credit card and other payments through approved virtual payment terminal systems and maintain accurate daily payment records.

9. Maintain accurate and timely financial documentation in the EHR, including insurance information, guarantor order, insurance details, collections, payments, payment arrangements, financial counseling, and patient or responsible party communication.

10. Monitor insurance coverage throughout the treatment episode and re-verify benefits for coverage changes, lapses, new benefit periods, and coordination-of-benefits issues; promptly communicate changes in patient financial responsibility to the patient and site leadership.

11. Collaborate with Outpatient facility leadership, Admissions, Business Development, Utilization Review, and Revenue Cycle Management to resolve financial and insurance barriers and support a smooth financial experience for patients.

12. Submit weekly deposit reconciliation to Revenue Cycle Management or the designated facility representative and update all related tracking spreadsheets.

13. Meet established performance expectations for verification turnaround, upfront collections, financial form completion, payment arrangements, and timely documentation, and proactively follow up on outstanding patient balances and financial items.

14. Escalate significant financial, coverage, payment, or documentation barriers to the Program Director/Coordinator and National Director of Outpatient Services when resolution falls outside the scope of the position.

OTHER REQUIRED TASKS:

15. Provide strong customer service by promptly answering and returning patient and family calls and inquiries regarding insurance and patient funding, resolving issues and concerns within 24 hours whenever possible.

16. Track and follow up on information requests from patients, facility leadership, and the National Director of Outpatient Services.

17. Assist with month-end close, reporting, and reconciliation activities as needed.

18. Support standardization of financial counseling and collection workflows across all Outpatient sites and assist leadership with process improvement initiatives.

19. Attend required virtual team, operational, and individual check-in meetings.

20. Accept and incorporate supervisory feedback and adapt to changing workflow, patient, and site needs.

21. Maintain professional and technical knowledge through required education, training, and ongoing professional development.

22. Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, state, federal, accreditation, and organizational requirements, including secure handling of patient information in a remote work environment.

23. Perform other duties as assigned to support patient services and organizational operations.

Requirements

Education:

  • Minimum of a High School diploma required.
  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, healthcare administration, or a related field is preferred.

Experience:

  • Experience working in a remote setting.
  • Minimum two years of experience in healthcare financial counseling, insurance verification, patient access, patient collections, or revenue cycle preferred.
  • Experience in behavioral healthcare or outpatient settings and prior remote work experience preferred.

This position is fully remote, with flexible start times between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Some travel may be required as the role evolves and responsibilities expand.

Benefits

We offer great benefits including 401(k), paid time off plan, medical, dental, vision, and much more.

The Company complies with state and federal nondiscrimination laws and policies that prohibit discrimination based on age, color, disability, national origin, race, religion, or sex. It is unlawful to retaliate against individuals or groups based on the basis of their participation in a complaint of discrimination or on the basis of their opposition to discriminatory practices/EEO

We are proud to be a drug-free workplace.

jobs.title: FCM - Corporate Travel Consultant (T.Rowe Price Team) - Remote, USA
jobs.excerpt: Corporate Travel Consultant (T. Rowe Price Team)FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.
jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant (T.Rowe Price Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday.

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI tools to assist in various stages, including the screening and assessment of applications. These tools support our evaluation of candidates based on role relevant qualifications, skills and experience. All decisions are made by our hiring team and stakeholders.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. jobs.description:
About World Business Lenders (www.wbl.com)

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general purpose short-term real estate collateralized commercial loans to a broad customer base comprised of small and medium sized businesses throughout the United States that lack access to traditional funding.

WBL services its loan portfolio and loan portfolios for third parties, specializing in the management of non-performing loan pools and REO.

Position Details:

  • WBL is a U.S.-based company with a 100% remote workforce.
  • This is a remote Contractor position.
  • Working hours will be 9:00 AM-6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.
  • The job requires excellent oral and written command of the English language.
  • Resumes must be submitted in English.

Position Summary:

  • The Internal Communication Analyst ensures employees have accurate, timely, and accessible information by maintaining the People Department SharePoint/intranet, keeping the company’s organizational charts up to date, drafting company-wide announcements, and developing policies and SOPs for every department in partnership with department heads.
  • With a strong data and automation profile, the analyst also identifies opportunities to streamline recurring communications and organizational change processes.
  • This role requires exceptional written and verbal English skills, as the analyst will communicate with employees, managers, and leadership across the company.

About the Role:

  • This role is part of the Communications Team within the People Department, working alongside the Marketing Analyst to ensure all company communications are clear, consistent, and delivered on time.
  • The Internal Communication Analyst combines strong writing skills with a data-driven approach, using tools such as Power BI, Excel, and Power Automate to improve how information is managed and shared across the company.

Typical Day-to-Day:

  • Drafting and distributing announcements for new hires, promotions, departmental changes, and other organizational updates.
  • Updating organizational charts and coordinating related changes with Information Operations and the People Department.
  • Publishing and organizing documents, templates, and resources on the SharePoint/intranet.
  • Drafting or updating policies and SOPs with input from stakeholders.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Case Manager Lead is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination, and execution of the pre-litigation case management team within the pod. This role ensures cases are properly investigated, documented, and progressed toward demand preparation and settlement.

The Case Manager Lead acts as the operational leader for the case manager team, ensuring case managers execute consistently, maintain organized files, and follow firm workflows and documentation standards. This role partners closely with the Pre-Litigation Attorney, who provides legal direction and strategy for cases.

What You Will Own

1. Case Manager Team Supervision

  • Supervise 3–5 Pre-Litigation Case Managers within the pod

  • Provide guidance on case handling procedures and documentation standards

  • Provide coaching and day-to-day support to help case managers execute effectively
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between the case manager team and the Pre-Litigation Attorney
  • Handle escalations from clients and providers, resolving issues before they reach the attorney or Ops Manager

2. Medical Management & Case Value Ownership

6. Personal Caseload Management

  • Manage approximately 50 active pre-litigation cases, with an emphasis on higher-value matters

What You Bring

jobs.excerpt: Build at the front edge of AI. Use Claude Code every day to turn complex business problems into working software — fast.
jobs.description:
Build at the front edge of AI.

Use Claude Code every day to turn complex business problems into working software — fast.

About the Role

We’re one of the leading workforce management software companies, building technology used by businesses to manage their people, attendance, payroll, performance, and operations.

We’re looking for an exceptional AI Product Development Engineer to join us. This is not a traditional software development role. You’ll be working in an environment where AI is used every day to design, build, test, and improve real software products at incredible speed.

Claude Code is a core part of how we work. You’ll use it to research problems, design solutions, build prototypes, test functionality, debug issues, and rapidly iterate on new product ideas.

If you want to understand where software development is going over the next few years, this is the kind of role where you’ll experience it firsthand.

Why This Is an Exceptional Opportunity

You’ll be working right at the forefront of AI-assisted software development — not by watching demos, taking courses, or experimenting on side projects, but by using AI every day to solve real business problems and build real software for real companies.

We are building exceptional things at lightning speed, and you’ll be right in the middle of it. You’ll see how experienced business leaders think through problems, how experienced software developers structure and review solutions, and how AI can dramatically compress the entire development cycle.

For the right person, the learning curve will be extremely steep. It would be difficult to find an environment where you can get more practical exposure to AI-driven software development in such a short period of time.

· Work with Claude Code every day.

  • Build and test new software concepts at lightning speed.
  • Learn how to direct AI effectively rather than simply ask it to generate code.
  • Learn how to evaluate AI output critically and spot what it gets wrong or misses.
  • See how AI changes product design, software development, testing, and iteration.
  • Work directly with deeply experienced business leaders and software developers.
  • Solve complex, real-world problems for internal teams and enterprise clients.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Work with internal stakeholders and enterprise clients to understand real business problems and product requirements.
  • Think deeply about the problem before jumping into development.
  • Break complex problems down into clear functional and technical solutions.
  • Design practical, simple, and intuitive software experiences.
  • Use Claude Code as a core part of your daily development workflow.
  • Rapidly build working software prototypes and product features.
  • Use Claude Code to write, review, debug, refactor, and test code.
  • Develop new features and enhancements for our workforce management platform.
  • Build customized software features for enterprise clients.
  • Test your own work thoroughly, including usability, functional, and edge-case testing.
  • Iterate rapidly based on stakeholder feedback.
  • Work with experienced developers to move successful prototypes into production.
  • Continuously experiment with better ways to use AI to build software faster and better.

This Role Is About Thinking, Not Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a specification and then starts programming. We want someone who can be given a difficult problem and figure it out.

You should naturally ask:

What is the real problem here?

What is the simplest effective solution?

How should the user experience work?

What could go wrong?

What are the edge cases?

How can I use Claude Code to build and test this quickly?

Your job is not to manually write as much code as possible. Your job is to solve product problems quickly and intelligently using AI.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field.
  • Strong academic background, preferably from one of the leading universities in the Philippines.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals.
  • Ability to build modern web applications and software prototypes.
  • Experience with Claude Code, or a strong desire to become exceptionally good at it.
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking.
  • Ability to break complicated problems into clear, solvable parts.
  • Strong product mindset and an ability to understand what users actually need.
  • A natural flair for application design, UI/UX, and intuitive workflows.
  • Curiosity and the willingness to keep digging until you understand a problem properly.
  • Confidence to work independently without needing every step spelled out.

· Strong English communication skills.

Who You’ll Learn From

One of the biggest advantages of this role is the people you’ll work with. You’ll collaborate directly with deeply experienced business leaders, product thinkers, and software developers.

  • Experienced business leaders who understand how companies operate and what customers really need.
  • Experienced software developers who have spent years building complex systems.
  • Product leaders who can help you understand how great software gets designed.
  • Enterprise clients with complex, real-world operational problems.

You won’t be sitting in a corner receiving tickets. You’ll be part of the conversations where problems are understood, solutions are designed, prototypes are built, and products are improved.

How We Build

We move fast. We build. We test. We learn. We improve. And then we do it again. AI is not an add-on to how we work — it is at the center of how we build software.

If You Want to Become Exceptional at AI-Assisted Software Development

This role is designed for someone who wants to become extremely good at building software with AI.

You’ll be surrounded by people who are actively pushing what is possible with these tools and building at a pace that would have been difficult to imagine only a few years ago.

If you’re technically strong, highly curious, ambitious, and excited about the future of software development, this is the kind of environment where you can learn incredibly fast — while building real things every day.

Think deeply. Build fast. Learn AI by doing it every day.

jobs.description:
About the team

The Social Media team at Zillow sits within Marketing and Corporate Affairs and helps bring our brand to life across the channels where people discover, engage with, and talk about Zillow every day. We’re a collaborative, creative, and data-informed group that partners closely with brand marketing, creative, analytics, and cross-functional teams to build meaningful connections with home shoppers, renters, and real estate professionals. Together, we use storytelling, audience insights, and real-time performance learnings to create social experiences that support Zillow’s business goals and reflect our customer-first approach.

About the role

We’re looking for a strategic, creative, and community-minded social marketer to help grow Zillow’s presence with real estate professionals.

In this role, you’ll help lead social strategy for Zillow For Agents, building a channel that agents actively choose to follow, engage with, and participate in. You’ll develop content that helps agents grow their businesses, understand Zillow’s products and offerings, stay connected to what’s happening across the industry, and connect directly with their peers.

Agents are at the center of this work. You’ll build relationships across the agent community and find creative ways to bring their expertise, experiences, and voices into Zillow’s social presence - whether through an ongoing ambassador relationship, a creator partnership, a conversation captured at an industry event, or an organic post worth amplifying.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B social strategy, community building, content, and advocacy. The ideal candidate understands that growing an influential B2B social presence requires more than publishing great content: it requires deeply understanding the audience, building relationships with them, and creating a community people want to be part of.


This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $93,900.00 - $150,100.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $89,200.00 - $142,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Own and evolve Zillow For Agents social strategy, translating business priorities, audience needs, product moments, industry trends, and cultural opportunities into compelling social programming across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
  • Drive audience growth and engagement by developing programming designed specifically for real estate professionals - continually testing new formats, franchises, voices, partnerships, and distribution strategies to expand Zillow’s reach and relevance with agents.
  • Lead social-first content development, partnering with creative teams and agencies to develop content that’s built for the way agents consume and engage with social.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the agent audience and business, staying close to the conversations, challenges, trends, and opportunities shaping agents’ work and using those insights to inform social strategy and content.
  • Build and grow Zillow’s agent social community, identifying and cultivating relationships with credible, influential agents who can become active advocates for the brand. Maintain an always-on pipeline of agent talent and create opportunities for agents to engage with Zillow, one another, and the broader Zillow For Agents community and use our channels to amplify their POVs.
  • Activate agent voices through social-first storytelling, bringing agents into Zillow content through testimonials, product stories, educational content, events, campaigns, organic amplification, and other opportunities that showcase their expertise and experiences.
  • Lead social strategy for agent events and industry moments, developing pre-event, on-site, and post-event programming that extends the impact of Zillow-owned and industry events through content, community participation, and agent storytelling.
  • Partner cross-functionally across the agent business, building strong relationships with Product Marketing, Sales, Events, Communications, Research, Partnerships, Paid Media, and other teams to uncover stories, talent, insights, and opportunities that can come to life on social. The current role already functions as a connective point across many of these teams.
  • Use performance and audience insights to continuously improve the strategy, identifying what resonates with agents and translating those learnings into stronger content, programming, and community initiatives.

What we’re looking for


  • 4–6+ years of experience in social media, B2B marketing, community, content marketing, creator marketing, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and what makes content successful across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.
  • Experience developing social or content strategies tied to measurable audience growth, engagement, or business objectives.
  • A strong instinct for community building - you understand how brands can create relationships with audiences rather than simply market to them.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills and comfort working directly with customers, creators, partners, or other external talent.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to recognize a compelling story, credible voice, or social opportunity - and quickly determine how to bring it to life.
  • Experience working with creators, influencers, ambassadors, advocates, or user-generated content programs; experience managing or partnering with an influencer agency is a plus.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex products, business priorities, and industry topics into approachable social content.
  • Ability to operate strategically while still being willing to execute - from developing an annual strategy to grabbing a camera at an event when a great story presents itself.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to navigate multiple stakeholders, priorities, approvals, and workstreams.
