jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: FMX is looking to expand our Sales team to support continued growth while ensuring our current customers continue to receive a great experience with FMX.
jobs.description:
FMX is looking to expand our Sales team to support continued growth while ensuring our current customers continue to receive a great experience with FMX.

The Account Manager is part of the Sales team and focuses on increasing customer value and “stickiness” through account expansion. In this role, you’ll identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional features and solutions to customers within your territory, helping them get more out of FMX as their needs evolve.

You’ll work in a fast-paced, high-energy, and collaborative environment where you’ll be expected to bring initiative every day, contribute to our sales strategy, and positively impact our company culture.

Responsibilities:

As an Account Manager, you will:

  • Upsell and cross-sell additional features of the FMX software
  • Convert leads generated by the retention team and generate leads within assigned territory
  • Prospect for new leads through the use of sales sequences and tools
  • Present informed offers that take into account customers’ goals, needs, and recent activity
  • Keep accounts in compliance with the licenses that were purchased
  • Collaborate regularly with the Marketing department to produce effective campaigns
  • Record meetings, phone calls, follow-ups, and miscellaneous tasks in Gainsight
  • Follow upsell and expansion playbook to work an account from qualified to closed
  • Collaborate with the Customer Retention Manager and the rest of the CS team to build pipeline and close deals
  • Travel to customer events; approximately 1-3 events per quarter

Requirements

Experience & Qualities:
What are we looking for in this role?

  • Strong knowledge of the FMX platform
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas
  • The ability to connect customer goals, product usage, and setup to identify meaningful expansion opportunities
  • Strong relationship-building skills across customers and executive stakeholders
  • The ability to understand customer needs, goals, and what success looks like for them
  • Good judgment around when and how to proactively engage customers
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, including basic data structure and configuration
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills
  • A creative, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving
  • A positive, customer-focused mindset
  • Self-motivation, accountability, and follow-through
  • A willingness to learn, take feedback, and continuously improve
  • Flexibility to occasionally work outside of FMX’s standard operating hours
  • A match with our values: Excellence, Teamwork and Integrity

Benefits

FMX Benefits and Life at FMX:

  • You’ll make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction of our content and the future of our company.
  • Competitive benefits: 100% company-paid health, dental, vision, long and short term disability, and life insurance.
  • Work from home: At FMX, we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have one, mandatory all-company event each year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and co-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.
  • Home office stipend: We’ll give you everything necessary to do your job (company sponsored laptop, headset, etc.). We will also provide up to $500 to help with equipment, furniture and accessories. You will also get $60/month toward your home internet connection.
  • Generous PTO and UTO (unplanned time off) policies: If you’re sick, why should that cut into your vacation time?
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible schedule to help you manage personal appointments, such as doctor or dentist visits, as long as you're meeting performance expectations and project timelines.
  • You’ll enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.

The hiring process for this role:

  • Apply! Submit your resume and answers to the application questions below via the Workable portal
  • Phone screen with PeopleOps: A 30-minute conversation to review your background and experiences, discuss the culture at FMX, and ensure that you understand the general expectations for the role. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about compensation, benefits, etc.
  • Hiring manager conversation: A 60-minute interview with the hiring team, split into two portions. You can expect the first half of the interview to be dedicated to a technical sales exercise. During the second portion of the interview, be prepared to discuss your background as well as what you’re looking for in your next role and what direction you see your career path taking. Also, this is a great time for you to ask questions about the expectations for this role, team culture, etc.
  • Final Panel Interview: A 60-minute panel interview, split into two portions. The first portion will be a continuation of the conversation with the hiring manager, focusing on company culture and what direction you see your career path taking. The second portion of the interview will be with key teammates that you’ll be working with on a daily basis. This is a great time to ask role specific questions or ask about the team culture.
  • Offer & Onboarding: Candidates who receive an offer will be required to complete a background check prior to onboarding. New hires are also expected to work onsite at our Columbus, OH office during their first week to complete onboarding and connect with the team in person.

Compensation:

  • The base salary range for this position is expected to be $50,000-$55,000. This position is also eligible for commissions. OTE for this position is expected to be $100,000-110,000 annually.
  • 401(k) and medical / dental / vision / short and long term disability / life insurance

Other considerations:

  • The candidate for this position can be located anywhere in the US.
  • All of our positions are remote-first, meaning you'll primarily work from home, with a few in-person visits to the office each year. You will be required to come to our office in Columbus, OH, for your first week of work and for our annual all-company summit. Facilities Management Express will cover accommodations for these visits.

Company:

FMX is founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio and develops a cloud-based, software-as-a-service facility maintenance and management product. FMX serves education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets and is one of the fastest-growing companies in its space. Check us out at:

Note: All other company requirements are documented in the FMX Teammate Handbook. FMX is an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.

jobs.description:
Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos. Vamos lá?

Muito prazer, nós somos a Aurum! 🖤

Somos uma empresa consolidada no mercado de softwares jurídicos. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais inovadoras para uma nova forma de advogar. Nosso trabalho ajuda milhares de pessoas advogadas a gerenciarem melhor suas tarefas e aumentarem sua produtividade no dia a dia. Legal, né?

Quer saber um segredo? Nós só conseguimos fazer tudo isso porque temos as melhores pessoas aqui. 😎

E como chamamos essa galera? #PessoasÁureas. Hoje somos mais de 200 pessoas espalhadas em todo o Brasil e também contamos com o apoio dos nossos escritórios em Florianópolis (SC) e São Paulo (SP).Não importa onde estamos, a nossa cultura é a mesma, sempre guiada pelos nossos valores.

Aliás, com o apoio de pessoas tão incríveis, valores fortes e uma culturamassa, a gente já conquistou 10 vezes o selo doGreat Place to Work™e em 2025 ficamos bem posicionados em todos os três rankings que participamos.

E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time?

Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração, comunicação, e claro, proximidade e transparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a darmatch! 🥰

Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são.

📌Dentro do time suporte sua missão será:Atuar na resolução de atendimentos de diferentes níveis de complexidade, garantindo uma experiência eficiente, humana, consultiva e resolutiva para os clientes Astrea.

O Analista de Suporte Pleno deve compreender as necessidades dos clientes, investigar problemas, oferecer orientações contextualizadas e apoiar o melhor aproveitamento do produto, indo além da resolução pontual das solicitações.
Também deverá contribuir para a identificação de dificuldades recorrentes, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria, utilizando sua experiência em atendimento e seu olhar sobre a jornada do cliente para colaborar com a evolução dos processos e da operação de Customer Care.
Espera-se uma atuação com autonomia, responsabilidade pelos resultados e capacidade de adaptação, equilibrando a qualidade dos atendimentos individuais com a contribuição para os resultados coletivos do time.

👉Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga:O modelo de trabalho é100% remoto!

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

  • Realizar atendimentos aos clientes por chat, conduzindo as interações de forma consultiva, personalizada e resolutiva;
  • Atuar com autonomia na investigação e resolução de demandas, buscando compreender as causas dos problemas e evitar soluções superficiais;
  • Orientar os clientes sobre funcionalidades, configurações e possibilidades de utilização do Astrea, considerando seus contextos e necessidades;
  • Adaptar a linguagem e a condução dos atendimentos conforme o perfil, o nível de conhecimento e a necessidade de cada cliente;
  • Identificar dificuldades de utilização, barreiras de adoção e oportunidades de orientação que possam contribuir para uma melhor experiência;
  • Reconhecer situações de maior complexidade ou que demandem envolvimento de outras áreas, realizando os encaminhamentos necessários com clareza e contexto;
  • Identificar padrões de dúvidas, dificuldades recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria a partir dos atendimentos realizados;
  • Sinalizar riscos e situações que possam comprometer a experiência do cliente, contribuindo para uma atuação mais preventiva;
  • Propor melhorias em processos, procedimentos, fluxos de atendimento e materiais de apoio;
  • Contribuir para a construção e evolução da base de conhecimento e dos procedimentos do time;
  • Compartilhar conhecimentos e boas práticas com os seus pares, contribuindo para o aprendizado coletivo;
  • Participar de projetos e iniciativas da área, trazendo a perspectiva da operação e das necessidades dos clientes;
  • Registrar corretamente os atendimentos, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade das informações;
  • Acompanhar seus indicadores de desempenho e qualidade, utilizando dados e feedbacks para identificar oportunidades de evolução;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre o Astrea, suas funcionalidades, atualizações e principais necessidades dos clientes;
  • Gerenciar sua rotina e prioridades com organização e responsabilidade, mantendo consistência na qualidade e produtividade das entregas;
  • Atuar de acordo com os princípios e comportamentos esperados para a senioridade pleno: autonomia, autorresponsabilidade, adaptabilidade, evolução, inovação, comunicação, colaboração e orientação a resultado.

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Experiência profissional consistente em customer care, atendimento ao cliente, suporte ou relacionamento, com vivência na condução de demandas de forma independente;
  • Experiência com atendimento por canais digitais, especialmente chat e/ou plataformas de relacionamento;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de estruturar orientações claras e adequadas a diferentes públicos;
  • Capacidade de escuta ativa e interpretação das necessidades dos clientes, considerando o contexto de cada solicitação;
  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade investigativa para analisar problemas, buscar informações e identificar possíveis soluções;
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade na condução dos atendimentos e na gestão da própria rotina;
  • Organização e capacidade de priorização diante de diferentes demandas e cenários de volume;
  • Agilidade e adaptabilidade para assimilar novos conhecimentos, ferramentas e processos;
  • Autorresponsabilidade pelo próprio desenvolvimento, com iniciativa para buscar conhecimento, utilizar feedbacks e atuar sobre suas oportunidades de evolução;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes sistemas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, compartilhar informações e reconhecer quando precisa buscar apoio;
  • Interesse em atuar de maneira consultiva, com foco na experiência e no sucesso dos clientes.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, especialmente no modelo SaaS;
  • Vivência em operações de Customer Experience, Customer Success ou Customer Care;
  • Experiência com atendimento consultivo e orientação de clientes para melhor utilização de produtos ou serviços;
  • Conhecimento de plataformas de atendimento, CRM e gestão de conversas, como Intercom;
  • Familiaridade com indicadores de atendimento, como CSAT, TMA, FCR, recontato e qualidade;
  • Conhecimento sobre jornada do cliente, ativação, adoção e retenção;
  • Experiência na identificação de padrões e recorrências a partir dos atendimentos;
  • Participação em iniciativas de melhoria de processos, construção de procedimentos ou projetos operacionais;
  • Experiência no compartilhamento de conhecimentos, orientação de colegas ou apoio a treinamentos;
  • Conhecimento sobre o mercado jurídico e a rotina dos profissionais que utilizam o Astrea.

Informações adicionais

E dá uma olhada no que oferecemos às pessoas áureas:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição:R$ 1.300 mensais no cartão flexível, sem desconto em folha.
  • Auxílio Home Office:R$ 135,00 mensais, sem desconto em folha.

  • Guapeco: plano de saúde pet com adesão simples, cobertura nacional e reembolsos de até 100%.

  • E muito mais!Com uma cultura de feedback, guildas de desenvolvimento, PDI no onboarding, Aurum Talks, reuniões frequentes com toda a Aurum, transparência em OKR, ações comemorativas, avaliação de desempenho, programas de desenvolvimento entre outros processos que ajudam a desenvolver cada vez mais as pessoas áureas.

jobs.excerpt: About Stranger SoccerThe #1 way adults play football in the UAE.
jobs.description:
About Stranger Soccer

The #1 way adults play football in the UAE. We operate across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman — 200+ games every month, 30,000+ downloads, a real community of players who show up, play, meet people, and come back. Two years in, we're at the inflection point where disciplined execution on growth, retention and operational excellence is everything.

About the Role

You will run the business day-to-day on everything that doesn't require physical presence. On-ground Field Growth Operators (one per emirate) handle games, hosts, venues and players in person. You own strategy, data, growth, systems, and the operating rhythm. You report directly to the CEO and are the second-most senior person in the business.

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. If you need to be managed closely, this isn't the role.

What You'll Own

Strategic + Commercial

• P&L visibility and margin management

  • Growth strategy — acquisition, retention, pricing, membership economics
  • Weekly and monthly KPI reviews; health of the business
  • Competitive analysis and product positioning
  • Membership + Unlimited Pass performance management

Marketing + Growth

  • Paid acquisition and marketing spend allocation
  • Retention campaigns across all channels

• SEO, GBP, and partnership channels

  • Customer journey mapping and intervention design

Operational Systems

  • Design, document and enforce SOPs across the team

• Reporting and dashboards

• Monthly review framework with the CEO

  • Coordination with HQ product team on roadmap and prioritization
  • Weekly Friday delegation handoff — document weekend priorities and ensure Sat-Sun operations run smoothly without you

Team

  • Direct reports: three Field Growth Operators (one per emirate)
  • Direct management of the remote Customer Service / Ops team (2 people). Build SOPs, set and track KPIs, coach, raise the ceiling of what they can handle
  • Coordination with external partners — SEO, legal, accounting, product
  • Input into all hiring and firing decisions

What You WON'T Do

• Attend games physically — FGOs do that

  • Live in Dubai — this role is deliberately remote
  • Handle in-person customer disputes — escalated to FGOs first
  • Do venue on-site walkthroughs — FGOs scout, you review and approve

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 5–8 years of experience, at least 3 in a growth-stage startup
  • Background in marketplace, consumer tech, food delivery, ride-hailing, fitness, or similar two-sided

businesses strongly preferred

  • You've actually grown and scaled a business — not advised it, not strategized it, but moved real numbers. You

can walk me through specific growth you drove and what you learned

  • P&L exposure, real growth metrics, real customer behavior — not just slides
  • Strongly analytical — you can procure our data, analyze it, and act on it. Specific tools don't matter; knowing

what questions to ask and what to do with the answers does

  • Proactive, independent operator — you spot problems, propose solutions, and execute without being chased
  • Experience managing distributed teams, or as a senior IC across multiple workstreams
  • English fluency essential; Arabic a bonus
  • Writes clearly and concisely — this role runs on async communication
  • Comfort with ambiguity and startup grit

Culture fit

  • Honesty over politics. Tell me when I'm wrong.
  • Ownership over blame. Fix it before escalating.

• Data over opinions. Bring the numbers.

  • Speed over perfection. Launch, measure, adjust.

• Self-direction over supervision.

Working Hours

Set the team up for success every day — but Saturday and Sunday are when you're offline. By Friday evening the team must now exactly what to do over the weekend without you.

  • Working days: Monday to Friday
  • Daily core hours: 11:00–19:00 UAE time (GST), fully online
  • Daily extended coverage: 19:00–21:00 UAE time, reachable within 30 minutes for time-sensitive issues on game nights (Thu-Fri especially)
  • Weekends off: Saturday + Sunday fully off, reachable only for genuine emergencies
  • Friday delegation handoff: Document weekend priorities and empower the team before you log off Friday evening
  • Total effort: 40-50 hours per week during working days
  • Timezone requirement: South Asia, Middle East, Africa, or Eastern Europe ideal

How to Apply

Send the following to :

  • A short note on why this role interests you (≤200 words). No cover letter templates — write like a human

• Your CV or LinkedIn profile

  • One growth or operations project you ran: the problem, what you did, the result, and what you learned
  • A 30-60 second video (filmed on your phone) answering: who you are, why this role, one career achievement that proves you can do this

Job Description:

FINANCIAL ANALYST SENIOR

Position Summary


The Senior Financial Analyst is responsible for comprehensive financial management and reporting for assigned programs. This role provides end‑to‑end financial oversight, including revenue and cost management, forecasting, invoicing, customer reporting, audit support, and compliance with contract and corporate requirements. The Senior Financial Analyst partners with Program Management, Billing, Cash Operations, Division Finance leadership, and other company departments to ensure accurate, timely, and actionable financial insights that support both program execution and corporate performance objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Financial Management

  • Validate and reconcile monthly invoices in accordance with contract terms, period of performance, CLIN structure, and funding.
  • Generate financial and expenditure reports, including ITD and current-period spending, spend against contract value and funding, and forward-looking funding needs.
  • Support customer performance reporting with financial metrics as required (examples: cost‑per‑transaction, cost-versus-volume analysis, and budget variance reporting).
  • Deliver complete, accurate, and audit-ready financial packages.

Internal Financial Reporting & Controls

  • Conduct monthly revenue, cost, margin, WIP, and funding reconciliations using Oracle’s PSR, PMR cost reports, P&L Investment reporting, and Revenue Worksheets.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies, including funding limitations, WIP issues, and revenue/billing exceptions.
  • Maintain program Estimate at Completion (EAC) requirements, incorporating ITD actuals, to‑go assumptions, margin performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Provide EAC updates and financial insights for division and corporate forecasting cycles.
  • Support monthly close activities by ensuring all adjustments, funding updates, and reconciliations are completed within the financial close calendar.
  • Prepare monthly financial narrative and variance explanations for leadership reviews.

jobs.excerpt: The role at a glanceWe're hiring a sharp, AI-native Junior Creative Strategist to make sure every video ad we launch is the best version of itself.
jobs.description:
The role at a glance

We're hiring a sharp, AI-native Junior Creative Strategist to make sure every video ad we launch is the best version of itself.

  • Role: Junior Creative Strategist

  • Salary: £40,000 - £45,000 base, depending on experience

  • Location: Remote-first, based in the UK or Europe

  • Hours: Full-time, flexible

  • Reports to: a Senior Creative Strategist

About Elavate

Elavate is a UK multi-collagen brand for women 40+, built to help them feel like themselves again through menopause and beyond.

We launched in 2024 and have grown into one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK. We're fully bootstrapped and have grown almost entirely through performance ads.

It started when our founder, Alex, got fed up of buying his mum overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen. So he made one that actually works, tastes great and is affordable.

Creative is the engine of the business. Our strategists, in-house video editors and agency partners put out 100+ new ad concepts a month across influencer, UGC, high-production, AI and animation formats.

The role

Our goal is simple: launch the best ads possible, as fast as possible.

Our strategists write the scripts and brief the concepts. Our video editors, in-house and agency, build the ads. You own everything in between: you take a raw script and make sure it becomes a finished, launch-ready video ad, on time and with zero mistakes.

That means reviewing every edit, giving editors notes that make the ad better, keeping the pipeline moving, and using AI to make the whole process faster every week.

The bar: when you sign off an ad, it should be ready to go straight live, with no second check needed. Our north star is a concept briefed this week and live in the ad account by the following Thursday.

What you'll actually do

Most of your week goes on reviewing edits and working with editors. The rest goes on the pipeline, learning from live ads, AI and scripts.

Review every ad before it goes live

  • Watch every first draft from our in-house editors and agency partners, and leave timestamped notes in Frame.io.

  • Catch everything: captions, typos, clipped words, audio levels, pacing, weak B-roll, hooks that don't stitch into the body, the product showing too early.

  • Push past "correct" to "better": stronger hook visuals, music, SFX, text styles and cuts.

  • Plan 3-6 cutdowns and extra hook variations for each ad, so we test more versions of every idea.

Make our editors better

  • Turn scripts into clear briefs, with a short Loom showing the dream edit.

  • Give specific feedback ("change X because Y") so the same note never comes up twice.

  • Run weekly check-ins with your editors, match work to their strengths and keep output on track.

Keep the pipeline moving

  • Own the production board in Notion: assign edits, chase deadlines and reassign when someone's off.

  • Get influencer content over the line: every hook, every file and whitelisting access, tracked and ready.

  • Hand final files to media buying, named and labelled so launches are clean.

Learn from what's live

  • Read the comments on our live ads for objections, questions and new hook ideas.

  • Know which ads are winning and why, and bring those patterns into the next edit.

  • Keep a swipe file of the best DTC ads and new formats worth testing.

Build the AI workflow

  • Help build our AI editing pipeline, using tools like Claude Code, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs.

  • Keep teaching the system: feed it new formats, references and examples so the output improves every week.

  • Help editors adopt new tools, and check AI edits as closely as human ones.

Write and improve scripts

  • Review agency scripts and fix logic or flow issues before anything gets filmed.

  • Write bottom-of-funnel scripts, hooks and variations using our copy frameworks and AI tools.

What you'll bring

  • Strong with AI. You use Claude every day, you're comfortable in Claude Code, and you've built automated workflows that save real time.

  • A ruthless eye for detail. You spot a typo, a clipped word or a flicker on the first watch.

  • Clear, specific feedback. You can explain exactly what to change and why, in writing or on a Loom.

  • Technical confidence. You understand how video editing works (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci or similar) and you pick up new tools fast.

  • Taste for direct response. You watch a lot of ads, you know why a hook stops the scroll, and you care whether an ad sells, not just how it looks.

  • A team player. You'll work under our senior strategists, so you're collaborative, responsive and active on Slack.

  • Ownership and speed. You juggle several projects, chase people without being chased, and figure things out before you ask.

  • No ego. You take blunt feedback well and act on it fast.

  • Based in the UK or Europe, working remotely.

Nice to have

  • A background in video editing, content creation or creative strategy. Any one of these is a great fit.

  • Experience at a DTC brand or performance agency. No supplement experience needed.

  • An understanding of acquisition numbers: ad spend, cost per purchase and what makes an ad scale.

  • An interest in direct response copywriting.

  • Something you've built yourself: a side project, a small business or a startup.

Where this goes

This is a junior role with a path to Creative Strategist.

You'll have access to sharp senior strategists and creative minds who'll help you improve your own skills. The progression is simple: you get better at creative yourself, and keep developing into a stronger strategist.

Our current junior strategists already run weekly editor meetings, review agency work and are moving into scripting.

Pay, perks and how we work

  • £40,000 - £45,000 base, depending on experience

  • A pay review at 3 months against agreed goals, then clear pay tiers from there

  • 30 days off a year

  • Private health insurance

  • A learning budget for courses, communities and coaching

  • Paid AI tools, including Claude

  • Remote-first, with flexible hours

  • Direct access to the founder

  • Free Elavate products

At Elavate we move fast, own our work and hold each other to a high standard. In return, you'll learn faster about creative here than almost anywhere else.

jobs.description:
About our company

Triptease. We are a disruptive force in the tech space for online travel. Never one to shy from big challenges, we built our reputation on empowering hotels to stand up to the might of Online Travel Agents.

We are uniquely positioned to help hotels in their greatest time of need. The world class data set we've been building, combined with a new set of digital marketing tools, has positioned us to accelerate our impact to hoteliers.

With offices in London, NYC, Barcelona and Singapore, we drive over £1bn in revenue for hoteliers around the globe. As we gear up for our next stage of growth, now is an ideal time to join our fast-growing and well funded technology business.

Inclusion is how we unleash the power of diversity. It is how we build our teams, cultivate our leaders and ensure Triptease is the right fit for every person. Come join us on our journey and be comfortable bringing your authentic self to work. Be you!

The Team

  • You will be working in a small squad of between 2 and 6 people responsible for building, growing and maintaining different parts of the Triptease stack.
  • We have both frontend and backend components, with a lean towards backend.
  • All our teams are small, empowered and autonomous: we own the strategy and actions we need to take to be successful.
  • We embrace honest and open discussion. We truly value collaboration and are invested in maintaining a team that encourages everyone to contribute.
  • We run daily standups, weekly planning and frequent retros and feedback sessions.
  • We embrace pair programming the vast majority of the time.
  • We practise trunk-based development and continuous delivery.
  • At the end of each week, we join the rest of the company to showcase what we've accomplished and share our pride in the work we have done with our colleagues.

The Tech Stack

TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Mongo, Google Cloud Run / Kubernetes, BigQuery, Pub/Sub. We build with coding agents as part of everyday work. All squads use a similar stack, which is great for building up expertise and having other engineers to support you.

Requirements

We're looking for

  • You build with coding agents in your day-to-day work and can explain how: what you hand to the agent, what you keep, and how you check the output.
  • You verify by system, not trust. Tests come first, you review by risk, and you catch output that looks right but isn't. When something slips through, you fix the spec, tests or rules so it's caught next time.
  • You've led substantial pieces of work end to end, more than once, and they were plainly yours.
  • You lead technical decisions: you propose the approach, set out the trade-offs and bring the team with you.
  • You've shared a way of working with agents that your team now uses, such as skills, guardrails or specs.
  • You're collaborative, open-minded and comfortable pairing all day.
  • Experience building distributed, high availability, high throughput systems that keep data consistent.
  • You're proud of the code you ship and leave it better than you found it, whoever wrote the first draft.
  • Tests are integral to how you build, and you use them to drive design.
  • You're comfortable from client side to server side, with a lean towards back end.
  • You love shipping and seeing how it performs in production: delivery pipelines, A/B testing and monitoring.
  • You're customer-centric, work well with product managers, and spot the product decisions an agent would otherwise make by default.

Bonus points

  • Public Git repos that show how you build with agents, such as agent rules, skills, specs or the harness you work in.
  • You've thought about building for agentic clients, such as MCP servers and APIs.
  • You have an entrepreneurial streak, with some great examples of how you saw an opportunity and made it happen.
  • You have experience in several programming languages and value bringing ideas from other ecosystems into your current environment.

Location: remote, based in the UK, Spain or Portugal.

Benefits

Why join us?

  • Be part of a fast-paced, dynamic team at the forefront of travel technology innovation.
  • Enjoy a collaborative and fun working environment with opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Competitive salary package and rewards for high performance.

Our start-up culture means everybody's contribution matters and is celebrated. We set ourselves ambitious goals and are proud of our ability to deliver those through smart working. We're growing: get on board fast, be part of the journey, and have a real impact on an award-winning, fast-growing company.

Benefits will vary depending on location

  • Paid vacation days
  • Working abroad for 4 weeks a year (within a +/- 3 hour time zone)
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Monthly health and wellbeing allowance: use it for gym membership, private healthcare, massages, therapy, cinema and more
  • Yearly learning allowance*
  • Life Event leave (marriage, divorce, moving house, child's first day at school, ceremony or graduation)
  • Make a Difference (volunteering) day
  • Plus much more!

*Subject to passing probation

We also offer:

  • Quarterly review socials
  • Hybrid or remote working
  • Refer a Friend policy
  • Flexibility with childcare
  • Sabbaticals (from year three onwards)

We do not require external agency support for the recruitment of this role. Thank you.

Our Operating Model and Culture

  • In Product-Engineering, we hire people we trust, and then trust them to make their own choices on how they want to work and how they want to reach a goal. This sounds simple but it requires a lot of investment in the right company culture. Our team is made up of autonomous squads who decide what they work on, how they work, and within them have all the skills they need to complete their mission. That means we have no centralised teams (Ops, QA etc).
  • We think we are doing a good thing for hotels and guests and believe in our mission. We are working on a highly scaled platform that hotels use to build direct relationships with their customers and cut out middlemen. Our software operates on around 10k hotels and collects ~30M guest events a day, and growing. That's a big opportunity to positively impact a lot of people.
  • We engage with our customers to validate assumptions and test new features. We like to go deep on the problem. 'Start with the problem' is one of our three core principles. Beyond tools like FullStory, Intercom and Analytics that help us learn about users, each squad has friends in CS and Sales, and even hoteliers themselves, to help build that knowledge. Hotel visits and travel research budgets are also a big plus.
  • We care deeply about diversity and inclusion. Within Prod-Eng we have a dedicated D&I squad who meet regularly to propose actions to improve D&I within the team and the wider business. Outside of hiring, we work hard to foster psychological safety. We truly value collaboration and are invested in maintaining a team that encourages everyone to contribute.
  • We optimise for learning. We regularly give each other feedback and reflect on the ways we work. We use Notion to bring efficient transparency and create a home for everything we do. Initiatives like Discovery Days, Field Trips and Coding Dojos bring new people together and create more learning and development opportunities.
  • We celebrate our progress. At the end of each week, we join the rest of the company to showcase what we've accomplished and share our pride in the work we have done with our colleagues.

Triptease is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with an active cross-functional diversity squad devoted to addressing diversity challenges in the company and industry. We welcome applications from diverse and non-traditional backgrounds. Applicants will not be discriminated against on the basis of any protected characteristic(s) in terms of the Equality Act (2010).

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect (North America)
jobs.excerpt: What you’ll doYou’ll join a small, senior Data & Analytics team at a real estate investment firm that has built a sophisticated data platform on Snowflake, pulling together 40+ data sources.
jobs.description:
What you’ll do

You’ll join a small, senior Data & Analytics team at a real estate investment firm that has built a sophisticated data platform on Snowflake, pulling together 40+ data sources. The platform has grown fast, and the team now needs an architect who can set the direction: how the data should be layered, modeled, governed, and served so that reporting is reliable and the business can trust it. The immediate priority is financial reporting: mapping account-level activity through account hierarchies into financial statements.

You will:

  • Assess and shape the platform architecture. Review the existing Snowflake environment, work out what is actually working and what isn’t, and define the target architecture: layering from raw through staging to marts, naming and grain standards, and how corrections and late-arriving data are handled.

  • Design the financial data model. Model general ledger activity, charts of accounts, and account hierarchies so they roll up cleanly into financial statements and management reporting, and stay consistent as new sources are added.

  • Design for the business, not just the ticket. Work with finance, investment, and operations stakeholders to understand how Transactions, Reporting and source of truth, and Day-to-day decision making depend on the data, and translate that into scalable designs.

  • Own integration design across 40+ sources. Define patterns for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration across real estate systems, finance systems, and external feeds, with attention to lineage, data quality, and testing.

  • Optimize for performance and cost. Guide warehouse sizing, query performance, and cost management in Snowflake, and make trade-offs visible to engineers and non-engineers alike.

  • Set the standard and lead by example. Run design reviews, produce clear design documentation, mentor data engineers, and push back when something isn’t right.

  • Prepare the platform for what’s next. Shape how the team approaches governance, data cataloging, and AI-enabled use cases so outputs are consistent and reusable.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone highly technical who cares deeply about craft and can explain design choices to people who aren’t engineers. You must bring:

  • 7+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or database engineering, with real ownership of production data platforms

  • Deep, hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred; Databricks or similar considered), including performance tuning and cost management

  • Strong data modeling skills: stating and enforcing grain, dimensional modeling, layered architectures, and handling corrections and late-arriving data

  • Advanced SQL and experience designing efficient schemas for high-volume environments

  • Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and integrations across many sources, with a transformation framework (dbt or similar) and an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)

  • Finance literacy: experience modeling general ledger data, charts of accounts, and account hierarchies into financial or management reporting

  • Proven ability to diagnose and improve platforms you didn’t build, and to decide what to fix first

  • A quality mindset: testing, data quality, lineage, and clear design documentation (diagrams, decisions, trade-offs)

  • Strong English communication and comfort with remote, asynchronous work across time zones

  • A practical working relationship with AI tools in how you design, build, and document

Bonus points for

  • Experience in asset management, investment firms, or commercial real estate

  • Familiarity with systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, Argus, VTS, or CoStar

  • Experience building analytics-ready models for BI tools (Power BI in particular)

  • Exposure to Snowflake AI capabilities (Cortex, agent-building) or data catalog and governance initiatives

  • Leadership of data architecture across multiple projects or business domains

  • A track record of mentoring other engineers

Why You'll Love Working Here

Real impact. You'll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference.

An outstanding team. Talented, kind, hard working people who care about their craft and about each other. No egos. No politics.

Growth. You'll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility, at your own pace.

A culture of excellence. We care about doing the right thing for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high quality work, delivered sustainably.

Variety and stability. We're profitable, independent, and over two decades strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You'll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn't. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate toward a clear hierarchy and well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn't your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation, and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won't suit you.

  • Inheriting an existing environment doesn't appeal. This role starts by stabilizing and improving a platform someone else built, with a lot of moving parts. If you only want greenfield projects, you'll find it frustrating.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We're obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means feedback that's sometimes nitpicky. If refining work until it's excellent feels over the top, this won't be a fit.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. Priorities shift and processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, if this sounds like fuel, we'd love to talk.

How to Apply and What to Expect in the Interview Process

  1. Your work. Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We'll look at depth, the quality of your thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

  2. Lateral team fit. You'll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

  3. Work trial. You'll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

  4. Engineering deep dive. A collaborative session with our engineers.

  5. Project fit. An interview focused on prioritisation, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the messy middle.

Pay rate

$40–$125+ USD/hour, paid via PayPal

United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, and Australia/New Zealand

Skills assessment (1–3 hours)

jobs.description:
DEPARTMENT:Regulatory Affairs

LOCATION: Durham, NC, Fully Remote

COMPANY:Humacyte Inc (Nasdaq: HUMA) is developing a disruptive biotechnology platform to deliver universally implantable bioengineered human tissues, advanced tissue constructs, and organ systems designed to improve the lives of patients and transform the practice of medicine. The Company develops and manufactures acellular tissues to treat a wide range of diseases, injuries, and chronic conditions. Humacyte’s initial opportunity, a portfolio of Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessel (ATEVs), is currently approved for use in vascular trauma repair and is in late-stage clinical trials targeting multiple other applications including AV access for hemodialysis and peripheral arterial disease. Preclinical development is also underway in coronary artery bypass grafts, pediatric heart surgery, treatment of type 1 diabetes, and multiple novel cell and tissue applications. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for AV access in hemodialysis was the first product candidate to receive the FDA’s Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation and has also received FDA Fast Track designation. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for urgent arterial repair following extremity vascular trauma also received the RMAT designation. For more information, visit www.Humacyte.com.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Director Commercial Regulatory Affairs & Associate General Counsel serves as the primary legal and commercial regulatory advisor supporting the commercialization of SYMVESS. This position has dual accountability for providing legal counsel to Commercial Operations and serving as the Regulatory Affairs representative for advertising, promotion, and product communications.

This individual serves as both the Legal and Regulatory Affairs representative on the Medical-Legal-Regulatory (MLR)/Promotional Review Committee (PRC) for SYMVESS and partners closely with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, Sales, Training, Compliance, and senior leadership to enable compliant and effective commercialization.

The role requires the ability to translate complex product labeling, clinical evidence, FDA requirements, and healthcare legal requirements into practical guidance for a specialized commercial organization. The Associate General Counsel is expected to engage early in commercial strategy and provide practical, risk-based solutions rather than functioning solely as a late-stage reviewer.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Serve as both the Legal and Regulatory Affairs representative on the SYMVESS MLR/PRC and provide review and approval of promotional, educational, digital, market access, training, congress, and field-used materials.
  • Evaluate materials for consistency with FDA-approved labeling, claims substantiation, fair balance, risk presentation, material facts, clinical and scientific data, and the distinction between promotional and scientific communications.
  • Serve as the commercial Regulatory Affairs subject-matter expert for SYMVESS advertising and promotion, interpreting applicable FDA/CBER requirements, guidance, enforcement actions, and regulatory precedent.
  • Oversee or support required FDA submission of promotional materials, including applicable Form FDA 2253 processes.
  • Lead development and maintenance of the SYMVESS claims matrix, including standards for approved claims, references, qualifiers, clinical and labeling support, comparative claims, and high-risk or prohibited claims.
  • Serve as a strategic legal advisor to Commercial leadership and counsel cross-functional teams on commercialization strategy, healthcare professional interactions, speaker programs, advisory boards, consultant arrangements, congresses, market access, reimbursement communications, digital engagement, patient support, and competitive positioning.
  • Provide guidance regarding the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, Open Payments requirements, applicable state laws, privacy considerations, industry standards, and company policies.
  • Provide Legal and Regulatory oversight of training for personnel interacting with vascular surgeons and other healthcare professionals, including approved indication, claims, safety information, unsolicited questions, scientific exchange, competitive discussions, off-label inquiries, and escalation to Medical Affairs.
  • Establish practical Legal and Regulatory standards for QR codes, Important Safety Information, digital fair balance, email promotion, text/SMS communications, websites, digital sales materials, congress content, and HCP follow-up communications.
  • Lead the SYMVESS MLR/PRC governance framework, including roles and responsibilities, submission standards, timelines, service levels, escalation procedures, substantiation standards, and precedent documentation.
  • Identify significant legal and regulatory risks early and develop practical mitigation strategies and compliant alternatives that support timely business decisions.
  • Partner with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Compliance, Market Access, Finance, Corporate Communications, and executive leadership.
  • Other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school.
  • Active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.
  • Typically 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, FDA regulatory, healthcare, or life sciences legal experience, with level determined by depth and breadth of experience.
  • Significant experience with prescription drug and/or biologic advertising and promotion and demonstrated experience serving on or advising an MLR/PRC or comparable promotional review committee.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently perform both Legal and Commercial Regulatory review of promotional materials and activities.
  • Strong working knowledge of FDA advertising and promotion requirements, healthcare fraud and abuse laws, and the regulatory framework applicable to prescription products.
  • Experience counseling Commercial organizations on pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercialization activities.
  • Ability to assess complex legal and regulatory issues, exercise independent judgment, distinguish material risk from theoretical risk, and communicate practical recommendations to senior business leaders.
  • In-house pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience and experience supporting FDA-regulated biologics and/or CBER-regulated products preferred.
  • Experience supporting product launch, specialty products used by specialist physicians or surgeons, promotional claims matrices, Form FDA 2253 processes, Veeva Vault PromoMats or a comparable platform, and digital or omnichannel promotion preferred.
  • Strong written, verbal, negotiation, interpersonal, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Possess a positive roll-up-the-sleeves attitude and optimistic outlook.
  • Strong ability to work in a fast-paced team environment with fluctuating priorities and demonstrated ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to set priorities in a timely manner.
  • High degree of flexibility and adaptability.
  • Self-motivated and organized critical thinker with solid interpersonal and business communication skills.
  • Represents the organization in a positive and highly professional manner.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Stock Options
  • 401k Plan with 4% Match and no Vesting Schedule
  • Medical, Vision and Dental Plans
  • Company Paid Long Term/Short Term Disability
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • 23 Days Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 10 Company Designated Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave Policies

jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

Role Overview

The Insurance Verification Coordinator is responsible for the accurate and timely verification of patient insurance eligibility, benefits, and authorization requirements to support LifeStance Health’s revenue cycle operations. This role plays a critical function in front-end revenue cycle management (RCM), ensuring services are financially cleared prior to treatment, and that patient accounts are accurate, compliant, and billing-ready.

The Insurance Verification Coordinator independently manages new and established patient verifications, identifies prior authorization and referral requirements, confirms network participation, and resolves front-end account discrepancies on a national basis. This position requires strong analytical skills, payer knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a remote, high-volume, production-driven environment.

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description. This position is a remote role with the ability to sit within any US locality where LifeStance is represented.


Compensation: $20.00- $24.00 Hourly with potential bonus


Key Responsibilities:

Insurance Verification & Benefit Review

  • Verify eligibility and benefits for new and established patients via payer portals and direct payer outreach across commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and other federally funded or state-sponsored health plans.
  • Perform ongoing re-verifications to ensure active coverage and accurate benefit information throughout the course of treatment.
  • Determine coverage compatibility with LifeStance services, including therapy, psychiatry, medication management, and telehealth.
  • Confirm provider network participation status and identify out-of-network implications following established guidelines.
  • Identify, obtain, and document prior authorization, pre-certification, and referral requirements.
  • Verify and manage Employee Assistance Program (EAP) benefits, including session limits, authorization requirements, and payer-specific billing guidelines.
  • Submit or facilitate authorization requests and ensure approvals are accurately recorded in the billing system and patient record.
  • Maintain complete, accurate documentation of all verification activities in the electronic health record (EHR) and practice management systems.
  • Perform all activities in accordance with LifeStance policies, standard operating procedures, and payer-specific guidelines.

Patient Data & System Interface (Phreesia and Related Platforms)

  • Utilize Phreesia and other internal and external platforms to review patient-submitted insurance and demographic information.
  • Review and act on insurance-related tasks and documentation received through the EHR, patient portal, and other internal workflows.
  • Validate and reconcile patient-reported insurance data against payer-verified eligibility information.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies between submitted documentation and payer records prior to service delivery.
  • Collaborate with front office and cross-functional teams to correct demographic or insurance inconsistencies impacting eligibility or billing accuracy.

Front-End Revenue Cycle Support

  • Resolve front-end revenue cycle issues within assigned work queues, including correcting insurance information and identifying coverage discrepancies.
  • Investigate and evaluate necessary rebilling of claims to the appropriate payer when incorrect insurance information is identified and corrected, following established processes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve patient chart issues that impact claim submission or patient billing accuracy.
  • Proactively identify potential billing barriers and take corrective action prior to claim submission.
  • Work assigned escalated accounts to facilitate accurate and timely reimbursement.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Communicate detailed and accurate insurance benefit information to internal partners.
  • Alert practice operations and leadership to uninsured, underinsured, or high-risk accounts.
  • Participate in workflows that may require direct patient communication to clarify coverage, obtain additional insurance details, or explain benefit findings.
  • Serve as a resource for insurance benefit interpretation and payer requirements within the scope of the coordinator role.

Operational Support

  • Meet established productivity, quality, and accuracy standards.
  • Participate in special projects, workflow enhancements, and process improvement initiatives as assigned.
  • Support leadership with routine operational reporting and data requests as required.

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in medical insurance verification, medical billing, or healthcare revenue cycle operations
  • Working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid,andEmployee Assistance Program (EAP)structures
  • Understanding of prior authorization and referral processes
  • Experience using electronic health records (EHR), automated billing systems, and patient intake platforms such as Phreesia
  • Ability to interpret intake data and reconcile discrepancies between patient-reported and payer-verified information
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage a high-volume workload independently in a remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including patient-facing communication
  • Demonstrated awareness, inclusivity, and sensitivity in working with individuals from diverse backgrounds

Position Summary:

The NSWC PCD S24 Anti-Terrorism Afloat Equipment (ATAE) Team is seeking a dedicated, highly qualified contractor Subject Matter Expert (SME) with deep technical expertise in both soft and hard ballistic armor systems. This role will directly support the S24 Program Manager (PM) in managing the full lifecycle development, testing, qualification, and sustainment of ATAE body armor and personal protective systems.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Senior Ballistic Armor Acquisition & Test Engineer SME: Pay commensurate with experience.

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Includes the following:

  • Test Documentation Review: Thoroughly analyze and evaluate ballistic test plans and protocols generated by ATC and commercial test facilities against applicable DoD specifications and military standards (e.g., MIL-STD-662, NIJ standards, specific Purchase Descriptions).
  • Test Witnessing: Witness First Article Testing (FAT) and Lot Acceptance Testing (LAT) on-site at Aberdeen Test Center (ATC) and qualified commercial ballistic laboratories (e.g., Element/NTS, Chesapeake Testing/Oregon Physics).

  • Represent the NSWC PCD S24 ATAE Program in inter-service working groups, including the Joint Service Body Armor Working Group (BAWG).

No supervisory/management authority

  • Ballistic Expertise: Proven hands-on background in ballistic testing methodologies, performance standards, and test range protocols for both soft
  • armor (flexible aramid/UHMWPE packages) and hard armor (ceramic, metallic, composite inserts/plates). • Range & Quality Oversight: Demonstrated experience witnessing and evaluating FAT/LAT ballistic test events at Aberdeen Test Center (ATC) or certified commercial ballistic testing facilities.
  • Technical Writing: Proven track record authoring or contributing to military Purchase Descriptions (PDs), technical manuals, and Maintenance Requirement Cards (MRCs).

About Signalmash
Signalmash operates a cloud communications platform that enables businesses to manage and deliver RCS, SMS, and MMS messaging through carrier and technology-provider integrations. The platform includes customer onboarding, messaging APIs, routing, compliance, vendor integrations, usage tracking, and billing.
As we scale our go-to-market motion, we are adding an India-based GTM Engineer to design, build, and operate the systems that power our outbound revenue engine.
The Role
The GTM Engineer will own the machinery of outbound: the systems that find the right companies, enrich and score them, reach them across email and LinkedIn with strong deliverability, and hand qualified conversations to our sales team with full context.
This is an engineering role that serves sales, not a marketing role with tools. You will treat pipeline generation as a system that is instrumented, tested, and improved every week. You will work directly with US leadership, and what you build will become the operating system our SDRs run on.
This is a hands-on builder position. The successful candidate must be comfortable wiring APIs and webhooks, debugging workflows at the data level, and proving with numbers that campaigns work before scaling them.

  • Build and operate end-to-end outbound systems including ICP definition, list building, enrichment waterfalls, email verification, segmentation, and signal-based prospecting.
  • Own cold-email infrastructure including domains, mailboxes, warmup, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sender rotation, inbox placement monitoring, and send-volume discipline.
  • Orchestrate multi-channel outbound across email and LinkedIn using data-driven personalization.
  • Maintain CRM integrity through lead routing, deduplication, lifecycle management, reply classification, meeting handoffs, and reporting.
  • Apply AI to research, personalization, lead scoring, reply triage, and workflow automation using tools such as Claude Code.
  • Measure replies, meetings, and pipeline performance, quickly improving or replacing underperforming campaigns.
  • Deliver clean account lists, dashboards, documentation, and outbound systems that scale with the business.

JOB TITLE: Inventory Specialist

DEPARTMENT: Purchasing

EXEMPT STATUS: Exempt

REPORTS TO: Inventory Manager

REMOTE OR HYBRID WORK ELIGIBILE: Remote

SUMMARY:

The Inventory Specialist is responsible for managing customer-specific inventory, consigned inventory and general warehouse stock. The Inventory Specialist collaborates with the Customer Service and Sales teams to review and manage zero on hand reports and analyze and adjust minimum/maximum stocking levels at the warehouse and for industrial vending solutions. Tasks also include analyzing item class, velocity, fluctuations, generating ad-hoc inventory reports, consignment reconciliations, database management and problem-solving any issues regarding stocking levels.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with sales, customer service and the customer with zero-on-hand, minimums and maximums and stocking levels
  • Collaborate with sales reps across the country to review special customer requirements or needs related to inventory
  • Review fluctuations in inventory use and production in collaboration with sales and customers
  • Manages database validation steps to ensure database accuracy, including:
  • Adding and removing items, updating status from active to discontinued and maintaining part numbers and suppliers via ACD (Add Change Delete) process across multiple inventory databases (vending and ERP)
  • Maintains the inventory database in the vending system (AutoCrib software); including initial item set up in Autocrib
  • Transferring and redeploying inventory to appropriate stocking locations
  • Generate ad-hoc inventory reports through SQL queries
  • Research and execute customer vending returns
  • Provide support by monitoring and responding effectively and in a timely manner to requests received through the inventory helpdesk
  • Analyze and review item warehouse/consignment velocity and usage trends to recommend stock status changes and purchase path changes
  • Coordinating with internal partners on inventory exposure (active, slow and inactive) and identify solutions to develop plans for inventory redeployment, returns, etc.
  • Apply strategic forecasting to ensure the availability of all necessary materials required to support the supplying and vending process
  • Perform any general needs for consigned inventory along with special projects as required by management
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Reports to the Inventory Manager

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • 2+ years of related inventory management experience a plus
  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university or certification equivalency preferred
  • Work independently or as part of a team, changing gears when required, and multitasking
  • Ability to analyze inventory data and plan appropriate stocking levels
  • Strong problem solving and analytical thinking, planning, prioritization and execution skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication (verbal and written) skills; self-starter and self-disciplined
  • Sound judgment and shrewd decision-making skills
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task
  • Excellent computer skills: Internet Research and intermediate to advanced MS office (Word, Outlook, Teams) and data entry is required; highly proficient in Excel including pivot tables and V Look Ups; SQL and Prophet21 (P21) experience a plus
  • Work under pressure of deadlines while maintaining a professional attitude and calm demeanor
  • Accuracy and attention to detail required
  • Ability to work with little or no supervision
  • Passionate, Adaptable, Customer Focused and Teamwork oriented
  • Strong sense of urgency and accountability
  • May travel up to 10% of the time to visit a DGI office for various meetings

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending and walking
  • Moderate to heavy use of hands in grasping, repetitive hand movement and finger coordination in keeping records and using a keyboard
  • Speech and hearing to communicate effectively in group settings, one-on-one, and by telephone
  • High level of concentration, confidentiality and organization
  • Ability to multi-task

REMOTE/HYBRID WORK REQUIREMENTS: In order to work remotely the Employee Must:
