jobs.excerpt: About the roleAs Director of Growth Marketing, you own the acquisition and conversion strategy that connects marketing investment to qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and revenue across the SalesRabbit portfolio.
jobs.description:
About the role

As Director of Growth Marketing, you own the acquisition and conversion strategy that connects marketing investment to qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and revenue across the SalesRabbit portfolio. You translate company go-to-market priorities into an integrated growth plan and lead the people, programs, investment, and partners responsible for delivering it. You are accountable for setting priorities, allocating investment, improving performance, and explaining the commercial results.

PPC and SEM generate most of our lead flow today. You will strengthen that foundation while developing acquisition opportunities across existing products and the launch of RoofRabbit. Your scope includes paid acquisition, integrated campaigns, prospect lifecycle, conversion optimization, account-based marketing, and events. You connect these programs to the buying journey, improving how prospects discover our products, evaluate their value, become qualified opportunities, and convert into customers.

You partner closely with Product Marketing, which owns buyer segmentation, positioning, product launch strategy, sales enablement and training, competitive intelligence, and customer adoption and expansion strategy. You translate that foundation into campaigns, offers, and conversion experiences that reach the right buyers and move them toward revenue. You coordinate with Brand and Content on creative and organic demand, and with Product on activation, self-service conversion, and sales-assisted product-led growth. You establish clear responsibilities across these teams so shared goals produce coordinated execution.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role. You will personally lead critical Growth Marketing work while building the team, operating rhythms, and capabilities required to scale. You must be able to move from an investment decision to the underlying campaign, funnel, or customer data, identify what is limiting performance, and direct the changes needed to improve it. You will develop internal talent and manage specialist agencies with the same expectations for quality, accountability, and business impact.

You use AI and automation as a core part of how the function operates, accelerating research, segmentation, campaign development, personalization, experimentation, and analysis while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment. Your success is measured by qualified pipeline, bookings, acquisition efficiency, funnel conversion, and your ability to consistently turn insight into better commercial results.

Who We Are

Sales Rabbit is a software company built for roofing and field sales. It builds the tools contractors and reps use at the door, in the office, and on the job: to generate demand, sell, operate, and get paid. Those tools run from the first lead to the final payment, so the job doesn't get lost in between. They're designed to help contractors maximize their efficiency. We build software solutions that propel our customers' businesses forward: Roof Rabbit for roofing and Field Rabbit for everything else sold door-to-door.

Everything runs as one unified, AI-native platform, in a single flow from lead to cash. Our solution brings together AI canvassing, online estimates, instant quotes, territory mapping, scheduling, communication, weather data, proposals, financing, measurements, project management, material ordering, inspections, and payments.

We believe speed decides who wins in the field, and that belief changes how we build and operate. As a distributed team, we focus on moving faster, operating with greater agility, and using AI and automation as practical force multipliers. Our goal is simple: help contractors grow more efficiently while building a company that can learn, innovate, and deliver value faster.

What You Will Own

Growth Strategy and Investment

  • Build the growth plan across products, audiences, and buying motions, with explicit pipeline commitments, investment assumptions, conversion goals, and priorities.
  • Translate company strategy into quarterly plans and a weekly operating cadence that makes progress, risks, and decisions visible.
  • Allocate investment across channels and programs based on customer quality, acquisition economics, conversion performance, and the maturity of each growth opportunity.
  • Protect the existing acquisition engine while testing new audiences, offers, channels, and product entry points.
  • Provide clear recommendations on what to scale, improve, stop, or resource differently.

Acquisition and Campaign Performance

  • Own paid acquisition strategy and execution, with immediate responsibility for PPC and SEM performance.
  • Build integrated campaigns across products, segments, and audiences using positioning and customer insight developed with Product Marketing.
  • Continuously improve targeting, bidding, offers, creative, landing pages, and conversion paths based on downstream performance.
  • Lead prospect nurture, trial communications, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs that improve conversion.
  • Direct paid media and specialist partners, maintaining visibility into their work and accountability for commercial outcomes.
  • Coordinate with Brand and Content on campaign assets and organic demand without taking ownership of the editorial calendar, social channels, or SEO and AEO strategy.

Funnel Performance and Product-Led Growth

  • Establish shared funnel definitions, qualification criteria, Sales handoff standards, and performance measures with Sales, Product, and Operations.
  • Lead funnel reviews that identify constraints, establish corrective actions, and assign clear owners.
  • Partner with Product on activation, trial or freemium conversion, and product-qualified Sales handoffs.
  • Own the marketing components of these journeys, including acquisition, landing-page conversion, prospect communications, and reactivation. Product owns in-app onboarding, activation mechanics, and checkout.
  • Build a disciplined experimentation program across audiences, offers, messaging, channels, and conversion points.
  • Define reporting requirements with Operations and use the resulting data to make investment and execution decisions. Operations owns systems, routing implementation, and reporting infrastructure.

Account-Based Marketing and Events

  • Develop target-account programs with Sales, including account selection, buying-group priorities, engagement plans, and follow-up.
  • Own the commercial strategy for conferences, executive dinners, webinars, partner events, and other field programs.
  • Connect event and account engagement to qualified meetings, opportunity creation, and deal progression.
  • Use specialist partners for production and logistics while retaining internal ownership of objectives, audience, experience, and results.

Team Leadership and Operating Discipline

  • Establish the function before the full team is in place, then sequence the hiring and development of Growth Marketing and Field & ABM capability based on demonstrated business needs.
  • Set clear expectations for internal employees and external partners, review the quality of their work, and coach them toward stronger performance.
  • Personally lead the most consequential work while developing the team’s judgment and execution capabilities.
  • Make deliberate resource decisions based on the work required and the return expected.
  • Build repeatable AI-enabled workflows that improve research, segmentation, campaign development, personalization, experimentation, and analysis.
  • Communicate performance clearly, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and escalate material risks with options and a recommendation.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS growth, demand generation, or revenue marketing, with meaningful leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success building or significantly improving a Growth Marketing function in a high-growth or transformation environment.
  • Ownership of meaningful acquisition investment and a record of measurable impact on qualified pipeline, bookings, customer acquisition, conversion, or growth efficiency.
  • Deep hands-on PPC and SEM experience, including targeting, bidding, conversion tracking, creative testing, landing-page optimization, and downstream pipeline analysis.
  • Strong lifecycle marketing and experimentation skills, with examples of improving prospect, trial, nurture, or reactivation conversion.
  • Commercial fluency across acquisition cost, payback, pipeline economics, Sales conversion, and customer value.
  • Working experience partnering with Product on activation, self-service conversion, or product-qualified Sales handoffs.
  • Experience working closely with Sales and Operations to improve qualification, routing, follow-up, and funnel visibility.
  • Ability to translate Product Marketing positioning and buyer insight into effective offers, campaign briefs, and conversion experiences.
  • Experience developing ABM or field programs tied to measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Experience hiring and developing teams, managing agencies, and personally intervening when execution or performance requires it.
  • Strong judgment under constraints, including evidence of stopping ineffective work and reallocating resources.
  • Clear executive communication and the ability to align senior stakeholders around decisions and commitments.
  • Practical use of AI and automation across research, segmentation, campaign development, personalization, experimentation, analysis, and execution, with repeatable workflows you can demonstrate.

Preferred

  • Experience in roofing, home services, construction technology, field sales, or vertical SaaS.
  • Experience marketing a multi-product portfolio or platform.
  • Experience scaling both sales-led and product-led acquisition motions.
  • Experience developing ABM and field programs that produce measurable commercial results.
  • Experience in founder-led, private-equity-backed, or significant transformation environments.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first six months:

  • The existing paid acquisition engine has dependable coverage, a documented performance baseline, and an active optimization program.
  • Sales and Marketing use shared qualification definitions, handoff standards, and pipeline reporting.
  • Reporting connects marketing investment to qualified opportunities, activated accounts where relevant, bookings, and acquisition efficiency.
  • A repeatable experimentation program improves priority conversion points and informs investment decisions.
  • RoofRabbit has a measurable acquisition plan coordinated with Product Marketing on audience and positioning and with Product on activation and self-service conversion.
  • Prospect lifecycle programs have clear audiences, conversion objectives, and measurement across priority buying journeys.
  • ABM and events have clear target accounts, commercial objectives, follow-up ownership, and measurable opportunity creation.
  • Agencies operate against explicit scopes and performance expectations, and supporting hires are sequenced against demonstrated business needs.

KPIs

  • Marketing-sourced qualified pipeline and bookings.
  • Cost per qualified opportunity.
  • Cost per activated account for applicable product-led journeys.
  • Conversion by product, channel, and buying motion.
  • Acquisition cost and payback, measured with Finance.
  • Target-account opportunity creation and event program efficiency.

Activation and self-service paid conversion are shared outcomes with Product. Sourced and influenced pipeline are reported separately, and numerical targets are established from the operating baseline and growth plan.

Who Thrives Here

You take accountability for business outcomes and communicate directly when performance is off plan. You investigate the cause before increasing spend, identify the most important constraint to growth, make decisions with incomplete information, and change course when the evidence warrants it.

You combine analytical depth with strong customer and creative judgment. You can evaluate the audience, offer, message, channel, conversion experience, and downstream commercial performance together rather than optimizing each in isolation.

You are comfortable protecting an established acquisition engine while testing new products, audiences, and buying motions with clear hypotheses and disciplined investment. You understand both sales-assisted and self-service journeys and know how to partner with Product on activation without treating product-led growth as simply another acquisition campaign.

You can establish strategy and personally inspect the work. You develop people, use outside expertise effectively, and maintain clear ownership across functions. You understand that content and creative are essential to growth and can direct their use in campaigns while respecting Brand and Content’s ownership of editorial, organic acquisition, and brand expression.

You use AI and automation to improve research, segmentation, analysis, experimentation, personalization, and execution, with appropriate checks on accuracy and quality.

You bring urgency without creating unnecessary activity. You communicate clearly about what is working, what is underperforming, what will change, and where a decision is needed. You take accountability for results, give credit generously, and are willing to acknowledge when an assumption or decision was wrong.

At Sales Rabbit, we hire for operating cadence and mindset. The people who do best here share a few things in common:

  • Active Curiosity - You seek root causes before proposing solutions and stay ahead of industry trends and tools.
  • Grit & Scrappiness - You roll up your sleeves on hard, ambiguous, unglamorous work. You build from scratch and clean up inherited debt.
  • Extreme Ownership - You take accountability for outcomes, proactively communicate blockers, and deliver with minimal oversight.
  • Bias Toward Impact - You measure success by business outcome, not effort. You course-correct fast and without ego.
  • Team-First Collaboration - You listen to understand, give credit generously, and push back when something is wrong - to protect the outcome, not win the argument.

Benefits

  • 20 days of PTO
  • 10 paid holidays
  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and Basic Life Insurance
  • 401(k) employer match
  • Company phone plan

Sales Rabbit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

Today, consumers can find JustFoodForDogs at JustFoodForDogs retail locations, their favorite retailers and on-line at JustFoodForDogs.com. The company’s offerings include daily meals, shelf-stable products, supplements, and treats. To learn more about JustFoodForDogs, visit JustFoodForDogs.com

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Talent Acquisition Specialist leads the organization’s recruitment lifecycle by delivering consistent, equitable, and compliant hiring practices across all departments.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Talent Acquisition Specialist leads the organization’s recruitment lifecycle by delivering consistent, equitable, and compliant hiring practices across all departments. By serving as an active talent advisor to hiring managers, this role shapes accurate job postings, designs structured interview frameworks, and executes competitive, budget-aligned offers. Additionally, the position serves as the primary steward of the ATS, driving workflow automation, training leaders in recruitment best practices, and ensuring audit-ready data hygiene. Ultimately, this role serves as a vital bridge between candidates, department leaders, and HR leadership to uphold organizational standards and foster long-term workforce retention.

Mission, Culture, and Values

At Dane Street, we believe exceptional employee experiences create exceptional client experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous improvement, accountability, and care.

We care for our customers, we care for our employees, and we care for one another. Every team member plays an important role in creating an environment where people feel respected, supported, empowered to grow, and inspired to do meaningful work.

What You'll Do

  • Full Cycle Talent Acquisition
    • Lead structured intake sessions with hiring managers to understand role scope, technical qualifications, core competencies and team dynamics that may impact recruitment efforts.
    • Review standard Job Descriptions and specific business needs stated by hiring manager to identify any tailored revisions necessary for successful recruitment efforts.
    • Leverage diverse channels to proactively source talent and maintain pipelines for recurrent roles.
    • Conduct phone screenings for the hiring manager.
    • Advise in the creation of compliant interview guides/templates to maintain consistency and integrity in the interviewing process.
    • Facilitate interviews when needed by assisting with scheduling or advising based on recruitment best practices to maintain a consistent and objective selection process.
  • Offer Management
    • Partner with hiring managers to frame realistic and competitive offers based on salary ranges.
    • Prepare formal offer documentation and submit through the approval workflows to ensure prompt review and determination.
  • ATS Management
    • Serve as the primary administrator of the ATS, managing user access, candidate pipelines, dispositions, and general data hygiene.
    • Suggest and implement workflow paths and automations to improve the efficiency of the recruitment process when necessary.
    • Train new managers on use of the system, workflows, and processes of the organization.
    • Ensure all practices and guidance are in accordance with federal, state and local employment laws.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What Makes this Role Successful

Success in this role is defined by establishing trusted, consultative partnerships with hiring managers to implement and refine frontline success profiles. By aligning role competencies with Dane Street’s culture and operational demands, the Talent Acquisition Specialist guides hiring teams toward candidates who achieve long-term success and advance our strategic goals.

As a sounding board, advocate, and talent advisor, the successful candidate leverages market insight and organizational influence to lead managers to decisive, objective, and well-calibrated hiring decisions.

What Your First 90 Days May Look Like

30 days:

  • Gain an understanding of Dane Street’s core operational functions and recurrent frontline roles.
  • Align with HR Director on an understanding of compensation philosophy and structure
  • Conduct a baseline audit and understanding of the existing ATS workflows and processes.
  • Partner with Sr. HR Manager to understand Frontline Success Profiles and their implementation with the hiring teams.
  • Schedule introductory 1-1s with key department leaders/hiring managers to understand their hiring dynamics
  • Begin transitioning ownership of existing requisitions

60 days:

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and automations
  • Draft and prepare for rollout of templates for compliant interview guides and scorecards
  • Review existing interview training and suggest any additional hands-on training the organization could benefit from
  • Begin proactive sourcing of candidates and building pipelines for recurrent roles
  • Begin executing offers with hiring managers

90 days:

  • Independently manage the recruitment lifecycle across assigned departments and roles
  • Serve as the primary advisor and sounding board on recruitment process
  • Begin reviewing metrics with HR Director related to hiring initiatives to set goals and measure progress.
  • Identify long-term plans for full optimization and automation of the recruitment lifecycle.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Prolonged periods sitting or remaining stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Constant operation of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital productivity tools.
  • Close visual acuity required to view computer screens, analyze data, and read extensive digital documentation.
  • Frequent communication with team members, leadership, and external partners via email, chat, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
  • Occasional moving or positioning of office equipment or files weighing up to 10–15 pounds.
  • Occasional travel for recruitment events or team meetings (less than 10%).

Why Join Dane Street?

  • Collaborative remote culture
  • Professional growth opportunities
  • Meaningful work supporting the healthcare industry
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Great Place to Work Certified since 2021
  • Commitment to employee development

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support your own internet services.

Maintain an uninterrupted internet connection.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

At Dane Street, caring for people is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or similar field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Must Haves:

  • 5 years of full-cycle recruitment experience within a corporate environment or equivalent combination of agency and in-house.
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining ATS, including customizing workflows and templates.
  • Firm grasp on use of salary bands and compensation literacy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience transitioning teams to a new ATS
  • SHRM-CP, PHR, or LinkedIn Certified Professional-Recruiter
  • Experience recruiting in healthcare or insurance industries
  • Prior experience managing SLA frameworks and improving efficiencies in ATS workflows

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. jobs.excerpt: Your Future is our Future At Lumeris, we believe that our greatest achievements are made possible by the talent and commitment of our team members.
jobs.description:
Your Future is our Future


At Lumeris, we believe that our greatest achievements are made possible by the talent and commitment of our team members. That's why we are actively seeking talented and collaborative individuals who are passionate about making a difference in the healthcare industry. Join us today as we strive to create a system of care that every doctor wants for their own family and become part of a community that values its people and empowers you to make an impact.


We're excited to consider every qualified candidate authorized to work in the United States, although we are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time.

Position:

VP, Medicare Advantage Chief Actuary

Position Summary:

Provides oversight, strategic direction, process improvements, and best practices for the department. Responsible for all actuarial and underwriting/pricing functions in support of Essence Healthcare’s Medicare Advantage plan operations. Partnering closely with the leaders of Risk Adjustment, Pharmacy, Health Plan Product, and Stars Strategy, this role delivers forward-thinking strategies and provides business direction regarding actuarial rate setting, pricing, annual CMS Part C and Part D bid submissions, risk adjustment factor forecasting, premium development, valuation and statutory reserve setting (including IBNR), financial risk management, product development, and performance analytics to maintain long-term financial sustainability, market competitiveness, and high Star Ratings performance.

Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Leadership & Talent Development: Develops, implements, and guides strategic direction for the Medicare Advantage actuarial function. Oversees, coaches, mentors, motivates, supports, and develops a cross-functional team, building specialized internal capabilities in Medicare Advantage pricing, Part D benefit economics, reserving, risk adjustment, healthcare economics, and advanced healthcare analytics. Oversees goal setting/review, regular guidance and 1-1 check-ins, career development/planning, upskilling, resource allocation, staffing, budget creation/management, succession planning, and other People & Culture programs/activities as needed. Fosters accountability, collaboration, and innovation to ensure organizational goals are met.
  • Executive Business Intelligence & Plan Performance: Oversees and supports cross-functional alignment to ensure the best possible business intelligence and understanding of company financials in communications to executive team and the Essence Healthcare Board of Directors; delivers clear visibility into emerging Medical Loss Ratios (MLR), emerging claims trends, membership and revenue dynamics, member cohort profitability, risk score performance, and regulatory revenue shifts.
  • MA Product Design & Pricing Architecture: Serves as the primary actuarial authority for Medicare Advantage product strategy and pricing. Partners with Health Plan Product, Clinical, Pharmacy, Network, Finance, and Market Growth leaders to evaluate Plan Benefit Packages (PBPs), supplemental benefits (e.g., dental, vision, hearing, OTC allowances), formulary and cost-sharing structures, service-area expansion, and specialized plan offerings. Balances member value, growth objective, competitive positioning, regulatory requirements, while achieving margin targets.
  • Valuation, Reserving & Risk Management: Responsible for actuarial valuation for financial reporting functions. Oversees pricing and valuation for all Essence Healthcare plan offerings. Directs the estimation and review of unpaid claim liabilities (IBNR), premium deficiency reserves, and risk-sharing settlements in strict accordance with statutory accounting principles (SAP), NAIC guidelines, and CMS Minimum Medical Loss Ratio (85% MLR) standards. Enhances risk management, internal controls, and pricing policies/procedures.
  • CMS Bid Strategy & Submission Execution: Leads the end-to-end development, actuarial modeling, review, documentation, certification, and HPMS (Health Plan Management System) submission of annual Medicare Advantage Part C and Part D bids, ensuring 100% on-time adherence to statutory CMS June deadlines and full compliance with CMS Bid Instructions, Call Letters, and Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs). Establishes rigorous assumption governance, scenario testing, quality controls, executive review, and bid-to-actual monitoring. Ensures compliance across all activities.
  • Regulatory Policy & Executive Strategy: Informs and participates in pricing strategy discussions with executive team. Interprets and models the financial impacts of CMS Advance Notices, Final Rate Announcements, county benchmark adjustments, and risk adjustment model changes (such as the transition from CMS-HCC V24 to V28). Partners with the VP of Risk Adjustment to align risk score progression forecasts with bid pricing assumptions. Develops and implements new pricing strategies and methods to adapt to market dynamics.
  • Regulatory Financial Settlement & Guidance: Ensures all actuarial financial statement items are established in accordance with relevant actuarial, regulatory, and accounting guidance, including CMS Part D risk corridor reconciliations, low-income cost-sharing (LICS) subsidies, federal reinsurance settlements, and Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) accruals.
  • Governance, Quality Assurance & Audit Readiness: Oversees the creation of and adherence to all key processes, procedures, analyses, and techniques. Guides department adoption of best practices to minimize inaccuracies and ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and business requirements, maintaining full audit readiness for CMS financial exams, RADV audits (in coordination with the Risk Adjustment team), and RAPS/EDPS encounter data reviews.
  • Innovative Methodologies & Star Ratings Economics: Creates continuous improvement initiatives by monitoring industry trends and developing best-in-class tools and techniques that ensure application of innovative actuarial methodology and adoption of actuarial best practices. Collaborates with the VP of Quality and Stars Strategy to quantify and incorporate the financial implications of CMS Star Ratings (Quality Bonus Payments and rebate percentages) into long-term strategic plans and multi-year bid curves.
  • Cross-Functional Partnerships & Value-Based Care Alignment: Forges strong, productive, collaborative, cross-departmental relationships and serves as liaison. Consults, influences, shares data review/results, and positively impacts the adoption of strategic, statistically-sound business opportunities.
  • Actuarial Program Leadership: Provides strategic direction for the Company actuarial program, establishing consistent study time and other exam-related guidelines to foster credentialing (ASA/FSA/MAAA) across junior and mid-level actuarial staff.
  • Performance Analytics & Executive Dashboards: Provides pricing analysis, reports, and dashboards to track the performance of various programs, maintaining detailed bid-to-actual variance analyses, inpatient/outpatient unit cost trends, and risk score trajectory tracking.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related quantitative field.
  • Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) and a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA) in good standing, meeting the qualification standards to issue Statements of Actuarial Opinion and CMS Medicare Advantage Part C and Part D Actuarial Certifications.
  • 15+ years of health actuarial experience with at least 7–10 years of direct, senior leadership experience in Medicare Advantage bid preparation, Part C/Part D pricing development, reserving, risk adjustment, and CMS health plan financial management.
  • Significant executive leadership within a Medicare Advantage organization, health maintenance organization (HMO), or national managed care carrier (e.g., Humana, Devoted, UnitedHealth, or prominent regional MA plans), with direct exposure to executive leadership and governing boards.
  • Expert understanding of CMS bid mechanics, HPMS filings, CMS-HCC and RxHCC risk adjustment models, Part D direct subsidy/formulary economics, Star Ratings financial mechanics, and statutory IBNR reserving.
  • Excellent financial knowledge and deep understanding of the economics, actuarial, and accounting aspects of the health care industry, specifically value-based care delivery, capitation, two-sided risk sharing, and Medicare Advantage statutory balance sheet management.
  • Proven ability to develop, support, coach, mentor, and empower a cross-functional team of credentialed actuaries, students, and healthcare economics data analysts.
  • Highly skilled at developing pricing strategies and plans for new products and innovative services, including specialized MA plans (e.g., Chronic or Dual-Eligible SNPs) and consumer-centric supplemental benefit packages.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively across functional teams and different organizational levels to deliver results under strict, non-negotiable statutory timelines (e.g., annual June CMS bid deadline).
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with sales and growth teams to evaluate Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) targets, geographic service area expansions, and competitive market positioning.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with demonstrated experience presenting complex actuarial models and financial trade-offs to Executive Leadership, Plan Leaders, and Board Committees.
  • Ability to effectively organize and prioritize dynamic workflow during high-pressure bid cycles and regulatory filing windows.
  • Ability to work with integrity, ethically and continuously uphold organizational values

jobs.excerpt: Role purpose The Regional Mobilisation and National Advocacy Consultant will accelerate the adoption of digital PrEP across England.
jobs.description:
Role purpose

The Regional Mobilisation and National Advocacy Consultant will accelerate the adoption of digital PrEP across England. The postholder will build commitment through regional public health and commissioning networks, develop a pipeline of areas ready to implement, and influence the national policy and leadership environment needed for sustainable scale.

Working closely with the UK PrEP Programme Manager, the role will provide regional reach, senior stakeholder engagement and national influencing capacity. The role will require active area-to-area mobilisation, working directly with individual local systems to identify readiness, secure senior buy-in, address practical barriers and move areas from interest to implementation. It will help translate learning from UK PrEP pilots into practical implementation support, stronger commissioning cases and wider adoption.

Programme context

Across the UK, PrEP pilots have focused on two complementary ways to widen access. Digital direct-to-consumer (DTC) PrEP enables people to access PrEP through a predominantly remote, digitally supported pathway. Other pilots have integrated, or bundled, PrEP into clinical services that people already use, including women's health hubs.

Together, these approaches are building practical evidence about how PrEP can be made more accessible, embedded within existing care pathways and implemented sustainably across different local systems. This role will focus primarily on scaling digital PrEP in England while ensuring that learning from both models informs regional mobilisation and national advocacy.

Key Responsibilities

Regional mobilisation

  • Lead targeted city-to-city mobilisation across priority areas, tailoring engagement to each local system’s commissioning context, stakeholder landscape, unmet PrEP need and implementation readiness
  • Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders, including Directors of Public Health, Association of Directors of Public Health networks, Fast-Track Cities and relevant commissioning networks.
  • Prioritise engagement using national PrEP data, needs assessments and local intelligence, with a focus on areas where new access routes could address unmet need or inequalities.
  • Undertake stakeholder and power mapping to identify decision-makers, influencers, potential allies and barriers within each local system.
  • Identify and support local champions, assess readiness to adopt digital PrEP and agree the next steps needed to build local commitment.
  • Develop and manage a pipeline of areas progressing from initial interest to commitment, implementation planning and delivery.
  • Convene regional and cross-system discussions that bring together public health, commissioning, sexual health, primary care, women's health and voluntary and community sector partners.
  • Connect interested areas with the digital PrEP implementation support offer, drawing on the London toolkit and learning from UK PrEP pilots.
  • Develop locally relevant cases for adoption by translating evidence into clear benefits, requirements and practical options for commissioners and providers.
  • Identify recurring barriers to adoption, including governance, commissioning, procurement, workforce, data and pathway issues, and explore regional or collaborative solutions.
  • Share regional intelligence, progress and learning with the UK PrEP Programme Manager and implementation partners to strengthen the wider programme.

National advocacy and influence

  • Identify and engage influential national champions for digital PrEP and innovative PrEP delivery models.
  • Build and maintain relationships with the Department of Health and Social Care, UK Health Security Agency, NHS England and other national HIV, sexual health and public health stakeholders.
  • Ensure that evidence, outcomes and implementation learning from digital direct-to-consumer PrEP and integrated clinical pilots are visible and accessible to national decision-makers.
  • Position digital PrEP and integrated delivery models as complementary contributions to the HIV Action Plan, including commitments to improve remote PrEP provision and scale effective innovation.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to influence national policy, guidance, commissioning approaches and investment decisions that could enable wider adoption.
  • Translate programme evidence and local intelligence into clear, persuasive messages tailored to different national audiences.
  • Work sensitively with national and voluntary and community sector partners, recognising different roles, priorities and organisational dynamics.
  • Represent the programme in relevant national and regional meetings, networks and forums.

We are looking for a credible and influential senior public health professional who can build commitment across complex systems and turn strategic interest into practical action.

Essential experience and knowledge

  • Strong credibility with Directors of Public Health, commissioners and regional or national health leaders.
  • Established professional networks across several English regions, extending beyond London.
  • Experience of influencing national health policy and engaging senior stakeholders.
  • A strong understanding of local authority public health commissioning and decision-making, including budgets, governance, procurement and the commissioning of new services.
  • Knowledge of sexual health, HIV prevention and PrEP, including the barriers that affect equitable access.
  • Experience of spreading, scaling or implementing innovation across organisations or systems.
  • Experience of interpreting data and evidence and translating it into clear, compelling arguments for change.
  • Understanding of how health inequalities and service design affect access to prevention services.

Skills and attributes

  • Strong stakeholder and power-mapping skills, with the ability to navigate competing agendas and complex organisational dynamics.
  • Excellent relationship-building, facilitation and communication skills.
  • Confidence and judgement to engage senior stakeholders and bring the right people together.
  • A pragmatic, proactive and energetic approach, with the ability to maintain momentum across multiple relationships and workstreams.
  • Political sensitivity and the ability to work constructively across statutory, clinical and voluntary and community sector partners.
  • Ability to collaborate, exercise sound judgement and operate with a high degree of autonomy.

Desirable experience

  • Experience of digital or remote health pathways, direct-to-consumer services or digital transformation.
  • Experience of integrating prevention interventions into existing clinical services, such as primary care or women's health hubs.
  • Experience of working with voluntary and community sector organisations and people with lived experience.
  • Experience of developing or delivering implementation support, toolkits or spread-and-scale programmes.

Indicative deliverables / success measures

  • Mobilisation pipeline established for 4 - 5 priority cities/local systems, with rationale, readiness status, key stakeholders and agreed next steps.
  • Active mobilisation delivered in at least 3 – 4 priority areas, including senior stakeholder engagement, follow-up actions and connection to the digital PrEP implementation support offer.
  • 2 - 3 areas progressed from interest to a practical next step, such as implementation planning, development of a local adoption case, senior sign-off or formal consideration through commissioning routes.
  • Stakeholder and power mapping completed for priority areas, identifying decision-makers, champions, blockers and routes to secure commitment.
  • Key barriers to adoption summarised, with proposed solutions or escalation routes for regional or national consideration.
  • National advocacy support delivered through briefings, messages or presentations for senior stakeholders, including DHSC, UKHSA, NHS England and relevant national partners.
  • Regular progress reports provided to the UK PrEP Programme Manager, covering pipeline status, stakeholder intelligence, risks, opportunities and recommended next steps.

jobs.excerpt: Company DescriptionHi there—at Razorfish, we’re leaders in what's next.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Hi there—at Razorfish, we’re leaders in what's next. Since the dawn of the internet, we’ve helped brands move first through every era of transformation, defining what digital means for business and now leading brands into the age of AI. Everyone has a prediction. Razorfish has a track record.

Named a Most Innovative Agency three years running (2024–2026) by Campaign US, our work reflects a proven ability not just to anticipate what’s coming, but to help our clients actively shape the future. No matter the trend or cultural moment, delivering real business impact wouldn’t be possible without our people. We bring together curious, driven, and diverse thinkers who challenge convention, push boundaries, and hold a high bar for creative excellence.

If you’re motivated to work alongside top performers, push the boundaries of what’s possible, and help define where technology, business, and marketing are headed next—this is the place to do it.Join us at razorfish.com.

This role at Razorfish will serve as a member of Publicis Groupe's strategic internal agency, Constellation.

Constellation serves as an internal-facing brand formed by a collective of Publicis Groupe agencies to address our client's creative, data, strategy, media, and technology requirements. Team members collaborate across agencies while functioning as sub-divisions within their respective brands to provide dedicated support for the client. By acting as a unified interface, Constellation eliminates operational silos and presents a single service entity and primary point of contact for the client.

Overview

Constellation is Publicis Groupe's dedicated agency for Samsung, bringing together client leadership, strategy, media, data, CRM, creative, technology, delivery, and operations in service of a single client. The Senior Vice President, Transformation Lead works directly with the Executive Vice President, Business Operations to turn Constellation's most important and complex business problems into implementable change.

Constellation is entering a period of significant transformation. Like the wider marketing-services industry, we need to evolve how work gets done to create a more efficient, scalable, and outcome-oriented operating model. Many of today's workflows are highly bespoke, complex, and capacity-constrained. Over the next 12 months and beyond, Constellation will redesign priority areas of the business using process re-engineering, automation, AI, data, and new operating models to improve productivity, quality, speed, and scalability while continuing to deliver exceptional outcomes for Samsung.

This is not a conventional project-management role. The Transformation Lead is expected to understand the realities of a modern marketing-services organization, take ambiguous cross-functional problems, establish the facts, diagnose what is not working, define a practical future state, help senior stakeholders make the necessary choices, and translate the agreed direction into an actionable implementation plan.

The closest shorthand is a strong, experienced management consultant with meaningful agency or marketing-services experience who has moved beyond producing recommendations and knows how to drive implementation. The successful candidate will operate independently, exercise sound judgment, and reduce rather than add to the leadership burden.

This is a senior practitioner role. The Executive Vice President sets the transformation agenda and executive mandate; the Transformation Lead takes major assignments, develops the answer, and drives them through decision, mobilization, and implementation.

*Please note that this is a 6 month contract position.

Responsibilities

The ask:

  • Lead transformation work across selected priority business and operating-model challenges.
  • Redesign priority areas of Constellation's operating system to improve efficiency, scalability, and business performance.
  • Turn poorly defined problems into clear transformation briefs, practical choices, and executable plans.
  • Connect organizational, process, technology, data, commercial, and change implications so that the whole problem is addressed.
  • Move work from diagnosis and design through decision, mobilization, and implementation.

Key responsibilities

  • Structure ambiguous problems: Take complex or poorly defined business issues and turn them into clear questions, hypotheses, workplans, and decision points.
  • Establish the fact base: Gather and synthesize the evidence required to understand the current state, including business needs, workflows, roles, handoffs, pain points, performance data, and stakeholder perspectives.
  • Diagnose the current state: Identify root causes in processes, operating models, organization, governance, technology, or ways of working rather than simply cataloguing symptoms.
  • Design the future state: Develop practical future-state processes and operating models, including capabilities, workflows, roles, decision rights, governance, talent implications, and enabling technology.
  • Develop options and recommendations: Frame realistic choices for senior stakeholders, make trade-offs and implications explicit, and provide a clear point of view rather than merely recording competing opinions.
  • Lead senior working sessions: Plan and facilitate cross-functional discussions that test the work, resolve disagreement, and move stakeholders toward decisions.
  • Translate decisions into implementation: Convert an agreed future state into a sequenced roadmap with outcomes, workstreams, owners, dependencies, resources, risks, milestones, and measures of success.
  • Mobilize the work: Help establish the right team, ownership, governance, and initial operating cadence so that agreed changes move into execution.
  • Integrate business and technology change: Ensure AI, automation, data, platforms, and technical solutions follow the business problem and future workflow rather than becoming the starting point.
  • Track value and adoption: Define practical baselines and success measures, test whether changes are working, and adapt the plan where implementation is not producing the intended outcome.
  • Communicate with clarity: Create concise, decision-oriented materials for senior agency and client leaders that make complex issues understandable without oversimplifying them.

How the role works

  • With the Executive Vice President, Business Operations: The EVP sets the mandate, priorities, and executive context. The Transformation Lead develops the fact base, shapes the answer, and drives the work toward decision and implementation.
  • With accountable business owners: Business owners retain accountability for subject-matter decisions and outcomes. The Transformation Lead provides the method, structure, challenge, and momentum needed to move the work forward.
  • With Delivery / PMO: Delivery / PMO manages plans, cadence, dependencies, status, and delivery discipline. The Transformation Lead owns the transformation logic: diagnosis, future-state design, options, recommendations, and the integrity of the implementation roadmap.
  • With Technology, Data, and AI: Technical leaders own architecture and build. The Transformation Lead defines the business problem and future workflow, ensures requirements are coherent, and connects the solution to adoption and value.
  • With Change, Communications, Talent, and Finance: Specialist partners lead their respective interventions. The Transformation Lead ensures those interventions are grounded in the agreed future state and brought into the work at the right time.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in business transformation, operating-model design, management consulting, or business operations, including substantial experience in an agency, marketing-services, media, CRM, creative, digital, or comparable client-services environment.
  • Deep understanding of agency and marketing-services operating models, including how complex client work is scoped, staffed, delivered, and scaled across functions.
  • A demonstrated ability to redesign complex, bespoke, capacity-constrained workflows using process re-engineering, automation, AI, data, and enabling technology, with measurable improvements in productivity, quality, speed, scalability, and margin.
  • A demonstrated record of taking ambiguous, cross-functional business problems from diagnosis through future-state design and into implementation.
  • Strong process and operating-model capabilities, including current-state assessment, root-cause analysis, workflow design, organizational design, roles and decision rights, governance, and implementation planning.
  • The ability to connect organizational, process, technology, data, commercial, and change considerations without treating them as separate exercises.
  • Sound judgment and the confidence to form a point of view, make trade-offs explicit, and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
  • The ability to influence and drive decisions without relying on direct authority.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication, with the ability to make complex issues simple without making them simplistic.
  • A bias toward action and implementation, including comfort producing a strong first cut, testing it with others, and improving it quickly.

Additional Information

The Power of One starts with our people! To do powerful things, we offer powerful resources. Our best-in-class wellness and benefits offerings include:

Paid Family Care for parents and caregivers for 12 weeks or moreMonetary assistance and support for Adoption, Surrogacy and FertilityMonetary assistance and support for pet adoptionEmployee Assistance Programs and Health/Wellness/Comfort reimbursements to help you invest in your future and work/life balanceTuition AssistancePaid time off that includes Flexible Time off Vacation, Annual Sick Days, Volunteer Days, Holiday and Identity days, and moreMatching Gifts programsFlexible working arrangements‘Work Your World’ Program encouraging employees to work from anywhere Publicis Groupe has an office for up to 6 weeks a year (based upon eligibility)Business Resource Groups that support multiple affinities and alliances

The benefits offerings listed are available to eligible U.S. Based employees, are reviewed on an annual basis, and are governed by the terms of the applicable plan documents.

Razorfish is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our employment decisions are made without regard to actual or perceived race, color, ethnicity, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability, medical condition as defined by applicable state law, genetic information, marital status, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact .

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. SPEEDNET | We build software... for the banking, finance and insurance industry.

Jesteśmy z Gdańska i… robimy software. Nasz zespół tworzy ponad 230 osób specjalizujących się w aplikacjach webowych i mobilnych.

Jesteśmy zaufanym partnerem dla kilkudziesięciu klientów, których od ponad 24 lat wspieramy w dostarczaniu złożonych rozwiązań programistycznych, od product designu, przez tworzenie oprogramowania, testowanie czy consulting technologiczny.

W naszym portfolio znajdziesz zarówno realizacje odjechanych startupowych pomysłów, apki wspierające biznesy średnich i małych przedsiębiorstw, czy pełne funkcjonalności multiplatformowe systemy bankowe. Zdobyte przez lata doświadczenia i umiejętności naszego zespołu poprowadziły nas ku specjalizacji w branżach: banking, fintech i insurtech.

Aktualnie szukamy osoby z doświadczeniem w analizie biznesowej, która dołączy do długofalowego projektu realizowanego dla branży ubezpieczeniowej i wesprze rozwój nowoczesnych procesów sprzedażowych w kanałach online/direct – może to właśnie Ty?

🔎

👉 Szukamy właśnie Ciebie, jeśli:

  • posiadasz min. 4 letnie doświadczenie w analizie biznesowej i systemowej zdobyte przy projektach realizowanych dla branży ubezpieczeniowej lub finansowej,

  • dobrze rozumiesz procesy biznesowe charakterystyczne dla sektora ubezpieczeń, takie jak sprzedaż polis, obsługa klienta, obsługa szkód, odnowienia czy zarządzanie produktami ubezpieczeniowymi,

  • znasz specyfikę regulacji oraz wymagań wpływających na procesy biznesowe w branży ubezpieczeniowej,

  • doskonale znasz język angielski w mowie i piśmie (min. poziom C1),

  • masz doświadczenie w analizie wymagań biznesowych i systemowych oraz we wspieraniu procesów pre-sales, w tym zbieraniu wymagań, estymacji i przygotowywaniu wycen,

  • praktycznie wykorzystujesz UML oraz BPMN do modelowania procesów i projektowania rozwiązań,

  • potrafisz skutecznie współpracować z interesariuszami biznesowymi oraz zespołami technicznymi,

  • cechują Cię wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne, analityczne oraz proaktywne podejście do rozwiązywania problemów,

👉Co w zamian?

Przede wszystkim możesz liczyć na swobodną atmosferę i kulturę pracy opartą na zaufaniu oraz partnerskich relacjach.

Ponadto w pakiecie mamy:

⏰ praca zdalna i elastyczny czas pracy, bo dbamy o work-life balance,

📚 biblioteczka firmowych e-booków,

🤸‍♀ pakiet medyczny i karta sportowa,

🍻 firmowe browarki (unlimited) i… sporo firmowych integracji,

🏢 nowoczesne biuro na 31 piętrze Olivia Star, a w nim bilard, piłkarzyki, szafka śniadaniowa, pyszna kawa i świeże owoce,

🌎 budżet relokacyjny… jeśli planujesz przeprowadzkę do Trójmiasta,

🏐 liczne zajęcia “po godzinach” dofinansowane przez firmę: od planszówek, siatkówki i piłki nożnej, po rowerowe wypady, marsze na orientację czy warsztaty DIY... a najlepsze jest to, że ta lista cały czas się rozrasta, bo nasza ekipa regularnie dorzuca kolejne pomysły!😎

👉Jak będzie wyglądała rekrutacja?

1. Krótka rozmowa telefoniczna z Zosiąz HR,

2. Spotkanie online lub w biurze z Zosią oraz naszym Lead Business & System Analyst.

3. Rozmowa z klientem końcowym.

To jedyne etapy rekrutacji - potem pozostaje Ci już tylko czekać na odpowiedź.

jobs.title: Talent Operations Specialist (Talent Acquisition)
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAt Rankings. io, the candidate experience doesn't end when someone signs an offer.
jobs.description:
Description

At Rankings.io, the candidate experience doesn't end when someone signs an offer. We're looking for a Talent Operations Specialist who can turn that "yes" into an exceptional new-hire experience, one that is organized, intentional, and consistent from offer acceptance through an employee's first several months with the company.

As a fast-growing, fully remote digital marketing agency serving law firms, we need someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about creating a white-glove experience for every new hire. You'll play a critical role in ensuring a seamless transition from candidate to employee, coordinating across teams, anticipating needs, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

While this role offers a clear growth path into full-cycle Talent Acquisition, the initial focus will be owning our white-glove onboarding experience, employee engagement initiatives, and Talent Operations processes. As you demonstrate success, you'll progressively develop your recruiting skills, expanding into candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and eventually full-cycle recruitment.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition, takes pride in delivering an exceptional people experience, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where excellence and accountability matter.

Your Mission: Create an Exceptional New-Hire Experience

You’ll own the onboarding experience from signed offers through Day 90 and help support employees beyond onboarding through structured check-ins, surveys, and stay interviews. You’ll partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, IT, and hiring managers to ensure every new hire has the tools, training plan, communication, and support they need to hit the ground running.

This is more than checking boxes.You’ll own and continuously improve a process that includes dozens of moving pieces for every hire while helping us create an onboarding experience that supports engagement, retention, and long-term success.

Responsibilities

Onboarding & New-Hire Experience

  • Own the full onboarding lifecycle from signed offer through Day 90, coordinating approximately 30–50+ tasks per new hire to ensure a seamless, white-glove experience.

  • Lead new-hire check-ins at 1 week, 30 days, 60 days, and 90 days, proactively identifying concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.

  • Coordinate 6-month employee surveys and conduct quarterly stay interviews, sharing actionable feedback and trends with HR and department leaders.

  • Collaborate with IT, HR, Talent Acquisition, and hiring managers to ensure systems access, onboarding documentation, and employee information are completed accurately and on time.

  • Partner with the Experience Coordinator to coordinate new-hire swag and personalized onboarding touchpoints.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new hires, providing responsive communication, guidance, and support throughout their onboarding journey.

Talent Operations & Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate onboarding records, workflows, and documentation across Rippling, ClickUp, Notion, and other internal systems.

  • Proactively identify onboarding gaps, streamline workflows, and implement improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency, and the employee experience.

  • Track onboarding milestones, completion rates, and employee feedback to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

Talent Acquisition & Recruiting Support

  • Support recruiting operations and hiring initiatives, including candidate communication, interview coordination, and applicant tracking.

  • Assist with proactive candidate sourcing, outreach, and pipeline development during high-volume hiring periods.

  • Progressively develop recruiting skills through resume screening, candidate sourcing, interviewing, and other hiring activities, with the goal of growing into a full-cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in onboarding, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, recruiting coordination, or People Operations.

  • Experience managing multiple employees or candidates through different stages of a structured process simultaneously.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage 15–20 new hires at different stages of onboarding without losing sight of the details.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create a welcoming, white-glove employee experience.

  • Comfortable taking ownership of a process from beginning to end rather than simply executing an existing checklist.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment where priorities and hiring volume can shift quickly.

  • Genuine interest in employee engagement, retention, and building an onboarding experience that sets people up for long-term success.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with an ATS, HRIS, or similar people systems; experience with Teamtailor or Rippling is a plus.

  • Familiarity with project management and documentation tools such as ClickUp.

  • Mountain Time (MST) candidates are strongly preferred to provide coverage later in the business day, as many hiring decisions and onboarding needs arise toward the end of the Central Time workday.

Benefits

  • Starting salary: $60,000

  • Recruiting commission opportunities in addition to base salary

  • Fully Remote

  • Unlimited PTO

  • $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program

  • Quarterly professional development stipend

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

What to Expect in the Interview Process

  1. Resume Review: The Talent Acquisition Manager will review applications and resumes to identity candidates whose experience aligns with the role.

  2. One-Way Interview: Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.

  3. Live Zoom Interview:Candidates who advance will meet with the Talent Acquisition Manager and HR Generalist to discuss their experience, organizational skills, approach to employee experience, and role expectations.

  4. Final Live Zoom Interview:Finalists will meet with the Talent Acquisition Manager and VP of Human Resources to discuss career goals, team alignment, and long-term growth opportunities.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Development Manager

Job Description Summary

Responsible for developing, executing, and directing the overall strategic objectives involved in the development and acquisition of land to include feasibility analysis, establishing scope and developmental schedules, and leadership for all activities related to the client’s real estate development projects from inception and architectural design through municipal approvals and zoning throughout the region.

Job Description

  • Create tailored development schedules for a land lease / acquisition based on zoning status, conditional use permits, platting and required third party approvals to pursue speed to construction start for a given project
  • Manage and lead a team of architects, civil, structural, electrical engineers & more to confirm the economic and zoning viability of a land site
  • Lead and present at local staff, design review boards, planning commission and city council meetings to represent the clients and pursue zoning and site plan approval
  • Manage the launch and receipt of all given surveys to qualify a land site ranging from Title Reports, ALTA Survey, Geotechnical reports, Environmental reports, Sign Surveys and more depending upon the site
  • Play critical leadership, coordination, and communication role with all stakeholders including the client, architects, civil, structural, electrical and mechanical engineers, sign vendors and more
  • Manage program and project efforts for new store developments, store relocation, and multi-state program roll-outs
  • Assist during the initial leasing / purchase agreement feasibility phase by: reviewing all surveys and providing cost and zoning analysis back to Real Estate for review and consideration
  • Pursue all approvals from County, City, State & more to prepare a land site for Lease Commencement or Closing and communicate with the client and all stakeholders each step of the way
  • Meet established development timelines by: reviewing master project schedules for assigned projects, ensuring Architects & Civil Engineers are provided with accurate and timely information, verifying material procurement and delivery are synchronized with schedules, regularly monitoring progress of all projects, visiting sites, and requesting modified completion target dates when necessary
  • Provide value engineering ideas and opportunity for savings regularly through project evaluation
  • Complete all required documentation/paperwork and provide timely and accurate project status reporting while traveling

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree; Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering or related discipline, 5+ years of development management in the commercial

construction industry or equivalent as an Owner’s Representative, or any similar combination of education and experience

  • Experience in pre-construction and land development efforts ranging from site planning, grading plan reviews and utility design and review
  • Expertise in Feasibility / Due Diligence, Site Planning, Permitting, Site Analysis, civil design and construction, Entitlements, Land Use, Land Planning, Utility Providers and Construction
  • Proven experience in working with local municipalities and organizations to pursue site plan / zoning approvals for a given concept
  • Experience in managing restaurant, banking and/or pad site projects preferred
  • Certification in PMP, PE, AIA, LEED, or CMAA preferred
  • Proficient in preparing and tracking detailed project budgets and schedules
  • Proven experience leading and managing numerous facets of multiple projects simultaneously
  • Solid understanding of construction industry, terminology, codes, documentation, and design disciplines
  • Ability to read, understand, and apply construction standards and plan sets
  • Proficient with project management software (e.g. Microsoft Project, NIKU)
  • Ability to conduct weekly project meetings either onsite or via conference calls with clients, contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders
  • Demonstrated customer/vendor relationship building experience
  • Excellent organizational, presentation and communication skills

• Ability to travel 25-50%

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

The Product Analyst – Digital Transformation advances SCRI’s digital strategy by translating business needs into practical technology solutions. Serving as a bridge between business and IT teams, this role supports process improvement, data integrity, and AI-enabled transformation within SCRI Development Innovations. The position emphasizes hands-on delivery, rapid experimentation, and measurable business outcomes.

Abilities

  • Collaborate effectively with leaders, product owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams.
  • Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate solutions based on user and system feedback.
  • Manage competing priorities and adapt in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare or life sciences technology/product initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success driving technology adoption and identifying high-value AI or automation opportunities.
  • Hands-on experience developing or piloting low/no-code, AI-enabled, or other proof-of-concept solutions.

In this role, you will report to the Sr IT Program Manager.

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of the Next Generation PLM replacement, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, risks, quality, and benefits realization.

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to align global product-development and lifecycle-management processes, define requirements, manage scope, and maintain clear accountability for decisions and deliverables.

  • Drive organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, readiness assessments, and adoption planning for impacted users and functions.
  • Identify and proactively resolve cross-functional risks, resource constraints, competing priorities, and dependencies with ERP, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and downstream enterprise systems.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready program documentation, including plans, requirements, decisions, risks, issues, actions, test evidence, deployment readiness, and lessons learned.

Skills You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • PMP or CAPM certification preferred
  • 5 plus years of progressive experience managing complex or cross-functional project
  • Demonstrated success leading large, complex, cross-functional enterprise technology or business-transformation programs from initiation through deployment and stabilization.
  • Experience delivering PLM, product-development, engineering, quality, or master-data solutions in a global manufacturing environment.
  • Strong command of project and program management disciplines, including integrated planning, financial management, dependency management, risk and issue management, change control, and executive reporting.

  • Ability to translate business objectives and technical constraints into clear plans, decisions, actions, and leadership communications.

Job Description:


The Senior Technical Product Owner owns the product backlog, release cadence and stakeholder intake for the Retail Performance Engine (RPE) platform. What makes someone successful in this role

  • Curiosity and persistence. You ask questions until the answer is clear. You follow up, as many times as it takes, when an unanswered question is blocking the team. You document decisions and meeting outcomes so nothing gets lost.
  • Ownership. You make trade-off decisions among scope, quality and timeline, and you are accountable for what ships.

Role Responsibilities

  • Backlog and sprint ownership: Own and prioritize the backlog in Azure DevOps. Break epics into user stories with clear acceptance criteria, plan sprints with the team, and accept completed work.
  • Requirements discovery: Lead kickoff and discovery sessions with stakeholders and other teams. Identify dependencies, overlaps with existing systems, data and file-feed needs, and open questions. Write up summaries and next steps.
  • Intake and triage: Serve as the primary contact for support, client managers and internal teams. Convert emailed issues and requests into spikes, stories or bugs, and prioritize them against sprint capacity.
  • Release coordination: Plan releases with the team and communicate release dates and code-freeze windows. Prepare or review release notes and keep stakeholders informed before and after deployment.
  • Stakeholder communication: Give regular status updates on progress and risks. Escalate blockers early and give leadership the information needed to resolve them.
  • Roadmap and vision: Work with the Product Manager and stakeholders to shape product goals and a prioritized roadmap that balances customer needs, business value and technical capability.
  • Customer engagement: Join customer and client-facing meetings to understand needs and make sure what is built delivers value.
  • Cross-team collaboration: Coordinate work that spans multiple teams or products, such as loyalty/rewards, CashPlease and administration tooling.
  • Continuous improvement: Help maintain Azure DevOps practices, improve the SDLC process, and keep the backlog well groomed.
  • Team leadership: Informally mentor less experienced Product Owners and help energize the team around product goals. Support technology modernization efforts (APIs, AI, services, cloud) as they affect the roadmap.
  • Fulfill other duties as assigned.

Required Skills

Overview

About Certara

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

As we continue to evolve our scientific capabilities and technology platforms, we are seeking a Vice President of Translational Science (DMPK) to provide scientific leadership, strategic vision, and innovation across Simcyp’s Translational Science team.

The Vice President of Translational Science (Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics, DMPK) leads Simcyp’s Translational Science organisation, shaping the scientific direction of DMPK‑driven Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic (PBPK) innovation while partnering closely with clients, key opinion leaders, regulators, and cross‑functional internal teams.

This role combines scientific excellence, executive leadership, strategic decision‑making, and external influence, with a strong focus on delivering high‑impact Model‑Informed Drug Development (MIDD) through the Simcyp platform.

You will champion innovative translational approaches, including the application of AI/ML and advanced data science, to enhance data integration, model translation, predictive performance, and platform evolution.


Responsibilities

Scientific & Strategic Leadership

  • Provide scientific leadership and direction for strategic initiatives, setting translational science priorities, making decisions on scientific approaches, and delivering strategic initiatives while balancing scientific ambition with platform feasibility, timelines, and regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee, support, and contribute to the design, execution, reporting, and dissemination of scholarly scientific work from the Translational Science in DMPK team.
  • Champion innovative translational approaches, including the integration of AI/ML, real‑world data, and advanced analytics to enhance PBPK‑based translation.
  • Present Simcyp translational science outputs at national and international conferences, workshops, and scientific forums.

Platform & Technical Oversight

  • Hold overall responsibility for scientific regression testing of the Simcyp Simulator, ensuring ongoing rigor, quality, and consistency of platform outputs.
  • Apply deep DMPK and translational science expertise when supervising the implementation of new scientific modules and capabilities within the Simcyp platform.
  • Work in close partnership with the software development teams to translate scientific requirements into robust, maintainable, and high‑performance software solutions.
  • Provide scientific leadership across the full Simcyp platform lifecycle, including prioritisation, development, validation, release, post‑release support, and strategic retirement of capabilities.
  • Guide the Translational Science team in creating, maintaining, implementing, and testing scientific modules and platform components.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Oversee the development, communication, and presentation of strategic initiatives, ensuring transparency, scientific clarity, and alignment with long‑term platform and company strategy.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of MIDD workshops, focused training sessions, and capability‑building activities related to the Simcyp platform, leading workshops as required.
  • Visit client and prospective client organisations to advise on the optimal use of Simcyp, integration of DMPK knowledge, and best practices in translational modelling.
  • Engage proactively with regulatory agencies and support platform qualification and regulatory science initiatives.

People & Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a large, multidisciplinary Translational Science DMPK team (~35 high‑calibre scientists), fostering a culture of scientific excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous professional development.
  • Set clear priorities, expectations, and development plans aligned with corporate and scientific objectives.

Executive Leadership

  • Contributing to operational management decisions, company policies, and long‑term strategy in alignment with Board objectives.
  • Act as a key scientific interface with key opinion leaders, ensuring external scientific insight informs internal priorities, platform evolution, and long‑term strategy.
  • Hold executive accountability for Translational Science delivery, including prioritisation, resourcing, risk management, and trade‑off decisions impacting the Simcyp platform.

Qualifications

  • PhD in Pharmacokinetics, DMPK, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in Pharmacokinetics, DMPK or Pharmaceutical Sciences
  • Extensive experience in translational science, PBPK modelling, and DMPK, ideally spanning both industry and consultancy environments.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, highly skilled scientific teams and complex, multi‑stakeholder programmes.
  • Strong record of scientific publications, conference presentations, and external engagement.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the presence and credibility to operate effectively at executive, regulatory, and client‑facing levels.
  • Experience or strong interest in applying AI/ML and advanced analytics to translational science and model‑informed drug development.
