jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

As Senior Insurance Product Manager, you'll serve as the product owner for an assigned regional Medicare Advantage portfolio, connecting market and portfolio strategy to accurate bid filings, member-facing product content and operational implementation.

You'll lead product execution across the annual Medicare Advantage lifecycle, including CMS bid filings, benefit configuration, service-area updates, crosswalks, plan lists and member materials. You'll work closely with Actuarial, Finance, Network, Compliance, Operations, Marketing and Market Leadership to ensure approved product decisions are accurately reflected across filings, systems, materials and operational processes.

You'll also serve as the primary Product Management contact for assigned markets and portfolios. You'll represent Product Management in Regional Strategy discussions, evaluate product and benefit questions, identify gaps or risks and develop practical recommendations that consider competitive, financial, regulatory, operational and member implications.

This is a highly collaborative individual-contributor role for someone with strong product judgment, deep attention to detail and the ability to independently lead complex work across multiple partners and firm CMS deadlines.

Own Regional Medicare Advantage Portfolios

  • Serve as the primary product owner for assigned regional Medicare Advantage portfolios throughout the product lifecycle
  • Translate enterprise, segment and market strategies into clear product requirements, deliverables and execution priorities
  • Maintain an integrated understanding of the portfolio’s benefits, service area, plan structure, market positioning and implementation requirements
  • Connect product decisions across strategy, bid development, CMS filings, member materials, systems and operational implementation
  • Identify portfolio gaps, inconsistencies, emerging risks and opportunities and develop practical recommendations for Product Management and market leaders
  • Evaluate how changes in one area of the portfolio could affect other products, markets, systems, materials or member experiences
  • Maintain accurate records of product decisions, requirements, owners, dependencies and follow-up actions

Lead Medicare Advantage Bid Filing and Execution

  • Lead Product Management execution across the annual Medicare Advantage bid cycle for assigned portfolios
  • Partner with Actuarial, Finance, Compliance, Network, Operations and other functions to translate approved product direction into complete, accurate and compliant CMS submissions
  • Establish and manage workplans, milestones, dependencies, review points and partner responsibilities for assigned filing activities
  • Coordinate development and validation of Plan Benefit Package data, service areas, plan characteristics and other applicable filing components
  • Ensure bid assumptions and product decisions are appropriately documented and consistently reflected across filing deliverables
  • Monitor progress against CMS and internal deadlines, identify risks early and facilitate timely resolution or escalation
  • Maintain clear visibility into filing status, outstanding decisions, dependencies and areas requiring leadership attention
  • Capture lessons learned and apply them to improve future bid-cycle planning and execution

Maintain Filing and Configuration Accuracy

  • Conduct thorough quality-control reviews of Plan Benefit Package data, service areas, plan characteristics, crosswalks and other filing components before submission
  • Validate that approved product and benefit decisions are accurately reflected across applicable tools, files and systems
  • Identify inconsistencies among source documentation, filing data, member materials and downstream implementation requirements
  • Coordinate resolution of defects, discrepancies and unanswered questions with accountable functional partners
  • Update and validate county and state expansion information based on approved business decisions
  • Maintain the National Plan List and applicable crosswalks to support accurate filings, implementation and operational readiness
  • Apply disciplined version control, documentation and evidence-retention practices to assigned product deliverables
  • Escalate quality, regulatory or timing risks when resolution requires decisions or authority beyond the role’s scope

Own Product Content and Member Materials

  • Own the accuracy and completeness of Annual Notice of Change, Evidence of Coverage and Summary of Benefits content for assigned regional portfolios
  • Translate approved benefits and product decisions into clear, consistent and compliant member-facing content
  • Coordinate content development and review with Compliance, Marketing, Operations and other applicable partners
  • Validate alignment among approved benefits, CMS filings, source documentation, member materials and downstream systems
  • Identify content inconsistencies, ambiguous requirements and potential member impacts and facilitate timely resolution
  • Maintain clear documentation of content decisions, changes, approvals and outstanding issues
  • Support quality reviews and readiness activities necessary to deliver member materials accurately and on time
  • Apply lessons learned from defects, questions and prior cycles to strengthen future content-development practices

Provide Strategic Oversight of Provider Directory Configuration

  • Provide product oversight of provider directory configuration and maintenance for assigned portfolios
  • Ensure provider directory requirements remain aligned with approved benefits, network strategy, service areas, CMS requirements and member materials
  • Partner with Network, Compliance, Operations and other functional teams to clarify requirements and resolve product-related questions
  • Evaluate the potential member and portfolio impact of directory configuration issues or inconsistencies
  • Validate that material product or network changes are reflected accurately across applicable directory processes and member communications
  • Monitor identified issues and ensure appropriate owners, actions and resolution timelines are established
  • Escalate significant risks when directory information could create compliance, operational or member-experience concerns

Lead Market and Functional Partnerships

  • Serve as the primary Product Management contact for assigned Market Leadership, Individual Product Actuarial and other portfolio stakeholders
  • Build trusted relationships by providing accurate information, responsive support and clear visibility into product decisions and deliverables
  • Represent Product Management in Regional Strategy calls and other market or functional forums
  • Present concise product recommendations, portfolio updates, risks, decisions and unresolved issues to working teams and leaders
  • Gather market insights and functional input and translate them into actionable product considerations
  • Navigate competing market, financial, regulatory, operational and member priorities and facilitate alignment within the role’s authority
  • Clarify decision ownership and engage the appropriate accountable leaders when final direction is required
  • Follow through on commitments and maintain clear records of decisions, owners and next steps

Support Portfolio Strategy and Product Decisions

  • Apply product-lifecycle knowledge to identify gaps and opportunities from strategy through implementation
  • Evaluate proposed product and benefit changes using competitive, financial, regulatory, operational, network and member considerations
  • Gather and synthesize data from relevant sources to identify patterns, implications and potential tradeoffs
  • Develop practical recommendations that explain the issue, supporting evidence, available options, risks and proposed path forward
  • Help market and Product Management leaders understand the downstream implications of portfolio decisions
  • Distinguish confirmed facts and requirements from assumptions or areas requiring additional validation
  • Monitor emerging product, market and regulatory developments and identify potential implications for assigned portfolios
  • Support continuous refinement of regional product direction within established enterprise and segment strategies

Support Annual Enrollment Period Readiness

  • Lead Product Management readiness activities for assigned portfolios during the Annual Enrollment Period
  • Confirm that key product information, reference materials, escalation paths and partner responsibilities are established before the enrollment period begins
  • Respond to market, sales, operational and member-related product questions with accurate and timely information
  • Research complex product inquiries and coordinate input from functional subject-matter experts when necessary
  • Track product issues, questions, decisions and emerging themes through resolution
  • Identify recurring questions or defects and recommend improvements to materials, processes, training or system configuration
  • Escalate significant product, compliance or member-experience risks using clear facts and recommended next steps

How you achieve results matters as much as what you deliver. You'll model Humana's values by being Caring, Curious and Committed, and you'll put the Humana Way into practice by living the Golden Rule, keeping work simple, playing to win, keeping your eyes on the horizon and playing as one team.


You'll listen before assuming and consider how product decisions affect members, markets and teammates. You'll ask thoughtful questions, remain open to new information and use data without allowing unnecessary complexity to slow decisions.

jobs.excerpt: about us: battleface is building a humanity-focused travel insurance company to bring people and the world together.
jobs.description:
about us: battleface is building a humanity-focused travel insurance company to bring people and the world together. For too long, travel insurance has centered on the company and not the traveler. We're changing that by connecting people with customized coverage at the right price, exactly when and where they need it.

Our global assistance arm, Robin Assist, powers the 24/7 support, medical coordination, and claims services that travelers rely on — not just for battleface, but across the industry. Together, we're setting new standards for how travelers are cared for worldwide.

about the role: we're looking for an experienced Claims Customer Service Manager to lead, develop, and oversee our customer service operations within the claims department.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who understands travel insurance claims, knows how to manage people, and is comfortable working with technology across multiple communication platforms.

Our customers contact us during some of the most stressful moments of their travels. We need someone who can ensure they receive accurate information, timely responses, and professional, empathetic support. Whether they're contacting us by telephone, email, or live chat.

The right person will bring credibility, accountability, and structure to the team. You'll be responsible for developing our people, improving service standards, identifying operational gaps, and ensuring that technology helps us deliver a better customer experience.

We're looking for a leader who can make decisions, solve problems independently, and take ownership of results. This isn't a role for someone who simply monitors performance reports. We need someone who understands the work, can coach others through complex situations, and isn't afraid to get involved when needed.

what you'll do:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and manage the Claims Customer Service team, providing day-to-day oversight, direction, and support.
  • Establish clear expectations around service quality, productivity, professionalism, and accountability.
  • Develop and deliver structured onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching programs.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, quality assessments, and individual development sessions.
  • Identify knowledge gaps and provide practical training to improve team performance.
  • Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and scheduling to maintain appropriate service coverage.

Customer Service Operations

  • Oversee customer interactions across telephone, email, live chat, and other digital communication channels.
  • Ensure consistent, accurate, and timely responses to policyholders, claimants, brokers, and insurance partners.

  • Manage escalated customer inquiries, complex claims-related questions, and service complaints.
  • Ensure customers receive clear explanations of claims processes, documentation requirements, coverage decisions, and next steps.
  • Coordinate closely with Claims Adjusters, Medical Assistance, Operations, and other departments to resolve customer issues.
  • Identify recurring customer complaints, service failures, and operational bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, case ownership, and follow-up across all customer interactions.

Technology & Process Management

  • Take ownership of the effective use of customer service technology, including telephone systems, shared inboxes, live chat, claims management platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Manage and optimize workflows across platforms.
  • Ensure team members are proficient in the technology required to perform their roles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation, routing, case management, and operational efficiency.
  • Work closely with IT, Product, and Engineering teams to troubleshoot issues, implement improvements, and support new technology.
  • Help develop and implement AI-assisted tools that improve customer communication, quality assurance, and operational performance.
  • Ensure customer records, interaction histories, and claims information are accurately maintained across systems.
  • Develop clear standard operating procedures, training materials, and knowledge resources.

Quality Assurance & Performance

  • Establish and maintain a structured quality assurance program covering telephone calls, emails, and chat interactions.
  • Regularly review customer communications for accuracy, professionalism, empathy, and compliance with internal standards.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, including response times, service levels, first-contact resolution, quality scores, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
  • Provide meaningful reporting and recommendations to senior management.
  • Ensure customer service representatives understand the limits of their authority and escalate claims decisions appropriately.
  • Identify performance issues early and implement measurable improvement plans.
  • Maintain consistency in customer service standards across different teams, shifts, and geographic locations.

what we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in insurance customer service, claims operations, or a related financial services environment.
  • 3+ years of people management experience, ideally leading customer service or claims support teams.
  • Strong understanding of insurance claims processes, policy benefits, documentation requirements, and customer communications.
  • Experience in travel insurance, medical assistance, or insurance claims administration is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multichannel customer service operations, including telephone, email, and live chat.
  • Strong technical proficiency and experience managing CRM, contact center, ticketing, and claims management platforms.
  • Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and translate findings into measurable improvements.
  • Proven experience developing training programs, coaching employees, and managing team performance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex insurance matters clearly.
  • Confidence handling escalations, difficult conversations, and sensitive customer situations.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Sound judgment, independent decision-making, and a practical approach to problem-solving.
  • Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

what makes you successful:

  • You're a credible leader who earns the respect of your team through knowledge, consistency, and accountability.
  • You understand that great customer service requires both empathy and operational discipline.
  • You're comfortable with technology and can confidently introduce new tools, improve existing workflows, and help others adapt.
  • You don't wait for problems to escalate — you identify them early and take action.
  • You can balance customer expectations with policy requirements, operational realities, and business priorities.
  • You know how to turn performance data into practical improvements.
  • You're comfortable making decisions independently while knowing when to escalate.
  • You lead by example and are willing to step into customer interactions when the situation requires it.

why join us:

  • We're building something different in travel insurance and assistance. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our Claims Customer Service team operates, introduce better technology, develop our people, and directly influence the experience we deliver to travelers worldwide.
  • This is a remote position with a global team. Flexibility, collaboration, and accountability are essential. Travel emergencies don't follow a 9-to-5 schedule, and neither does our commitment to helping customers.

  • Shape how AI actually collects debt at some of the world's top banks

  • Flexible, low-commitment engagement that fits around your current job.

  • Work directly with a founding product/AI team backed by Northzone, ElevenLabs and Lakestar.

  • Competitive hourly consulting fee.

jobs.description:
The Employment Fraud Risk Lead / Manager is a recognized subject matter expert responsible for establishing and leading a dedicated enterprise capability for the prevention, detection, escalation, response, reporting, and ongoing mitigation of employment-related fraud.

This role provides a single point of accountability within the People Organization for employment fraud risk, establishes operational plans and standards for the job area, and moves the organization from a primarily reactive approach to a sustained, coordinated, and proactive risk management model

The Employment Fraud Risk Lead will lead and partner across the People Organization—including Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Onboarding, and People Business Partners—as well as Legal, Compliance, Ethics, IT Security, Operations, third-party vendors, and other relevant stakeholders. The role will develop and implement scalable processes, controls, governance, and reporting that impact functional results; drive consistent adoption across geographies; and communicate risk insights, recommendations, and program performance to leadership.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Own the global enterprise strategy and operational plan for employment fraud prevention, detection, escalation, response, mitigation, and remediation, with accountability for functional outcomes.
  • Serve as the recognized enterprise subject matter expert and primary point of accountability for employment fraud risk across the People Organization, applying advanced expertise to resolve difficult and complex issues.
  • Establish, implement, and continuously improve the enterprise employment fraud risk framework, including operational standards, governance, roles and responsibilities, escalation pathways, and decision-making standards that influence functional results.
  • Manage and coordinate suspected employment fraud escalations from recruiters, hiring managers, onboarding teams, Employee Relations, People Business Partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain employment fraud policies, procedures, risk registers, red-flag frameworks, response playbooks, escalation protocols, and decisioning standards.
  • Identify and assess fraud vulnerabilities across the candidate and employee lifecycle and recommend preventive and detective control enhancements.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition on candidate fraud indicators, identity verification, screening controls, and emerging recruitment-related fraud risks.
  • Collaborate with IT Security on identity-related risks, suspicious activity, digital anomalies, and technology-enabled fraud detection.
  • Coordinate complex or high-risk matters with Legal, Compliance, Ethics, Employee Relations, Operations, and other relevant functions.
  • Support appropriate engagement with external stakeholders, including third-party vendors and law enforcement agencies.
  • Establish centralized tracking of suspected and confirmed employment fraud attempts, incidents, trends, outcomes, and remediation activities.
  • Develop metrics and key risk indicators to monitor fraud exposure, control effectiveness, response performance, and emerging risks.
  • Conduct or support root-cause analysis following significant incidents and ensure identified control improvements are implemented and sustained.
  • Monitor emerging employment fraud trends, typologies, technologies, and methods used to circumvent recruitment, identity verification, and onboarding controls.
  • Translate fraud intelligence, incident learnings, and threat trends into new or enhanced processes, controls, standards, training, and operating practices, and lead implementation across relevant functions.
  • Prepare clear, concise, executive-ready reporting on employment fraud risks, trends, incidents, control performance, and remediation activities.
  • Advise and provide periodic updates to senior leadership and relevant governance forums, presenting risk implications, recommendations, trade-offs, and progress against operational plans.
  • Drive consistent adoption of employment fraud standards and controls across geographies while accounting for local legal, regulatory, privacy, and operational requirements.
  • Develop guidance, awareness materials, and training to enable People teams, hiring managers, and other stakeholders to recognize and appropriately escalate potential employment fraud.
  • Establish sustainable governance, performance review, and continuous-improvement mechanisms to ensure the employment fraud risk program evolves with changing threats and business needs.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 10+ years of progressive professional work experience in HR, Risk, Compliance or similar roles.
  • 5+ years of advanced professional knowledge and significant relevant experience in one or more disciplines such as fraud risk management, investigations, compliance, employee relations, corporate security, risk management, cybersecurity, internal controls, or human resources.
  • Demonstrated experience managing sensitive investigations, fraud matters, risk events, or complex escalations involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of fraud risk assessment, control design, root-cause analysis, remediation, and governance principles.
  • 5+ years of implementing Enterprise HR Solutions. Strong organizational and program management skills, including the ability to lead large or complex cross-functional initiatives with limited oversight, manage multiple priorities, and drive actions through completion.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish operational plans and develop and implement new processes, controls, standards, playbooks, escalation protocols, and decision-making frameworks that impact functional results.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies, emerging risks, and systemic control weaknesses.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across organizational boundaries and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to make balanced, defensible decisions in sensitive, complex, or ambiguous situations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex fraud and risk matters into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to prepare concise, executive-level reporting and communicate effectively with senior leaders.
  • Ability to handle confidential employee, candidate, investigative, and organizational information with appropriate discretion and integrity.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience developing, implementing, or leading an enterprise fraud prevention, investigation, risk, or control framework within a complex organization.
  • Experience working within or closely partnering with Talent Acquisition, Human Resources/People, Legal, Compliance, Ethics, Employee Relations, Corporate Security, or IT Security functions.
  • Experience operating within a global organization and implementing risk or control frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Knowledge of candidate identity fraud, employment fraud, recruitment fraud, social engineering, digital fraud, or related emerging threats.
  • Familiarity with identity verification, background screening, candidate authentication, anomaly detection, or other fraud prevention technologies.
  • Experience working with third-party vendors responsible for recruiting, background screening, identity verification, onboarding, or related services.
  • Experience engaging with law enforcement, external investigators, regulatory authorities, or other external stakeholders in connection with fraud matters.
  • Experience developing key risk indicators, dashboards, management reporting, or other mechanisms for measuring fraud trends and control effectiveness.
  • Knowledge of relevant privacy, employment, data protection, and regulatory considerations associated with employment fraud prevention and investigation.
  • Experience designing and delivering fraud awareness, risk education, or training programs.

jobs.description:
Triptease is a hotel technology company helping independent hotels and groups drive more direct bookings. We invoice customers worldwide through three regional entities, each with its own ledger and multiple currencies.

We are moving to a new finance system in December. Before then, we want our sales ledgers clean, reconciled and accurate, so we migrate good data and start the new year strong.

Working alongside the Credit Control team, you will focus primarily on collections while supporting ledger clean-up and migration readiness.

This is a role for an experienced, self-sufficient credit controller who can take ownership of a collections workload and deliver results with minimal supervision.

Key responsibilities

    • Chase overdue invoices by phone and email, prioritising the oldest and largest balances
    • Manage dunning sequences and customer correspondence activity in Upflow
    • Resolve invoice queries and disputes with Customer Success, Billing and Sales to unblock payment, within SLAs
    • Negotiate payment and maintain accurate records of contact, promises to pay and account status
    • Escalate payment plans, credit-risk concerns and high-risk accounts to the line manager
    • Carry out customer account reconciliations, matching receipts, invoices and credit notes
    • Reallocate unapplied cash, debits and credits to the correct invoices, customers and entities
    • Clear unreconciled items and receivables-related suspense balances
    • Assist in cleansing customer master data and support validation of opening AR balances for migration
    • Flag process gaps and data issues so they are fixed at source, not carried forward
    • Provide regular updates on collections, aged-debt movement, cleared items and outstanding issues.

What success looks like

    • Week 1: Up and running in Xero and Upflow; priority accounts and aged-debt exposure identified with line manager
    • Weeks 2–6: Collections underway on the oldest balances; reconciliations and reallocations progressing entity by entity; credit balances reduced.
    • Weeks 7–10+: All allocated accounts resolved, opening AR balances validated, and handover notes completed

Requirements

  • 2+ years recent Xero experience
  • 3+ years credit control experience
  • Extensive account and bank reconciliation experience
  • 3+ years credit control experience, including proactive telephone and email collections, dispute resolution, dunning workflows and escalation of high-risk accounts
  • 2+ years, recent, hands-on Xero experience, including allocations, credit notes, customer reconciliations and AR reporting
  • Extensive account and bank reconciliation experience, using Excel, Xero and other tools to match receipts to invoices, investigate variances and clear unapplied cash
  • Experience managing multi-currency AR ledgers across multiple entities
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivots and reconciliations
  • Confident chasing customers by phone and email, firmly and professionally
  • High attention to detail and a methodical approach to cleaning up historic data
  • Able to start immediately and work independently with minimal supervision.

Benefits

Why join us?

  • Be part of a fast-paced, dynamic team at the forefront of travel technology innovation.
  • Enjoy a collaborative and fun working environment with opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Competitive salary package and rewards for high performance.

Our start-up culture means everybody's contribution matters and is celebrated. We set ourselves ambitious goals and are proud of our ability to deliver those through smart working. We're growing: get on board fast, be part of the journey, and have a real impact on an award-winning, fast-growing company.

jobs.excerpt: About the teamAt Zillow, we are continuously evolving how people move and live, helping to shape the future of real estate.
jobs.description:
About the team

At Zillow, we are continuously evolving how people move and live, helping to shape the future of real estate. Achieving that vision requires bold thinking, rapid adaptation, and talented people who are excited to tackle complex challenges.

Within that broader ambition, Rentals represents one of the most dynamic opportunities in the industry. Macro trends—from affordability pressures to shifting renter demographics—are transforming how people find and secure homes. At the same time, the market is highly competitive, with large, established players and rapidly evolving expectations from both renters and property professionals.

At Zillow Rentals, our aspiration is clear: to build the largest and most trusted rentals marketplace—helping renters get home while helping our partners unlock success.

Over the past decade, Rentals has grown into the fastest-growing business line at Zillow, powering a marketplace that connects millions of renters with property managers and owners across the country. While we’ve made tremendous progress, we believe the most exciting opportunities still lie ahead.
The stakes are high. With persistent housing affordability challenges and fluctuating vacancy rates across markets, the need for better tools, transparency, and efficiency in renting has never been greater. Our goal is to build products that make renting easier for consumers while enabling our partners to operate more successfully in a rapidly changing landscape.

Within Rentals, Single Family (SF) advertising is one of our biggest growth opportunities. Zillow already reaches most of the single-family rental market, but we have a big opportunity to help these listings even more. In 2027 we’re relaunching our SF advertising products to that opportuntiy, and we’re building the marketing program to help that relaunch land.

About the role

Zillow Rentals is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Specialist to own marketing for our Single Family (SF) advertising products, the paid advertising products that help single-family rental owners and property managers fill vacancies faster on Zillow.


This role will shape product-market fit for our SF advertising products, along with how they are positioned and brought to market for business audiences, from mid-market property management companies to large institutional owners. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, Data Science, Research, Comms, and Marketing, you’ll translate customer insights and performance data into clear value propositions and proof of value.


As the first dedicated marketer for SF advertising, you’ll run the program end to end, from positioning and launch planning to hands-on execution in sales enablement, email, web, and industry events, while partnering with shared Comms, Brand, Media, and Web teams. This role is ideal for a product marketer who likes building from the ground up, brings structure to ambiguity, and wants real ownership of business outcomes. It requires strong writing skills, structured thinking, and the ability to simultaneously manage many cross-functional initiatives in a fast-moving environment.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


SHARPEN PMF, DEFINE CVPs


  • Bring customer and market insights back to Product to sharpen product-market fit and guide roadmap priorities, pricing, and packaging decisions
  • Translate insights into clear Customer Value Propositions (CVPs), messaging frameworks, claims, and competitive positioning for SF advertising products
  • Partner with Product, Research, and Data Science to build proof of performance (e.g., paid vs. free results, ROI, and lead-to-lease outcomes) that customers can see in their own data

LEAD GO-TO-MARKET EXECUTION


  • Own go-to-market strategy and launch planning for 2027 SF advertising products, including a new tiered lineup and self-serve checkout
  • Lead the campaign that migrates existing customers onto the new products, plus win-back and nurture programs for inactive and prospective customers
  • Ensure messaging consistency across product surfaces, web, marketing campaigns, sales materials, and customer communications
  • Manage timelines, stakeholders, and dependencies to deliver coordinated launches

ENABLE SALES AND DRIVE ALIGNMENT


  • Build and maintain sales enablement yourself: talk tracks, one-pagers, objection handling, case studies, and ROI stories
  • Support enterprise renewal and mid-market sales plays, and run the feedback loop with Sales on customer needs and objections
  • Serve as the connective tissue between Sales and the rest of the org, bringing Voice of Sales insights into product roadmap and campaign plans

RUN THE MARKETING PROGRAM


  • Plan lifecycle email (onboarding, migration, nurture, partner newsletter), web content and testing, and paid demand generation, working with shared partners as applicable
  • Own the SF presence at industry events and conferences, and co-marketing with property management software partners
  • Measure what’s working, refine messaging based on results and market feedback, and help build the case for future marketing investment
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

CORE SKILLS


  • 5+ years of experience in B2B product marketing, or a similar strategic role in product management or consulting
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to distill complex products into clear customer value
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort turning performance data and research into proof points and insights
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage complex go-to-market programs, such as a launch, relaunch, or customer migration
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Hands-on across the marketing mix (messaging, sales enablement, email, web, and events) and comfortable building a program from the ground up

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE


  • Experience working in SaaS, advertising products, or real estate / proptech
  • Experience marketing to business buyers, including both sales-led and self-serve motions
  • Familiarity with experimentation, lifecycle marketing, or growth frameworks
  • Familiarity with property management or property management software

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.

  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?

  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkhedenEen afdeling binnen een publieke organisatie beschikt over meerdere datasets die de afgelopen jaren zijn verzameld, maar nog niet systematisch werden geanalyseerd.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Een afdeling binnen een publieke organisatie beschikt over meerdere datasets die de afgelopen jaren zijn verzameld, maar nog niet systematisch werden geanalyseerd. De opdracht omvat verschillende analysegebieden.

  • Het koolstofmonitoringsnetwerk werd in juli 2021 opgestart om de hoeveelheid koolstof in Vlaamse bodems in kaart te brengen. Gedurende tien jaar worden bodems onder alle landgebruiken bemonsterd, waaronder bodems in waterrijke gebieden, (half-)natuurlijke graslanden en bodems die door overheden, lokale besturen en burgers worden beheerd. Na twee werkjaren kunnen de eerste gegevens worden voorgesteld en verder onderzocht. De resultaten moeten op termijn bruikbaar zijn voor LULUCF-rapporteringen en prognoses, bijvoorbeeld om te onderbouwen of landbouwbodems of residentiële gebieden koolstof opslaan of verliezen.
  • In 2022 werd een methode ontwikkeld die jaarlijks automatisch een bodemafdekkingskaart genereert. De kaart combineert administratief gekende bodemafdekking met gemodelleerde bodemafdekking op basis van middenschalige winterluchtopnames. De methode legt meer verharding nauwkeuriger en frequenter vast dan voorheen. Ze moet nog worden geoptimaliseerd, onder meer omdat het model waarschijnlijk minstens jaarlijks opnieuw moet worden getraind.
  • Het ruimtegebruik in Vlaanderen wordt per hectarecel opgevolgd voor 2013, 2016, 2019 en 2022. Deze gegevens kunnen ruimtelijk worden geanalyseerd. Hoewel er de voorbije jaren veel ervaring is opgebouwd, blijft het een aandachtspunt om veranderingen te detecteren en hun statistische betrouwbaarheid te beoordelen.
  • De afgelopen zes jaar werden jaarlijks ongeveer 80.000 vergunningen ontvangen via een vergunningenloket. De basisrapportering over de aantallen vergunningen is onder controle, maar er is behoefte aan uitgebreidere analyses. Zo wordt onderzocht welke voorwerpen binnen één project geografisch bij elkaar horen, bijvoorbeeld een bemaling bij de bouw van een appartementsgebouw of de sloop en nieuwbouw van een gebouw op dezelfde locatie. Daarnaast wordt gezocht naar opvallende trends in de gegevens, zoals meer of minder aanvragen voor een bepaald type in een bepaalde periode of regio.
  • Via een studieopdracht werd met behulp van AI een eerste gebiedsdekkende veenkaart voor Vlaanderen opgesteld. De kaart heeft nog niet de gewenste nauwkeurigheid. Statistische interpolatietechnieken kunnen worden ingezet om de kwaliteit verder te verbeteren.
  • De komende jaren wordt de interne expertise voor het statistisch analyseren van datasets verder uitgebouwd. De expert voert analyses uit, licht de aanpak toe en herneemt die samen met een beperkte groep van 10 tot 20 medewerkers. Zo moeten medewerkers op termijn gelijkaardige analyses zelfstandig kunnen uitvoeren. De statistiekgeletterdheid binnen de afdeling is al versterkt. De volgende stap is om analyses verder te ontwikkelen tot publiceerbare resultaten, met meer aandacht voor grafieken en presentatie.
  • De expert ondersteunt ook bij het opzetten en uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles op gepubliceerde data en documenten en helpt bij het analyseren van datasets voor rapportering over de leefomgeving.
  • In 2025 wordt met een proefproject onderzocht hoe Natural Language Processing (NLP) kan worden ingezet voor de geautomatiseerde verwerking van vergunningsbeslissingen, in het bijzonder ongestructureerde PDF-documenten. De focus ligt op het ontwikkelen en toepassen van technieken om voorwaarden en lasten uit deze documenten te extraheren, te categoriseren en te interpreteren. Het proefproject moet een opstap vormen naar een bredere toepassing binnen de organisatie, waarbij kennisoverdracht een belangrijke pijler vormt.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je brengt de volgende kennis en ervaring mee:

  • ervaring binnen de publieke sector;
  • ervaring met het geven van opleidingen en kennisoverdracht;
  • ervaring met R en statistische softwarepakketten;
  • ervaring met de technologie in kwestie of een gelijkaardige technologie;
  • kennis van datamining en outlier detection;
  • ervaring met datavisualisatie in R Markdown;
  • ervaring met GIS-analyses en geografische data;
  • ervaring met open-sourceontwikkeling;
  • kennis van Python;
  • kennis van neurale netwerken;
  • je kunt je professioneel uitdrukken in het Nederlands.

⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (50%).

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThe Product Manager (Healthcare Payments & HSA/FSA) is a core execution role within WEX's Health & Benefits digital organization.
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Product Manager (Healthcare Payments & HSA/FSA) is a core execution role within WEX's Health & Benefits digital organization. This role is responsible for driving the delivery and continuous improvement of WEX's payment products — including HSA debit card rails, claims reimbursement flows, ACH/RTP money movement, real-time payment notifications, and spend authorization logic — that sit at the intersection of member experience and financial operations.

This PM operates with a strong bias for outcomes over output: they connect every feature decision to adoption, retention, cost-to-serve, or revenue impact. They bring domain fluency in healthcare payments and fintech, use AI-enabled workflows as a default starting point for synthesis and analysis, and are trusted partners across engineering, compliance, operations, and external payment vendors.

This role is the payments execution engine for H&B's product organization. The right candidate is someone who is equally comfortable reviewing ACH return codes and presenting trade-off recommendations to senior stakeholders — and who makes disciplined prioritization decisions with incomplete information.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

As a Product Manager for Healthcare Payments you will:

  • Execution & Outcomes-Oriented Delivery (60%): Own end-to-end execution for payment product features including HSA debit card rails, claims auto-adjudication, ACH/RTP money movement, and real-time payment notifications. Actively participate in and facilitate core Scrum ceremonies (e.g., Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Refinement, Demos, Retrospectives), stepping up to lead ceremonies as needed. Drive short-term delivery with a bias for speed, iterating quickly based on stakeholder feedback and outcome data. Ensure delivery choices connect directly to adoption, revenue, and operational efficiency targets.

  • Discovery & Strategy Support (15%): Lead discovery for payments-specific product problems — including spend authorization flows, payment partner integrations, and compliance-adjacent money movement constraints. Synthesize customer insight, payment industry signals, and competitive intelligence into testable hypotheses. Use AI-enabled research tools to accelerate synthesis while maintaining rigorous human judgment on conclusions.

  • Insights-Driven Decision Making (10%):Navigate payment-specific metrics including authorization rates, decline rates, transaction error rates, auto-adjudication throughput, and cost-per-transaction. Use both qualitative and quantitative inputs to drive prioritization decisions. Cross-check AI-generated analysis against source data and apply appropriate rigor based on decision reversibility and risk.

  • Collaboration & Trusted Partnership (10%):Drive effective communication with engineering, compliance, finance, operations, and external payment partners (card networks, ACH processors, custodians). Clarify decision ownership, proactively resolve impediments, and ensure no ambiguity turns into delivery drift. Understand the H&B payment strategy and contribute grounded ideas on sequencing and trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession & Learning (5%): Identify friction in the member payment experience — from card declines and reimbursement delays to claims submission errors — and translate trends into actionable product improvements. Participate in customer empathy sessions with employers, members, and brokers. Apply a test-and-learn approach to validate payment UX hypotheses before full build.

Your Skillset:

  • Payments Domain Expertise: Working knowledge of healthcare payment ecosystems: HSA/FSA/HRA debit card rails (Visa/Mastercard), ACH, RTP/FedNow, and claims reimbursement workflows. Familiarity with payment compliance constraints: IRS 213(d) substantiation rules, IIAS, Reg E, and AML/KYC implications for benefits accounts. Understanding of payment partner ecosystem: card processors, custodial bank partners, clearinghouses, and third-party payment APIs.

  • Product Execution: Ability to own end-to-end delivery for complex, dependency-heavy payment features across experience, technology, compliance, and operations.Strong prioritization discipline — can distinguish important from urgent, articulate feature trade-offs in business terms, and make bounded calls without full consensus.Comfortable operating with incomplete data; explicit about confidence levels, risk, and what still needs validation. Demonstrated track record in Agile product delivery, with hands-on experience participating in and leading team Scrum ceremonies.

  • Discovery & Customer Empathy:Experience leading discovery for payment-adjacent product problems, translating member and employer pain points into testable hypotheses. Participates in direct customer research; understands the 'why' behind payment friction — not just what members click but what prevents them from completing transactions or claiming reimbursements. AI-Native Execution: Uses AI as a default starting point for research synthesis, competitive analysis, and requirements drafting — while maintaining human accountability for judgment, risk framing, and final product decisions. Able to design AI-assisted workflows that remove manual steps without simply layering tools on top of existing habits.

  • Commercial Instinct & Systems Thinking: Connects roadmap decisions to adoption, efficiency, and revenue/retention impact — not just feature completeness.Understands how payment product choices affect cost-to-serve, operational load, error rates, and member financial outcomes.

  • Collaboration & Influence: Establishes clear decision ownership; keeps cross-functional teams aligned without requiring universal consensus before moving.Communicates clearly to engineering, compliance, finance, and operations partners; adapts narrative for technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in business, technology, computer science, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in product management roles with direct ownership of feature delivery.

  • Demonstrated experience in fintech, healthcare payments, or consumer financial products — with hands-on knowledge of payment rails, money movement, or benefits account platforms.

  • Proven ability to translate customer and operational insights into testable hypotheses and ship short-to-medium-term product outcomes.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, compliance, operations, and external vendor partners.

  • Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative analysis; ability to navigate data dashboards and make decisions with imperfect information.

  • Prior experience at a health benefits administrator, HSA/FSA/HRA platform, or fintech company

  • Familiarity with IRS substantiation requirements (IIAS, 213(d)), Reg E, and AML/KYC frameworks in a benefits payment context.

  • Experience with real-time payment (RTP/FedNow) or ACH product development.

  • Working knowledge of claims adjudication logic or auto-adjudication workflows.

  • Experience designing AI-assisted product workflows — using LLMs or agents to accelerate research, synthesis, or insight generation.

  • MBA or equivalent graduate education in business, technology, or health systems.

What will give you an edge:

Drawing from WEX's Digital Competencies 3.0 framework, the Payments PM at level III demonstrates:

  • Scope: Owns outcomes for a defined set of payment features. Independently connects digital work to customer value, operational realities, and business objectives — not just shipping features on time.

  • Discovery: Independently leads discovery by synthesizing customer insights, generating hypotheses, and designing lightweight experiments. Connects opportunity spaces to revenue levers and cost-to-serve implications, not just roadmap slots.

  • Decision Quality: Makes timely calls by combining data, model outputs, and frontline context. Explicit about confidence levels and what still needs validation before proceeding.

  • AI-Native Execution: Uses AI as the first pass for repeatable work — drafting, synthesis, competitive research — while keeping human accountability for judgment, escalation, and risk decisions.

  • Commercial Instinct: Connects every initiative to customer value, revenue, margin, retention, or operating efficiency. Frames payment features in terms of business outcomes, not just technical requirements.

  • Systems Thinking: Understands how payment product choices ripple through downstream operations, compliance obligations, member experience, and financial performance.

Travel Requirements:

  • Travel %: 5%

  • Overnight Travel %: 5%

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $89,800.00 - $120,400.00

jobs.excerpt: 🧬 About us We’re iubenda, the team turning compliance into a growth engine.
jobs.description:
🧬 About us

We’re iubenda, the team turning compliance into a growth engine. We help over 110K businesses all around the world build trust, boost performance, and grow without limits. Now part of team.blue ( we’re scaling privacy tech with confidence, creativity, and a little bit of attitude. Join a team that moves fast, thinks big, and makes privacy feel exciting again!


🎯 Mission & Core Purpose

As a Pricing & Monetization Expert, you'll be the person behind the logic of how iubenda makes money. You'll dig into usage and revenue data to find where we leave value on the table, from price increases on the existing base and country- and currency-based pricing to new segments, packaging and add-ons. You'll model the impact (churn, revenue uplift, timing) and own the recommendation and the revenue result.

You'll be hands-on from day one: designing and analysing pricing experiments, building forecasts, and working side by side with our BI team and the Growth team. We operate in a mature, competitive market rather than a hypergrowth one, so every gain comes from smart, evidence-based decisions.

You'll report to Raffaele Negro, VP of Growth, who leads all self-serve growth at iubenda.


💼 Key Responsibilities

Pricing & packaging

  • Own the pricing and packaging strategy across iubenda products: price increases on long-standing customers still on legacy pricing, country- and currency-based pricing, and new customer segments, with the option of different structures or products for specific customer clusters.

  • Generate your own hypotheses from usage and revenue data, and bring them to the VP of Growth with a clear business case.

  • Define pricing and packaging for new product launches and new markets.

  • Own the free-to-paid upgrade path from a pricing and packaging perspective.

Modeling & forecasting

  • Model the impact of every change before it ships: expected churn, revenue uplift and timing (for example, how many existing customers we expect to lose if we raise prices in a given country).

  • Build and maintain revenue forecasts, so we know when new revenue will land, and track them against actuals.

  • Combine product usage data with financial revenue data, together with the BI team.

Pricing experimentation

  • Design, run and analyse pricing and conversion experiments (price points, plans, paywalls, upgrade prompts), with statistical rigor.

  • Align with the CRO/Growth team on any test that touches the website or product surfaces.

  • Decide whether to ship, stop, or iterate based on the results.

Add-on & expansion monetization

  • Define which add-ons and upgrades to offer to which segments of the existing paid base, and when, based on usage signals and account maturity.

  • Work with the marketing teams that execute campaigns, so the logic behind every offer comes from you.

  • Track add-on attach rate and expansion MRR, and adjust priorities accordingly.

💡Experience & Skills

Must haves

  • At least 3-5 years in pricing, monetization or revenue growth at a subscription business (SaaS or digital subscriptions). E-commerce experience alone is not ideal.

  • Hands-on experience personally running pricing or conversion experiments (A/B tests), backed by a solid statistical background.

  • Strong modeling and forecasting skills: you can estimate the impact of a change, such as expected churn from a price increase, before it ships.

  • A track record of originating pricing or packaging changes, building the business case and driving them to measurable revenue impact, not just executing plans designed by others.

  • Experience with multi-currency and multi-country pricing.

  • Daily, hands-on work with data: advanced Excel and a BI tool such as Power BI or Looker Studio.

  • Comfort using AI tools in your daily workflow.

  • A clear, concise communicator who builds arguments with data and works well alongside BI and CRO colleagues.

  • Full proficiency in English.

Nice to haves

  • Background in legal tech, privacy or a direct competitor, or in companies that grew fast through pricing changes.

  • Pricing work for a country or product launch.

  • Success in a mature, competitive market rather than hypergrowth.

  • Experience with SQL/BigQuery, Stripe or Adobe Analytics.

  • CRO and product-led growth knowledge.

👤 How you'll work with others

You are the person who decides what to do about the data, not the person who executes someone else's plan.

  • VP of Growth: you bring ideas, models, and recommendations, and agree the way forward together.

  • BI team: a small team analysing product usage data, which you'll combine with financial revenue data. You work with them day to day.

  • Growth: you brief them on tests that touch the website or product surfaces, and a CRO background on your side helps you connect pricing changes to conversion effects.

  • Product and Marketing: you shape what gets built and promoted around pricing, packaging, and add-ons.

➕ What Success Looks Like

In your first three months you are working autonomously, with a clear view of where we stand and your first initiatives in motion.

  • Month 1: onboarding, learning the products, customers, pricing history and data.

  • Months 2-3: a clear snapshot of the current monetization status, your first initiatives and campaigns in place, and a plan for what to test and build next. Results are a bonus at this stage; autonomy and direction are the goal.

Ongoing KPIs

  • Free-to-paid conversion rate, tracked monthly.

  • Add-on attach rate and expansion MRR from the existing paid base.

  • A live, prioritized backlog of monetization initiatives that you originated, beyond what others hand over.


🌐 Location

We're a remote-first company. You can work from wherever you're most productive in the world.
For those based in Italy or nearby, if you enjoy a mix of remote and in-person work, you can also take advantage of our offices in Milan and Bologna.
For those based in Mauritius, while you can work from anywhere on the island, we encourage regular in-person collaboration at our Port Louis office, typically once per week.
Wherever you’re based, this role involves working within a ±1 CET time frame to stay closely aligned with the rest of the team and make collaboration easy.


🎁 Benefits

  • Remote work🌴 Work 100% remotely, or from our offices, whatever works best for you. We're fully structured for seamless remote onboarding and collaboration (forthose based in Mauritius,we expect weekly in-person collaboration).

  • Company retreats🏔️ Once a year, we hold fully paid, week-long retreats in beautiful locations such as Venice, Athens, and Palermo, where we work, connect, and recharge together.

  • All-in-One flex budget 💳 A yearly sum of up to 1,000€ that you can tailor to your personal needs, whether it’s private health coverage, meal vouchers, childcare, learning, fitness, or other lifestyle choices. You can invest in what matters most to you (total amount, availability of specific services, payment method, and taxability may vary depending on local regulations).

  • Work equipment supply scheme💻 A policy designed to help you create the perfect setup and perform at your best.

  • Collaborative, multicultural team🧩Join a team of talented, international colleagues in a friendly, open, and highly collaborative environment.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Storage
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreSolana is the leading high-performance network powering internet capital markets, payments, and crypto applications, built to become the capital market for every asset on earth.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Solana is the leading high-performance network powering internet capital markets, payments, and crypto applications, built to become the capital market for every asset on earth. Anza is the core engineering team behind it. Founded by the engineers who built the original Solana validator client at Solana Labs, we develop Agave, the network’s primary and most widely run validator client, and ship the software that pushes the boundaries of blockchain performance and scale.

We advance the frontier of Solana’s core protocol. Most recently, Anza built and shipped Alpenglow, the biggest upgrade in Solana’s history, replacing the network’s original consensus protocol and bringing deterministic finality in about 150ms to mainnet-beta. And we’re just getting started, with work underway on faster block propagation, quicker leader handoffs, and the infrastructure that will carry Solana’s next phase of growth.

The Role

As a Software Engineer specializing in storage, you will play a critical role in fortifying Anza’s Agave client and the broader Solana network. The AccountsDB team owns the custom storage engine at the heart of every Solana validator. Every account on Solana, from balances to program state to token holdings, lives in AccountsDB, and every transaction the network processes reads from and writes to it.

Your work will directly contribute to the performance and reliability of our blockchain infrastructure, ensuring account state is stored, indexed, and served efficiently as the network grows.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Develop and Optimize the Storage Engine: Design, implement, and optimize AccountsDB’s core storage paths, including account file layout, the account index, and the read and write caching layers, to improve throughput and latency across the validator.
  • Reduce Resource Footprint: Lower memory and disk requirements as account state continues to grow, to keep validator hardware requirements in check.
  • Background Services: Improve the flushing, cleaning, shrinking, and purging processes to reduce write amplification and keep resource usage predictable under sustained load.
  • Snapshots and Startup: Optimize snapshot generation, loading, and index generation to shorten validator startup and catch-up times.
  • Correctness and Integrity: Ensure account state remains correct across forks, rooting, and crash recovery, where bugs can have network-wide consequences.
  • Testing and Validation: Create and execute comprehensive tests to validate the reliability and efficiency of the storage engine, including stress tests, fault injection, and performance benchmarking.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including runtime, block production, and core protocol engineers, as well as other Solana client teams, to ensure seamless integration of storage components across the validator.
  • Documentation and Code Review: Maintain thorough documentation of AccountsDB design and behavior and conduct peer code reviews to uphold high standards of code quality and consistency.

What You'll Bring

  • Systems Engineering Background: Bachelor’s degree in CS, Engineering, or relevant practical experience, alongside 3+ years architecting data stores, file systems, databases, or high-throughput storage systems.
  • Systems Languages & Storage Architecture: Mastery of Rust, C, or C++. Comprehensive grasp of low-level storage mechanics, including memory-mapped files, page caching, index structures, on-disk formats, and garbage collection mechanisms.
  • I/O Subsystems: Advanced knowledge of kernel-level and hardware I/O pipelines, NVMe constraints, buffered versus direct I/O, and modern async interfaces like io_uring.
  • Kernel & Memory Management: Strong understanding of custom memory allocators and Linux kernel scheduling, page management, and I/O handling under intense throughput.
  • Concurrent Programming: Proven experience building concurrent systems, featuring deep knowledge of lock overhead, lock-free structures, and hardware memory models.
  • Profiling and Optimization: Track record of profiling and tuning low-level code with an emphasis on hardware mechanics, memory bus saturation, and CPU cache efficiency.
  • Systemic Problem Solving: Ability to debug intricate software architectures, isolate performance bottlenecks, and execute robust engineering solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills and a team-first mindset for working alongside technical peers in an open environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LSM trees, B-trees, or hash-based storage engines such as RocksDB, LevelDB, or WiredTiger.
  • Background in versioned or multi-version data stores, snapshotting systems, or blockchain state storage.
  • Familiarity with Linux, systems automation tools, and systems architecture.
  • Active participation in Bitcoin/Ethereum/Blockchain projects or the open-source community is highly desirable.

Benefits

Why Join Anza?

We offer a dynamic, fast-paced environment where innovation and problem-solving are at the heart of everything we do. Here, your work will have a direct impact on the security and scalability of blockchain technology, contributing to the foundation of decentralized applications worldwide.

We're excited to welcome individuals who share our passion for pushing the boundaries of blockchain technology. If you're ready to take on the challenge and contribute to the next generation of blockchain infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a Site Activation Leader (Study Start-Up Lead, Site Start-Up Lead) to join our team working remotely.

As a Site Activation Leader, you will provide expert planning and functional oversight for clinical trial programs and individual studies, driving operational excellence and the on-time, high-quality initiation of clinical research sites. You will lead site activation activities from feasibility through activation, coordinate the study critical path, and help enable efficient study conduct and enrollment across multiple studies and therapeutic areas.

You will join a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where your leadership will connect project management, site start-up teams, clinical operations, clients, and investigative sites. Through strategic planning, cross-functional coordination, process optimization, and quality oversight, you will strengthen site activation delivery and contribute directly to the successful execution of clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead site activation planning and strategy development for assigned clinical studies, overseeing milestones and deliverables from site feasibility through last site activation.
  • Develop, coordinate, and execute the study critical path plan, including site feasibility, site selection, Regulatory Green Light, site initiation, site activation, system setup, Trial Master File and Expected Document List management, ethics committee and regulatory authority or Ministry of Health strategy, informed consent form customization, risk mitigation, activation requirements, tools, documents, and reporting.
  • Monitor and report site activation progress across multiple studies, identify potential delays and risks, and lead cross-functional teams in resolving complex activation challenges.
  • Provide guidance to site activation team members and serve as a liaison among project management, site start-up teams, site activation functions, and clinical operations leadership.
  • Manage client relationships and communications regarding site activation timelines and deliverables, and serve as the Study Start-Up Subject Matter Expert for designated client accounts.
  • Provide strategic guidance, best practice recommendations, and technical expertise to support optimal study initiation and site activation outcomes.
