jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative (BBS914)
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an Outbound Sales Development Representative to drive outbound pipeline for a fast-moving B2B sales intelligence platform.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Outbound Sales Development Representative to drive outbound pipeline for a fast-moving B2B sales intelligence platform. You will prospect into SMB and mid-market accounts, conduct outbound outreach via phone, email, and LinkedIn, qualify leads, and book meetings for the sales team. You will also use AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow to research accounts, personalize outreach, and move faster than a traditional SDR.

This is a high-activity, execution-driven role with a clear playbook and defined metrics. If you are a confident communicator with strong English skills, know how to run a structured outbound motion, and use AI to work smarter rather than harder, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This is a full-time role structured as 3 weekdays plus 2 weekend days; weekend availability is a core requirement and non-negotiable
  • Weekend shifts rotate across Opener, Mid, and Closer shifts to provide 24-hour coverage; exact shift schedules are confirmed prior to start
  • Work at the front end of the pipeline for a B2B platform with strong case studies and real customer traction
  • High-ownership SDR role with direct impact on revenue and growth

What You'll Work On

Outbound Prospecting and Cold Outreach

  • Conduct high-volume outbound outreach via phone, email, and LinkedIn to target accounts
  • Research and qualify prospects using the platform's intelligence tools and AI-assisted research
  • Write clear, personalized cold outreach that generates responses without reading as spam
  • Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving toward a booked meeting

Lead Qualification and Pipeline Management

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads against defined ICP criteria
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all outreach and pipeline activity in the CRM
  • Track activity volume, response rates, and meeting conversion metrics consistently

AI-Enabled Outreach

  • Use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT daily to research accounts, draft personalized messaging, and improve outreach efficiency
  • Continuously test and refine messaging based on response data and feedback from the sales team
  • Stay current on AI tools that can improve prospecting speed and quality

Meeting Booking and Handoff

  • Book qualified meetings for the sales team with full context and qualification notes
  • Coordinate scheduling and follow-up to keep prospects engaged through the handoff
  • Ensure clean, accurate handoffs so the sales team walks into every call fully prepared

What You Bring

  • Prior SDR, outbound sales, or lead generation experience with a track record of booking meetings
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills; this is a non-negotiable requirement for a phone and email-first role
  • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT as a daily part of your workflow for research, drafting, and outreach personalization
  • Experience with CRM platforms for logging activity and managing pipeline
  • Confident phone presence with the ability to handle objections and rejection without losing momentum
  • Self-directed and disciplined with the ability to hit daily activity targets independently
  • Available to work a schedule of 3 weekdays plus 2 weekend days including both Saturday and Sunday on a rotational shift basis; this is a hard requirement

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into SMB markets including verticals such as HVAC, dental, restaurants, or similar
  • Familiarity with sales intelligence or data enrichment platforms
  • Experience with sales engagement platforms such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar
  • Background in B2B SaaS or GTM-adjacent roles

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your outbound sales experience, and walking through how you use AI tools to research a prospect and personalize your outreach before a call

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a confident communicator, know how to run a structured outbound motion, use AI to move faster and work smarter, and are available to work weekends as part of your regular schedule, this role gives you the activity and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit.
jobs.description:
Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security


At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond.


Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup’s With Distinction honor — a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures.

Remote Location Mexico

The Senior Technical Solutions Analyst- will support the core back-office application strategy across the Americas technology ecosystem supporting Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, and broader business operations. This role serves as a key technical consultant for America’s IT’s business stakeholders and ERP sustaining and support teams, translating complex operational objectives and production support requirements into practical, repeatable solutions that align with stakeholder needs, enterprise standards, and long-term platform strategy.


This individual will bring a consultative mindset, strong business partnership, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in support of the business’ priorities. This role will help create clearer direction for sustaining and support practices, improve incident-to-change discipline, evaluate the use of automation and embedded analytics, and support M&A and process harmonization related to evolving business needs.

What You Will Do:


  • Serve as a strategic technology partner to Americas back-office business unit stakeholders, translating business objectives and production support requirements into clear solution direction and actionable plans.
  • Own and help evolve the ERP sustaining and support strategy for capabilities across core modules (GL/AP/AR, Fixed Assets, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Inventory, MRP/MPS, Shop Floor), integrations, and related middleware/patches.
  • Act as a business-facing technical consultant lead for incident, problem, and change management for back-office systems, translating stakeholder needs into prioritized, executable support and enhancement solutions with clear success criteria and SLAs.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and platform delivery to identify and resolve system inefficiencies, recurring incidents, and technical debt that impact business operations, while proactively recommending scalable, future-proof remediation and stabilization approaches.
  • Establish and support intake, prioritization, and governance processes for sustaining initiatives (break/fix, defects, small enhancements, compliance fixes), ensuring transparent visibility into business value, sequencing, resource tradeoffs, and platform alignment.
  • Evaluate technology solutions, automation, and AI capabilities and advise when to use embedded ERP features vs. external/custom tools, ensuring alignment with company AI policy, security, and business value.
  • Lead proofs of concept and pilot efforts to validate new sustaining tools or automation approaches (e.g., chatbots for common transactional queries, automated reconciliations), assess business value, and reduce risk prior to broader rollout.
  • Bring discipline to execution through stakeholder analysis, testing expectations, user acceptance planning, cutover/readiness planning, and adoption/change coordination for sustaining releases and patches.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work across Platform Delivery, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, DevOps/Infrastructure, Procurement, and business process owners to reduce blind spots and delivery/downtime risk.
  • Support vendor evaluations, contract and renewal discussions, support escalations, and vendor alignment in partnership with procurement and enterprise architecture for ERP product and managed service providers.
  • Support M&A and carve-in/carve-out planning by assessing ERP impacts on processes, master data, integrations, and recommending phased, low-risk approaches aligned with business priorities.
  • Produce clear communications and executive-level reporting that connects technical tradeoffs, risks, recurring incident trends, and prioritization with business impact and recommended decisions.

What You Need to Succeed:


  • 5+ years of experience in ERP support, enterprise platforms, business solutions, product or program leadership, or related roles supporting core back-office systems and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience with major ERP platforms (Microsoft D365 F&O, Microsoft Dynamics AX2012, Oracle 11i, etc) and related integration technologies (middleware, APIs, EDI).
  • Strong understanding of business processes across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Warehouse operations and how they map to ERP configuration, master data, and integrations.
  • Proven ability to establish governance, prioritization, intake, and support practices (incident/problem/change) and bring structure to complex, fast-moving, or loosely governed workstreams.
  • Experience with production support tooling and frameworks (ServiceNow), monitoring, SLAs, on-call processes, RCA, and post-incident remediation tracking.
  • Knowledge of data concepts relevant to ERP (master data management, interfaces, data quality, reconciliation) and comfort working with SQL and data teams to investigate issues.
  • Familiarity with compliance and audit requirements (SOX, data security) and applying controls and documentation in an ERP environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior business leaders, translate technical complexity into business impact narratives, and operate effectively across matrixed teams without direct authority.
  • Strong systems thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to quickly understand new operational domains and apply technology thoughtfully to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Comfortable operating as a high-impact individual contributor initially, with the ability to mentor others and help scale the function over time.

Why Work for Us?

Allegion is a Great Place to Grow your Career if:


  • You're seeking a rewarding opportunity that allows you to truly help others. With thousands of employees and customers around the world, there’s plenty of room to make an impact. As our values state, “this is your business, run with it”.
  • You’re looking for a company that will invest in your professional development. As we grow, we want you to grow with us.

Why Patients Need You

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients.

What You Will Achieve

The Rare Disease (RD) Key Account Director (KAD) will develop market insights and understand influencers on the market and Accounts/Customers in RD Therapeutic categories. This colleague is responsible for managing Accounts and developing key C-Suite/Administrative and RD therapeutic service line leader relationships.

The RD KAD is responsible for the development and implementation of Account Plans for the assigned Accounts and will identify, develop and pull through potential partnership opportunities between Pfizer and the Accounts/Customers. Work with other Pfizer stakeholders in the identification and development of appropriate RD KAD opportunities.

Responsible for working with state, regional or district business leaders and cross-functional Pfizer specialists to ensure appropriate level of support for an Account. Additional responsibilities include segmenting and prioritizing Accounts as well as identifying key Customers within the Accounts. Key Accounts can include, but are not limited to Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), Integrated Delivery Systems (IDSs), Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), Medical Groups (MGs), Independent Physician Associations (IPAs), professional societies, HCP organizations, quality improvement organizations, and IDN specialty pharmacy (SPP) within the defined distribution network (DDN).

How You Will Achieve It

The Pfizer RD KAD role has three key focus areas: Customer Engagement, Account Management and Business and People Leadership.

Customer Engagement

  • Identify key Customers including the decision making and influencing network (within and those impacting on the Account and local health economy).
  • Maintain effective relationships with key Customer C-Suite and RD therapeutic service line leaders, administrative and decision-making roles within a prioritized Account
  • Develop effective relationships with key opinion leaders and stakeholders in local health economies.
  • Understand and seek to influence key local, regional and national healthcare issues and best practices aligned to market and key Accounts (political and advocacy organization engagements to be led by Political Affairs colleagues).
  • Manage co-execution of Project Plans (holding Customer and Pfizer accountable for plan execution).

Account Management

  • Manage a set of prioritized Accounts to achieve agreed business objectives.
  • Seek out opportunities for synergy and collaboration to achieve both Pfizer and Customer goals through active and transparent Customer/Account Planning.
  • Analyze and understand local environment, Account business, and aligned Pfizer priorities to create Account plans which identify mutually beneficial opportunities.
  • Leverage RD value propositions to create mutually beneficial business opportunities that result in action.
  • Identify, connect and communicate multiple insights from various stakeholders to develop a plan of action that is mutually beneficial to Pfizer and the customer.

Business & People Leadership

  • Partner with RD IAT to facilitate colleague understanding of local market/customer drivers.
  • Impact and influence development of KAD efforts locally, regionally or nationally by partnering with needed cross functional teams to compliantly shape efforts and deliver results.
  • Share and help scale proven practices across the region and nation.
  • Lead and support development of high functioning, x-functional team (sales, medical, marketing, HIT and IM KAD), consistent with account team model.
  • To be a local expert on healthcare reform, the evolving landscape and the organization of Accounts/Customers.
  • Lead the development of RD Account and strategic planning priorities.
  • Demonstrate a broad base of Rare Disease therapeutic category market knowledge and dynamics of healthcare which influences IDN behavior. Recognizes when and how to involve colleagues from other functional areas (IAT) to effectively build and execute strategic plans that address an issue or solve a problem.
  • Utilize organizational awareness skills and alignment of Pfizer's priorities to include appropriate Pfizer colleagues with an Account to optimize value provided to the Customer and to Pfizer.
  • Lead pull through activities in alignment with Pfizer business leader direction.
  • Effectively coordinate with cross functional teams.
  • Communicate a short-, mid- and long-term view of Pfizer business with Key Accounts, delivering ongoing opportunities for RD portfolio, aligning across all Pfizer Business Units when appropriate.
  • Provide regional marketing and strategy teams key local and Customer specific insights that they can then utilize in crafting new market specific materials.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Management and/or Account Management experience is strongly recommended.
  • Bachelor's Degree required. MBA or advanced degree in a related field preferred.
  • 5-10 years of previous pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical marketing/sales experience preferred with at least three years spent in a promoted position and/or developmental role with demonstrated leadership across peer and manager groups.
  • Rare Disease and/or Specialty Cardiovascular experience and expertise strongly preferred.
  • Product launch experience preferred.
  • Prior team management preferred.
  • Candidate expected to live in geographic area of role.

Other Job Details

Last Day to Apply: November 11, 2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. jobs.title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Group 1001is a consumer-centric, technology-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can-do culture.
jobs.description:
Group 1001is a consumer-centric, technology-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can-do culture. Group1001’s culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, communication, core business focus, risk management, and striving for outcomes. This goal extends to how we hire and onboard our most valuable assets – our employees.


Why This Role Matters:


Group 1001 is seeking a hands-on Senior Offensive Security Engineer to lead penetration testing and red team operations across our cloud, endpoint, application, and API environments. You will be the technical owner of our offensive testing program: planning and performing penetration tests, running red and purple team exercises, managing our private bug bounty program, and reducing our external attack surface.


As our application security and SDLC practices mature, you will also embed with development teams, align testing to their release cycles, and help move security testing earlier in the lifecycle. This role reports to the AVP of Security Lifecycle & Architecture and works closely with Security Architecture, Detection Engineering, Threat & Fraud Defense, and Audit. If additional headcount is approved, you will provide technical direction and mentorship to a second offensive security engineer.


How You'll Contribute:


  • Plan, scope, execute, and report on penetration tests across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments, endpoints, internal web and desktop applications, and APIs, with clear, prioritized remediation guidance.
  • Partner with development teams to learn their release schedules, plug testing into their delivery cycles, and help mature application security and SDLC practices.
  • Lead and perform quarterly red team and purple team operations that simulate real-world adversary tactics to test detection, response, and overall resilience.
  • Manage the private bug bounty program, including strategy, scope, vulnerability triage, severity validation, and coordination of remediation with internal teams.
  • Operate the enterprise continuous attack surface monitoring platform, triage external findings, and drive remediation to closure.
  • Oversee third-party testing vendors, including the annual external penetration test: define scope and objectives, review deliverables, and ensure results align with internal priorities and regulatory expectations.
  • Validate remediation through retesting and track findings to closure with application, infrastructure, and security owners.
  • Translate offensive findings into defensive improvements by working with Security Architecture, Detection Engineering, Threat & Fraud Defense, and Audit.
  • Develop and refine offensive tooling, techniques, and processes to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the program.
  • Track and report program metrics, risk reduction, and security posture improvements, and present results to technical teams and senior leadership.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, and work direction to additional offensive security team members as the team grows.

What We're Looking For:


  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, red teaming, or equivalent offensive security roles.
  • Demonstrated experience performing penetration tests against cloud environments (Azure, AWS, and/or GCP), endpoints, web and desktop/native applications, and APIs.
  • Experience conducting full-scope red team operations and purple team exercises.
  • Strong background in vulnerability triage, risk prioritization, and guiding remediation with development, infrastructure, and security teams.
  • Experience managing or significantly contributing to a bug bounty program.
  • Familiarity with continuous attack surface management platforms and external exposure reduction.
  • Solid understanding of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and modern detection and response capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings and risk to executives and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience developing custom tooling, exploits, implants, payloads, or evasion techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with commercial and open-source offensive tooling (for example Cobalt Strike, custom C2 frameworks, Burp Suite) and the ability to build or modify tools as needed.
  • Programming or scripting proficiency (Python, PowerShell, C/C++, Rust, etc.) sufficient for custom tooling or exploit development.
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSCE, GXPN, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • Experience working with or managing third-party penetration testing vendors.
  • Experience working with development teams on secure SDLC, DevSecOps, or secure code review.
  • Knowledge of detection engineering, SIEM/EDR capabilities, or blue team perspectives.
  • Prior experience in financial services, insurance, or other regulated environments (for example NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500).
  • Prior experience mentoring or leading other security engineers.

What Success Looks Like:


You are the primary owner of offensive security outcomes for Group 1001: delivering a steady, well-scoped penetration testing cadence, running a continuous testing program that reduces real-world risk and improves detection and response, and maintaining a high-quality bug bounty and attack surface management function. Development teams see you as a partner rather than a gate, and leadership gets clear, metrics-driven reporting on risk reduction.


Compensation:


Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $200,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $270,000/year plus bonus in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits Highlights:

Employees who meet benefit eligibility guidelines and work 30 hours or more weekly, have the ability to enroll in Group 1001’s benefits package. Employees (and their families) are eligible to participate in the Company’s comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plan options. Employees are also eligible for Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability. All employees (regardless of hours worked) have immediate access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program and wellness programs—no enrollment is required. Employees may also participate in the Company’s 401K plan, with matching contributions by the Company.

Group 1001, and its affiliated companies, is strongly committed to providing a supportive work environment where employee differences are valued. Diversity is an essential ingredient in making Group 1001 a welcoming place to work and is fundamental in building a high-performance team. Diversity embodies all the differences that make us unique individuals. All employees share the responsibility for maintaining a workplace culture of dignity, respect, understanding and appreciation of individual and group differences.

jobs.excerpt: Multilingual recruiting for Europe, from home, paid in euros per placement.
jobs.description:
Multilingual recruiting for Europe, from home, paid in euros per placement. Open to recruiters based in Casablanca and across Morocco.

Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.excerpt: Notre équipe de recherche et développement recherche un développeur senior pour participer au développement de la plateforme logiciel Vortex.
jobs.description:
Notre équipe de recherche et développement recherche un développeur senior pour participer au développement de la plateforme logiciel Vortex. La plateforme de Vortex Studio contribue à l'immersion de nos simulateurs de formation pour machines lourdes dans diverses industries, incluant les industries de la construction et portuaires. La plateforme Vortex Studio est aussi utilisée pour l'ingénierie et l’aérospatiale, pour la planification de missions, le prototypage virtuel, la création de contenu numérique interactif pour les véhicules, la conception de machines autonomes et de leurs modules de contrôle.

Votre parcours professionnel correspond au développement logiciel d'applications temps réel, au développement d'engins ou de simulation avec un intérêt pour l'architecture logicielle et son application dans des logiciels commerciaux.

Nous avons plusieurs postes de disponibles en dévelopement logiciel qui regroupent plusieurs champs d'expertise.

Rôle et responsabilités:

  • Joindre une équipe Agile.
  • Contribuer au développement des applications et des outils de la plateforme Vortex.
  • Collaborer au sein d'un groupe multidisciplinaire de programmeurs, d'ingénieurs mécanique, de concepteurs de niveaux et de spécialistes en assurances qualités.
  • Développer des fonctionnalités dans certains de ces champs de compétence:
  • Créer et améliorer les outils de création de contenu for CM-Labs simulators.
  • Intégration avec d'autres logiciels, tels que Unity Engine.
  • Investiguer et analyser la performance de nos unités de simulations e.g câbles, sol déformable, vehicules, scripts, etc...
  • Contribuer à résoudre des problèmes rapportés par nos usagers.
  • Communication inter-processus pour simulation distribuée, déboguage à distance et notre plateforme infonuagique.
  • Installation, activation de licences, et déploiements de logiciels et de contenu de simulation.
  • Architecture générale de la plateforme et du SDK.
  • Intégration de composants matériels, tels que des contrôleurs (USB, CANopen) et de plateformes de mouvement (D-Box).
  • Participer au processus de développement
  • Déterminer la portée et estimer les tâches avec l'équipe.
  • Proposer, discuter et réviser des conceptions avec l'équipe.
  • Coacher les développeurs juniors aux bonnes pratiques.
  • Programmer les fonctionnalités et les tests associés
  • Passez en revue vos propres modifications de code et celles d'autres développeurs.
  • Fournir la documentation de l'utilisateur final.

Job Description:

Our software R&D team is looking for a Senior Software Developer to join us. The individual will be responsible for working on the continuous development of our Vortex software platform. The Vortex platform is used to develop simulators for training operators and mission planning in different domains such as heavy equipment for construction, ports, and mining, as well as robots, remotely operated vehicles, submarines, and more. The platform is used for our own immersive training simulators as well as by external customers.

Your professional background is from software development of real-time applications, games, or simulation engine development, with an interest in software architectural patterns and designs.

We have multiple openings available in software development that regroup several fields of expertise.

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Join a team of agile developers
  • Contribute to the development of Vortex Platform's applications and tools.
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional group of software developers, mechanical engineers, level designers, and QA specialists
  • Implement features related to:
  • Creating and improving tools of content creation for CM-Labs Simulators
  • Integration of 3rd parties software, such as Unity engine.
  • Investigating and analyzing the performance of our simulation units: cables, deformable soil, vehicles, scripts, etc...
  • Contributing to solving user-reported issues.
  • Inter-processes communication for distributed simulation, remote debugging, and with our Cloud platform.
  • Installation, licensing, and deployment of software and content packages.
  • The overall architecture of the platform and SDK.
  • Integration of 3rd parties hardware, such as controls (USB, CANopen) and motion platforms (D-Box).
  • Participate in the whole pipeline of feature development:
  • Scope and estimate tasks with the team.
  • Propose, discuss, and review designs with the team.
  • Coach junior developers to good practices.
  • Code features and related tests.
  • Review your own code changes and those of other developers with pull requests.
  • Provide end-user documentation.
  • BAC en informatique ou en génie logiciel ou expérience équivalente
  • 7+ ans d'expérience dans le développement logiciel C++ pour applications commerciales
  • Expert dans le language C++ et la programmation orientée objet.
  • Connaissance approfondie de la conception d'applications et de l'architecture de logiciels.
  • Compréhension des principes d'assurance qualité des logiciels.
  • Fort sens des responsabilités et de l'engagement.

The Director leads governance of complex global opportunities, oversees Project Support and Delivery, the Field Management Response Team, the Project Management Unit, Contracts, and the World Bank Support Unit, and promotes responsible growth through strong portfolio performance, risk management, learning, and engagement with donors and multilateral development banks.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Management

Global Portfolio Stewardship, Award Compliance, Finance, and Risk

Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Money team, you own backend services behind customer accounts and money movement from design to production: ledger and balances, transfers and payments, bank integrations, interest and statements, and daily processing. You design for exactness, auditability and security first, make sound decisions under real traffic, and mentor engineers around you.

  • Design, build and run scalable, secure backend services and APIs for accounts, balances, transfers and payments.
  • Own larger features and services end to end, including monitoring, alerting and on-call follow-up.
  • Design the ledger and balance logic: double-entry records, holds, available and ledger balances, reversals and complete audit trails.
  • Design every money flow for correctness: idempotent requests, clear transaction states, safe retries and handling of unknown results from banks.
  • Integrate with banks and payment networks, and make those integrations resilient to timeouts, delays, cut-off times and duplicate or out-of-order messages.
  • Build and improve reconciliation, settlement and end-of-day batch processing, and drive root-cause fixes for every mismatch.
  • Build risk controls such as transaction limits, velocity checks and fraud rules, with Risk and Compliance.
  • Keep services fast and stable during busy periods, such as salary days and month-end, and plan capacity ahead of known peaks.
  • Lead design reviews and give thoughtful code reviews.
  • Investigate production incidents, run root cause analysis and ship lasting fixes.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and share knowledge within the team.
  • Work with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Security to turn requirements into reliable solutions.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of professional backend engineering, with a track record of owning production services that handle money or other critical transactions.
  • Languages: Strong in Java, Go or another modern backend language.
  • System Design: Solid understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven design, distributed transactions, and reliability and observability practices.
  • Data & Messaging: Hands-on with relational databases (transactions, locking, query tuning), caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka).
  • Banking Domain: Working knowledge of ledgers, payment networks, bank integrations and reconciliation, or strong experience in comparable payment or e-wallet systems.
  • Infrastructure: Experience running services on cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), with containers and CI/CD.
  • Mindset & Domain: Ownership mindset and clear communication. Experience in banking, payments, e-wallets or another regulated financial environment is a strong plus.

Benefits

  • Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
  • Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
  • Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks

jobs.title: Оператор вихідної лінії контактного центру банку
jobs.excerpt: Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом.
jobs.description:
Райффайзен Банк — найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.

У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 


Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

  • Здійснювати продаж банківських продуктів існуючим та новим клієнтам банку

Твій досвід та навички: 

  • Вільно володієш українською мовою
  • Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером
  • Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла
  • Готовий до роботи у напрямку телефонних продажів
  • Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації
  • Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми
  • Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді
  • Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

  • Конкурентна заробітна плата: гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.
  • Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.
  • Комфортні умови праці: віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
    (засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)
    Графік роботи роботи пн-пт з 9:00 до 18:00
    Є можливість працювати по 4\6 годин на день.
  • Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.
  • Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.
  • Крута команда: наші колеги – це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.
  • Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.
  • Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

    • Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 
    • Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC
    • Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 
    • Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 
    • Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

    • Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів  
    • Підтримуємо принципи різноманіття, рівності та інклюзивності.
    • Ми відкриті до найму ветеранів і людей з інвалідністю та готові адаптувати робоче середовище під ваші особливі потреби
    • Співпрацюємо зі студентами та людьми старшого віку, створюючи умови для зростання на будь-якому етапі кар’єри.

В Райфі ти маєш значення! 

Бажаєш дізнатися більше? – Підписуйся на нас у соц.мережах: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn 

Твій рекрутер: Катерина Бубнова - Олександра Гіндрова -

Відгукуйтесь на вакансію, заповнюйте коротку анкету на нашому сайті і ми зв'яжемось з вами якнайшвидше!

Job Duck is seeking a highly organized, personable, and results-driven Intake Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients seeking legal representation. In this role, you will manage incoming inquiries, conduct initial intake interviews, assess prospective clients against established firm criteria, and guide qualified leads through the consultation and onboarding process. You will play an important role in creating a positive first impression while ensuring that attorneys receive accurate, well-organized information before meeting with prospective clients. The ideal candidate is empathetic, confident communicating with individuals facing stressful situations, and comfortable balancing consultative sales skills with exceptional client service. Customer Success Manager - BEAMON AI (DE/AT)

As our Customer Success Manager - BEAMON AI (DE/AT) you will operate at the intersection of law, technology, and customer enablement, with a strong focus on making complex AI-driven functionality understandable, usable, and valuable for self-serve customers.

Your role is pivotal in driving business growth, ensuring customer satisfaction, and identifying opportunities for expansion. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking, sharp, and motivated professional with a passion for technology adoption. Your responsibilities will include providing data-driven strategic insights, maintaining high operational standards, and collaboratively solving complex business problems.

This is a hands-on AI adoption role that has a strong technical component. Therefore we are looking for someone who is comfortable navigating uncertainty: you will think about adoption strategy, and ROI metrics,but also roll up your sleeves to help our customers accelerate their legal work through the power of AI. We are currently only considering candidates with near-Native proficiency in German.

Travel may be required.

THE ROLE

  • Work proactively with our customers to ensure they are successfully leveraging our products and creating business value with BEAMON AI.

  • Use analytics and feedback to maintain stakeholder engagement and customer satisfaction nurturing accounts for renewals and expansion.

  • Ensure customer retention and customer satisfaction through increased product adoption and increased usage.

  • Monitor product usage patterns to proactively identify users who are stuck or at risk of churning

  • Be hands-on in solving technical issues for your customers

  • Build relationships with assigned customers and strategically identify opportunity for growth and expansion.

  • Be the customer advocate while capturing customer feedback and collaborating with the Product team to improve our product.

  • Develop and share best practices with team members to continually improve the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of our processes.

  • Travel to meet our customers or to join or speak at international events and conferences.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

MUST HAVE

  • Native German speaker

  • Highly fluent English speaker

  • ././MBAdegree in business, law, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience/touchpoints in the legal or legal tech industry.

  • Ability to stay calm, patient, and empathetic when assisting customers.

  • You have strong communication skills to explain technical issues and resolutions to both engineering and non‑technical stakeholders.

  • You are effective at working cross‑functionally in a high‑trust environment.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

  • You leverage AI in your daily work.

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Experienced in customer support, success, or enablement in legal tech

  • Experience with rolling out AI software and stewarding AI adoption.

  • Proficiency with adoption and product analytics tools such as Userpilot or Pendo.

  • Background in conducting webinars or training sessions

  • Start-up and remote work experience

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation package: We offer competitive salary packages that reflect your skills, experience, and the impact you’ll have on our team.

  • Competitive Benefits: Along with 30 vacation days, we also offer Wellhub, JobRad, a generous Work From Home Allowance to make sure your home office has everything you need, paid parental leave & more!

  • Cutting-Edge Technology: You’ll be at the forefront of tech, working with advanced AI models, including large language models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques, gaining hands-on experience with the latest innovations.

  • High-impact role:Your contributions will directly shape BEAMON’s growth and success.

  • Collaborative and innovative team: Join a company with a strong culture of ownership, ambition, and teamwork.

  • Team Onsites:We regularly organize team off-sites at exciting destinations across Europe, where we come together to collaborate, bond, and have fun. So far we went to Portugal, Italy and Greece – stay tuned for this year’s destination!

  • Learning & Growth: You will have the opportunity to learn and grow every day, especially in AI-driven technologies, as we push the boundaries of what’s possible in automation.

ABOUT BRYTER

Our mission is to enable legal professionals to do their jobs better. We do this by combining the power of AI with the precision and control of workflows with BEAMON AI and BRYTER Workflows.

BEAMON AI supports legal professionals in their work: from drafting, summarising and research, to contract revie. BRYTER Workflows uses rule-based and AI workflows to orchestrate legal processes and document automation.

In short, we’ve built a platform that enables lawyers to get more done every day, without working longer hours.

Global brands like McDonald’s and ING Bank, and law firms like Ashurst and Linklaters, use BRYTER every day to improve efficiencies and scale their services.

BRYTER is a remote-first company with offices in New York, London and Frankfurt.

CURIOUS? PLEASE APPLY

Mobile / UI/UX Engineer

Stanbridge University | Technology & Product Engineering

Position Summary

Stanbridge University is seeking a highly capable, product-minded Mobile / UI/UX Engineer to design, develop, and enhance our growing ecosystem of student-facing digital platforms.

This mid- to senior-level position combines mobile application development, front-end engineering, and user experience design. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can translate complex workflows into intuitive, visually compelling, and functional digital experiences—and independently build the solutions they design.

The engineer will initially focus on enhancing existing digital platforms, improving usability, performance, and mobile responsiveness while helping establish a consistent, scalable user experience across the University's broader application ecosystem. The role will also contribute to the design and development of new student-facing applications and emerging digital initiatives.

As our platforms evolve, this position will play an important role in expanding our mobile capabilities, including developing native or cross-platform applications for iOS and Android. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to progressively assume greater technical ownership, including independently architecting, developing, and deploying complete mobile applications.

We are seeking a versatile builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-moving environment, embraces AI-assisted development, and takes ownership of solutions from concept through deployment.

Key Responsibilities

Mobile Application & Front-End Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive, mobile-first web applications and interfaces.
  • Contribute to the architecture, development, and deployment of student-facing mobile applications for iOS and Android.
  • Build reusable, scalable front-end components that support consistent functionality across multiple platforms.
  • Translate product requirements, wireframes, and design concepts into production-ready applications.
  • Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and usability across devices.
  • Integrate front-end applications with APIs, authentication systems, and existing backend services.

UI/UX Design & Product Experience

  • Own the design and implementation of intuitive, engaging user interfaces and experiences.
  • Develop wireframes, interactive prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity interface designs.
  • Establish and maintain shared design systems, reusable components, and visual standards.
  • Identify usability challenges and implement practical improvements based on user feedback and product requirements.
  • Ensure consistency in navigation, accessibility, responsiveness, and visual design across the University's digital platforms.
  • Balance design quality with technical feasibility, maintainability, and delivery timelines.

Product Engineering & Execution

  • Collaborate directly with engineering and product stakeholders to deliver enhancements across existing and emerging digital platforms.
  • Take ownership of assigned features from initial design through development, testing, deployment, and iteration.
  • Troubleshoot application issues, improve existing functionality, and contribute to ongoing product optimization and stability.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers and other technical teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical planning, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute as a hands-on individual engineer in a collaborative, AI-enabled development environment.

AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation

  • Leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, prototyping, debugging, and delivery.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment when evaluating, validating, and integrating AI-generated code.
  • Explore emerging technologies and development approaches that improve the student experience.
  • Help establish efficient, repeatable development practices without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.

Required Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: Clearance: Current, active SECRET clearance required Travel: CONUS and OCONUS, including contingency and austere locations Employment type: Full-time, contingent on contract award About KVGKVG LLC is an international mission support company headquartered in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, with Program Management Offices worldwide.
jobs.description:
Clearance: Current, active SECRET clearance required
Travel: CONUS and OCONUS, including contingency and austere locations
Employment type: Full-time, contingent on contract award

About KVG

KVG LLC is an international mission support company headquartered in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, with Program Management Offices worldwide. We deliver base operating and life support, expeditionary construction, logistics and commodities to U.S. military and Government customers under Navy, Air Force, Army, DLA and Department of State contract vehicles. Recent work includes ten miles of force-protection barriers on the southwest border, protective bunkers in the UAE, exercise life support in Japan and the Philippines, and bulk fuel delivery to Pine Gap, Australia.

About the role

KVG is bidding as a prime contractor on the U.S. Air Force Contract Augmentation Program VI (AFCAP VI), a multiple-award IDIQ run by the Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC) at Tyndall AFB, Florida, for rapid-response construction, services and commodities worldwide. The Alternate Program Manager is one of two key personnel named in the contract. You work alongside the Program Manager on day-to-day program execution and act as Program Manager, with full authority, whenever the PM is unavailable or when designated.

The Alternate Program Manager is identified in our proposal and signs a letter of intent before proposal submission on 1 December 2026. Employment in the role begins at contract award, currently expected in late 2027, and carries a minimum 12-month commitment from that date.

Location

Remote within the United States; Gettysburg, PA or Tyndall AFB / Panama City, FL area preferred.

What you will do

  • Act as Program Manager in the PM’s absence, with authority to commit KVG’s funds and resources to the Contracting Officer.
  • Serve as one of the primary 24-hour contacts in the 24/7 on-call rotation: one-hour callback to the Contracting Officer, binding proposals within 24 hours on urgent requirements, on site within 24 hours CONUS or 48 hours OCONUS, and the two-hour in-person or secure-VTC response at Tyndall AFB for classified taskings.
  • Manage assigned task orders across engineering, construction, services and commodities: schedule, cost, quality, subcontractors, Government property and deliverables.
  • Prepare task order proposals, Task Order Management Plans, quality control plans, mission-essential plans and modification packages.
  • Produce program reporting: FLASH reports, situation reports, monthly status and cost reports, and the Key AFCAP VI Contact Listing.
  • Supervise Site Managers and Alternate Site Managers at dispersed locations and coordinate Government, subcontractor and vendor interfaces.
  • Keep the AFCAP Management Plan components current and support compliance with security, safety, property, CTIP and vendor threat mitigation requirements.
  • Oversee deployment readiness: Tyndall AFB processing, SPOT letters of authorization, medical and immunization standards and pre-deployment training.
  • Complete the Government’s AFCAP contractor training after award.

Minimum qualifications

These are the Government’s stated criteria for the position. Each one is verified from your résumé, your experience narrative and the DoW security database, so please address each directly.

  • U.S. citizen.
  • Current, active SECRET clearance. Clearance eligibility, an expired clearance or a clearance in process does not meet this requirement.
  • Two years of program management experience within the last seven years, with demonstrated expertise in each of the following:
    • Government appropriations
    • Engineering, construction, services or commodities
    • Government acquisitions
    • Management of multiple task orders greater than $400,000 each
  • Willing to sign a letter of intent committing to the role on award and to serve in it for at least 12 months.
  • Able to deploy CONUS and OCONUS and to meet DoW contractor deployment standards (medical and dental screening, immunizations, pre-deployment training).

Preferred

  • Experience on AFCAP, LOGCAP, WEXMAC, Navy base operating support or a similar contingency IDIQ.
  • Experience with Air Force installation support (civil engineering or force support functions).
  • Experience with cost-reimbursable task orders and Government cost reporting.
  • PMP or equivalent; bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, logistics, business or a related field.
  • Experience supervising personnel at multiple sites, including OCONUS.

How to apply

Apply through this posting and include the following:

  • Resume with month and year for each position.
  • A summary of the Government contracts and task orders you managed in the last seven years: customer, scope, dollar value, locations, your role and dates.
  • Confirmation that your SECRET clearance is current and active, the agency that granted it, and a facility security officer who can verify it. Do not send a Social Security number; KVG’s security lead will collect verification details separately.

KVG LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Overview

Responsible for developing and maintaining the trusted data foundation that supports technology performance reporting, operational and risk metrics, analytics, and operational insights. This role acquires, transforms, structures, and maintains data from multiple sources to enable consistent, scalable, and automated reporting and analytical solutions. The position also designs and supports an interim analytics data repository to meet current business needs while partnering with enterprise data teams and preparing for transition to long-term enterprise data solutions.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities

System Enhancement & Data Warehouse Support

  • Evaluates, enhances, and maintains technology performance data warehouse solutions, reporting capabilities, and analytics platforms.
  • Develops and supports data structures, processes, and applications that improve access to technology performance metrics and operational insights.
  • Designs, develops, tests, and implements enhancements that align with existing system architecture and enterprise technology standards.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve solution performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability.

Data Ingestion & Source Integration

  • Develops and maintains data ingestion processes that integrate information from technology platforms, operational systems, vendor applications, and other internal and external data sources.
  • Supports source-to-target mappings, data integration requirements, and data movement processes.
  • Develops and maintains interfaces utilizing APIs, database connectivity, and file-based integrations to ensure efficient and reliable data acquisition.
  • Collaborates with business and technology stakeholders to identify new data requirements and integration opportunities.

Data Transformation & Curation

  • Develops and maintains ETL/ELT processes that transform source data into trusted analytics-ready datasets.
  • Applies business rules, data validations, standardization processes, and transformation logic to support reporting and analytical requirements.

Analytics Data Modeling

  • Supports reporting and analytics initiatives through the development of optimized data structures and reporting datasets.

Historical Data & Snapshot Management

  • Participates in special projects and meetings as needed to provide technical insight and recommendations.
  • Promotes best practices related to data management, reporting, analytics, software development, and operational support.

Data Analysis

  • Reviews specifications, coding, test plans, documentation, and implementation activities to ensure quality and alignment with business needs.

jobs.excerpt: Are you passionate about helping organizations turn complex AI security challenges into clear strategies and practical solutions?
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about helping organizations turn complex AI security challenges into clear strategies and practical solutions? At Plain Concepts, our AI Security Studios team helps organizations adopt AI securely and responsibly by defining how risks, controls and responsibilities should be managed throughout the AI lifecycle.

As an AI Security Governance Architect, you will help design and operationalize cybersecurity governance frameworks for AI, Generative AI and agentic AI, working closely with security, architecture and business teams. You will act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for AI governance, translating emerging AI risks into practical security controls, requirements, processes and architecture patterns that organizations can actually implement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve AI security governance frameworks, covering AI use case registration, risk classification, security controls, approvals, exceptions, monitoring and periodic reassessment.
  • Align AI security governance with recognized standards and regulations, including NIST AI RMF, NIST Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the EU AI Act.
  • Assess AI, GenAI and agentic AI use cases from a cybersecurity perspective, considering risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, identity and access management, excessive agent permissions, model exposure, third-party AI services, data residency and AI supply chain risks.
  • Translate AI risks into practical security controls, including security policies, technical requirements, architecture patterns, guardrails, evidence requirements, ownership and acceptance criteria.
  • Define security requirements and architecture patterns for different AI scenarios, including internal copilots, Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG systems, AI agents, ML models, vendor AI solutions and low-code/no-code AI automations.
  • Integrate AI security governance with existing security tooling and processes, including solutions such as HiddenLayer, Sentra and Zenity, as well as GRC, IAM, DLP, SIEM/SOC, cloud security, CMDB and data governance environments.
  • Define and improve AI security governance deliverables, including AI security control frameworks, use case classification models, security requirements, architecture patterns, risk acceptance processes, security review templates, KPI/KRI dashboards and maturity roadmaps.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong background in security governance, security architecture, risk management, AppSec or Cloud Security.
  • Strong understanding of AI and GenAI security risks, including LLM application security, prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, RAG security, AI agent permissions, model/API exposure, model supply chain and third-party AI services.
  • Experience designing and operationalizing security governance and control frameworks, with the ability to turn policies and risk requirements into practical controls, processes and security requirements.
  • Knowledge of AI security and governance frameworks, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and related AI risk and security standards.
  • Ability to work across security, architecture and business teams, translating complex cybersecurity risks into clear requirements and recommendations for both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to create executive-ready materials as well as detailed security and control documentation.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI governance programs, GenAI security assessments or AI Security Posture Management (AISPM).
  • Experience securing enterprise AI environments such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG solutions or AI agents.
  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture, Secure SDLC/DevSecOps, DSPM, GRC or AI-related SOC monitoring.
  • Familiarity with tools such as HiddenLayer, Sentra, Zenity, Wiz, Microsoft Purview, Defender, CSPM/CWPP, DLP or SIEM/SOAR platforms.
  • Knowledge of third-party AI risk management and security control evidence automation.
  • Understanding of privacy and AI regulatory requirements, including GDPR, DPIAs, data classification and the EU AI Act.

  • Fully remote work (optional) 🌍

Plain Concepts is a global company of over 500 people passionate about technology and innovation. Department Overview

WDTech is Walker & Dunlop’s technology organization, bringing together product, design, engineering, data, infrastructure, information security, and operations to build, operate, and protect the technology that powers our business.

You will have the opportunity to apply modern technology and AI within one of the nation’s leading commercial real estate finance and advisory services firms. W&D’s market position, deep industry expertise, client relationships, and proprietary data provide a strong foundation for solving meaningful business problems, improving how we work and serve our clients, and creating new sources of competitive advantage.

Across WDTech, we combine business context with disciplined technology practices and a high standard for security, resilience, and quality. Teams have ownership of meaningful problems and collaborate across disciplines, make thoughtful decisions, and continuously improve the products, platforms, and capabilities that move W&D forward.


The Impact You Will Have

The Senior Cloud Services Engineer, II, will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting the cloud infrastructure that powers Walker & Dunlop’s technology platform. This position will help ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of our cloud environments while enabling engineering teams to build and deliver innovative, data-driven solutions.


Working closely with Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure teams, the Senior Cloud Services Engineer, II, will help modernize and automate our cloud operations, implement infrastructure best practices, and support highly available systems that serve both internal users and external products. This role will directly impact the productivity of WDTech teams and the performance of the platforms that support collaboration, communication, monitoring, and data governance across the organization.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise collaboration, monitoring, and security platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Box, and Cisco Email Security (Ironport).
  • Manage and optimize enterprise cloud services and SaaS platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and availability for internal users and business applications.
  • Independently evaluate complex infrastructure challenges, recommend technical solutions, and implement improvements to cloud services, system performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Automate the provisioning, configuration, and management of cloud resources as required.
  • Utilize monitoring and observability solutions using tools such as SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted to ensure proactive detection of system performance issues and service disruptions.
  • Support enterprise data governance and compliance initiatives through the implementation and management of tools such as Microsoft Purview.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of complex technical incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement operational improvements to enhance system reliability and operational maturity.

Lead & Senior Data Engineers

Location: Remote United States (US work authorization required)

Job Type: Multi-month engagement, likely to extend

Openings: 4 positions, 2 Lead and 2 Senior

Start Date: Around December 1, 2026

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the Role

We are building a team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform pulls data from the many systems a hospital runs on, maps it into a shared ontology and knowledge graph, and uses it to help executives make operational decisions, act on them and measure the results.

The hardest recurring problem is getting messy enterprise data in, clean and trusted, for every new customer. You will build that: connectors and pipelines from HR, scheduling, EHR and external benchmark sources into Snowflake on Azure, mapped to the ontology and published to a Neo4j graph. You will make it repeatable, so the next customer’s data goes live in days, not months. You will work with real, sensitive client data, and you will use AI-assisted development as a normal part of how you build.

Lead vs Senior

Both levels are hands-on and write production code every week.

Lead: Owns the technical direction of a pod: its design, its standards and the order in which work gets done. Works directly with the client’s architects and data owners to agree source extracts, data contracts and acceptance criteria. Reviews other engineers’ code and designs, and is accountable for what the pod ships. You have led a small team of engineers, set technical direction and worked directly with client architects and stakeholders.

Senior: Owns significant pieces end to end, such as a source connector, a set of mappings or the reconciliation for a domain, inside the direction the Lead sets. Works independently, raises problems early and needs no day-to-day supervision.

What We're Looking For

  • You have integrated messy enterprise source systems in production, not just clean APIs. You can talk through two or three: what the source really looked like, how you handled late files, schema drift, duplicates and conflicting records, and what you would do differently.

  • Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on Snowflake. You have built and run layered pipelines (raw, cleaned, modelled) with dbt or equivalent, with mappings and rules kept as versioned code.

  • Data contracts and versioned schemas. You define what a source must send, validate it on arrival, quarantine what fails and evolve schemas without breaking what sits downstream.

  • Data quality, lineage and reconciliation as part of the build. You can prove that totals match the source, trace any number back to the record it came from, and rerun a load without duplicating data.

  • Regulated or sensitive data. You have worked under PHI/PII controls such as HIPAA: masking and tokenisation, least-privilege access, audit trails and keeping sensitive fields out of places they should not be.

Strong Plus

  • Healthcare data: HR and workforce systems such as Workday or UKG, scheduling and timekeeping, or EHRs such as Epic, Cerner or MEDITECH.

  • Mapping data into an ontology or a common data model shared across many customers.

  • Entity resolution: matching people and records across systems without a shared identifier.

  • External benchmark or reference data feeds, by data share or flat file.
