jobs.excerpt: Job Description SummaryAs part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Principal Technical Product Manager, Data & Platform owns the D&S Palantir Foundry environment and leads delivery across the technical teams that build on it and feed it.
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Principal Technical Product Manager, Data & Platform owns the D&S Palantir Foundry environment and leads delivery across the technical teams that build on it and feed it. This person will own platform health, configuration, access and security markings, and ontology development for the D&S Foundry instance and the shared demonstration environment. This person will also be the program owner for 8+ platform functions (data products, platform support, predictive models, emerging technology, user-facing applications, and fleet data), managing the dependencies between them without owning the teams directly. The role also governs Foundry resources, cost, and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) capacity, and owns the platform's access model, including enrollment of external customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role. It turns the D&S data strategy set by the Chief Technology Office (CTO) into a reliable, governed platform that the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) products and our AI roadmap run on.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

Palantir Foundry Platform Ownership

  • Own platform health. Keep the D&S Foundry instance available, performant, and correctly configured, and own the platform roadmap that keeps it that way.
  • Run the demonstration environment. Keep the shared Foundry demo environment current, stable, and ready for customer-facing and leadership demonstrations on short notice.
  • Build the ontology. Drive ontology development in step with front-end work in Workshop and Contour, so the data model and the applications on top of it evolve together.
  • Manage the Palantir roadmap. Serve as the primary vendor contact for licensing, product roadmap, support escalations, and new capability adoption.

Palantir Foundry Resource, Cost, and AIP Management

  • Govern platform resources. Oversee compute allocations, ontology volumes, and storage across every Foundry usage account, and partner with the platform teams to keep resources optimized and fully visible.
  • Own cost attribution. Monitor, analyze, and manage platform consumption and cost down to the usage account, project, and ontology level, with proactive reporting and usage controls (FinOps).
  • Manage AIP capacity. Partner with Palantir to manage AIP utilization, usage thresholds, platform limits, and spend, balancing advanced AI capability against cost containment and operational stability.
  • Security, Access Governance, and B2B Enrollment
  • Own the access model. Own the Foundry security posture: design and maintain role-based access controls (RBAC), fine-grained security roles and markings, and scalable access provisioning, so every dataset and application is visible only to the people cleared to see it.
  • Control intangible exports. Define and maintain the strategy for intangible exports (export-controlled technical data shared electronically through the platform) in partnership with Export Compliance.
  • Run customer B2B enrollment. Oversee business-to-business (B2B) onboarding, identity federation, and enrollment workflows so external customers get secure, compliant multi-tenant access.

Cross-Team Platform Delivery and Dependency Management

  • Run the platform as one program. Coordinate delivery across Data Foundry, Platform Support, Insight Engines, Future Tech Labs, Digital Service Delivery, and Fleet Data Hub Support, plus the Data Flow Engine and Cloud & Solutions Design teams in the CTO organization.
  • Own the dependencies. Map, track, and resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain a single integrated view of the platform roadmap and release plan.
  • Sequence releases. Partner with Platform Support on patch and release management for the D&S Foundry instance so changes land without disrupting users.
  • Bring models into production. Work with Insight Engines to integrate predictive models, machine learning (ML), and simulations into the platform and the applications that use them.
  • Move emerging technology to the platform. Partner with Future Tech Labs to take promising technologies from evaluation and prototype to deployed capability.

Data Products and Platform Strategy

  • Translate strategy into execution. Partner with CTO Architecture & Data to turn the D&S data strategy and technical standards into the DSCX platform roadmap.
  • Centralize critical data products. Work with Data Foundry to model, secure, and publish the data products and semantic layer that DSCX applications depend on.
  • Set the data quality bar. Define data quality, lineage, and governance tagging standards for the platform, and measure against them.
  • Build the foundation for AI. Make sure the data behind TrueChoice Defense (TCD) fleet management and supply optimization, and every AI capability on the DSCX roadmap, is defined, governed, and ready to use.
  • Platform Reliability and Compliance
  • Own the escalation path. Partner with Platform Support on Level 1 through Level 3 (L1-L3) incident resolution and own escalations that cross teams.
  • Keep the platform audit-ready. Drive Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) readiness and vulnerability remediation for the D&S Foundry instance, along with data governance and audit readiness.
  • Partner on infrastructure. Work with CTO Architecture & Data, which owns the Amazon Web Services (AWS) tech stack, the Data Flow Engine, and architecture review, so platform needs are reflected in infrastructure and data delivery decisions.

Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead without authority. Align 8+ technical teams behind one platform plan through clear priorities, transparent tradeoffs, and credible follow-through.
  • Set the platform standard. Provide principal-level leadership and mentorship across the D&S Digital Technology team for data platform management.
  • Improve continuously. Use FLIGHT DECK, the GE Aerospace lean operating model, to cut toil and shorten delivery cycles. You will need to be AI experienced and know how to use AI agents to help the platform teams deliver more.

Environment

  • The D&S Foundry instance runs on AWS infrastructure owned by CTO Architecture & Data, with data arriving through the Data Flow Engine from U.S. and international sources. The platform handles export-controlled and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) data, so access controls, security markings, and governance tagging are core to the work. The shared demo environment supports customer-facing and leadership demonstrations alongside the production instance, and external customers access the platform through B2B enrollment.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience, OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 13 years of professional experience, OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 15 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in data platform management, technical product or program management, or a related Distinct Area of Work (DAW).

Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.


Eligibility Requirement:

  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

Desired Characteristics:

Technical Expertise

  • Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry (ontology, pipelines, Workshop, Contour, security markings) or a comparable enterprise data platform (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Working fluency in data modeling, semantic layers, and data governance.
  • Experience managing consumption-based platform cost and capacity (FinOps), ideally Palantir Foundry and AIP.
  • Experience designing RBAC and identity federation (e.g. SAML, OpenID Connect, Microsoft Entra B2B) in a multi-tenant environment.
  • Experience with DevSecOps practices, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), and secure platform operations in a regulated environment.
  • Experience delivering in an Agile environment (Scrum and Kanban) alongside engineering and architecture teams.

Business Acumen

  • Breaks complex platform roadmaps into sequenced, dependency-aware delivery plans.
  • Manages a strategic software vendor across licensing, roadmap, and support.
  • Connects data quality and platform reliability to the business decisions they support (e.g. fleet readiness, supply optimization).

Leadership

  • Aligns teams they do not manage around a shared plan.
  • Explains the reasoning behind platform tradeoffs.
  • Recognizes when a process needs to change and shapes it with the CTO and platform teams.

Personal Attributes

  • Finds important patterns in seemingly unrelated technical and operational information.
  • Sustains momentum across teams through setbacks.
  • Innovates and integrates new processes that add measurable value to GE Aerospace.

Key Success Metrics:

  • Platform reliability: Foundry availability, incident resolution time against service level agreements (SLAs), and demo environment readiness.
  • Data quality: critical data product coverage, data quality scores, and governance tagging completeness.
  • Delivery velocity: cross-team dependencies delivered on time and release cadence.
  • Compliance: CMMC and vulnerability findings closed on schedule, and audit readiness.
  • Cost and capacity: platform consumption attributed by usage account, project, and ontology; spend and AIP usage within approved thresholds.
  • Access governance: access provisioning time, access reviews completed on schedule, and customer B2B enrollments completed without security findings.

Location and Travel:

Location: Cincinnati, OH (Evendale), strongly preferred. Additional eligible U.S. locations include Atlanta, GA; Livonia, MI; and Niskayuna, NY.

Travel: up to 10% for vendor engagement, cross-team planning, and leadership demonstrations.


Note:

The base pay range for this position is $152,000 to $222,000 annually. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 13th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.

jobs.excerpt: About UsSeismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue.
jobs.description:
About Us

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of product management experience building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
  • An AI-forward way of working. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
  • A business owner's mindset. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
  • Technical fluency. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
  • A strong point of view, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
  • Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
  • You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
  • You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
  • Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
  • Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
  • Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.

Job Description

SUMMARY: The Data Science Specialist, Audit & Compliance Analytics supports Compliance, Funding Compliance, Internal Audit, and SOX by applying data analytics to audit, testing, monitoring, and risk management activities. This role combines audit and internal control knowledge with technical data skills to improve the efficiency, consistency, and depth of assurance activities across the organization.


The ideal candidate has experience in external audit, Internal Audit, SOX, risk advisory, compliance testing, or a similar assurance function, with a strong interest in using data and technology to enhance traditional testing and monitoring approaches. Big 4 public accounting or professional services experience is strongly preferred.


The role will analyze large and complex datasets, develop repeatable testing routines, identify exceptions and potential risks, and create audit-ready documentation and reporting. The Data Specialist will also help expand the use of automation, AI, and modern analytics tools across Audit, Risk and Compliance.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

Audit, Compliance & Control Analytics

  • Apply data analytics to support Internal Audit, Compliance, SOX, operational reviews, and other assurance activities.
  • Translate audit and compliance objectives into data requirements, testing procedures, queries, and analytical routines.
  • Develop and execute data-driven testing procedures to evaluate transactions, populations, processes, and controls against defined requirements.
  • Analyze complete populations to identify trends, anomalies, exceptions, and potential control issues.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and completeness and accuracy procedures.
  • Evaluate testing results and supporting evidence and clearly document conclusions and exceptions.
  • Develop repeatable analytics that can be used for recurring testing and monitoring.
  • Identify opportunities to replace manual or sample-based testing with automated or population-based analytics.
  • Escalate significant or anomaly exceptions and data quality concerns appropriately.

Internal Audit & SOX Support

  • Support Internal Audit and SOX engagements through data analysis, population development, control testing, and exception analysis.
  • Prepare and validate populations used for audit and control testing.
  • Test key reports, system-generated data, and other information used in controls.
  • Perform data-driven procedures to assess completeness, accuracy, validity, and consistency.
  • Support testing of key controls and management review controls through data analytics.
  • Develop automated testing routines for recurring SOX and audit procedures.
  • Prepare audit-ready workpapers and supporting documentation, including data sources, queries, filters, methodology, testing steps, and results.
  • Support Internal Audit and SOX teams in identifying opportunities to increase testing coverage and improve testing efficiency.

Compliance & Privacy Monitoring

  • Support recurring compliance monitoring through data analysis, exception reporting, and automated testing.
  • Analyze access, user, and other privacy-related datasets in support of FERPA and applicable state requirements.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring routines to identify unusual activity, exceptions, or potential compliance issues.
  • Perform data testing against policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and established controls.
  • Document monitoring procedures, results, exceptions, and supporting evidence.
  • Partner with Compliance and other stakeholders to investigate and resolve data-related questions and exceptions.

Funding Compliance Analytics

  • Perform analytics supporting the accuracy and completeness of district and state funding submissions.
  • Validate enrollment, attendance, demographic, and program participation data.
  • Analyze funding-related populations to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and potential reporting issues.
  • Investigate data exceptions and discrepancies and support resolution with business and data teams.
  • Develop repeatable analytics and automated reports to strengthen funding compliance monitoring.
  • Maintain clear documentation and evidence supporting funding analyses and testing.

Data Analytics & Automation

  • Write and maintain SQL queries and Python to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Develop datasets and analytical routines that can be reused across audit and compliance activities.
  • Build dashboards, reports, and visualizations that clearly communicate testing results and areas of risk.
  • Support automation of manual testing and monitoring processes.
  • Explore the use of Python, AI, machine learning, and other emerging technologies to improve audit and compliance analytics.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, IT, GRC, and other technical teams to understand data sources, system functionality, and data limitations.
  • Maintain documentation of data sources, business rules, analytical logic, assumptions, and validation procedures.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Internal Audit, Compliance, Funding, IT, Data Engineering, GRC, and business stakeholders.
  • Translate business, audit, and compliance questions into actionable analytical requirements.
  • Communicate analytical results and testing findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Provide data and analytical support for audits, reviews, compliance assessments, and management reporting.
  • Develop strong working relationships across functions while maintaining appropriate independence and objectivity.
  • Escalate complex issues, significant exceptions, and data concerns to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics or appropriate functional leader.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.


MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in external audit, Internal Audit, SOX, risk advisory, compliance testing, or another assurance function.
  • Demonstrated understanding of internal controls, audit methodology, control testing, evidence evaluation, and audit documentation.
  • Experience using data analytics to support audit, compliance, risk, SOX, or control testing.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills and experience querying and analyzing large or complex datasets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify exceptions, trends, inconsistencies, and potential control issues.
  • Ability to translate audit or compliance requirements into data queries, testing procedures, and analytical routines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to clearly document methodology, assumptions, testing procedures, results, and supporting evidence
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, etc.); Web proficiency.
  • Ability to clear required background check

Certificates and Licenses: None required.


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience at a Big 4 accounting or professional services firm in Audit, Risk Advisory, Technology Risk, SOX, Data & Analytics, or a related practice.
  • Experience performing SOX, ITGC, operational, financial, compliance, or technology-related testing.
  • Experience using analytics to perform population-based testing or identify exceptions across large datasets.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
  • Experience with SQL and Python or other scripting languages for data analysis and automation.
  • Experience with data Snowflake, DBT, and Github
  • Experience working with enterprise systems such as ERP, HRIS, SIS, LMS, CRM, or financial systems.

  • Experience developing automated audit or compliance testing.

Job Title: Master Class - Business Consultant - Life Sciences R&D (United States)

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the Life Sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.

We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.

Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.

Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

If you’re graduating with an advanced degree, have 3-5 years of industry experience, or have served your country and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.

The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

    • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
    • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
    • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions
REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
    • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); Other non-Consulting work experience; or Veteran/Military Service
    • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
    • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
    • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
    • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
    • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team
THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
    1. You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
    2. Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
    3. The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise.
    4. Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
    5. You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Compensation

    • Starting Salary: $130,000
    • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a salary increase and be granted equity

Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (Azure)

Type: Remote Contract
Location: United States (US work authorization required)
Openings: 2 positions, including 1 Platform Lead
Start Date: Around December 1, 2026
Duration: Multi-month engagement, with potential extension

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the role

We are building a senior engineering team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform helps operations leaders understand what is happening across their workforce, make informed decisions, take action within the enterprise systems they already use, and measure the results.

We are looking for two Senior DevOps / Platform Engineers, including one Platform Lead, to design, build, secure, and operate the production infrastructure supporting this platform.

The environment will run within the client's own Azure tenant, handle regulated workforce and operational data, and support isolated production deployments for individual customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring deep Azure expertise, infrastructure as code, cloud security, and production platform ownership. You will establish the initial build environment, develop the production infrastructure, and implement the automation, security controls, observability, and disaster recovery capabilities needed to operate a reliable enterprise platform.

For the Platform Lead position, you will also own key architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and work directly with the client's architects and security teams.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain production Azure infrastructure, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep, creating reusable modules and automated provisioning processes.

  • Establish the initial build and development environments, followed by secure, production-ready infrastructure within the client's Azure tenant.

  • Design and implement isolated customer deployments, ensuring strict separation of subscriptions, networking, encryption keys, and data stores.

  • Build repeatable infrastructure deployment processes that allow new customer environments to be provisioned consistently and efficiently.

  • Implement secure identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time access, and break-glass procedures.

  • Design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using client-controlled repositories and runners, including automated testing, security scanning, approval workflows, and controlled production releases.

  • Implement cloud security controls and support enterprise security assessments, penetration testing, compliance reviews, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Build observability capabilities across customer deployments, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, and integration with enterprise SIEM platforms.

  • Design and implement resilient infrastructure, backup strategies, zone redundancy, and disaster recovery solutions, including secondary-region failover capabilities.

  • Define recovery objectives, conduct disaster recovery and performance testing, and document results and remediation actions.

  • Collaborate with application engineers, security teams, enterprise architects, and client stakeholders to ensure infrastructure meets operational, security, and performance requirements.

  • Develop operational runbooks, infrastructure documentation, and incident response procedures.

  • Participate in production on-call rotations, incident troubleshooting, and post-deployment hypercare.

  • Take ownership of infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

  • For the Platform Lead position, guide technical architecture, establish platform engineering standards, coordinate engineering activities, and represent the team in client architecture and security discussions.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • Senior Azure platform engineering experience. You have designed, built, and operated production Azure environments end to end, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. You have personally implemented infrastructure rather than only maintaining environments designed by others.

  • Infrastructure as code. Strong hands-on experience with Terraform or Bicep, including reusable infrastructure modules, automated provisioning, configuration management, and infrastructure lifecycle ownership.

  • Security and regulated environments. You have built production platforms handling PHI or similarly sensitive data and successfully supported HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable enterprise security reviews. You have participated in penetration testing, addressed security findings, and produced technical evidence for compliance assessments.

  • Identity and secrets management. Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time and break-glass access, credential rotation, and secure secrets management. You understand how to eliminate long-lived credentials from pipelines and repositories.

  • Multi-tenant infrastructure architecture. You have designed and operated customer-isolated environments with separate networking, encryption keys, and data stores. You can automate repeatable customer deployments while maintaining strict security boundaries.

  • Secure CI/CD engineering. Experience building production deployment pipelines within enterprise-controlled environments, including secure runners, environment promotion, approval workflows, container and dependency scanning, and coordinated releases across multiple deployments.

  • Disaster recovery and resilience. Hands-on experience implementing backup strategies, zone-redundant infrastructure, secondary-region recovery environments, and documented RTO/RPO objectives. You have personally executed and validated production disaster recovery or failover tests.

  • Observability and production operations. Strong experience implementing logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, security event monitoring, and performance testing. You can troubleshoot production issues, identify bottlenecks, and participate in on-call support.

  • Technical ownership and stakeholder communication. You can independently own complex infrastructure initiatives, explain architectural decisions to enterprise architects and security reviewers, and document operational procedures and technical trade-offs.

  • Strong English communication. You are fluent in written and spoken English and comfortable collaborating directly with US-based engineers, enterprise architects, security teams, and client stakeholders.

  • US location and work authorization. You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the US. Occasional domestic travel may be required.

  • Available around December 1, 2026.

Additional requirement for the Platform Lead: Previous experience leading a small platform engineering team, establishing technical standards, owning architectural decisions, and representing infrastructure designs in enterprise client discussions.

Nice-to-haves

  • Healthcare technology experience, particularly provider, payer, workforce management, or other regulated healthcare platforms.

  • Snowflake administration, including customer-specific environments, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys, replication, and failover.

  • Experience operating graph databases such as Neo4j in production, including clustering, encryption, backup, and patching.

  • Experience deploying and supporting Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, including regional data controls and infrastructure for AI applications.

  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, or equivalent security monitoring and governance tools.

  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps for production containerized workloads.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, scripting, and CI/CD engineering.

  • Experience supporting enterprise platforms with strict security, availability, and customer isolation requirements.

  • Technical interview (30 min)

We strive to move efficiently from step to step to make the recruitment process as fast as possible.

jobs.title: Freelance Recruiter – Commission Only (€400–2,400 per placement) – Pretoria
jobs.excerpt: Same time zone as Europe.  If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
Same time zone as Europe. If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Pretoria and across South Africa.

Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

  • Builds Stability: Is looking for a long-term team extension, with the option to move from part-time to full-time after the first three months based on workload and performance.
  • Includes Benefits: Health insurance (HMO) is included from day one.

You’ll get career transformation, direct visibility with the business owners, and the chance to shape how a growing MSP runs its support, without being stuck as an anonymous seat on a large helpdesk.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core first-line support role covering live phone support, email requests, user administration and routine infrastructure maintenance for clients that are mostly accounting firms and nonprofits. You aren’t just resetting passwords; you’re triaging every request against clear SLAs, keeping clients informed, escalating smartly, and turning rough notes into proper SOPs.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • Live Phone & Email Support: Handling urgent calls (helping the customer live where possible) and email requests through a structured triage flow: review within 10 minutes, resolution plan or escalation within 15 minutes, implement, inform the customer, log a timesheet.
  • SLA-Driven Resolution: Meeting acknowledgment and resolution targets across Critical (15 min / 1–1.5 hrs), Non-Critical (30 min / 2–4 hrs) and Non-Urgent (1 hr / 4–6 hrs) requests.
  • User Lifecycle Management: Onboarding and offboarding users in Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
  • Desktop, Network & Printer Troubleshooting: Resolving everyday end-user issues remotely via N-sight RMM and TeamViewer.
  • Daily Maintenance: Running server, email and Microsoft 365 maintenance checks, and raising and tracking tickets with cloud providers for affected clients.
  • Documentation & SOPs: Turning existing rough documentation into written SOPs for the most frequent request types, so a second technician could be onboarded from them.
  • Continuous Improvement: Spotting recurring issues and proposing a script, checklist or RMM automation that measurably reduces repeat problems or resolution time.

Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Are a Mid-Level Support Pro: You have solid IT support experience, ideally within an MSP or supporting multiple client environments.
  • Thrive on Live Support: You’ve handled live phone support and email ticket queues against defined SLAs, and stay composed with frustrated users.
  • Know the Microsoft Stack: You have hands-on experience with Active Directory user management, Microsoft 365 administration, and Windows server and email system maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot Methodically: You resolve desktop, network and printer issues and can clearly explain the solution. Expect real-world scenario questions in the interview.
  • Can Script and Speak Cloud: You have working knowledge of scripting (e.g. PowerShell) and foundational cloud knowledge.
  • Have Used an RMM: You’ve worked with an RMM platform (N-able N-sight preferred, comparable tools accepted) and remote-access tools such as TeamViewer.
  • Respect Access Boundaries: You work strictly within the access you’re given and handle sensitive client data with care.
  • Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, log your work consistently, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.
  • Communicate with Clarity: You explain technical issues plainly to non-technical staff by phone and in writing, and you document procedures by habit.
  • Can Commit to the Schedule: You’re self-directed and available for an early-morning shift aligned to Australian business hours.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Experience supporting accounting firms or nonprofits.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • SLAs Are Met: You’re consistently acknowledging and resolving client requests within service levels across every priority, backed by timesheet and ticket records.
  • Triage Is Second Nature: Every phone and email request follows the triage flow, and no request is left without a clear next step.
  • The Support Window Is Yours: You independently own first-line support, user on/offboarding and routine server, email and Microsoft 365 maintenance, with the founders involved only for escalations and site visits.
  • Documentation Is Built: Written SOPs cover the most frequent request types and form a library a second technician could learn from.
  • Trust Is Earned: You flag recurring issues and SLA risks before they become client problems, and you’ve proposed at least one concrete improvement to how support runs.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m a solid, reliable technician who’s great with clients and good at fixing things. I just want a team that gives me real ownership, clear SLAs, and room to grow into a bigger role.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

Stage SEO : Off Page

GreenTomatoMedia · À distance ou à Chiang Mai (Thaïlande) · 6 mois, dès que possible

Le stage

Une partie de notre stratégie SEO repose sur la publication d’articles sur des médias tiers : sites d’actu, de sport, de lifestyle, en France et à l’international. Le principe est de s’appuyer sur la puissance de ces sites pour positionner nos contenus sur des requêtes très concurrentielles dans l’iGaming.

Tu rejoins l’équipe SEO pour piloter ces publications de bout en bout, du choix du média jusqu’au suivi des positions. Tes décisions ont un impact visible dès les premières semaines.

Si tu aimes comprendre pourquoi un site ranke, écrire des contenus qui performent et voir tes articles grimper dans Google, ce stage est pour toi.

Tes missions

  • Analyser des médias pour repérer ceux qui ont le meilleur potentiel : autorité, trafic, thématique, mots-clés et pages sur lesquels ils se positionnent déjà.
  • Choisir, pour chaque média, les mots-clés qu’il a réellement les moyens de viser.
  • Analyser les SERP et les concurrents pour comprendre ce qui ranke, et construire des plans d’articles qui collent aux attentes de Google.
  • Rédiger et optimiser les articles publiés sur ces médias, en français et dans d’autres langues selon les marchés.
  • Préparer les articles pour la publication : mise en forme, tableaux, comparatifs.
  • Suivre les positions et le trafic des articles publiés, et proposer des mises à jour quand c’est nécessaire.
  • Utiliser l’IA (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex) pour aller plus vite sur l’analyse, la rédaction et les tâches répétitives. On te montrera comment on s’en sert au quotidien.

Marchés et langues

Nos publications couvrent de nombreux marchés européens et internationaux. Chaque langue que tu maîtrises est un vrai atout : précise-les dans ta candidature.

Ton profil

  • Un œil exigeant à l’écrit, quelle que soit la langue : tu sais juger si un article tient la route et le retravailler.
  • Un vrai goût pour l’analyse : tu aimes creuser les données d’un site pour comprendre ce qu’il vaut.
  • Une première approche des outils SEO (Ahrefs, Semrush ou équivalents) est un plus.
  • Un bon niveau d’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
  • De la curiosité pour l’IA : tu utilises déjà ChatGPT ou Claude, et idéalement tu as testé Claude Code ou Codex.
  • À l’aise avec l’univers de l’iGaming.
  • Autonome, organisé(e) et rapide, avec le souci du détail.

Infos pratiques

  • Lieu : à distance ou à Chiang Mai (Thaïlande)
  • Horaires : 35 h par semaine, flexibles, dont 4 heures par jour en commun avec ton manager
  • Durée : 6 mois
  • Début : dès que possible
  • Congés : 1 jour par mois
  • Rémunération : 1 000 € par mois en télétravail

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Apprendre une stratégie SEO que peu d’agences maîtrisent, sur des projets réels.
  • Travailler sur des niches parmi les plus concurrentielles du web.
  • Un suivi direct et des retours quotidiens.
  • Des méthodes de travail modernes, assistées par l’IA.
  • Une équipe sympa et une ambiance détendue.

Le processus de recrutement

  1. Candidature et entretien RH : si ton profil nous intéresse, on te propose un premier échange.
  2. Test pratique : une mise en situation proche du poste.
  3. Entretien avec le SEO Manager : on revient ensemble sur ton test, et tu rencontres la personne avec qui tu travailleras chaque jour.

Pour postuler

Envoie ton CV avec quelques lignes sur toi : les langues que tu parles, ton expérience en rédaction ou en SEO, et les outils d’IA que tu utilises.

Salary: 1000 EUR

Job Title: Rundi Interpreter

The Rundi Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Rundiand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an HCM Cloud Platform & DevOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and environment management framework supporting a major federal HCM modernization program. This program deploys Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM across multiple federal agencies and requires secure, reliable, high‑performance environments across DEV, TEST, STAGE, and PROD.

You will work within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in a FedRAMP Moderate+ boundary, build automated pipelines, maintain configuration baselines aligned to NIST SP 800‑128, and orchestrate quarterly Oracle cloud updates. Using tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, and Python, you will automate provisioning, environment replication, and disaster recovery operations. This role is ideal for engineers passionate about operating resilient and secure cloud platforms at federal scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM configuration promotion across all environments using Jenkins, Terraform, and Python.

  • Administer Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) resources in FedRAMP Moderate+ environments including compute, networking, storage, and IAM configurations.

  • Establish and maintain configuration baselines aligned with NIST SP 800‑128, ensuring deployments are fully traceable and auditable.

  • Orchestrate quarterly Oracle SaaS updates across program environments, coordinating regression testing, impact analysis, and rollback procedures.

  • Implement disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity (BC) capabilities including automated failover, backup/restore processes, and DR testing cycles.

  • Monitor performance, capacity, and availability using OCI monitoring tools, and configure automated remediation workflows to meet uptime SLAs.

  • Apply infrastructure‑as‑code practices through Terraform for provisioning, configuration management, and replicating environments consistently.

  • Enforce FIPS 140‑3 encryption requirements for all platform components; coordinate with cybersecurity engineers on key management and certificate lifecycle.

  • Manage environment refresh cycles, data masking, and sandbox provisioning to support agency onboarding and parallel deployment workstreams.

  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, and deployment procedures supporting both daily operations and ATO documentation.

  • Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, infrastructure automation, and technical debt remediation.

  • Serve as the technical authority for the platform domain, defining standards, best practices, and design direction across workstreams and Agile Release Trains.

  • Lead and mentor engineering and functional team members; foster innovation, influence cross‑functional decisions, and represent technical strategy to program leadership.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

  • Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering, DevOps engineering, or enterprise systems administration.

  • 8+ years of hands‑on experience with OCI, AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or comparable FedRAMP‑authorized cloud platforms.

  • Strong proficiency with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) and experience automating build, test, and deployment workflows.

  • Hands‑on experience with Terraform or similar IaC tools for declarative cloud infrastructure management.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or Bash for automation, deployment orchestration, and monitoring.

  • Understanding of federal compliance requirements including FIPS 140‑3, NIST 800‑53, and FedRAMP control baselines.

  • Experience with configuration baselining, change control, and release management across multi‑environment enterprise deployments.

Desired:

  • 11+ years of cloud platform or DevOps engineering experience, including work on large‑scale OCI or Oracle SaaS deployments.

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect or Operations certification.

  • Experience managing Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM environments including quarterly updates, sandboxes, and refresh cycles.

  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800‑128 and federal configuration/change control boards.

  • Experience implementing DR/BC solutions including automated failover and RPO/RTO validation.

  • Knowledge of container orchestration and microservices (Kubernetes, Docker).

  • Experience supporting federal ATO/RMF processes and providing infrastructure artifacts (SSP, POA&M, scan results).

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies such as OIC and OCI in HCM or ERP contexts.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$105,100-$231,100

We aren't just riding the recent AI wave, we have been deeply rooted in machine learning and statistical analysis for 10 years, delivering real, measurable value to a stable, loyal client base of manufacturers.

Imnoo is a leading SaaS platform built to analyze CNC parts, automate quoting and planning, and seamlessly connect the cloud with real manufacturers and shop-floor machines. We are looking for a unique hybrid—a CAD AI IoT Engineer / Tinkerer—who thrives at the intersection of software architecture and physical hardware. You won't just be writing code behind a desk; you will be the mastermind connecting our battle-tested algorithms directly to the pulse of the factory floor. If you love reverse-engineering industrial protocols, building edge data pipelines, and parsing complex 3D geometry to automate the business of manufacturing, this is your playground.

  1. The Ultimate Tinkerer’s Playground: You get to work with a dynamic mix of physical machines, Raspberry Pis/Industrial PCs, and modern cloud architectures.

  2. Drive AI in Manufacturing: Your work directly feeds the data pipelines that power our AI quoting and calculation engines, making a tangible impact on how factories operate.

  3. High Autonomy & Impact: You will be tackling unsolved problems in a fragmented industry, with the freedom to prototype, test, and deploy creative solutions.

  4. Shape the Industry: Play a critical role in a leading SaaS company that is actively transforming the contract manufacturing and CNC industry.

Requirements

  1. CAD/CAM & Geometry Parsing: Proven experience working with CAD/CAM environments and deep knowledge of CAD/CAM API integration to programmatically extract feature data and metadata.

  2. Industrial IoT Connectivity: Hands-on IoT experience, specifically focused on extracting telemetry and operational data from the shop floor.

  3. Machine Controller Mastery: Experience connecting with and pulling data from diverse CNC controllers (e.g., Heidenhain, Fanuc, Siemens) using industrial protocols (OPC UA, MTConnect, FOCAS, etc.).

  4. Core Programming: Strong coding experience in Python, C++, C#, , or similar languages to build scalable integrations, edge agents, and rapid prototypes.

  5. Edge Deployment: Solid experience using Docker to containerize applications and reliably deploy them to industrial edge devices or gateways.

  6. Ecosystem Integration: Experience connecting custom software with 3rd-party services for manufacturing, such as ERP systems, cutting tool databases, or external APIs.

Make a real difference in manufacturing

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary
The Design Principal is responsible for design decisions related to a portfolio of datacenter projects which can include: new construction, phased expansion, retrofits and upgrades, acquisition conversions, M&E equipment selections, and standards upgrades in either a specific region or globally. They are an exceptional industry professional progressing towards becoming a recognised expert on datacenter design. The Design Principal critically assesses design decisions with consultation with more senior staff across disciplines and applies required Equinix standards and country specific regulations to make the best design choices. They manage the relationship and output of key design partners and equipment suppliers for their assigned projects and critically assess and escalate issues where the relationship with such partners is not meeting expectations.

Responsibilities

The Design Principal, Engineering Development (Mechanical), reporting to the Director, Global Engineering Development, has responsibility for:

  • Global mechanical engineering direction of Equinix design through continued development of Equinix’s Reference Designs

  • Evaluation of new products and engineering approaches, supporting the Innovation incubation process, for incorporation into the Reference Design on reaching maturity

  • Supports Regional Design teams with project implementation of Reference Design

  • Provides subject matter expert direction to the Major Capital Equipment (MCE) team dealing with portfolio-wide procurement of mechanical equipment

  • Engages with key customers to ascertain their continuously evolving design requirements and directs Reference Design configurations to meet those customer design requirements

Design Process

  • Owns and leads a design process, interacting with Architectural, MEP, and other design partners to deliver a portfolio of world class datacenters with a strong focus on technical excellence, mission critical resilience and cost management

  • Reviews and contributes to the development of globally standardized tools, techniques and processes for the management and reporting of the design process

  • Works with peers in other regions to drive consistency and technical excellence on design and delivery practices and methodologies

  • Thinks and acts in a global manner, considering the applicability of any design decision, innovations or standards changes for all regions

  • Conducts the master planning of expansion portfolio using global design standards and templates; incorporating regional information to apply these to the inception of projects

  • Generates project visualization, initial model using reference design templates and cost estimate for business case inception

  • Liaises with regional team to incorporate local infrastructure into the design

  • Liaises with commercial management team regionally and globally to assist business case generation

  • Liaises with regional team to procure local variations on equipment where Reference Design equipment selections are not available

  • Prepares regional-specific and customer-specific configurations of the Reference Design, reacting to local market conditions and customer requirements

Cross-Functional Co-ordination

  • Maintains interpersonal relationships with internal technical staff, external design consulting partners, construction management, commercial management, and regional P&L holders to ensure appropriate stakeholder exposure and buy in to Data Center projects

  • Appropriately leverages the center of excellence teams and more senior Design staff to augment their individual technical expertise to ensure all facets of the datacenter design are adequately considered and approved

  • Manages internal and external resources via their influence and outstanding competencies

  • Partners with Global Operations, Global Design Standards, and other internal Equinix teams to achieve alignment on design details to support the creation of multi-discipline Reference packages

  • Partners with Procurement teams in the evaluation and selection of mechanical equipment and provides lifecycle support of selected equipment to Global Operations, applying lifecycle feedback to selection process

  • Supports xScale and Global Account Management in conversations with key customers on design requirements and keeping customers updated on Equinix’s design roadmap

Project Management

  • Indirectly manages experienced electrical and mechanical engineering staff in the Independent Technical Review to deliver a portfolio of world-class datacenter designs on time and to budget

  • Directly responsible for managing the design schedule for assigned projects to ensure on time creation and review of BODs, REIC Submissions, and design documentation for IFP and IFC sets

  • Manages, with the aid of the commercial management team, design budgets and controls change management requests during the construction phase, in consultation with the Construction Manager

  • Works hand-in-hand with the regional design teams and Construction Managers to deliver Concept Designs and Standards that support the delivery of world class datacenters

  • Manages, with the aid of the commercial management team, the costs of the designs to ensure appropriate balancing of cost flexibility and global standardization

  • Tests the cost impact of design concepts with the Commercial Management team and keeps a logical record of pricing-tested design concepts that have been discounted

  • Manages Reference Design external consultant team, providing direction on mechanical engineering

  • Manages and documents customer technical requirements, solutioning customer-specific accommodations within Reference Designs

Design Oversight

  • Stays up-to-date on advancements in design being investigated by the centers of excellence teams to ensure technologies support future Data Center design and construction needs and feeds back information to construction for incorporation of changes

  • Ensures designs meet Equinix’s Global Design Standards and the business needs for capacity, density, and function

  • Utilizes design review findings and best practices to inform Reference Design development

  • Feeds back to GDSTR team requested changes to Global Design Standards arising out of projects

  • Brings a systemic and scale-focused approach to tools and process for early stage design, identifying shortfalls or opportunities to scale and conceptually ideates tools and process development solutions

  • Owns the Mechanical discipline of the Reference Design and assists regional teams in the selection and implementation of configurations or variations

  • Owns the repository of Reference Design mechanical equipment technical submittals and the feedback loop from projects and vendors for necessary updates

Qualifications

  • 7+ years’ experience in a Design MEP Firm or in the design team of a Mission Critical Building operator or Subcontractor OR 7+ years’ experience as an Architectural lead in a Mission Critical Architectural Design Practice

  • Pan-global experience of local mechanical design/construction practice is highly desirable. The ideal candidate has experience and electrical code/regulation/law familiarity in AMER, EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Advanced Degree (Masters) in Mechanical Engineering is preferred, Bachelor's Degree acceptable or extensive and demonstrable experience in role

  • PE, CEng or local equivalent, for Engineering route candidates desirable but not essential

  • Spoken and written English proficiency is essential, additional languages are strongly desirable

  • Experience of design requirements of major customers is highly desirable

About UpSkill Universe

UpSkill Universe is a global leader in AI-driven skills transformation and inclusive workforce development. Since 2015, we’ve designed and delivered award-winning digital skills, AI fluency and workforce development programmes for over 650,000 learners worldwide, partnering with organisations including Google, Sky, Walmart, HSBC and TikTok.

We design cutting-edge, scalable learning experiences that help enterprise organisations build AI capability, digital confidence and future-ready leadership. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, human performance and business impact.

As we continue to expand across the UK, Europe, US, Sub-Saharan Africa and Asia-Pacific, we are hiring a contract based part-time Partnerships & User Acquisition Manager to play a critical role in one of our exciting upcoming projects.

About the Role

We are looking for a part-time contract based (3 months) data-driven User Acquisition and Partnerships Manager to build a scalable growth engine for our AI-focused Learning Experience Platform (LXP). Your primary objective is to drive high volumes of SMB enrolments by leveraging the reach of major membership organisations. Instead of traditional one-to-one sales, you will focus on one-to-many distribution, creating automated and repeatable marketing playbooks that turn partner networks into a consistent stream of new users.

Core Responsibilities

1. Scalable Partnership Strategy & UA

  • High-Leverage Distribution: Build and manage a "growth-first" pipeline of partners including focusing on those with the largest active SMB memberships.

  • The "Growth Playbook": Develop a repeatable onboarding and activation framework for new partners to ensure every signed partnership results in immediate and sustained user traffic.

  • Segmented Acquisition: Tailor the LXP value proposition for specific cohorts (e.g., "AI for Accountants" for ICAEW vs. "AI for Tech Scale ups" for Tech Nation) to maximise conversion rates.

2. Growth Marketing & Channel Execution

  • Automated Partner Toolkits: Design and deploy "Plug & Play" marketing assets for partners, including white-label email sequences, social media kits, and webinar templates that require minimal effort from the partner to execute.

  • Multi-Channel Campaigns: Coordinate large-scale outreach via:

    • Email Marketing: Scheduled blasts through partner-owned databases.

    • Social Proof & Engagement: Using LinkedIn, X, and business forums to drive organic viral growth within the SMB community.

    • Targeted Digital Advertising: Running performance-based ads to supplement organic partner traffic.

  • Launch & Event PR: Orchestrate "earned media" moments around programme updates or tool launches to spike registration numbers.

3. Content-Led Conversion

  • Case Study & Testimonial Engine: Systematically capture success stories from SMBs using the LXP to create "Social Proof" assets that lower the friction for new users to sign up.

  • Value-First Outreach: Lead "Taster" webinars and digital workshops that provide immediate value, using them as a high-conversion top-of-funnel entry point to the LXP.

4. Funnel Optimisation & Analytics

  • Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO): Analyse the user journey from partner referral to LXP sign-up, identifying and removing friction points in the registration process.

  • Data-Driven Reporting: Track and report on key growth metrics: Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Partner Activation Rate, and Total Active Users.

  • Feedback Loops: Use data to identify which partner types or marketing channels are driving the highest quality users and double down on those segments.

About You

  • Growth Mindset: You come from a background in User Acquisition, Growth Marketing, or Partnership Management where "success" is measured by user numbers and scale.

  • SMB Expert: You have a deep understanding of the SMB landscape and know how to cut through the noise to reach busy business owners.

  • Systems Thinker: You don't just want to do things once; you want to build a process that allows for 10x growth without 10x the manual effort.

  • Digital Native: You are comfortable with marketing automation, CRM tracking, and social media dynamics.

How to Apply

If you are excited about this role and the opportunity to drive change in the AI landscape, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV and portfolio on this job posting.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing, building, testing, and deploying applications using Angular 2+ and/or React.

  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, microservices, REST APIs, and modern software development practices.

  • Experience providing technical leadership within agile development teams.
