At Aequilibrium, we build innovative digital solutions that help organizations transform how they operate and serve their customers.

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade AKS clusters, including private cluster networking, node pool sizing and autoscaling, workload identity, ingress, certificate management, and cluster upgrade lifecycle
  • Own infrastructure as code end to end in Terraform: author and refactor reusable modules, manage per-environment workspaces and state, and drive changes through pull request, plan review, and apply
  • Design and implement advanced CI/CD pipelines ensuring quality, security, and efficiency, including container image build/publish and progressive promotion from lower environments to production

  • 5+ years of experience in a DevOps engineering role with significant Azure experience

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced skills in Terraform, or other IaC tools

  • Programming and Scripting: Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python) and proficiency with one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, C#/.NET, Node.js)
  • Containerization and Microservices: Extensive experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Helm, container registries, and microservices architectures
  • Complex Configuration Management: Expertise in configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, etc.)
  • Robust Networking: In-depth knowledge of networking concepts, Azure virtual network and subnet design, private endpoints and private DNS zones, hybrid connectivity (site-to-site VPN, network virtual appliances/firewalls), and network security
  • Data and Messaging Services: Familiarity with Azure managed data services such as SQL Managed Instance (including failover groups), Cosmos DB, Redis/managed cache, Storage, and Functions
  • Observability: Experience with Azure Monitor/Log Analytics and KQL, plus at least one third-party observability platform (Datadog, Grafana, or similar)
  • Resilience: Experience designing and testing multi-region redundancy, RTO/RPO-driven DR runbooks, and failover automation
  • Security Focus: Strong understanding of cloud security principles, penetration testing, and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Multi-cloud: ScriptCycle's footprint spans both Azure and Google Cloud, with an active workload migration track. Exposure to GCP and GKE (including Autopilot) and to cross-cloud networking and identity is a strong plus, though Azure is the primary focus of this role; experience supporting a GCP migration

jobs.title: Customer Success Representative
jobs.excerpt: About AsterisAsteris has helped veterinarians manage their diagnostic images since 2004, and we're still built by people who know veterinary medicine from the inside.
jobs.description:
About Asteris

Asteris has helped veterinarians manage their diagnostic images since 2004, and we're still built by people who know veterinary medicine from the inside. Our Keystone Software Suite helps veterinary practices, hospitals, and specialists store, view, share, and report on diagnostic images easily and securely from anywhere. Asteris is part of Valsoft Corporation, which acquires and grows vertical market software companies.

The Role

As a Client Success Representative, you'll own the experience of our veterinary clients from their first day on the platform through every renewal. You'll onboard new practices, run Quarterly Business Reviews, solve everyday product questions, keep accounts healthy, and grow them through add-on modules.

This role suits someone who knows how a veterinary clinic actually runs, enjoys teaching, and isn't afraid to pick up the phone when an account needs attention. You'll work closely with our Sales, Product, and Support teams, act as the client's voice inside Asteris, and report to Jamie Phippen, Head of Customer Success.

Why Asteris

  • Made for vets, not adapted for them. Keystone is designed specifically for veterinary practices, from companion animal clinics to equine hospitals, rather than retrofitted from human medicine.
  • Clinical and software expertise under one roof. Asteris was founded by people with deep experience in both veterinary care and software, and we still build our products around feedback from the veterinarians and technicians who use them.
  • We take care of our clients ourselves. Our support team is in-house, so clients work with people who know them and the product, never a third-party call centre.
  • Connected to the tools vets already use. Keystone integrates with leading practice management systems, including DaySmart Vet and VetlinkPRO.
  • Stable backing, room to grow. As part of Valsoft Corporation, we have long-term stability while keeping the close-knit, family-values culture we were founded on.
  • Your voice shapes the product. The feedback you bring back from clients goes directly to the Product team.

What You'll Do

Onboarding

  • Lead new clients through implementation, from kickoff to go-live
  • Train veterinarians, technicians, and key stakeholders on the platform, virtually and occasionally on site
  • Set clear success goals with each practice and track progress against them

Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)

  • Prepare and run QBRs that review usage, outcomes, and goals for the next quarter
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders, including practice owners, medical directors, and practice managers
  • Share usage insights and recommend practical next steps for each practice

Product Troubleshooting

  • Answer day-to-day product questions and resolve basic technical issues
  • Escalate complex issues to Support or Product with clear, complete information
  • Follow up until each issue is fully resolved

Account Retention

  • Monitor account health and identify at-risk clients early
  • Proactively reach out to at-risk accounts with a plan to re-engage them
  • Relay client feedback to Product and leadership to shape the roadmap
  • Keep account notes, activities, and health scores current in Salesforce

Expansion

  • Identify clients who would benefit from additional Asteris add-on modules
  • Demonstrate the key benefits of add-on modules in a way that connects to each practice's goals and workflow
  • Run product demos during QBRs, check-ins, and onsite visits
  • Partner with Sales to move expansion opportunities forward and track them in Salesforce

How Success Is Measured

You'll own a book of business and be accountable for its health and growth, tracking and reporting on:

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR): keeping and growing revenue across your accounts
  • Expansion revenue: new revenue from add-on modules and upgrades
  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT): how clients rate their experience with Asteris

You'll review these regularly with your manager and use them to prioritize where you spend your time.

Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in the veterinary industry (clinic, hospital, or veterinary-focused company)
  • Comfort training customers and explaining software to non-technical users
  • Confidence calling at-risk clients and having candid conversations about their experience
  • Willingness to travel up to 10–15% of the time, mainly to veterinary tradeshows, conferences, and occasional client sites

Nice to Have

  • Customer success, account management, or sales experience
  • Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM
  • Experience running business reviews or presenting to clinic leadership

Who You Are

  • A team player who collaborates easily with Sales, Support, and Product
  • Outgoing and comfortable building relationships with everyone from technicians to practice owners
  • A natural demonstrator who can show clients the real-world benefits of add-on modules with ease
  • Detail-oriented, keeping accurate records and following through on every commitment
  • A fast learner who picks up new software quickly and enjoys teaching it to others
  • Client-focused, treating each practice's success as your own

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Base salary, plus a performance bonus tied to NRR, expansion revenue, and CSAT targets
  • Comprehensive group benefits through Canada Life, including health, dental, vision, mental health, and paramedical coverage, plus life, AD&D, critical illness, and short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Access to a group retirement savings plan you can contribute to
  • Unlimited vacation after one year of service
  • Fully remote, work-from-home role (travel up to 10–15% to tradeshows, conferences, and client sites)
  • The chance to make a real impact on a growing team in a specialized, mission-driven industry

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Asteris uses AI-assisted tools in our recruitment process to help screen, assess, or select applicants.

Asteris is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Accommodations are available on request throughout the hiring process.

Some screening questions may result in automatic disqualification.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.title: Global Security Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Global Security Operations Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for strengthening the firm's ability to detect, investigate, respond to, and recover from cybersecurity threats across its global environment.
jobs.description:
The Global Security Operations Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for strengthening the firm's ability to detect, investigate, respond to, and recover from cybersecurity threats across its global environment.

Working as part of the Global Security operations team, the successful candidate will lead complex security investigations, develop and optimize threat detection capabilities, and implement automation to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of security operations.

The role combines hands-on incident response with proactive security engineering, helping the firm move from reactive alert management toward an increasingly automated, intelligence-led security operating model.

Operating within a geographically distributed organization, the successful candidate will work closely with global and regional technology and security teams, provide technical leadership during significant incidents, and contribute to the continuous improvement of security capabilities. Based in APAC, the role will provide critical regional coverage as part of a coordinated global security operations function.

Responsibilities

  • Advanced Investigation and Incident Response
    • Serve as a senior escalation point for security incidents, assuming ownership of complex, ambiguous, and high-severity events that exceed first-line triage capability.
    • Conduct detailed investigations to establish initial access vectors, attacker activities and objectives, scope of compromise, and dwell time, documenting findings to an appropriate evidentiary standard.
    • Perform root cause analysis on confirmed incidents and near misses, identifying underlying security control or process failures rather than simply addressing immediate symptoms.
    • Act as technical lead during significant incidents across containment, eradication, and recovery, coordinating activities across global and regional teams.
    • Conduct host and network forensics and malware triage, engaging specialist forensic providers where investigations exceed internal capabilities.
    • Translate technical findings into clear statements of business risk for leadership and drive post-incident corrective actions through to closure.
    • Investigate identity-based attacks, account compromise, unauthorized access, and suspicious activity across cloud platforms and enterprise applications, including Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.
    • Participate in an on-call rotation and provide out-of-hours escalation support during serious incidents, and undertake additional projects and activities as required.
  • Security Automation & Detection Engineering
    • Design, build, tune, and maintain detection content mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, identifying and reporting coverage gaps against threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures relevant to the firm.
    • Reduce false-positive volume and analyst alert fatigue through systematic tuning, suppression logic, and automated alert enrichment.
    • Operationalize threat intelligence by translating reporting and indicators of compromise into actionable detections, threat-hunting hypotheses, and preventive controls.
    • Design, develop, and maintain automated response playbooks, including Logic Apps, automation rules, and SOAR workflows, to reduce mean time to detect and respond.
    • Write and maintain queries, scripts, and code (KQL, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent) supporting detection, enrichment, automated triage, and reporting.
    • Integrate security tooling and data sources through APIs and connectors, including onboarding new log sources with appropriate parsing, normalization, and validation.
    • Continuously assess and improve security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities, identifying opportunities to strengthen coverage, reduce operational complexity, and improve effectiveness through automation and technology optimization.
    • Identify opportunities to apply AI-assisted investigation, alert triage, and security automation capabilities to improve detection effectiveness, reduce manual effort, and accelerate incident response.
    • Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify suspicious activity, validate detection effectiveness, and uncover threats that may evade existing security controls.

Requirements

This is a hands-on technical role requiring demonstrated depth in security operations, sound technical judgment, and the ability to work with limited supervision. We value analytical rigor, curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to share knowledge and develop others as highly as any individual technology or certification.

Compulsory Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or detection engineering, including demonstrable experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC).
  • Proven experience leading complex technical investigations end to end, from escalation through root cause analysis to documented remediation.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with modern SIEM and endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms, including authoring and optimizing detection logic, conducting investigations, and managing data onboarding.
  • Strong practical automation and scripting abilities, including KQL and at least one of PowerShell or Python, with demonstrated experience developing and operating automation in production.
  • Experience designing and maintaining automated response playbooks using Logic Apps, automation rules, or comparable SOAR capabilities.
  • Advanced knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, Cyber Kill Chain analysis, and established incident response methodologies, such as PICERL.
  • Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP and networking, Windows and Linux operating systems, Active Directory, Entra cloud identity and authentication, and security operations across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with host and network forensics, malware triage, and the analysis of malicious email headers, links, and attachments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings and security risks to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with geographically dispersed teams, with flexibility to provide out-of-hours support during significant security incidents.
  • Occasional travel to support global cybersecurity operations and incident response may be required

Preferred Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GREM, OSCP, CySA+, SC-200, AZ-500, or CISSP.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft security technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience operating within a global, federated, or shared-services model, ideally in professional services or another highly regulated sector.
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or comparable control frameworks

Benefits

Benefits are aligned with the respective location.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities or requirements.
